It feels like all the upgrades and level ups are to just feel like something happens when it just doesn't mean anything.

I like the game so far, just not a fan of the push notifications when you're trying to play. Other than that, this is a solid RPG, and you did well. And thank you for not putting the Emperor into the game as a Character to be played.

At first, it was fun... after a bit, you can't progress in the campaigns cause your characters are not strong enough, and now you need to grind them on other things that require energy and energy is slow to obtain, free players will find themselves playing 6 or 7 matches a day and that's it... This game got boring for me pretty fast.

It's a good game. Though as all the rest, too heavy on the "give me money" aspect of it. If the Devs weren't so eager to please shareholders, maybe this game would rocket to the top? But apart from that... I love how there are multiple factions, how ever... I don't see how anyone would choose another faction, as you only get the default faction in the beginning. And you'd have to level characters up from scratch, if you wanna go with another. Massive grind...

Great potential but extremely unbalanced. Some characters completely broken. Also grinding process way to slow, there's not enough energy a day to make any progress. You can buy energy for crystals, but it's not fair trade by a long shot. And p2w aspect feels too expensive to be worth it. I've spent money on gachas before, but this one feels like a rip off.

The game is pretty good, got a lot of mechanics and content to go through. However, I noticed that buying the Tau Empire Requisition, that says "Featured character shards guaranteed" and "Featuring ALL units from the Tau Empire faction. For the Greater Good!" grants you World Eaters??? when did the children of Angron join the Fire Caste? Edit: 4-stars to 2-stars. Hit something in the mission selection screen that sent me to a "demo" of another mobile game that I had to close the game flee.
Extremely well made game. Surprisingly details and varied in it's game modes. Overall a cool introduction into the grim dark future.

Great game but after a few hours it gets impossible to progress without paying. I've been stuck on the same levels for the past couple of days without means of upgrading the heroes, unless I pay up. Edit: It has changed a lot since the early days and it's now a game worth playing even as a f2p. The bundles are still mad expensive but you can do without them or with just a few (daily blackstone, battlepass).

Started crashing at about 30 minutes. Lost some of my progress, still took up my resources though. Worried that if I bought something it would crash and I'd lose my money. Game is okay, but story isn't up to the usual games workshop standard. This one feels like it's trying to fund a different project though and I do enjoy your other content. Hope the next one turns out a little better.
I meet some issues this week playing this game. It starts glitching for some reason. I woul like if this issue got solved. May be it's because of the last game update?

game is alright, gotcha game obviously, but there is like a million different in-game currency that dont really do anything except this very specific thing(like you cant buy guns with money you have to have gun coins type stuff. very annoying) My main complaint is you do not choose a faction to start with and unlocking characters of your preferred faction is not easy. But game play itself is pretty good, so if you're a whale or like the boring ultra marines, then I will recommend the game.

The battles itself are decently funny, but incredibly easy. You just shoot at everything in range, use your abilities as soon as available, and you'll will without any real risk. And then your are showered with "rewards" that have little meaning, because there are just so many of them. While the mechanics could be fun and the game looks great, you basically spend more time clicking yourself through "rewards" than actually playing.

Pretty decent Warhammer strategy game. Monetization is heavy, but so are all mobile games in this genre. At least you sort of feel you're getting some bang for the buck. My biggest gripe however is that the only real time pvp are limited time events once every couple weeks that last only a day or two. These are BY FAR the most engaging game modes and really should be a full time mode. Would create much more incentive to invest money into the game rather than 99% AI opponents. Hint hint devs...

I heard about this game when it first came out but I put it off because like most Warhammer titles that come out on mobile it's just cash grabby garbage. But I am very happy and very surprised to say that I've been playing for literally hours now because I'm addicted to it and I have not spent a single dollar. I hope this trend doesn't change because if you like RTS games I think you'll enjoy this for what it is. A simple & fun turn based tactical set in the grim darkness of the far future.

This game has some awesome elements but very serious drawbacks. It is pay to play on a disrespectful level. Spending $20 to $40 will get very little. This game couldn't sell for $10, so the idea that ppl should pay $100s or $1Ks is stupid & greedy. But if you want the top tier characters, it's necessary. They also require a different type of troop to upgrade another type of troop. Meaning even after you pay for some characters you need to buy others just to upgrade them. Edit: unbalanced as wel

I really enjoy playing it, love how it has many different characters to play and different ways to play the game, the way the combat is I think is unique and addictive (in the good way). The 2 problems I have with it is though are how expensive the upgrades can be, and how all the different game options distract you from the main campaign.

The gameplay is fun and engaging, the graphics and interface are great, and the characters have powerful and game-changing abilities. That said, the monetization is absurd, and the offers are inescapable. Still worth playing, but not worth spending a lot on. Would love to see the Death Korps of Krieg added to the game.

The gameplay is great, but, it is 100% pay to win. The best characters are almost impossible to acquire unless you are willing to spend over 80$ sometimes to just unlock them(and that was on a Christmas "special") I would recommend you avoid, game is following Games Workshops model of over pricing everything and fishing for whales. Edit: New patch coming out that makes it even harder to compete with the whales targeting the summoner units that people who aren't pay to win use to be competitive

Low...very low character progression with very limited amount of resources. Story progression can get very hard after a single mission. The worst this is Tournaments, it says that the characters are capped at certain items and levels, but 50/50 enemy players can one shot with any of their characters as they were lelevs beyond you... don't know how this works and what im doing wrong, but tournament is a complete waste of time to wait insanely long for player to make a move, just to lose first tur

It's a decent Gacha Game and fun to play puzzle type game. There is a funny part to this game though. The company actually screws themselves out of a lot of money. I would list how, but they will need to pay me. However, learn the game before dumping money because some purchases are trash. And that's all I will say! Enjoy the game!

My favorite mobile game of all time, hands down. No purchases necessary, and it's great for casual and hardcore gamers alike! I can just play the campaigns and enjoy them leisurely, or I can really dive deep into stats and the meta and optimizing a perfect kill team. Beautiful game, through and through. Can't recommend it enough, especially for gtp users!
I had played offline for a bit. when i got back online, none of my gameplay registered. So I lost over 2hrs of game play. I will be uninstalling this, its a shame!

I wanted to like this game. I really did. But theres no depth. The amount of time it takes to unlock new characters is outrageous. And the number of micro transaction that are everywhere is shameful. Everything is a slow sloughing grind that takes forever with minimal reward. I am playing at this point only because Im that bored on the toilet. 1/5. Get rid of so many microtransactions, add more characters/more easily unlockable, add some more depth. Then maybe Ill play for more than a break.

Game is fun at first but it's not long before progression slows down immensely unless you pay. The game has an energy system, ridiculous loot requirements for high level characters, and the campaign scales so quickly that you need loot to progress. The game becomes purely about the grind after a certain point. The purchases are insane too, regularly £10-20 for most things.

Been enjoying the game quite a bit for the last couple months. There's pay to win stuff but the grind hasn't been terrible as a free player. There are constantly events and updates. You can decide the depth you want to get into it with some guilds playing with fully planned tactics in the new war feature. The only thing I would like to see added is a way to like comments in the guild chat.

it's a joke how monetized these games are. $20-30 for 2-3 characters, basically $10-15 for one, and that's only if you buy the "special value" packs - one character can easily cost you $200 as if you're buying a fully glued and painted figure for the physical game. what's more ridiculous is apparently enough people pay that to continue encouraging this absurd pricing.

The game itself is pretty fun but the game does bottleneck pretty quickly into making it so you have to spend money to progress, it's possible to do so without spending anything but the grind and rng is going to become so boring and frustrating you'll just stop playing, it's a joke how many different things they can try to get you to spend money on but on top of that the amount of money everything costs is ridiculous.

Fun so far. I'll update when I can. 12/18/2022- First issue literally on my birthday. The game keeps crashing mid fight. So far it happened twice during the ork campaign and once during a salvage mission. Uninstalled the game and re-installed it to try and fix the issue. All of my months of game progress is completely gone. If this is not fixed soon I'm done playing.

A great distraction for a week or two. Unless you're willing to spend money to speed up your progress you're basically farming for weeks for a chance to unlock something new, which from f2p perspective makes playing the game a slog. The battles themselves end up feeling like there's very little strategy involved in plays since you usually end up fighting opponents that are either a lot weaker or considerably stronger than you.

Honestly pretty fun, and while technically being Freemium, I haven't encountered much of a need to make purchases. The Devs focused on making the game fun for people to play before adding stuff to buy. I don't recommend buying though, the prices for a 10 roll is roughly equalivent to a box of table top mini's.
Overall fun. However, the optimization needs to be better. This game does not have the high-fidelity to warrant so much need for save data

Slow and stingy. Absolutely not f2p and expensive at that. Everyone is just playing the same units and you have to get several hours of gameplay to get your first 10 pull. The are about 4 upgrade systems for each character and i can see that getting slow, grindy and expensive very fast. Add to that that epic or legendary characters looks absolutely hideously difficult and expensive to unlock. You should feel excited after your first 10 pull. My reaction was...is that is?

not bad but i was really hoping I could choose who I wanted to play as not be forced to play as space marines and slowly work twords the people I actually wanna play. other than that games not bad and does feel kinda like 40k. all in all decent.

At first, I was quite skeptical. But now, I realise that this game is one of the best mobile games I have ever played. Reminds me of a great mix of Space Wolves, and the Star Wars heroes game. I'd recommend it for anyone who plays warhammer video games or the board game. One thing I think should be added is smaller units. Like Necron warriors, Tactical Marines, Chaos space marines. As all the weaker or more simpler units but fun to play around with.

Good little game, I haven't invested anything other than time and usually by now OTHER games cut you off to make you feel like you have to invest to progress, maybe I haven't hit that point yet but it's fun for what it is. I'm interested in seeing what else gets added as the game grows. I will say there's alot of little resources that the game isn't super clear on how to get/what they'll be used for but that's most app games these days so take that as you will

Referal: cox-65-fab If you want to try it, lets go, could be awsome in the future. But... As everyone say, could be really great overall, but everything is so slow and annoying as hell. You can do literally nothing with a days or even a week of "play" (after a few first hour)... Maybe the arena is the ona what is not refresh immensely slow, only just little slow... :) but alone its not enough for a daily fun experiance.

Eh... Only good at the start. Just your typical mobile game using the warhammer 40k name and license. You'll get stuck at the level 70 of the first story campaign, I don't even know what to do to get stronger it just seems impossible. Oh well, I've had my fun for a few weeks. At least I have space marine 2 on PC, a better game to spend my time on related to 40k.

Response is a lie. Let's be honest. This isn't free to play. You've locked several key items required for progression behind a paywall. You say you can get them by free means but you really can't. The way to get them free is through a finite gambling system that you're just simply out of luck if they run out and you didn't get one. Once they're gone they're gone forever and now you pay or quit. No second chance. No recharge. Just get lucky, pay or never progress. Period. No in between whatsoeve

the game is really fun. the good between a strategy game and casual. you can learn the characters very well and play with super planning or very casual. of if you want to win in pvp games you need to learn something. the only downside is some of the oldest character are a little weak compared to the new one. i hope they will buff them a little mostly the aeldary faction.
Pretty new to the whole warhammer lore and franchise but really enjoying myself with it so far!
fun but a little slow going. Needs better catch up mechanics
almost a 5/5 if not for the energy mechanic the game would be perfect

Interesting Sky Arena style game, easy to play extremely hard to master. I like the gameplay loop, I just hate that there are SO MANY micro transactions. If you play the game a lot you can KIND OF (not really) keep up with the micro buyers, but it's rather difficult. I would recommend this game if you like 40k, enjoy resource gathering to make your characters more powerful. If you dislike replaying the same missions, taking a month (if your lucky) to obtain a decent character.

I think the gameplay itself is fun enough, but it is so aggressively monetized that I can't recommend it. It's fun for a while, but you absolutely hit a wall where it is insanely difficult to progress if you don't pay. The packs are also extremely expensive for what you get. I don't recommend. There are way better games on the market with less aggressive monetization.

I really like the turn-based combat and all the available content, however, I feel like the game is being a bit harsh to the newcomers. For example, there is currently a 2 year anniversary event and it's unfortunate that I'm not able to obtain the previous days' rewards from this event. The event is still on-going, yet I have missed it just because I've joined the game a few days into the event. Another thing is that the bundles in the shop are a bit too pricy. Even 4X games aren't this pricy

Just decided to track items shown as received from missions vs items in the inventory. 8 common items shown as received. Go to scrap them - scrap all common items. Zero available. NONE of the items shown as won in the battles went into inventory. As this is a freemium game, cheating on items received during grinding is a code issue likely to financially benefit the the owner via purchases In other words it's at best a VERY convenient code error. At worst, it's fraud.

Brilliant game. As an advent lover of Everything Warhammer, this brings me closer to the lore and it's characters. Solid game mechanics and strategic game play not only make it enjoyable, but teaches you how to plan on the spot. The art style is also very good. Can't wait for more updates! Especially when it comes to legions. Please bring in the Grey Knights or Legion of the Damned!

I absolutely love this game, the two biggest issues that I have are as follows. •Microtransactions, I feel as though weshammer explained the shop almost perfectly. But I truly feel as though theirs almost no need for anything except for the campaign packs and requisitions. The biggest feeling of a waste of money is the req 10 pack... the last 3 I've gotten were useless. The Guaranteed character is almost always characters you already have. I've got more to talk about but this post is too big.

Typical pay to win. Once you reach level 45 of the first campaign, it's almost impossible to win a level if you haven't paid for one of their starter packs. Leveling up your character becomes almost impossible because they don't give you enough resources to level your character properly. The enemies are always conveniently powerful enough to prevent you from winning a three-star Victory. Even if you level up multiple times for one level, it's often not enough. Waste of time.

The games rules and combat are very engaging but very difficult to try different factions since every single gacha is completely random. Without money it will be months or years before you could build a desired team. For example I only pulled one nurgle unit with 30 total gacha pulls. The other frustration is camaigns are locked until you have a team built and if your luck is bad you'll never play story missions past the first campaign. Avoid unless you really love 40k more than money.

It's a 40k branded version of The Phone Game. You know, with multiple currencies to confuse any understanding of value, gacha loot boxes of characters, energy limits to enforce paying for access to the game, a battle pass to accentuate fomo, first time purchase bundles to force you into the buyer funnel... The shame of it is it's built on the bones of the game are a solid turn-based tactical game with a storyline from a strong property. Play it if you like 40k but don't spend money here.

Free to play progression becomes slow but play always feels meaningful. Been playing for over a year and I keep enjoying it more. Only criticism is that there's always new content but improvements are slow, makes me think there's a team dedicated to consistently pumping out new content but only 1 person who looks at improving things when they have spare time.

More resource collection then tactics. Cool characters and interesting possibilities but it's really just a collection game then a tactics game. You go from menu to menu collecting resources. So you can upgrade your squad. Very little actual strategy game. Just menu to menu getting resources trying to manipulate my brain into feeling good with constantly opening new boxes and getting more resources. Is this really what people want?

Good game, it's fun to outplay enemies and watch your favorite characters get stronger, though I wish getting characters wasn't so exclusive, it makes it hard to get the guys you want and it feels awkward to have mix matched characters on your team, seeing as they all constantly war with one another in the lore, but this game is still in production really, we still have factions and guild mechanics in the making, maybe then the roster will be more accessible.

Pretty flashy, an okay time spend for mobile game. The game starts slow and seems too simplistic at first, but the mechanics are a bit more in depth which is a +.Game offers many different types of 'upgrades' to your character which seems excessive and just adds to 'grind', but so far I haven't faced game complications (difficulty spikes or the like). This might come in later, of course, but so far it's an ok mobile game, not the worst Warhammer game and the time will show whether it's a 3 or 5
its fun and free, a bit too basic and a lot of pop ups when you try to play though. I paid a fiver for one character to support dev.

Buggy. The game often crashes during an onslaught or other token mission. The token is gone and there is no way to get back into the mission. I am wondering how somebody can develop a game with such a rookie mistake in 2022. Didn't you play other online games before? Can't you simply take my token after I finish (or fail) a mission? If you are afraid of possible cheating add a possibility to re-enter a mission after a crash. Your solution is not acceptable in a game based on an energy system.
its really fun but there are a lot of micro transactions
Love everything about it. Solid game, new updates, rotating events
love this game, perfect little time killer, and I find very engaging
Fun. Simple. Didn't fall asleep in the first 5 minutes of playing.
By far the most entertaining mobile game I've ever played. This is worthy of the WH40K IP.

Decent game, has some fun aspects but you have to grind or pay to be able to continue the campaign. The worst part of the game is the fact that you have to have "Raid Tickets" to quickly replay any level you have already beaten with 3 stars, but the part that makes it worse is there is only a certain number of times you can raid a level! Why make players use RAID TICKETS if you're already limited in the number of times you can play a level every day?! Just make the raids free!!!
I really am impressed by this app...Requires more Awesomeness though!
game is fun but I dont think other campaigns should have to be bought
gameplay is great also only did this because I assume it would ask me to rate game more if I didn't

Awesome Strategy Game from Launch to Updates. As a tabletop Warhammer 40,000 player, I like to look for games that are in a similar style. Tacticus plays similarly to that. The biggest differences are character leveling and hex movement. Other than that, I've found the slow gaining of experience and upgrades a way to keep me engaged as I strategize through hundreds of developer scenarios or against other players. My favorite part of the game is my guild. I have a great guild community.

I appreciate the game for what it is. A decently designed strategy video game that lets you play some of your favorite Warhammer characters. However, the long cooldown timers just to play at all and the EXTREME focus on paying to access most of the characters and campaigns and pay to win for the later levels and the pvp tournaments almost makes this a 2 star game.

It's a good game, I'm sure of that, but I'm really having some trouble with how difficult the fourth part of the first campaign is and how it looks like I need to use real money to buy stronger characters for me to progress through the game. It's especially hard when I'm just a kid and can't just spend money on a game. I also find that the only way to get certain characters is either by buying them or grinding a lot. Grinding is especially hard when I have no energy or raid tokens

This is a really fun, easy to learn game. You don't hafta be a 40k lore master to enjoy it, you can come in not knowing anything about the world, and have a blast. Here's the thing, you need to be able to zoom in a little bit closer to the battlefield, and you need an option yo make the text larger. If they added those two small things, it would be a straight 5 star rating.

Played since launch and it is a game with alot of potential but to bad that it is becoming a pure exploitation of a fanbase for money grabbing. The last event, adeptus mechanicus campaigning is a good example. Instead of making it like all campaigning a permanent part of the game they placed it so you play it for only 13 days after that in a few months you get a nother chance of it and if you don't have all the characters then you can't fight the last boss.

OK I originally gave the game 5 stars. But in the past couple weeks I have been having issues when I play. I constantly being stopped from playing because it's saying I'm not connected to wifi. I am connected. It's doesn't matter if I have full bars or not. Sometimes I can play a few games before itt says it and others I can't play at all. It sucks because I enjoy it when I can play it.

The game forces monetization down your throat at every turn. Pop-ups after dungeon, pop ups when you log in. The game play is okay save for the fact it's slow and tedious. It plays like an early 2000s flash game. Due to the high monetization, the game is very pay to win/pay to continue to play with energy and time gates. Overall, it was extremely disappointing.

This is one of the most heavily monetized games I've ever seen. While the concept and gameplay is decent, the fact that you have to actively dodge the hundreds of opportunities to spend absurd amounts of money makes it just irritating to even play. It seems like if I had played it long enough I'd eventually spend money by accident just because I have to work so hard to avoid the multiple pages of microtransactions which often cover more than 3/4 of the screen.

This game is great fun, I would give it a much higher score if it wasn't for the blatantly greedy cash grab. GW should be ashamed for allowing this with their IP. Just started playing about a week ago and having a blast. Unfortunately, the push for money is taking over the fun. Many games have a season pass, this one has a monthly season pass, and then an ultimate monthly season pass (for more money), then the energy, gems, tokens, power tokens, purchasable campaigns, and then the ads!

A lot of fun so far however. Having issues with a couple purchases and haven't heard a peep from the studio yet. I like to spend, I can spend. I won't if I can't get service in a reasonable time frame. The rewards for killing guild bosses are garbage. Arena rewards the same. No point in getting the higher chests.

The game is fun. No power creep so far (well into the main campaign and 2 of the others available). A separate currency, other than energy, for things like Arena or Onslaught battles feels very restrictive on the player's ability to complete missions, i.e. 'play 5 Arena battles, but you only have 3 Arena Tokens to do so!' Players should be able to play a battle after using all of that battle's raid attempts. I don't want to get screwed by RNG and just be unable to get certain character tokens.

Simple but funish tactical gameplay clashes with the least generous and most grindy mobile games I've seen in awhile. They boast about how many factions they have, but getting a single character, never mind a team of any besides the starters is mind-numbingly slow or hilariously expensive. Also if you uninstall, it deletes your progress. Spend less on your marketing and more on making the game worth playing.

Pay 2 win gacha game pretending to be turn based strategy. Game is playable for a few hours but character aquirement and growth is then blocked out by items you can only get by paying for or by luck that you get 2/3 tries each day. Game is designed around a predatory addiction system such that you have to log in daily to try and gamble to get the items to grow your characters. At some point it's no longer strategy, just luck on getting the items to make your teams hit hard enough to win

The game takes the Warhammer universe and puts it into digestible battles that require some tactical thinking to win. The biggest thing is that without paying money to accelerate your progress and items, you need to be patient. There are days where I raid one mission repeatedly and burn through all my energy just to get a gear upgrade, and then will be able to do nothing else for the day. However, you get a consistent stream of new characters that makes it fun still.
very good and don't need to spend money but I would like to know why I don't have sounds on the game lol
I really want to like the game. However the absolute flood of micro-transaction offers you have to filter through to actually get anything done ruins the experience.

Great gameplay with a large variety of characters to collect. I particularly love the art style, and how accessible the game is. However there are some major dealbreakers: 1- abusive monetization. I played the game for one day and got bombarded by over 200€ of offers. 2- No auto. Grinding dozen times the same easy fight is boring. 3- Bad Daily/Weekly task design. Raiding mission does not reward XP, Kill or victory for Tasks. Some tasks are random with a 1 hour time limit. No stamina = SOL.

Great game. Almost perfect. But you are forced to spend money or else you hit a brick wall. If you wish to progress without spending a few years grinding to level up charactors to any competitive and useful level, you have to spend money. This is fun for a few weeks until you hit the wall where you can almost no longer participate in any events or guilds due to lack of leveled charactors.

I like the game, but i have some gripes: 1) it has a huge amount of progression up front that eventually gets throttled 2) elevation and line of sight are hard to determine, which awkwardly messes with how your units behave 3) there's a massive difficulty spike in the campaign when swarm enemies are introduced because they take most of your health in 1 hit. Plus, only certain characters can take them out effectively, which makes them a huge pain 4) attack damage can be wildly inconsistent

Pretty standard tactics game with a 40k veneer. Not obviously pay-to-win and not at all unplayable if you're not spending money, however expect to shell out a few bucks if you're set on collecting and optimizing a particular faction. Nothing wrong with that, though, as there's plenty of value to be had in the $5-10 range. There's a glut of missions and personally I would've preferred quality over quantity in that regard, but nothing out of the ordinary for a time-sink phone game.

I'm hooked. What else can I say? The stamina system sucks big time, but it refills quite quickly compared to the stamina slop games...this is also like Raid when it comes to ″micro″transactions since they are more like MACRO and not very rewarding, specially the ones over 20+ yet they are not forced for real progression, even if they shove them in your face from time to time. I was looking for a ″Tactics″ kind of game and I can say this one scratches that itch, but not completely yet...

Their focus was money and then the game. Game is insanely simple and small scale battles. Prices are awful with 0 bang for your buck. While most games get you like 20 pulls for monthly subscription this game doesn't even give you 10. I also see almost no way to farm for 10 pulls. Gameplay is also insanely repetitive. Rates aren't great either. It's got potential and a good welcome pack but other than that it may be best to stay away and get fire emblem heroes or dislyte instead

A great game, doesn't push ads, you can play without having to pay to win. The only thing stopping this from getting 5 stars is that its so difficult to unlock characters, if you want to play a specific faction the game forces you to play through so much other mission and stuff to try and randomly unlock the characters you want. The game is actually good enough that I'd be willing to pay to unlock specific factions, but that's not an option.
Altogether not a bad game. They should make it where you can battle friends in your guild and make more characters but all in all a good game.

Fun, but frustrating. The "terrain" mechanics are TERRIBLE. Half the time is impossible to tell when terrain blocks attacks, HEALS, etc... The "arena" is TOTALLY unbalanced. Don't bother trying if you don't want to pay 2 win Dropping my review another star because the menu system is just garbage. It's completely unintuitive. Don't waste money on this ripoff, no matter how much you like WH40K.

The gameplay, at its core, is fun and has a lot of potential but: The badly designed gamemodes and poor AI really ruin how deep and interesting the game could be, 1v1 PvP is really fun but only happens once in a while as part of an event. Progressiom and pricing is absurd, F2P progression is abysmal and completely based around RNG so you can't even farm characters you like. P2W progression is.. expensive, characters cost 10-20€ to unlock without any upgrades, expect to pay thousands for upgrad

Continuously loses your progression and blocks gameplay because it deems there to not be service, regardeless of servive availability. Map design is woefully abysmal. Just another pay-to-win game, gameplay is nothing new or special. Game would get a 3/5 if they fixed the service glitch, however in order to deserve more than 1 star, the game has to be playable.

Overall, it's a fun game. However, it needs some serious love. I say this because the pvp side of the game is good right where it's at. PvE? Not so much. Having to wait hours for a single onslaught or salvage run ticket doesn't make sense to me. Furthermore, having energy is a huge thrill killer for the game. On top of that, having to use 6 energy for 1 mission depletes that energy VERY fast, especially when trying to upgrade your characters gear. Like I said, needs some love, not in pvp.

As with most f2p mobile gave it begins showering you with progress, then presents the "wall" at which units are simply too weak to progress. Then it is down to tedious grinding repetitions of whichever missions *might* drop things. It's dressed up as a tactics game, but it's really just stacking numbers. The influence your Tactical choices make is very minimal. Expect to be mildly entertained for 2 hours, then dumped into tedium and microtxn harassment.

while the gameplay itself is enjoyable and requires some strategy with being too hard, and the roster of characters so far is really good, but the reason I'm only giving it three stars is in the campaign your locked in to picking the three starting characters for a minimum of 3/5 slots, which makes buying new characters mostly pointless, I understand only allowing certain factions or locking you in to keeping one or at most two of the starting characters but three seems like to much.

This was very disappointing. I'm always looking for good Warhammer games, and this one had great potential. I was excited to play death guard and Tau. Then I realized that I was basically just playing a demo, and the full campaign cost $120. I'm used to micro transactions in mobile games, but this is on another level. It's basically a mobile game that cost $120 with micro transactions on top. I would play the game if it was actually free to play, but I'm not paying $120 just to play the campaign

Game has potential but has a lot of issues. For one you hit the wall of what you can do daily early with free to play. Costs for characters with resources is really unfair and too high. The other characters of factions are mostly locked behind crazy high character token grinds or ludicrously expensive additional mission content. $29.99 for the Chaos playset what the hell is that? The arena system matchmaking is broken so eventually you'll face players who have bought their higher tier characters
Seems like a fun game. Alot to take in, in the beginning but you get the hang of it.
Stop spamming users with excessive promotions, every single time they go to a new screen, it's especially annoying for subscribers to tacticians club
it's fun without trying hard. also weirdly fun to solve things.
So where I will say it is fun the only problem is it very heavy on trying to get you to pay things.
I really like the 40k game and this is a great representation of it in a video game! if you like the game you will like this.

Game breaking bug right in the beginning... Missions are introduced when they had been unlocked from the start.. then a forced idiotic tutorial starts where I'm supposed to claim a completed mission that isn't finished... So I'm locked at that screen. Devs, please stop incorporating forced tutorials. They are annoying as hell and in this case have ruined the game..
I absolutely love this game the black templars are my boys here and on the table top they could use a vehicle though
amazing offline game, hard to get used to the layout but fun nonetheless
there's an ad Everytime you finish a mission, kind of annoying
this game is by far the most addictive and fun game I'd ever played on my phone. by far 10/10 you should definitely download.
fun engaging game play/tactics with the leveling system being easy to understand. praise the emperor.

Edit -1*: found the pay wall. Level 15, it takes about 800 energy to farm gear pieces and you only get 100 a day. There are a lot of things to do, but only if you don't play the game for 2 days to let all the timers reset. Daily play gets you about 10 minutes of play time. Recommendation: lower timers for everything and lower cost of energy per level. Remove orbs for level increases. It's hard enough getting the ridiculous amount of hero shards.
Quick and easy game play, I still miss Space Wolves!
a lot of fun but I think the monthly pass is so expensive for a mobile game
Been very fun and well paced so far, it feels rewarding for the time played
Fun to play, you don't have to spend many hours a day on it to progress.
Love this game. The new dawn of war crossover update is fantastic.
awsome play this on all my mobils aways great my only issue is not enough dark angels and no fallen ones
I love the strategy the mechanics and warhammer I just wish there's an offline mode
Really great. The gameplay is very nice. Add salamanders pls
meh. not bad. tactical games aren't my thing. good graphics tho.
You have to play as a loyalist to the false emperor or pay $30 to play as The black legion. you can unlock by playing but you are forced to play as the corpse emperor's legions.
I love this game and I kinda want to have an age of sigmar version of this game I love the skaven and nurgle and I think it would be a lot of fun
these 40k games keep disappearing. long live tacticus!! the best 40k app in the galaxy.
love is game. Warhammer 40000 has a huge universe. not pay to win. you can LVL to upgrade your characters
in my case I got a new phone I downloaded the game started it up to find I have none of my old progress from when I already played it so not really happy with that
fantastic little game for fans of the table top and lore!! cant stop playing it!!!
Just a time sink. spend money if you want. but not necessarily needed to have fun.

Fun, simple (but can get complex), and addicting smaller-scale skirmish turn-based strategy game, which feels perfect for a Warhammer 40k mobile game. I've always wanted to play a Warhammer strategy video game that emulates the tabletop wargame to an extent but the ones that I've tried have always felt slightly too intimidating so this feels like the perfect 'gateway game.' Playing this makes me want to give those games another try, so bad.
A very satisfying game you should try. A slight issue is the amount of popups asking to buy something, but just ignore them and play the game.
My wife and I play this game and have tons of fun. Great introduction to the world for new people.

Started as a great game. Addictive, tons of unlocks, and resonable ramp up in difficulty. Some of the additional content was worth the money. However, I am here leaving this comment because I am locked behind a pay/time wall. Having to wait and/or play in order to continue a campaign is ridiculous. Otherwise a 5star game.

An ok game so far but way too much monetisation. The game is also extremely tight with freebies and is in need of more QOL improvements. The game play is extremely repetitive so any mode that requires completing just for grinding rewards needs auto or a skip function. Due to the game not being generous with summons you're also stuck with the same characters for a long time which adds to the tedium. Currently I can only bring myself to play the game for very short spells before I get bored.

This game has been very surprising, put together thoughtfully with real units and along with a story that is really engaging. I downloaded this after the YouTuber Majorkill suggested it and I don't think I'll uninstall it. Unlike other pay to win games this one doesn't force you into it, more like if you're very impatient you can buy some of the characters for not that bad a price. Only suggestion please put in some voice actors, the story is great and would be even better with voice over.
great game, tutorial is absolutely unnecessary and needs to be skippable. edit: 3 stars now. the forced tutorial and choices make the start of the game almost unplayable.

5/5 This game is Awesome I've played it for close to four years and the Dreadnought has been added!!! And Lord Titus because of Space Marines 2(I beat the game on pc). I am beyond exited due to this amazing game and the development team. This game is fun and time-consuming, perfect for afterwork and weekends!! Dreadnought makes the world go round. (I obtained the dreadnought, not what I was hoping for but it works)

The game is fun, no mandatory ads and has responsive tech support. However. The wait times for action points is longer than any other game I've played. This game is played 30 minutes at a time for story missions and up to 12 hours between major guild fights or special events. It's also an absolute slog when upgrading or even accessing characters that are needed in order to progress. The RNG used to grant upgrades and characters is unbalanced and takes months to access needed cards.

Grindy. Fork up some money? The game play is repetitive but still satisfying for a win. The mechanics have so many subtle nuances that require you to engage in many fascets, but is exciting, but laborious. The grind is real. And you'll experience stagnation after basically a weekend because you need some magical spoon or whatever to progress but the only way to acquire this item is through a daily "drop" or to purchase your own "drop". Hmmm.... No lore. Cash grab. Fun for a weekend.

Super basic and repetitive gameplay, most of the time scrolling through overly saturated shops looking for the green button. As a new player going in, you have to pay to participate in any new events. This ones for the whales

Game insists that I am not connected to the internet, even though I am. Then after finally getting the game to connect to Google Play after multiple failed attempts the games still says not connwcted to the internet. Been playing for a month or more never had a prior issue. I have made many attempts to play ever the past two days to no avail.

This game was fun at first and I like the typical Gacha systems they employ in the game. It doesn't require so much time and effort. However, one system they have which is just terrible is the Raid Currency. You eventually hit a point where you have to manually replay already-beaten campaign missions once you run out of raid tickets. It's stupid, get rid of the tickets. Or at least have an auto-play button for all game modes. I have a life, I don't want to replay missions over and over again.
keeps saying im not connected to internet and wont let me access my game. tho I am connected and got full service on my phone

While the gameplay itself is fun it is riddled with microtransactions to the point of ridiculousness. I'm pretty sure they even came up with some new ways to nickle and dime players. You can play F2P, albeit very slowly, as expected in any game that focuses more on microtransactions than game play, but your time is honestly better spent elsewhere in the long run.

This game is great, amazing if you're a fan of 40k. Seems like there's a lot of bitter reviews below and above and I'm not certain why. Yes, it helps to spend strategically, but FTP is viable, it will just take longer to progress. THAT'S HOW MOBILE GAMES WORK, PEOPLE. Devs gotta put food on the table, too. Keep up the good work, Snowprint. Looks like the game is really taking off and good for ya!

This has the bones of a good game using an excellent IP. The moment to moment gameplay is a decent tactical experience as well. However, it requires way too much screen time daily once you get past the initial two weeks. There is also an enormous roster that is extremely difficult to unlock, with many of the characters being inaccessible outside of special events or paywall transactions. It's really fun initially, but it gets so slow by the end it's not worth your time.

I'm a fan of tactics-style games so this has been fun for the tutorial levels and beyond. Not a huge fan of energy-to-play systems, but that's my biggest complaint so far. Being able to pick a faction to start with would have been nice - but that's because I'm not an Ultramrines player. Xenos all the way.

I'm a little spilt in my opinion. I really like the gameplay, I just started on friday, 2 days ago, invested 25€ (Yarrick 5€, Season pass 10€ and Saga of the Wolfen thingy 10€) yet I'm almost not able to play. I get that you need to make money on a free2play game but I play overwatch 2 which is free, I buy the season pass every 3 month and just play. So I get tons of gameplay for 10€ in Overwatch which needs more development than this game, but I don't get that here after spending 25€...

Some of these reviews seem to not understand how to play the game, or are reviwing the wrong game. The fact that you can't pay for additional plays other than campaign is the opposite of a pure P2W model and leveling characters is simple and quick once you understand how stats work. Strategy even for high end isnt too mind bending, though half these reviewers seem to just rush every game. And as for not being able to play enough, you can play roughly 45 games before refresh across the modes.

Lots to do which is great. I like the character design, whimsy but still 40k. The prices in the shop though are insane. Maybe offer more low cost ways to make farming your desired faction easier. Right now it's either dumping lots of money into gacha mechanics or paying 35€ and up for just getting a character without doing anything for it.

Look I get a lot of enjoyment from playing this game but straight up? You need to rework your requisition system, went for 20 total reqs and all of it was the bottom of the barrel, I really hope this review brings players to drawback on spending their money here because what's the point when it feels like you rip us off. Thanks for your time 👌

Great game for WH40K fans who don't have a lot of time on their hands. The dailies take 10 mins at most. Bit slow if you don't spend a bit of money but oh well. I love that they're gradually adding more and more factions. My favourites are the AdMech and I really hope the next Machine of War will be a Knight Crusader(Questor Mechanicus).

Games fun for about and hour or so until you hit the pay wall (timers) and have to wait an entire day to play any relevant gameplay. Also the PvP makes 0 sense, you will walk all over a higher level player only to get wiped by a lower level one immediately after. Characters seem hell bent on putting themselves in the worst positions possible, even when u try and put them elsewhere. It's too bad cause I enjoyed the first few hours of this game, sucks now.

I honestly have no issues with this game, it's fun and one of 3 mobile games that has kept my attention. I only wish the Salamanders were in it. Edit: If I may suggest, if you guys do the Salamanders you should add Sa'kan.

I'm really enjoying it, been playing for about two months. Lots of different game modes to play. Don't have to buy the in-app purchases, can just grind them out. Only game I play every day on my phone

Awesome experience. Although I'm not a Warhammer 40K fan with mini figures and these other stuff, I liked the turn-based style combat of this game, and little by little I learn about the Warhammer 40K universe
I just started and I'm enjoying this very much. there are a variety of characters which allow you to engage in various tactics to overcome your opponents. it's good fun.
Super fun strategy game that you can also play on your PC if you would like to. With no requirement to pay for items in game.
feels a little overwhelming at first. they throw a lot of mechanics at you, but it seems like a decent game. Obviously ptw, but I like the strategy aspect of it
Freemium, but very enjoyable. No cap on abilities without paying, just takes forever. Fair. Enjoying the game.

just got ripped off by a microtransaction for a character event. I enjoy the game, but the greed of the developers disgusts me. Do not waste any of your money on the transactions for character or faction development!
Fun and very enjoyable game! It's a lot of fun without having to feel the constant need to spend real money just to get somewhere.
fun game but doesn't respect your time. missed a login on the final day of an event and my entire investment went down the drain. anyway it was good while it lasted.
Everything is good so far. and the only thing it needs to improve is the gotcha system it's far too hard to get what you need to open crates.
it's fun I also like playing darktide and space marine 2 I know this is pretty basic as reviews go but I've been loving Warhammer 40k for about 6 years now and can't wait for more content
Somewhat fun turn based tactical gameplay, but abhorrent ad placement in every aspect of the game made it so wildly unfun.

pvp is completely broken the events are boring and don't explain what to do and unless you're willing to pay large amounts of money you won't progress much on pve so honestly don't waste your time theirs a lot better games than this
heavy on pay to progress, fun game not complete slop especially if you are a 40k fan. but expect slow progression without throwing a considerable amount of money at it.
let s be honest, it is fun time killer for true fan of warhammer. gameplay is simple and deep , some sort of tactic is avalible. but it is CHG
I've always been a fan of Warhammer and it's lore and absolute craziness. Especially the 40,000 game, so this game is definitely a good time passer

This is awesome please add ONE singular thing if you add this I will become a crazy person for this game You know ref codes. Please make it so you can reset it reseting it makes thing change. All the Blackstone you earned from entering it gets removed All the reqs that the persons ref code you entered gets taken away. And other things. So then letting you enter it again. Love and wishes from Me..... Please enter it I will have an addiction to this game if you add it.💗💗🙏🙏
engaging, abundant options, & upgrades. Difficulty strikes a decent balance between learning curve, & difficulty. overall a fun Mobil game.
super fun until you hit the pay wall, then there's little reason to play for more than a few minutes a day until the actions unlock again.
Great game if you like clicking through menus and claiming rewards, and a slow pay-to-play grind.
You know what, it is a gotcha game, but I legit haven't given them a dime (not including ad revenue) and I've been able to play with interesting characters.
game very fun, but I don't like how on the 10th day or someday like that the match is randomly over, even if you are dominating the server, it sucks, I would really appreciate it you would change it.
Just started and it's pretty good so far. I'd personally prefer a Adepta Sororitas battle group but it doesn't really seem like it lets you just pick like that.
Been an active player 4 a while now, & I can definitively that I love it... If U like 40K battle simulators with hexen-based tactical movements... Then, U will love it 2...
Energy mechanics are an automatic 1 star from me. I want to play when I want to play, not when I'm told it's ok. Want to play for an afternoon once a week? Too bad for you.

This game is so hungry for your wallet it's actually ridiculous. They lock dozens of upgrades for characters behind crates that you have to pay actual money for, if you want to go the f2p way you just have to hope you get a super rare, very specific item, as a random drop. Not to mention how other upgrades are constantly locked behind other campaigns that you need characters to play but said characters take months to get free. Oh and they give the vaguest descriptions of events.
Good game to pass the time when you've got that Warhammer itch, but can't scratch it through traditional means.
Garbage ad system with tons of broken in ending ads, borderline pornographic ads, and ads that don't redeem rewards properly. Fix your add system.

easy to understand how to play. But I would love to not start out as a faction i care nothing about. I wish you could pick what faction you actually want from the start. the pay for stuff wall isn't too bad.but to so it without taking out a loan is slow AF.
Pretty so far. Terrain and other aspects have to be accounted for. So tactics do come into play.
overall nice, but everything is pushing you to spend a lot of money. and jeez it's pricey.
With the IP of the Warhammer universe, SP have done a great job bringing this mobile game to life. Play for free, or splash some cash to progress faster. Waaaugh!
probably the best strategy Warhammer game on mobile it also has a bunch of different types of characters with different types of abilitys very addictive

While it definetly is a fun game, I fail to find a way the mechanics make this game unique from other games with this format. Stuff like items increasing strength or HP are concepts that are well known and have been used alot. If this game aims to go further than having a warhammrr texture pack, some attention to unique details would be great.

Update: way too many server issues lately. Constantly having connection issues. Pro: I enjoy the turn based gameplay and there's enough to do each day. Cons: It's very grindy with a lot of points where you get stuck until you spend a month grinding better gear or spend $20 to speed up the grind. The arena matchmaking system is terrible, you end up facing opponents that are 5x your level.

It's not pay to win but expect to grind away for a long, long time to get anywhere. I've noticed that all resources to fight in the different modes dissappear rather quickly and the wait time is just absurd. (11 and a half hours to fight again one time) Tactics are shallow but fun, it doesn't matter much though when others can spend money to buy their way up the ladders. If you're a 40k fan, you'll have a good time here. Other than that search elsewhere for the grind.

Love 40k, the models look great. But can eat up a ton of time of you run out of tickets while trying to collect gear. Getting shards for characters takes an eternity. The rates are so low. Basically if you are playing during a character launch you can likely unlock non legendaries. But after they likely won't be obtainable and even when they are it is at a pace that it will take you a very long time. Unless you pay for offers.

The graphics are really done well in the game. I do think alot of packs are thrown at new players too soon. And I really dislike timed packs, 2 or 4 hours till pack expires doesnt give players much time to decide to buy. 2 days would be better imo, and maybe reduce the packs activated. I played for only 2 hours and all the packs just confused me.

Profit-oriented design keeps this game from being truly enjoyable. To name a few - notifications leading to purchases that cant be acknowledged or turned off, which kills trust in the core feature of upgrading. The green 'new' icon might mean an upgrade or merely a purchase, the game doesn't see any distinction between the two. These are EVERYWHERE. If you want to play a clean game with no outstanding notifications, forget this noise. Ran out of space already. Tldr this is a shopping app

I played for a while until I had to uninstall due to storage issues at the time, installed again after some time and it practically forced me to start over. I couldn't find a way to fix this and linking my Google account didn't work either. Very disappointed since I'm a long time fan of 40k and had played this game since its release, even voted the year when it won best strategy game of the year in its favor. Hope to get some help but won't change this until it happens.

I've been playing this for years now. A terrific game, they do sell power/ progress for real money as any mobile game, but pvp isn't focus, it's most horizontal progression and it isn't too am absurd level, so I can't call it p2w. They also implemented one of the best features I've yet to see in a mobile game - they limit your daily ad amount, and they're and none of them are forced. So the amount of watching ads is small, and you have to be a bit strategic about them.

I enjoy the overall gameplay experience, and the Warhammer aesthetic of everything is pretty good. But the play experience is DRENCHED in micro transaction prompts, which I'm having a fine time ignoring so far but I imagine I'll probably be uninstalling in a week or so when the free play experience becomes a slog. I'd love to pay 5-10 Dollars for a game like this without all the gambling in it but I suppose that's not in the cards.

Overall experience is very smooth and refined, BUT !! the blatent cash grab is overwhelming. When you first start the game your given all these loot crates and rewards for accomplishable taskes, but the rewards slow down dramatically, you go from about 14 character/loot drops on your first day to mabey 8 stretched out over the next week (that is if your not spending money). The difficulty steeps up quickly with a decline in rewards. Kills the momentum and enjoyment. Great game, poor execution.

You really dont get to play as the faction you want, since you need a specific set of team members (that you never have the resources to aquire) in order to play their campaign, or the choice to buy them for about 30 dollars. I know its a mobile game, but thats horribly steep. Might as well buy an actual game at that point. Just let people have a bit more of a choice over who they want to play as, instead of shoveling the same tired faction.

After a couple of entertaining hours you hit a Major paywall and can barely advance without buying (very expensive) stuff. I even bought a character for € 5, but it only got me a little further. The most annoying thing is the "energy" you consume for every game. You have to wait a long time until it recharges, or you pay for it. Really frustrating not being able to play.

The game is nice even if i think there was a lot more work on the pay to play mecanics than on the gameplay itself. I could have copped with the neverending incentives to put ridiculous amounts of money in the game to unlock things faster, because you can progress if you're patient, it s hard, but possible...but slowly building up to the '10 requisitions' bundle which guaranty a caracter only to see that on the 67 caracters you get the same one 3 times in a row...that's the last straw.

This is not a game, it only takes money. The tactical elements are bare bones, the difficulty ramps up faster than the player can manage without paying money, your tankiest character will start getting one shot by standard enemies within a day. You have to collect pieces of characters via lootboxes to unlock them, and they take hundreds of little pieces, and you only get a few pieces per lootbox of a random character across all factions, again you could also spend money to unlock characters.

Ive always loved the table game but have never been involved in one so this is kinda what I imagine one is based of my previous knowledge of the game, I love it but ofc wish to play the real deal eventually.

It's fast paced for only the first couple of days, but once you get to the later stages it takes days to weeks to build up the characters to overcome a stage or just one level (of course if you bankrupt yourself with the ridiculous prices you can speed this up). It's frustrating having to hope for the perfect ai rolls that go in your favor to win a level or just wait to build up your characters because everything you need to do so is tied to a dice roll on wether you get enough of the material.

This game is microtransaction hell. Want a character? Good luck getting them. You will spend hours/days getting requisition scrolls so that you get a "guaranteed" character, only to get a character you already have on that drop. They are literally selling loot boxes for things you already have. Also, you can't complete events without spending money because they are deliberately short. And any unspent event currencies go any after the event if unused. Terrible cash grab.

It's pay to win. Non-paying players can enjoy it as well. Just dont expect fast growth. Added: The game is killing itself. Too many things to do in a day. Daily quests, daily achievement, guild raids, guild war with too short duration that forces us to play 10 battles a day, etc etc. I can no longer watch any ads to support the game.

Its an okay game. With many Handy game problems. Flashy you get some recourses instead of just all listet on one screen after a game. A tutorial that it just click this button now click this button. A ton of buyable packs that not even worth half of the money they want. But to this point of playing I dont get any ads for other games. The combat is simple but in a good way. Simple enough you can play when you have a quick break. But complex enough that you have to think.
I love warhammer 40k so much and this game gets me distracted a lot

As a 40k fan I want to like this game and just force myself to play at times due to the universe and collector style game. However it is lacking and requires an extreme amount of screen time to actually advance. I wouldn't mind spending money however paying for a premium battle pass and not even coming close to finishing it to unlock the character at the end is garbage. Hitting pretty much every milestone and still having to play every game mode to ensure all energy is used up is feels terrible.

The game is alright. The character designs are good...BUT...once you hit level 14, you hit the wall. Then it becomes a pay to play game. No matter how much you wanna grind to level up, it is practically impossible. Also, you have to wait days for the timers on onslaught, guild raid and raiders in order to get the 3 badges refilled. I got to mission 60 on one before I couldn't advance. And even if you DO wanna spend the money, they ask for A LOT and give you so little in return.

I love playing the game when im able too but, the time it takes to grind and what you get for rewards isn't really good. Mostly get ×1 on every item but definitely tons of coins, not enough black shards to get so the coins are useless. And the hours it takes for everything to regenerate just to play again is way too long for me personally.As far as a mobile game goes, aside from everything else, its engaging when you have all your energy up, great graphics, smooth game play.raid boss way too OP

Updated review: So, after giving this game a solid day of play, I decided to uninstall it. Battles are plentiful, but many of them are repetitive. Menus get buried under ads. In order to summon new Champs, you go right to he screen for all of the ads. There is very little choice on the faction you may want to play. No option for chaos, xenos or the imperium... so you are saddled with the ultramarines... the game killer for me are the ads and pay 2 win/collect.

I've been playing for almost a week. I have been finding that the strategy gets deeper as you play. And many simple characters can become a lot better then they start. However. My phone crashes every time I try to pull up the first two Thousand Son characters. And now that they are boss fights those screens crash too. Also the final boss page of the Ultra marine mission make my screen crash. Too many pop ups on the main page, no options to lower the graphics.

Contact us doesn't allow actual contact. Trying to simply share my experience as a new player but clearly the Devs don't want feedback. Still trying to figure out how to progress as a new player in a way that seems like actual progress. Campaign scales way to fast, it goes from reasonably challenging to complete stupid far to fast, with no clear path forward and far to many limits. Also micro transactions are supposed to be micro. The bundles cost to much compared to more engaging mobile games.

Nothing special. this game is only held up by its IP. it's extremely repetitive, the progress is super slow UNLESS YOU PAY. & if you're going to pay, then you are going to pay the most absurd prices that you've ever seen in your lifetime. Absolutely atrocious charges that get virtually nothing in-game. this is one for people to get addicted to and then spend a minimum of $10 US/month to try & deliver the illusion of progression. The in-game adds are getting longer & more perverse. 2 star max.

First day or two, you are racking up characters and having fun. Day 3, or around level 10, a pay wall slaps you in the face. P2W players are orders of magnitude stronger. You can't regen energy fast enough to really level or gain tokens to level characters. Autoplay levels is something you can't do unless you earn 'raid' tokens, and those are stingy. Could be fun, but it will be a very long grind, if you want Freeplay.

There hasn't been a real person or player writing a review here since long before 2021; as an actual Tacticus player you can tell because most of these ad complaints are generic to most other games, but unfortunately not this one... yes there are adds but they are usually confined to the game shop screen (and when you first log onto the game); you don't have popups in this game while you play... farm and grind and ultimately play... A Good game to play.

The barebones play is good. Unfortunately grinding out quests which involve playing the same/similar missions multiple times to get so much of a certain damage type or use certain characters are tedious af. Costs of purchasing items in real world money are a joke, some of the Christmas "deals" have very clearly been targeted at whales. Costs of upgrading characters past the 1st Legendary stage are too much. Uninstalled as the tedium and frustration outweighed the fun after a couple months.

Playing this game feels like going to a particularly boring job. The cartoon aesthetic cheapens the 40k IP imo. I felt like I got little back for the time invested. Even the codes felt like more effort than they were worth. Content creators try to get you to download the app with their discount code, but then it wont even come close to unlocking a new character. The other thing I found disappointing is the lack of tactics. Its more about levelling up and resource mining. Yawn...

Overall very fun if you like warhammer and tactical games, all the characters are fun and unique to use, and learning how you can combo some characters to makes some great plays. There are a variety of game modes to try that are unique and unlock you different items, upgrades ect. As for complaints is the time frame to get tokens to play the game modes is a bit much, the game does increase significantly in difficulty to the point where spending money does need to be spent to power up.

Generally fun Warhammer experience with light tactics and quick combat. Not an enticing monetization model, as almost everything starts at double to quadruple the price of low end packages in other similar games. $0.99-$4.99 packages simply don't show up to encourage budget buys. The game loop demands grinding, but if you enjoy the tactics, this will not serve as a hindrance, but wait-or-pay-to-play timers will. Fantastic soundtrack and ambience, and charming chunky character models to look at.

Its a nice game, very well made, funny. My only complain is that take a lot of time to evolve without buying powerups, and its ok, but the prices are crazy, even the most basic powerup available to buy is very expensive on my country(BR), would be nice if the prices where adjusted to the country reality, like clash royale was..

Great game mechanics and tons of fun. But its a hard grind if you're free to play, and slim pickings on good deals if you're a spender. Predatory marketing and heretical pricing are the name of the game for pretty much all of the in game purchases. Pity. But expected. Still, I advocate hard for the game itself. New content, good communication from developers, and overall a fun experience with a variety of challenging game modes requiring different approaches. I'm hooked. But mostly cuz I luv 40k

I have throughly enjoyed the game so far, and the guild I formed already talk regularly within the app. Haven't hit any sort of walls yet. Update: Switched my rating to 5 stars. This game is great. I usually feel like games like this are extremely predatory, but not this one. I haven't paid a cent and for the most part I can keep up the pace. Also, being new to the Warhammer lore this game is a nice starter to show what and how these groups and units function.

Took a couple months off due to moving, would load 10... 20... 21% then crash. So I uninstalled then reinstalled the game and it brought me right back to the tutorial. All my progress gone. I wanted to play Tau, finally unlocked one, and now back to square one with Space Marines. I'm uninstalling permanently I'd they can't manage to save their users data. I feel bad for people who actually wasted money on this.

Do not download this game it is not worth your time. The developers have the most anticonsumer approach to a video game I have ever experienced. Every single aspect of the game has been monetized and any chance of catching up to current players is hopeless. From PvE events to PvP there are little to few updates besides releasing something new they will surely charge you to unlock fully. Snowprint is well know for running games into the ground and it's only time before this one goes down.

If you want to be 2 years late to a game and not be able to do anything because you're too weak then this game is for you! Oh and better yet you can't really grind out gear because you level up in the onslaught and scavenger modes and you can't even beat any enemies to get gear anymore. And then you go to the arena and everyone has 2000 more power than you, and if they are your power level it's because they are leveling up a god they unlocked for 30$.

Honestly, don't play this. They don't want you to unless you are a whale. You will not have fun as a free to play player. You get enough energy to farm 2-3 items per day. You need 6 items a day to level up a character's gear. You need like 3 of those per character level. You need 20-75 shards to level up a character to get the new gear. IT TAKES WEEKS TO DO THAT. Everything is bad so you pay. Just don't.

This is the most addictive game I think I have ever played, so proceed with caution if you value your time. The game itself is great, but it is bogged down by a lot of the tropes of modern mobile games such as: - a cluttered UI that's confusing and hard to navigate for a newcomer - a restrictive energy system - microtransactions at every corner and gacha mechanics all throughout - very uninspired writing (except for the lore which is taken from the 40k universe) - harrowing levels of grinding

Limited daily progress tries to get you to spend money, which takes away from a solid (but casual) grimdark experience. Raids are fun, campaigns are fun, and the characters feel about right for their lore. But the hard cap on progress menas you can only play the game about 30 minutes a day before you have to spend money to unlock more "energy" to play more.

Had an issue with my account and tried to recover. Told by support they would help me out and then after they took the info they needed just ghosted me. Been months now with no fix and no contact So many hours wasted in what was otherwise a great Warhammer game. Hope you all enjoy it and never experiance any technical issues or require support from the developer

Fun gameplay but they advertise in-app purchases way too much. It feels like every page is just an ad for you to spend more on in-game currency. If that's not bad enough the in-app purchases aren't even worthwhile. Some are such a bad deal or misrepresented so much that it's embarrassing. I wish I could give a higher rating but it feels more like a cash grab that panders to Warhammer fans instead of a decent game.

What can I say about a game that's been advertised to hell and back? It's boring. Very boring. The amount of shards it takes and the slow rate at which you accumulate Black Stone makes it a slog. A campaign with 100 or so missions sounds like a lot of content but when you play it and realize it's just the same stage with cliffs and razor wire reshuffled it's clear that this game only exists for one reason, to pester you for micro transactions that will add maybe another few minutes of enjoyment

Honestly I expected this to be a Clash Royale ripoff before it came out. Having played it now though it's a pretty enjoyable little mobile strategy game. It has some of the issues that mobile games typically have. It's a bid grindy and a lot of the progression is locked behind RNG lootboxes, but other than that it's pretty fun.

DO NOT GIVE TIME to that game. I gave this game a good week long try. Being a big long time Dokkan free to play player, then legends player, I am used to gatcha mechanics. You hit a pay wall really quickly. I filled up my requisition orders 3 time to get a multi. That's 3 multis where I got almost nothing. Here to the corporate masters dealing with the drop rates : if your drop rate is too low, it removes the incentive for players to give you money to summon more. Gatcha 1-0-1

It can be quite... "pushy" when it comes to advertising add-ons and purchases, but if you ignore those, you get a quick, fun time killer involving your favorite Imperium or Xenos. We don't discriminate here. With a boost of energy, you tend to get rewarded for strategic thinking, The stars of each level are tied to specific goals, which the game tells you. Overall, not bad.

Typical pay to win game. Be prepared to have your wallet handy if you hope to make any meaningful progress in this game. They lure you in with the gorgeous graphics and Warhammer 40k hype, but after some fast progress through the only unlocked campaign, you will quickly get blocked by pay walls. Energy is capped, and you will quickly drain through it. Half the ads will install themselves. This game is made to cater to whales with fat wallets, much like the IRL game. I'm disappointed in thi!

Game play is good. Real good at first. But then when you get to the middle of it you'll find out how much this game is just PAY-TO-WIN. Even at the start of your journey you'll be bombarded with bundles of factions to buy to play it. Won't recommend this game to players looking for a past time. This is just Tabletop 2.0 competitive pay-to-win game that makes no sense.

This game is horribly pay-to-win, and some of the characters are just overpowered. Those characters are the ones you have to pay for. IF you install this game and go through hours of grinding to try and get a few more heros and create a custom warband... forget about it. I spent hours grinding to get a SINGLE ØRK FOR THE ØRK WARBAND I WANTED TO MAKE, AND DA GIT WAS WEAK AS FREEK. The nice thing going for this game is that it has mediocre graphics, which is nice for a mobile game. Also... get 40k

It's a typical gacha style game where you are supposed to spend thousands of EUR to play the game as it was meant to be. If you are not a big spender, then you have a massive grind wall ahead of you that will take years of mindless re-grinding of the same levels to get a couple of shards, heroes need up to 500 of them. Then comes the gearing process that also takes years as a F2P player. Also the campaigns aka missions to get champs and gear are locked behind champs, which can be bought ofc. 1*

The game play is really fun, I enjoy the number of characters on offer, and I like the variety of game modes. The game is the most warhammer 40k experience that you can get on mobile, as the characters all feel and play very similar to their table top equivalents. As a long-time player, I have seen this game get better and better as the developers continue to support the game and patch the game regularly.

The game is fun, but the monetization is really, really pricey. There's so many different forms of play and with the cluttered UI telling me about current "deals" I sometimes get lost trying to figure out how to get back to campaigns. I'm hoping adeptus mechancius are available sometime in the future.

The game asked way too early for a rating so I'm giving it better than mid. If I could give 2.5 without playing more when they asked for a rating, that's what it would be. Plus I'm only rating this high because even though there is extremely invasive ads for purchases, I haven't had to watch an add yet. Also I get the invasive purchases, I haven't felt obligated to make one yet though which is a plus

Decent game, although i think it could use bigger and more dynamic maps, not a five star because no playable Tyranids and the progression is waayyy to simple, it's just "get thing from this other thing to make space man hit harder", or "find generic gacha tokens to get a character you'll never use". If it's just named characters and stuff it's ok, but the fights just don't carry any impact or seem to be a problem, so far it's just "aaa, more grunts, next level please".

The game is interesting. The start can be very bothersome due to the amount of paid promotions that shows up to increase the strength of your units. The game play is smooth and the design on the characters is very nice. The cash shop can be very visible if you wish to do all the variable of the content provided. For a free to play player it can seem bit over the top but if you can get past the initial start the game is very fun an awarding once you start to get more of the other factions.

The monetization in this is really aggressive, I'd be happy to spend money if the game was made around actually having fun and being a video game instead of trying to milk as much money out of it's players as possible. The gameplay is serviceable but you can tell they made something that works and focused heavily on monetization After the first stages you ain't going anywhere with your progression unless you spend money. Really sad to see them use this license like this

I've been soft locked by the tutorial. The linear nature of it means I can play the game anymore.
