Essentially I'm supposed to win 4 battles to complete the first quest, but I've only done 3 and the game will not allow me to select Anything else, I'm forced to try to claim a quest I can't complete. The easy solution is to not have the tutorials be a railroad.

Predatory AF!! this game has been meticulously designed to encourage you to spend the maximum amount of money for the smallest of dopamine rushes to keep you spending over and over again.... Any problem you have in this game be conveniently solved by over spending your hard earned money. as with most games designed to turn you into a gambling addict , well, technically you can progress without spending , but of course its going to require an insane investment of your time to get anywhere. PASS!

I have enjoyed the game so far! Love the WH40K universe, the characters and setting. I like the different types of characters and how their special abilities can be clutch if you know how to use them. It's a mobile game which is why I don't give it 5 stars... All the typical gimmicks to try and get you to spend money. I haven't yet, so we'll see where this game is in a few months.

Imagine if you will, making a game in the warhammer 40k universe.. & messing it up... there are thousands of characters, mechanics you could use, factions, worlds, I could go on.. Now.. I would pay, to customize the appearance of a character or their color scheme, even skins sure But this game is like no, to much effort, just give me money.. like trying to be on par with how expensive the miniatures or even the books are but with 90% of the content missing. Well done guys 🤌

Classic grindy "rpg", constantly shoves expensive cash purchases in your face. Very limited content, you'll run out of things to do day 1 even without spending, then all thats left is to squeeze out 1-3 of the hundreds of character upgrades you need daily. You'll quickly stall in the levels with all your dudes getting 1shot, unable to level up until you rank uo, which will take weeks. Its like 1/10th of the fire emblem mobile game, but with more aggressive monitization and a warhammer skin.

Requisition drops are BS. You save for 10 then the guaranteed character is a character that you already have and they only give you five shards for that character. That's not a guaranteed character. Other other downfalls of this game is the maps are too small to actually have any strategic value. Plus they don't do a great job highlighting areas of height or non-movable space such as walls.

Lacks mechanics ( not gotcha mechanics, there are a lot of those). It advertises as a "tactical" game but it's like most simular tactical small incremental upgrade hero based games. There is no real strategy involved, no other units besides heroe units whiles enemy has "foder" and sacrificial units. It's really sad, I was really hoping for a nice mobile RTS, but this isn't it. At least the Warhammer 40 k assets are well done.

I've had this game for a week or so and it seemed pretty alright, the art style is ugly and everything looks like a toy, for this franchise blood is very important and there is almost none of it. What rocked the boat though was an unskippable commercial that was more than 30 seconds and it was "1 out of 2" so I uninstalled it immediately before I got violated by it, well, I did get violated by the first one. I've been violated by ads so many times now I've been thinking about suing ...

Same old pay to win formula. Even if you'd consider spending money, they've come up with a perfect way to make you spend more, you're always pooled with players of similar power, so unless you're a whale, you're gonna end up having a bad time. Absolute disgrace that Games Workshop is putting their name to this sort of low effort moneygrab.

Just waiting for Salamanders. Also the cool down times for tokens is in my opinion fairly long. And the enemies difficulty jumps up very fast. So you'll have to go back and raid past missions then wait for more energy to raid some more. Don't get me wrong this game is pretty fun and has a ton of potential...just (in my opinion) could use some cool down tweeks

I am redoing my review, at first glance thought it was a Gotcha type game. It has a system of Gotcha in it but everything can be earned by playing the game. Not just grinding but by getting better at it. Every character that unlocks can be your endgame character you don't have to try and get that rare character. Every rare character you can work towards or ignore and they will just unlock with time while your repeating a level to try and earn 3 stars on it. Few games I enjoyed longer I played.

Well, I don't know what happened to me, or perhaps they made certain aspects quicker to achieve (I know they made building a character's base stars easier for certain,) but I absolutely adore this game again. It actually got me back into the lore as well, which hasn't happened in a fair few years. For the City of Light!

If youbhavent started this game, don't. recent (3-6 months) changes are showing signs of the path to ultra monetization. ads are becoming more intrusive and longer, multiple battle passes, expensive packs. not to mention I spend all my time pressing one button for materials to upgrade. THEY HAVE ALL THE WHALES THEY NEED SO NOW THEY MILK! there's no way for a normal player to catch up so don't even try.

Solid, surprisingly deep gameplay. Overall a fun game for 40k enthusiasts The pros: Ads are out of the way Really deep roster with lots of customization options Is a playable warhammer game The cons: Art style is 4kidsy which makes sense given the platform but still feels weird given the setting Ultramarine are the starting units which always feels gross Monetization is wildly expensive, and some pve is time gated behind unlocking characters you can spend 30???? Dollars to unlock

Bored of it. And it's a very greedy developer. Never in my life have I seen so many prices for stuff you don't need. The entire front page is $5 here $20 there. It's a ridiculous top down hexagonal strategy 1v1. Not worth the time or money. Just go out and purchase Space Marine 2. That game is actually worth it.

Every time I see content and pictures from this game I get excited and I try to play it again and I'm disappointed again. You're just doing the same thing over and over again and collecting the cool characters list takes forever, everything is on a timer. It's too cluttered on the main page and the interface is just confusing and jumping back in to the game after some time just feels too daunting. This game could be so much better and it's just not.

AMAZING GAME! I really enjoy how it is like playing the game in real life and how you can even play with other people. The character designs are also really awsome and I love them. New stuff is always being added so it never gets boring, and when I had an issue I contacting them via email and they responded within less than 24 hours! Fun, exciting, and my favorite game.

Even for a gacha game, the grinds are insanity; to the point that only one person (as seen on the leaderboards) in the game has any max level characters Here are my main gripes: The purchases are all on the order of $50. A purchase doesn't really improve your quality of life at all, since you will need to upgrade it many times before it's valuable. Shards and gems are required to promote characters, obviously to extend the grind on a very small character pool. List continues, character limit.

Loving the game in general. Great support for new events almost daily that keep it engaging. There does seem to be a problem with connectivity at times which is a real bummer. The app constantly stops me playing as it says I'm not connected to the internet. I've tried switching between mobile data and wifi to no avail. Hopefully the Devs see this and can work on a solution.

This game is addictive in a way that's bad and good for you, the gameplay is simple, the strategy aspect is balanced, the grind is hard but fulfilling, it gets tougher as you go but is worth it. Only complaint I have I guess is the fact that my favorite legion(Raven guard) is not the game yet(: Don't get me wrong there's a lot of factions that you can play as, you can also synergize them together to fit your own play style. I'm looking forward to new factions being added in the future.

the game is fun enough for a tabletop-strategy type rpg. i wish the in game store prices weren't so inflated, but i guess it's standard for mobile games now-a-days. i just don't buy, they don't push too hard on the purcheses.. other than that, i get occasional crashes starting up the campaign, and my phone isn't even old, so whats up with that? busy servers maybe? idk. solid 4 stars though

The most Dynamic of the Warhammer games on Mobile platform. Each character differences are vital to missions, and some are demanded for success. Lots of variety but pay attention to resource allocation as the games pace will quickly reveal shortfalls in poorly developed units. Wish there was message option to other players for recruitment. Shortfalls are game play time...I find wait between recharge to be so long it hinders enjoyment and in game item cost or improvements out of proportion.

Not too bad of a strategy game! It does get a little grindy at a certain point but i always have something to do to keep me busy. The biggest gripe I have is: What is the point of raid tickets? It eats up so much energy to raid, and yet I have an astronomical amount of these tickets that I'll never be able to use all of them because I don't get enough energy, and you need the character tokens to consistently level up your characters but then you're just simply stuck in a loop.

It's a fun game play loop with a bit of grind to it, standard Gatcha affair, but it is a bit lighter on the monetization push than alot of Gatchas I've played. Could be improved with less randomization on the character picks but otherwise a fun game to spend your time on. Would be 5 stars if you could color your characters individually, or had an option to buy a team of generic characters you could color yourself.

So for the first 60 levels of the game it's a 4 star game. But after level 60 it becomes impossible to play. They want you to spend a bunch of money on requisition drops hoping you get upgrade items you need to level up your characters and if thats not enough they have 2 battle passes, a normal one then a very exclusive deluxe battle pass lol they just want money. Then the free way is to try and find upgrade items or character cards through replaying certain missions. But it's impossible

It's the best Warhammer game I've seen and it's unplayable. I have no idea what's going on or what I'm supposed to do. Nothing is explained, you win one battle and a thousand alerts light up and you get dragged to something else. They need like five more tabs to sort everything and a glossary. What is all this stuff I'm winning? Do I need to save it? For the amount of work this game takes learn real Warhammer.

They expect a heavy investment. I played for a few months and in the beginning was spending a little and moving along but you basically have to spend over $30 a month just not to run out of the basics so you can continue to grind. Well thought out game they just are a little too greedy. Prices should be a lot lower just deleted

Honest opinion it's a fun little game so far. Bought a character (Commisar Yarrick). Nice intro offer by the way. Marine flavors are limited, Ultramarine and Black Templar. They're not my factions but i like their design. Nekrons are pretty cool. That being said designs are neat, graphics are solid and well done. Gameplay is so far enjoyable.

I love this game. I wish that every single form of playing it wasn't on a timer, though. It'd be great if there was a permanent online casual arena or a "tactics training" option. That way, you could practice using different lineups and form new strategies based on them without any kind of risk or reward besides building a stronger strategy.

EDIT Dec.6.2022- There's lots of potential. The game is fun and the unit variation makes for a fun tactical puzzle. They've added new armies and will add more. It's worth playing. The time-gating is a very punishing through. Unlocking new characters is super slow. 10-pulls for summons guarantee a character, but it is most likely one you already have, which give upgrade mats instead. They are greedy with things you buy; most of the items cost a lot for almost nothing. The legendary event is hard.

Cool game but stingy. I was able to reach the last stage of the first chapter before progression came to a grinding stop. Gacha system is expensive and is very reluctant with cool drops, mostly just filler upgrade material. What's more is the campaign is locked behind owning specific characters, which as I said before, are not trivial to obtain so that's kinda a bummer. There's a cool game in here somewhere but it is really hard to overlook the overwhelming paywalling.

It's pretty fun, but it has the same issue as any "free" mobile game where you use "energy" to embark on missions. When the energy runs out, you pay for more or just wait until it replenishes. I have only spent $10, and that was on the battle pass to see what it was like, and it offers some extra rewards, but nothing game breaking.

Pay to play but very fun. My previous review was that it was pay to play but starved for content. They've definitely added more and seem to be on track to continue adding good stuff but nevertheless it's VERY pay to play. At a minimum you'll have to get the battle pass at $10 a month to feel like you aren't completely wasting your time. But this is Warhammer so I guess it's to be expected. This game NEEDS live PVP more often than once a month for 2 days...

Probably one of the worst combat I have ever experienced. At no time is there an ounce of strategy needed in this game due to the fact that the enemies attacks are purely random. Edit: pvp is a joke and the guild wars is worse. You skip your first turn and then watch your units drop because there's no difference between setting up and not. Skipping your 1st turn will almost always be the most optimal way of going about any and all pvp. This is just disappointing to see in a "strategy" game.

Just don't. The game offers ways to earn characters, starts you off with some, and has plenty to do. Skipping days isn't punishing, aside from a pop up or two there's not constant pressure to spend money. But when you want a character that takes more than, say, 80 "shards" to unlock? Say, one that takes 250? The game will hit you with "25$ for 75 shards toward the unlock! A """sale!"""" They run events you can spend money on... To not even unlock the character. Have your fun. Spend NO money.

Unless you only want to play Space Marines, don't bother with this game. The other armies are behind massive pay walls in the form of random drops. The game also forces you to upgrade characters that you don't want in order to progress. If they make all armies playable, I'd give it another try.

Everything is too expensive and it takes too long for the average player to progess even though i've already poured considerable amount of money into this, the only reason i keep playing is because i'm a giant WH40K fan. It sucks, because this game has a lot of potential to be one of the all time classic if the devs know how to play their cards right. But right now, it's looking to be just like any other exploitative f2p mobile games out there.

As with many warhammer franchise games, it has potential, but it is unavoidably destined to fall because of some incredibly time-consuming gaming traps. A lot of grinding, even for a gacha game, complemented by extremely tedious inventories, where you have about 5 completely different ways of empowering your troops, each harder to understand than the last. The progression also slows to a halt before even finishing the first campaign, and you can't even play the other ones without luck or whaling

The gameplay is fun and the visuals are great. I'm a bit cautious as I'm not seeing a lot of generous rewards compared to many other games for new accounts. Summoning scrolls are hard to get and so is premium currency. $30 to unlock the heroes needed to play their compaign is very steep. I fear many will have their progress grind to a halt and leave and the game will fade to nothing. In short, f2p is weak and monetization is seems the main aim.

To Grindy and expensive. It started fun but the battles got reptitve as I ran them over and over for just enough gear to get 1 upgrade while I had 9+ still waiting. I did spend some money but it felt like a drop of water in a pool. And the characters. After grinding for a week to get 10 shards towards a 120 shard character, the rhought of trying to grind for a 500 shard one. No, just no. The tactical part isn't bad but the lack of gear upgrades stopped my momentum and and It got real old.

Coming from someone who strongly dislikes mobile games, this one is pretty solid. The graphics while not as grim as some 40k fans might like, look great and the gameplay is fantastic, some of the best I've seen from a mobile game. The catch however is prices in the cash shop are pretty steep and the grind is intense. Regardless if u want something with with fast paced and enjoyable game play, it's definitely worth the download

Perfectly playable game, obviously focused on either long form play to slowly accumulate the items to get and improve characters or people with a lot of money to spend to get a lot of that now Have to knock off a star for the obvious lore inaccuracies, my ultramarines lose sometimes and that just won't do, who ever heard of an ultramarine losing anything

Very frustrating gameplay that has great potential but the difficulty ramps up so high by the end of the first campaign that you have to grind your life away to eek out the tiniest of upgrades that still don't help you. The grinding doesn't even encourage you to play the game, just play the same wave defense, spam your energy away, and then get recked in PvP where pay to win reigns. I really wish I could enjoy this game, but it doesn't actually want me to play so, guess that's that.

The epitome of monotonous grind. Drop rates are among the worst I've ever seen in a gacha game. I love 40k, but this is abysmal to play. Very unrewarding, takes way too long to get the currency needed to get new characters, unless of course you just shill them $5-$20. I get it, it's a F2P mobile game, that's what they do, but Tacticus takes it too far I feel like. I really wish I didn't spend $5 on this waste of time, I genuinely feel gross for doing that. If I could take it back I would.

This game is by far the most pay to win game I've come across. First 2 and a half chapters are great but then you hit a dead stop and they want you to pay 100s of dollars to progress with getting stones for requisition drops and everything else. Games sucks. Bad on the developers for making such a game targeted towards younger audiences.

I really enjoy this game. I've been playing since the start. its awesome for 40k fans. there are a lot of pros, but I would like to mention the cons. which are, if you are not a part of a guild or free to play, it will a VERY slow grind, and you will get no where in events. also, guild raids are a joke, the absolute worst part of the game. it requires WAY too much of your time, and its not well thought out. what they use to "balance" the raids just makes it worse.

Game starts fine with lots things to do and making you engaged. After month or so you reach pay wall where you progress is minimal. I have payed and wouldn't mind paying more but prices are too high. For 3 characters you have to pay around 50€ and then improve them next month or so so they can become viable to play them. While doing so you lose time and resources to level other characters. It became hard grindfest, without several hundred euros you will be stuck at 20k rating for very long time

The good: An excellent series of single player campaigns that allow players to experiment with new tactics and factions. There is no pay wall for players with A LOT of time on their hands. The bad: Limited energy. No auto battle. A clunky UI. A truly exhausting level of grinding is required for the daily missions, making this feel like a game that should have come out 15 yrs ago. The ugly: A bizarre lack of "rate up" or selector bannners. Want to play an advertised faction? Get lucky, I guess?

The game is well optimized, runs smooth, etc. Can be rather boring, though is fun when passing time while doing nothing is the other option. Unlocking characters is RNG based and takes way too long for such an RNG feature to be rewarding. If I was able to choose what characters I can unlock, then maybe this game might be worth playing, but it ain't. (⭐️⭐️⭐️) EDIT: After playing some more I realized that on the 10-pull of req, you can pull a char you have already, despite it saying otherwise.

I've heard of Warhammer since the late 90s and never played..this is my first experience with it and it's amazing. I've only played about 30mins no ads, no wait time, just a pure turn based game. The graphics and music are amazing. the lore seems awesome. I can't wait to find out more. The art work from the home screen to the game play looks great too. Honestly really great app by the developers hats off to you.👊.

Fun game, lot of strategy involved, but so many micro transactions. or regular transactions, let's be honest. $100 is hardly micro. The game would've been better off focussing on story rather than forcing the player to spend money. If you want to be competitive, playing free is not gonna be a fun journey.

Fun and exciting for a few hours. Quickly turns into a long and mindless (or absurdly expensive) grind. Characters are $13CAD and will take months to unlock through normal gameplay. You only get 15-20 minutes of activity before everything is time- (or money-) gated. Save your money for actual miniatures or the Dawn of War games.

I don't really know much about Warhammer or anything to do with the lore of it, but the game really doesn't say much about any lore beyond the description of characters you can unlock. the game itself is nothing special in my opinion, it's a serviceable mobile game, even when I played it in like 2020 it was basically the same. if you ask me what you can do to improve the game, take all the time you take playing this game and do something more productive with it like the dishes or mow the lawn.

It's an actual turn based strategy game. It starts off pretty easy but I can tell from some of the numbers and statistics that it should get a great deal more difficult fairly soon. It's suffering from feature creep and from the free to play model, but so far I haven't found anything that scratches the itch of having an actual game that makes you think and being able to pick up and drop easily.. a must for any phone game. I like it, it's free, try it.

It was a fun pick up put down game. Until the 3rd stage of the base campaign. The swarms are unbeatable and good luck trying to beat a boss that drops 3+ swarms that can one shot all your heroes. Another Warhammer game in the bin, which is a bummer because Warhammer fans are starved for games as it is. 2 stars for the 2 playable stages.

Paywall less than 3 hours in. My units can't get any stronger until I rank them up, but I can't rank them up without extreme grinding or paying for requisitions and hoping I get the things needed to rank my units up. Can't uses more than one type of unit in the campaign either, so trying other units won't work. It's fun, but that massive difficulty spike is not worth any amount of money.

Overall fun, Progress gimped to push monetization. Obvious pay to win issues, like extra currency earning for specific packs. Problem is that progression is so slow and with long recharge times, its actually impossible to earn anything without spending money. If they let up a little bit on the monetization, this would easily be a 5 out of 5 for a mobile game.

Decent strategy game that encompasses the 40k universe. If you're not that into 40k then honestly it's only okay. Graphics and abilities are great and fun though the lack of content for now hold it back. Am hopeful though that with a decent foundation that there is room to grow. Definitely pay to win on PvP side though haven't had issues with the PvE yet.

Very nice grind, and many of the upgrade materials are IN the missions for you to raid and get. Additionally the PvP is fun and the guild material is fun to work towards. The shard amount for some of the characters are too high though, forcing you into loot boxes that never get you what you need, unless you buy $200 worth, and even then its not guaranteed, and there is no way to convert useless shards you don't need or aren't building into. Besides that, 4.5☆, the devs are really nice 👌 👍

Aspects of this game are really fun. The actual gameplay is good, the art is decent. Where this game falls dowm is the constant monetization pop up's. Exit a menu, pop up for a charector pack. Finish a quest, pop up to upgrade the battle pass. Get a new charector, pop up for an upgrade pack. It's literally non stop. Decent game ruined by stereotypical mobile dev greed.

I've been playing for a while now, and you just don't have enough energy to really do anything. One raid cost 6 energy, and at level 30 something I only have about 116 energy. The max you can raid one level is 10 times with abysmal drop rates. Out of those 10 raids, you'll get anywhere from 1-4 of whatever item you're looking for. I've got to the point where I log in, spend my energy in about min, and I log back out.

Only thing keeping this from being a five star is the woefully unbalanced Tournament arena. heavily meta dependant, as all you need to do is play Orks and wait for your opponent to move close enough to begin charging. Regardless of how leveled your characters are, if they have Orks, they're gonna win. other than that, love the game. It's a little limiting with the energy set up, and I would like to see the times shortened a bit more. not enough to lose a star, though.

So far, this game has been fun. The game play loop is repetitive but there are lots of opportunities to execute unique strategies and use units' special moves to claim victory. However, the amount of currency based interactions as simple as attaching an item to a unit makes me think that as my funds inevitably decrease as the game becomes more challenging I will have to resort to using micro transactions just to keep playing the game. So far, this has not happened but we will have to see...

Very good, obviously looking forward to seeing more units. Only thing I'd say is the option from the start to play imperial, chaos or xenos. Dont want to collect neurons along side my marines and guard, plus I know why but maybe an option to colour your chapter, ork clan, craft world etc. Otherwise does what is says on the tin and good fun. Just add White Scars, for the Khan

Changed rating to 1. Purpose driven content, that you charge for, and not even being able to progress far enough to find make the amount ofnmoney worth it. Considering the app is free, we all understand that you must make some money for it to be able to be as good as it is. But example, Mortars from guard hit like 10x harder than the guardsmen with Las guns, is basically Gatekeeping. And that's toxic. There is many more instances. But you know what your doing. I'll change my rating when you fix.

At first, it took me a while to appreciate it, considering there were five tutorial levels and a few easy ones after that. Once it got more challenging, I found myself revisiting levels and trying to take as little damage as possible. There's so many levels and characters to get through, you'll stop caring about the other distractions on your phone.

Well made and good looking game with a lot of pay walls. The game is good and gets you hooked at the begining but soon you hit walls in all games modes where there is literally nothing you can do for days or weeks until you can grind you characters slightly stronger. Right now in all the story campaigns I cannot progress due to character level, onslaught mode is too strong for my current army, arena is a mess where you get way stronger opponents then you could ever handle. It's demoralizing

It has a lot of content and a lot of game modes. However, the current energy system is extremely frustrating. The campaign and pvp energy is ok, but the the energy/tokens for other game modes are really bad. You basically get 1 token per 16 HOURS... AND that mode has 3 different "levels" that each share that single token. These levels give rewards based on which faction you want to level up. There's no other way of playing more than 1 or 2 per day meaning you have to pay if you want to progress.

Pros : the game looks nice. There are quite some freebies. Cons: the game is bugged - 'problem with server' and reward loss. With super limited attempts, it's very irritating. Also its very payment interested - that's ok, but prices of everything are through the roof. Lastly - ads play important role and all available ads are super intrusive Temu ads, that are impossible to close without clicking and going to browser.

The game used to be fair a year / year and a half ago. Developers gave free stuff and codes were plentiful, the missions were fair and you felt like you got value out of paying. Now it's completely taking advantage of players and wanting you to spend more than ever before on missions, quests and events that are impossible to finish even if you spend money on it, lose sleep over completing everything you can and grinding it out. Its disgusting and I'm feeling taken advantage of and disenchanted

They'll take your money but won't deliver items you purchase in game. I purchased a bundle for $30, Google play store said payment was successful and then the game said payment failed. When I checked my bank account to see if I was charged or not I was surprised to find out that I was charged twice despite the game telling me the purchase failed. Needless to say I didn't receive anything.

Let me start by saying the adds are "partially" fake. Not in the "bad" way, but in the sense that I was given the impression I would "build my own custom army". That is intrue. This is a freemium game. You unlock characters via a lootbox mechanic. There are 5+ different currencies/tokens/etc that you level up with. The game wants you to buy these currencies. The fun factor is a 6.5/10, and it needs a internet connection. I imagine once I hit a grind wall it will drop to a 5/10.

Fun, but the amount of things that pop up and try to get you to buy stuff to progress the campaigns is super annoying. Just like most Warhammer games on mobile, trying to grab as much cash as they can. Sucks that they really limit your progression after an hour or 2 if you want to free to play

Simply just a money grab. It's a terrible shame Games Workshop lends their sublime 40k universe for this. No fun to get unless you're willing to pay hundreds/thousands of real dollars. edit: the battles itself are fun. And I'm more than willing to pay because I know development and support cost time and money. But paying €20+ for a campaign to have a small chance of getting shards for unlocking chars is unfair. Also the lootboxes, different tokens/shards/etc to hide real money worth is shady.

It's a great game, but after a certain number of wins, the game won't let you win. Opponents in the arena that should be easy to beat suddenly become unbeatable. Medic units constantly heal themselves of all damage more than you can deal each round. Setting up an unending loop. Every time I try to unlock a new character, I get items I don't need and have never needed.

Could be a 5 star game, but you can only play like 30 minutes a day. Game does the opposite of reward you for your patience. "Guaranteed character" is a lie. You wait for weeks only to get the same character shards over and over. The core of the game is great, the pay to play they built around it sux

Decent game, fun game-play and lots of potential. For the most part you are stuck playing your ultra-nerd ultramarine characters. You can unlock other factions characters but they aren't usable in all game modes which is super disappointing. Yet another Ultramarine simulator. The sooner game creators realize we play warhammer to play with our chosen guys, and not the generic "lawful-stupid" ultramarines, the better. Overall a disappointing experience.

In the grim darkness of current mobile gaming there are only shops, rewards, energy, premium currencies, season passes, events and ads. If you manage to endure all of that, you'll eventually reach a decent enough turn based tactical game. But is it worth the pain? Also, the art direction is awful. Too much fortnite, devs?

it's fun but it feels like you don't have the best control over your characters. It feels like I can never move my characters where I want to, and many times I'll command ranged characters to attack and they'll run up 3 spaces into melee and do a far weaker attack. Very frustrating! I'm not a fan of how I can't command someone to walk somewhere then order them to attack. It's all a single command to either move or attack and half the time attacking makes your guy run into fire or barbed wire.

They erased my first review so now they get 1 star, until they erase this one of course. Cash grab game. Can technically claim to be free to play but you will never progress anywhere without spending money. Abilities are horribly imbalanced. Game is "balanced" around 1 shotting the enemy team. In 8 months of playing they have come out with the equivalent of 3/5 of a campaign. Not a new campaign, just finishing 2 existing ones. Lottery is a slap in the face every time.

The game itself is fun but unless you are willing to fork out money for characters straight off the bat you are going to be dissapointed very quickly. The rewards are a joke, and you shouldn't expect to get very far unless you keep paying. Its a pity because this could have been a very fun game but as it is now I open it for five minutes just because I do like it as a game, I slam on the paywall and close the game after a few minutes. That is not the way to lure customers

I've played since a week or two after launch and it's definitely one of the better 40k mobile games. There's definitely a paywall or grind aspect and you hit it at about a month. After that you're lucky if you get 2-3 level ups a week but there's plenty of stuff to do and the game play is fun. If you're like me and you don't have a lot of time to play the ttrpg it's a decent substitute think of it like a really limited version of kill team if you're already in to 40k, or a spec ops vs game.

The game is good but the grind to get items to lvl up characters or getting new characters is too much. You will enjoy the game for first few days and then it becomes repetitve task to grind for items. No fun in that. Please make it a bit more easy to get items and nee characters without spending loads of money.

Very good game, don't approach it as a typical gatcha game, rolls are tough to get don't rely on them, in exchange the game is VERY ftp friendly, a large number of characters are grindable, and every new character has a 2 week event where you can earn them through some pretty easy missions and just playing the game. There are some small problems and certain characters are not very accessible but I HIGHLY recommend this game, best mobile game I've played and it's not even close.

Why is this a gotcha why it's such a good game but you cant even build the army you want unless you spend a absolutely unreasonable amount of money. If I could by the units I wanted directly I would. If they would level up through grind heavy gameplay that would be fine. But spinning a wheel to play the army's I want defeats the spirit of warhammer.

The game itself is a lot of fun and it's great while you can actually play. It gets to the point where you can only play 5-6 matches every few hours. I would not advise spending any money on this game because they have artificial locks that stop you from playing anything you spend money on. The energy system they use to allow you to play the campaign is silly and boring. I don't understand why you would want people to play your game less. If it wasn't for the time gating I'd give it 5 stars.

There is no story in the campaign. Few characters, 5 or less for each faction at the moment. Also quite grindy, even after unlocking a character, it requires lots of shards and all different kinds of resources to upgrade. After a week of playing, I felt I am hardly making any progress so I just want to quit now.

If youre a new player starting or have played this in less than a year then let me save you the time. DO NOT PLAY THIS GAME UNLESS YOURE MORE THAN A YEAR IN. You will NEVER be able to catch up even with spending $200 a month. You would need atleast $500 to be able to get to mid game and even then its too late for you to catch up. The game is predatory in nature and even though its free to play, its PAY TO SLIGHTLY PROGRESS. It's not even pay to win unless you're willing to spend $500 a month.

Would be higher rating if we could choose factions without a paywall. Gameplay is good, graphics are surprisingly good. But the generic on rails story progression system is not fun and not challenging. I can only assume it it gets interesting later... But the design has so much under utilized potential early on. Then again a game like this doesn't really need merit to carry itself. I can forsee it being a longstanding and worthwhile experience to keep coming back to. A spin off could be cool.

I thought it was just another pseudo-tactical farming game where it only pretends that your choices matter. And sure — here too you have to grind for shards, and what drops for you does affect a lot of your options… but tactics and planning have a surprisingly big impact on the results. Unfortunately, it’s addictive, and you don’t even notice when the day suddenly becomes shorter because of it. So — I recommend it.

3 months and very very little progress. Some games allow you to grind but this one you must pay and pay lots to be able to get any farther than 20 percent of the low level missions. $39.00 for a 2 entry level characters and next to impossible to get any other army period. Arena matches you with people 10x your strength and after a very short time it's an endless trip to the dentist. I changed phones and tried to get access again and it didn't work

Great game but get ready to open your wallet. Can be fun for a while and with events popping here and there you can get new characters just takes a while. If you like 40k I would give this a try for sure. Not 5 stars as I have encountered a game breaking bug in the arena where if you attack Scarab summons your characters doing so anything and you can't skip the round forcing you to retreat and forfeit points for leaderboard position. This cost me points in the season and rewards.

Game asks for 100+ euros to play all the content. It would be a good mobile game, even great maybe, if it wasn't that the free to play progression is straight up not possible. Content is locked behind having characters which you can not realistically unlock without paying money, and a big amount too. Just a game aimed at catching whales and not made for normal players,not even those willing to spend a little

I often try to stay away from mobile games because of the typical, "Come back in an hour or two while we upgrade this one building," design trope that only helps to feed gaming addictions. Glad to say that Tacticus simply takes an inverted approach! "Dude, you've no Energy or tokens leftover to stomp on other players or play the campaign - and you've exhausted your means of getting more (for now). Take a break." And they say "Heresy grows from idleness..!" XD

The core gamelan loop is great when you strip away the monetization. The strategic elements within each mission are engaging and varied. However, the fact that requisition scrolls don't reward hero shards 100% of the time is a huge issue. Sometimes they drop an arbitrary upgrade currency instead which you need to ascend heroes above uncommon status. These same orbs hardly drop from anywhere else. All of the currency needs rebalancing. I spend more time raiding and using menus than in missions.

Oddly addictive. That's a good thing. There are some typical gotcha systems that you'll be familiar with if you've ever put time into a "pull" mechanic. My only complaint is the complexity of the resources, characters, shards, etc. They're all stuffed into a "Read Me" journal system. It's reminiscent of having to read lore cards for an MMO like Destiny 1 but required to understand each function. Worth the time and possibly money of you like strategy games that don't apply too much seriousness.

I played galaxy of heroes for a lot of years. This game is totally different. It does not fill you with tasks to do all day or overload you with events and things you will miss. It is also WAY cheaper and I am having a great time gearing my team, even if it's not meta, I'm doing fine when climbing arena. Every time something bad happens, people get compensation, not like other games. Whales cannot whale their way buying everything, very hard to farm and gain energy. I'm liking it a lot.

This game is incredibly grindy even for a mobile game. Micro transactions are also one of the most expensive I ever saw. If you use money to try and breach the gap between new and old players, your effort will be invalidated by the next patch. Development team blatantly stated that fan's favorite mode will not be continued because the return on investment is simply not there. Not even WH40K and the really nice design of the characters can redeem this game.

The game play is fun, but your either guna grind like a second job, or buy crates that have slim to no chance of giving u what u need or want, they really want you to sink money in the game to advance. Unless u grind the same thing over and over again to try to unlock a single character. And by that I mean, for 80 tickets for a black templar u may only gain 1 or 2 each battle so 80 to 40 times for that character but then u have other characters worth 250 or worse.

Fun game but when you load it up it is full of pop ups to buy expansions and characters and all that junk. The UI is just a mess and that's why I uninstalled. It's fun but when you also finish a match I had 5 pop ups for in game purchases, you click in the wrong button at the bottom of the screen and it is FULL of in game purchases.

I used to really enjoy this game but recently the game has been increasingly buggy and freezing up every time when a battle ends, and when I added my Google account to back up my progress so I could reinstall the app and possibly fix the issue, the game was still acting up and I lost my months worth of progress and characters. Fix your game Snowprint.

Was fun but becomes wildly unbalanced very quickly. The amount of upgrade paths muddy up the accessibility. Art style makes it difficult to tell certain elevation changes which scre up a lot of your attacks that you would think would work. Majority of characters do not have a clear way of unlocking outside of random loot drops which would be fine if a lot of the different game modes require specif characters. This leads to half the game being inaccessible without and insane amount of dumb luck.

I get there's only so much you can do on mobile, but this is really a hero game, and with a strategic 40k game I'd much rather command legions. also don't like that I can't pick my starting army, wasn't willing to play until I got more familiar with the imperium of man through space marine 2. otherwise, it's fun I guess.

Hard and hellish grind for f2p players. After playing this game for a week I noticed that collecting resources for heroes gacha is very slow. On top of that, a lot of game modes required certain heroes to be playable. It's hard for new players to enjoy full experience without spending money. Generic p2w game like any other Warhammer mobile games.

Its what if warhammer and heroscape had a child with a crippling gambling addiction. The game has like 10+ currencies where the way to earn them isn't clear so you feel pressured to spend to progress. Also a begginers 1 time purchase pack for just under $30 with random contents? Really? Also loot boxes where you can't even pick your favorite faction to play. If you're a fan of strategy, 40k or the customization it offers irl, go elsewhere this is an insult to you, your time and your money.

This absolutely is a fun game, yet still very limited in heroes to choose from! As an avid Games Workshop fan and Black Library/Warhammer-lore reader, I am always on the lookout for games that do justice to that genre. This certainly is a pleasant game. Yet the selectable heroes (only 40 as of date) is way, way, waaaay to limited to really do justice to the huge universe of Warhammer 40k! So game Devs: step up and add some more selectable heroes please (at least 200-400?!).

My go-to time waster that doesn't let me waste enough time. Tacticus is a game I play daily. The game itself is enjoyable for Squad building, the core loop is fine, and typical for hero collection gacha titles, I'd argue at least more fair in the gacha gamba portion. The game does fall short however in how gatekept the content is, lots of heavy requirements to upgrade with little balance to keep you playing for extended timeframes, and events are hard to win due to progression drag.

I downloaded this yesterday and played it for a couple hours tonight while I watched TV. I've already ran out of stuff to do and advance without having to pay. I know they have to make money, but that pay wall hits wayyyy tooo fast. I don't even know if I like this game yet or how most stuff works. There's not a lot to this game so far and I don't see it being worth it after hitting a stopping point unless I pay after a couple hours of play. Takes all the fun out of it immediately.

i spent well over a year, maybe 2, to max out a single character, to finally feel like i made some progress, win in pvp at least half the time. then a whole new upgrade level unlocked, months more of farming and struggle. i didnt even try it, im disgusted. the game is old enough, that wasnt needed. its a money grab from people like me who want to stay on top but have ridiculous amounts of money to spend, in game purchases are ridiculously priced. it costs then nothing to produce this currency...

4star original: You know, it's not terrible. Definitely close-holding the summons. There is definitely a LOT of monetization going on. And expensive ones. UPDATE: 2-STAR now. Definitely hit a hard paywall around campaign 52. Enemies are incredibly strong. Characters do not advance as much and materials for upgrading are further ahead of where I can go. Really pushing you to just pay money to get through and advance. Pvp is pointless, all top players have dumped a ton of money just to... What..?

This is definitely the ultimate Warhammer 40k experience for your mobile! The community is super friendly and the developers are constantly trying to improve the game. Graphics are very clean and neat, and the gameplay is easy to learn, but you are often discovering new synergies. You'll certainly do better if you spend some cash on it, but it's definitely free to play viable.

There's an audio bug right now. There's this audio cue that I've earned something, but if I click on any other part of the interface it plays constantly until I close and restart. Otherwise, this is a pretty good game. The energy economy is brutal and clearly meant to make you buy Blackstone. In fact, it's pretty much all pay to win. But if you don't care about that, you can have fun maybe twenty minutes out of the day with this.

the game is fun and all but in multiple occasions you are forced to use the (Bad) starting three units only against enemies that can 1-3 shot all of the starting three making the later level a loop of using the blue capsules, making 1 wrong move and having to restart the mission and doing the same thing over and over again making the loop unfun and only making me not want you play nor put time into the game.

So far it's been a fantastic, easy going game. The only gripe I may have is the apparent difficulty in acquiring other Faction members, which by proxy makes unlocking campaigns other than the Indomitus either tedious, or cost money. For example, the octarious campaign requires you to unlock three members of the Orks Faction, which is either rng/tedious, or costs you about $30 USD.

Love this game, but I noticed after the latest update I'm having trouble finding items in the requisition forms of my guild, I'll tap on the item to locate it but it's always blank on where it's located and have had to manually search for them which after awhile gets pretty tedious. It'd be greatly appreciated if this bug was fixed.

PLEASE FIX THIS BUG I don't know if it's strictly an Android experience, but frequent lag and the app abruptly closing out tends to be a huge pain in the neck, especially when you are deep into a campaign, during onslaught or a raid because at that point you lose all your progress and don't get back the attempt you just wasted. It keeps happening, literally the only complaint I have but quite a substantial one. It's beyond frustrating and a huge waste of time at that point. 😬

Game is fun, have even dropped some cash on it. However, customer support seems to be an issue. I created a ticket using their programs and have had only the auto reply that the ticket was received. No way to follow-up and if you reply to the email I've read it restarts your place in the queue.

You click on any of the ads within the game to refresh a timer or complete a mission and the ad traps you in some ridiculous preview for another mobile game that you cannot exit and never ends. You're stuck in a loop and have to exit the entire game and restart everything. The notification to "do something" also stays constantly active making you think the mission page has something important when it's just a prompt to watch another broken ad.

Game is alot of fun. Good use of tactics combat. Some things need to change, mainly cooldown/cost of missions. To much energy per mission and to slow of a recharge for events and energy. Cutting regen time down on events by half if not more would be necessary if I was going to spend anymore then maybe 30min a day on it. Also more than one (very small) energy refill by ad would be welcomed. Once you reach lvl 16+ the MASSIVE slow down in character acquisition is deeply frustrating.

Faction of choice behind paywall. I was also playing the tutorial campaign and couldn't 3-star the 3rd Necron boss. I looked up pointers online only to find everyone else had the same problem. Unless you're willing to drop at least $30 for the CHANCE of getting different characters (or are extremely lucky with the free lootboxes) you're going to be playing as the Ultrasmurfs for a long time. I want to play as the Death Guard Chaos Space Marines, but oc most of their characters are rare drops.
super fun every level. constant player evolution and a very cool story. I love it and I'm hooked.
its not pay to win for the campaigns and horde mode.

A fantastic rendition of Warhammer combat to a fast paced, intuitive mobile game. My main and rather large gripe is with the progression. It is a c r a w l to make any real progress in this game compared to most other games on the store. Pulling currency is stingy, and many dupes are needed to advance at all. As well as literal weeks of daily mission grinding to advance only one or two stages in the campaign. Unfortunately, the gatcha and flow of progression ruins an otherwise fantastic game.

I’m a new Warhammer fan, and this game definitely delivers on the fantasy of bringing down the hammer of justice. The combat loop is satisfying, and there’s a real sense of progression as you watch your enemies tremble. The standout feature for me is the artwork. The aesthetics are incredible and truly capture the grimdark atmosphere I look for in these games. My only real gripe is the heavy focus on microtransactions, which takes away from the experience a bit. Overall, a fantastic mobile title
not bad, it is quite enjoyable. however I'd like to unlock other factions instead of the ultramarines.

Pretty good game so far. My only peeves with it is that there's not enough abilities to use per character; three is not enough, in my opinion. Another thing is content; there should be more campaigns based on all the characters that we have. Also, where are the gosh darn Grey Knights! How can I purge heretics, xenos, and daemons without the Grey Knights lol.

Really cool gameplay and models for heroes. Easy to get into and pass the time with. On the other hand, predatory business more with progression MASSIVELY slowing after the dopamine hit wares off favouring pay to win style setup to go any further with some levels. Enemies are a legitimate challenge where you have to employ actual tactics but some levels pit you against BS enemies and unfair starts as artificial difficulty, limiting actual tactics, anti player bias etc. Not fun after awhile.

Fun turn-based play, with lots of game modes. Grinds to a halt, though and turns to pay-or-wait system to progress. Technically the single player campaigns don't make you wait, but around level 70 or so they become so difficult that you have to level your characters to continue. Then you either do a handful of side-quests or pvp duels per day or you pay lots of money. Level 70 sounds like lots of free play, but you complete each level in 2-3 minutes

This is my favorite 40k mobile game so far but I just want to say that we have to wait way to much. If you wanna get tokens to level your characters you have to play onslaught, but you only get 3 tokens for onslaught and they take over 8 hours each to regen so you can play it again, and the tokens aren't per faction so you basically have to pick which faction you wanna level maybe 2 characters in a day and this is a problem with all the game modes.

Edited: requested a refund for deceptive practices this was such bs. This is the worst pay wall ive ever encountered. You speed through the first part so fast. Setting a great pace! Then you run smack into needing orbs which you can battle for in 12 hour increments, 1 at a time. Or you can buy them oh, and its 30 per campaign. So yeah.

I mean. Judging the game by itself yeah it is fun and takes some strategy in the later stages and it feels good to unlock characters without need to pay real cash. However, as a WH40k fan I would've appreciated if it wasn't a reskin of another game which I do not remember the name right now, but it was a medieval fantasy game, Tacticus only added a few mechanics here and there.

It's fun to pass the time for a while. And by that i mean figuring out the UI. What an absolute maze. The game itself is quite meaningless. You just press a bunch of buttons for arbitrary upgrades and level-ups. Then at some point you stop auto-winning battles and it essentially becomes pay-to-continue. No sense of achievement, just a chaotic mess.

Very addicting and surprisingly satisfying gameplay. However, it's VERY grindy and the progression after your first week or so slows down exponentially. It can seem painful on purpose to drive you to microtransactions, which are pushed but not annoyingly so, but it makes it all the more rewarding when you finally get and level your favorite character. The game has very active devs who provide in-depth updates and seem invested in the game and it's community, which is rare these days, so respect.

Game is good. Gameplay is solid but character progression is broken. - You need orbs to level up your characters - You need play onslaught missions to get orbs - To level up 5 characters (10 orbs each, 50 total) while a single mission only gives you 1 (sometimes none) - The missions gets harder the more you complete them - Meaning the game gets harder faster than you level up - Now you're stuck with low level characters and gears with no way to level them up

Pretty good so far, with one exception; it concerns the Premium and Ultimate pass program. I've purchased both on multiple occasions, but every time you do any updates to the game, my purchase of BOTH passes is WIPED OUT!!! As a result, I've had to spend my very LIMITED funds to replace them. As someone who is primarily F2P, how can this MISTAKE be resolved?

Love the game, great gameplay, and the strategy of the game is spot on. My only complaint is how much of a grind it feels like to level up characters, only because there's a limit to certain missions like onslaught, salvage runs, campaign and the arena. And don't get me started to the arena. Until you get your characters to a certain level I won't even bother unless to fulfill the daily missions.

Trash game. Pay to make any real progress. I tried to force my self to play it and do everything for 3 weeks, I got to make 2 *10 pulls and it looked like the rewards were scripted, the "rare" seemed to be the common characters that every new player had... The pvp was full of new ppl which says a lot, not many ppl stay to play this trash of a game

still on day one but very intriguing so far. five man squads, hex grid, upgradable characters and abilities, seems to be a developed endgame and an online community, but I've only skimmed. definitely freemium, but it doesn't yet seem to be too overbearing, and one review said even money isn't a guarantee of desired drops. seemed like a good number of long term players and I'd expect 40k players to not be hesitant in voicing their discontent if it were shoddy

Was excited to get into this alongside the new PC game coming out, but man. Every. Screen. Change. Is. Microtransaction. Ads. So intrusive, needlessly greedy, and frustrating. If that doesnt bother you, im sure its fun backed by a killer IP. But theres plenty of other tactical games that respect the player as a player and not just a wallet.

This game gets a 1 star solely because of the over-monetization and exploitation of the microtransactions in game that nearly forces you to use real money to progress or obtain new characters. However, there is a wide variety of characters, factions, and abilities that become available through the progression of the campaign missions and a fair bit of idle grinding each day to level up characters. Each character gets a paragraph or so of backstory with the missions also giving bits of lore.

Huge difficulty spikes designed to make you pay money for RNG drop pods for gear to proceed if you don't want to grind for days to get enough gear to beat the level, only to repeat the loop again after that level. Arena is a joke, always matched with people either way over me or way under me. Usually 2-3 wins in a row, then 5-6 losses in a row, repeat. Fun for a while, got easier in game after I spent money. Haven't spent money in a while and it's spiked hard mode again. Don't waste your money.

I'm glad more characters were added, but I really dislike the limited energy/tokens that keep me from playing once they run out. If progression is going to be this grindy and slow, it's ridiculous to limit how much you can play per day. It makes the game feel more like a free trial of a larger pay-to-play/win experience.

Is it a pay-to-win? Yes — but it’s still a lot of fun. The game has plenty of enjoyment and skill required, plus constant updates that keep it fresh. They must make money somehow. You can grind to get around the paywalls, but it’s definitely a huge grind wall. That said, the design, gameplay, and animations are really cool. I think it’s worth spending $5–10 on a good game. DEFINITELY RECOMMEND!

Amazing game for a mobile, I came in expecting an ad-filled cashgrab but was pleasently surprised. There's virtually no ads in the game, the only ads are ones you opt into watching and aren't in your face or required for progression. The premium currency is fairly obtainable without spending a cent. My only complaint is the lack of Adeptus Mechanicus units, praise the Omnissiah!

Great game, if you have thousands of dollars to spend. Progression is locked behind enormous paywalls. Even spending big on this game, don't bother reporting bugs, the 'customer service' will deride you and just call you confused, if they reply at all. Stick with your physical minis over this - the cash grab so grandiose that it would shock even EA and Bethesda.

First week, enjoying this game a lot. It's a hex-tile, turn-based strategy game. Your squad of up to 5 characters against the board. The gameplay is fun if you like that. Most of the game is just new levels, new locations, upgrading characters, upgrading equipment, unlocking new characters, etc. If you like the gameplay, sit back and enjoy! If you want to speed all that up, get out your $. There is a "PVP Arena" but it's not real-time against other players. More $ will make you better there.

If you love the Warhammer 40k franchise, then this particular game will not disappoint. It is quick enough you can play a battle in minutes, yet addictive enough to keep you playing for hours. I have just started playing, but it looks as though many of the different 40k races are represented and unlockable for play. Super fun so far and while playing for play looks like it will unlock game elements quicker, it is not necessary to still have fun and be competitive vs other players.

More Pay-2-Win shops than game, pretty much everything links to a shop. Pretty sure you could buy a top of the line PC and every console plus games for the total cost of the what they have in the shops. Servers appear to be offline a lot. Crashes repeatedly. Performance is garbage (even tried on BlueStacks for hopefully better performance). There's absolutely no community from what I've seen. It's just another pay2win pvp arena game.

This game has the worse pay 2 win system I've seen so far. After you play for a while you will hit a ridiculous pay wall. You can't unlock new campaigns because you don't have enough character and the character summon is very expensive compared to the insignificant rewards you get by completing missions or whatever. I would've given it 5 stars because i love the warhammer universe and the gameplay is actually nice.

It's very fun at first, but unless you're lucky with your requisitions/gachas, you may very well be spending no less than $13 for a 3 character team... which you need to play other stories. The story begins to slow down heavily after you've unlocked your starting 5 characters. It plays like Front Mission or Final Fantasy Tactics, but not like the actual WH40k game. Still, good story. The game doesn't stop being fun after it slows down, but you will find yourself waiting a bunch.
best game I've ever played on the phone! I would love to see a grey knights or carcharadon faction 🫶
The only mobile game I like. Surprisingly enjoyable even for completely F2P players, in fact 99% of "deals" are laughable value proposition.

Typical gocha game. Just a money grab with boring combat and a huge paywall. Boss fights are poorly designed and there is not much more strategy than make your characters more powerful. Very low brow ideas crammed into a warhammer costume. So many little cut scenes for just opening one chest, it makes the game take forever just to collect your dailies. Good luck finding anyone near your level on the arena, Completely impossible, you have to refresh 50+ times and waste your blackstone.

I personally really love it. I work In a factory and when on breaks it's a nice stress reliever and helps the day go by I love 40k listen to the books and lore while I work. I wish the Crimson Fists were in the game but I know that's a big if they ever will be. personally I give the game 5/5 on gameplay 5/5 on features 3/5 on drops you always get a lot of the same thing and never garunteed a new character which I get it how they make their money but I could see it annoying if your a f2p player

Best brand-IP mobile game. The game has lots to do, requires strategy, and represents the tabletop game and lore fantastically. The Devs are super hands on and generous. Guild communities are great. Yes it has the typical micro transactions associated with this type of game but you can get a lot of play out of this game as free to play. Progress isn't strictly tied to spending money, but the season passes and monthly Blackstone shipments (daily premium currency payout) are well worth it.

Very fun game. Slightly intrusive with how often it shows you packs to buy characters and items with real money, and it can get a bit grindy after a while, but the gameplay loop is great entertainment and the models are amazing for a mobile game so I don't mind all that much. Leagues of Votann faction update someday, perhaps? I can dream...

I'm going to hold off on giving it a 5 star review. I'm not saying it's awesome because it is. It's fast and quick pace and easy to pick up and learn. It takes the fast paced action of 40k kill team and puts it in your hand. Through, later up dates I can't wait to see what they add. I like the introduction of shorten seasons which is a fun way to grind. I may have to see what rewards will be offered. Right now I don't see a Google play save option. So if the game gets deleted.. I don't know.

Do not download, play, or spend any money on this if you dislike waiting on energy timers and bad balancing. After a couple of months you will have gone as far as you can in the campaigns, and the arena system becomes unplayable as most people drop down in the leagues on purpose and you will only have battles with players with characters orders of magnitude higher in leveling than your own and at this same time the amount of resources needed means you run out of energy for playing very quickly.

dont play, When I downloaded this I was under the impression I could start as any faction, but you have to start ultramarines. also its getting way to crowded, just way to much going on, shame its waisted potential. instead of focusing on actual game play they only update things to click when you open the screen and things to buy, game play never changes in positive ways, UI always changes for the worst.

Edit: At first I gave 5 stars. Fast non-stop action..new game modes, full of energy all the time, more than you can spend. And than it slows down..dramatically. Some game modes take forever to be able to play, once you stuck on a mission, farming can take days, slow progress. Arena would be fun but it gives opponents with much higher strenght etc.. I love warhammer and the graphics and the style and the universe itself but..this game is good but far from perfect. At least no ads!

The game could be amazing (if repetitive) if it wasn't for it crushing half the time which, if you know anything about this game, can cause very bad issues on your and your guild's progress. What's worse is that they don't seem to care much fixing it and such issues are relatively old. Other than that as others have said it's more pay to win although not absolutely imo but the priced are indeed beyond ridiculous, which I find funny considering what you pay for, is what you lose due to crushing.

The game lost it's fun. Seen better drop rates with warframe and monster hunter. As another note, I have an inactive guild now. Had 25 people now down to me. Everyone practically left due to the game being boring. I recommend not to get into the game and waste time. I have now spent like 3 months trying to unlock Celestine and sadly only have half of what she needs to unlock her.

Same stuff as all the other games. The games is good, then there is an overengineered system of tokens, crystals, assets, points, tiers, levels, stages, diamonds, coins that you can upgrade, merge, ascend, empower, enchant, level up, exchange, spend, whatever. All of it designed to tickle your brain's reward center just enough to buy ar least one of them for an outrageous price. But I guess that's just the state of mobile gaming rn.

Obviously set up to make money yet the amount of codes they give out for free stuff is wonderful and refreshing. Fun as hell regardless yet its kinda dumb that you only get so many ads a day for the whole game. Nowhere was it stated if you watched X amount of ads you would max out and not be able to watch any more, even if it has to do with your energy compared to refreshing the daily store for gear.
it's gotten better not as of a pay wall. seems you get better prizes if you pay still

As much as I am an addict to the 40k seireis when I first saw this game I was over joyed with excitement but later on the experience it starts to get boring and very hard, their are a lot of things about the game that's annoying so I'm bout to list them. 1. The boss fights are very hard and can one shot your heros instantly. 2. There are these annoying bugs that duplicate themselves, get to chapter 3 and youl see what I mean. 3. It tells you to deploy 3 heros atimmaticly. Don't recommend it.

Updated review 2024. This game has become too time consuming. It takes an average of 90 minutes per day to complete basic stuff despite reducing the number of arena games and playing on the highest animation speed. Bad things. The constant battle pass and multiple special events that never give you a chance to relax.

This game is designed to get your wallet out period. there is nothing micro about these in-game transactions. You're better off buying a gaming rig or taking your money to a casino than getting sucked into a pyramid scheme like this.
honestly, I wasn't expecting such a good game, as a Warhammer fan, I quite enjoy this game

I think you have a wonderful game, graphically, musically, with great content and game play. What you don't have is customer service. I have had an open ticket for over two weeks to resovle losing my account despite having spent money on the previous account. Paypal can easily find the account yet I haven't heard back from you. So I guess that is an okay to have Paypal take my money back, correct?

It starts out really good. About half way through the first campaign it becomes noticeable that you'll have to pay to win. Typical. Also, the massive amount of some materials for upgrades is ludicrous. The system is also rigged to give mass amounts of only 1 character material, example: Angrax is constantly pulled yet I never use him or want to use him. Will be deleting and not recommending if the imbalance isn't fixed soon

Tacticus as a hole is one of the most fun iPhone games I've played, but it has it's faults. The game play is fairly good and addicting. The music is a 6/10. As someone who doesn't typically like multiplayer, the multiplayer is great. For clarification, you don't actually play against other players in multiplayer, rather other people's accounts. My issue with the game is the difficulty curve. I've been stuck on part 5 for so long that I stopped playing Tacticus a month ago, and missed advents.

Has potential. The early stages of this game has shown me that the Summon units are overpowering in competition. All major teams I have been facing are comprised of Summonner units. The grind seems rougher than galaxy of heroes. Each unit requires well over 1000 shards total with additional resources anyway. It's not a month old yet but it's been fun so far.

It's not a terrible beginning for a game, but it becomes very repetitive very quickly. Every battle is trivial or impossible with little in between. Over all it just feels like maybe 1/10th of the content of a proper game, which makes it more irksome that they take every opportunity to sell you the other little tidbits for outrageous sums.

Turn-based squad game play is fine and the graphics are well-adapted for the platform, but the downright predatory pricing for pay-to-win and gatcha mechanics would probably make this subject to anti-gambling enforcement in saner jurisdictions. When you unlock a character the game asks for ridiculous cash to autolevel it up, probably saving a game week.

From an unbiased point of view (a person who isn't a Warhammer fan), I can tell you the game is bad, terrible, the animations are good, the gameplay is fun, but the economy is horrible, getting new units and building teams is impossible without real money, so don't waste your time
one of the best mobile games I've played, especially if you are a fan of Warhammer 40k

This game is awesome. They have made a perfect balance of strategy and RPG action. the developers actually listen to the Huge community and are always updating and adding to the game. Top 3 Best Mobile games ever, in my opinion of course. My favorite thing is that pretty much everything and every character can be earned or bought. it's worth at least trying out for a few hours at least.

Phenomenal 40k game with constant updates and new content. The devs listen to the player base and consistently communicate effectively. The game is very grindy, but rewarding. Yes, it has it's faults like the low rate on the drop pods for new heroes, but ya know what, the game is still great. Thank you for making such a great, simple, little 40k game.

Everything overly priced and from getting 3 stars on every level to suddenly barely being able to win is a bit of a sheer cliff. Makes the game feel almost pay to win when you go from easily winning to almost dying and the mission after is just basically an instant loss. Makes me unmotivated to play this game more and defintely doesnt make me want to waste money when id just have to spend more to do the same thing the next time it would happen. Id give this 0 stars if i could.

Great idea and fun concept. I love the lore added into the game and the mechanics. However, the pvp is bull and this is a for sure pay to win game. You will be left behind if you do pay to keep up in pvp. You want ads for loot boxes, well this game has loot boxes. This game has ads for you to spend you money on. All I am is saying if you want to play against the a.i cool, pvp? You need to spend some hard cash to win and be competitive Overall a fun game, just the game favors you if you spend $
peak so unique fun and is f2p although skower long grind if you dont spend
game is fun and pretty easy to get into, as long as you don't mind pop up's for booster packs or character packs

The cap for players is at Campaign 1 Misson 70. That's where you'll run into a hard stop if you are attempting to F2P it as the upgrades necessary to upgrade your characters are there. Also, supremely irritating are the "buy me" stuff that was placed before the free daily stuff in the so called shop. Don't know why they could have stacked them together and made it a sideways scroll through instead of individual ones. In its current form this game is mediocre.

One of the better games of its type that I've tried, with a lot more actual tactics than the average "collect and level up characters for battles" game. The different types of battles and regular events also keep things varied. Like any game with "pay to advance faster than if playing for free" features, the "funbucks" are super expensive (compared to say buying Steam games), but the advertising for them isn't too intrusive and "paying to win" is not a big issue (unlike some games).
very fun! Love 40k and this game fills the craving . Lots of rewards

This is a fun game but could do with more campaigns for the newer factions. Currently there are 7 which means you can only reliably get characters for 7 factions. If you want to play a specific faction you might have to grind through a lot of lootboxes which nobody finds fun. Not to mention that the campaigns are the only source of the rich 40k lore and the sole way to scratch that narrative itch.

Huge money grab. Its obvious from the beginning, but it was fun enough. Gets too repetetive, too quick. After unlocking around 30 heroes with one in the high level 20s, it becomes too much of a grind, which wouldnt be bad if you were able to grind without waiting hours between each sesssion unless you spend money. Each character unlock is at random with VERY low chances unless you spend cash. And none of it is cheap. Theres more that I cant fit. It's a mobile game using GW's buisness strategy

a massive cash grab and grind to get the best out of your characters. the game is geared up to make you open it every day to get to so-called bonuses, missions, but you just run out of things to do due to limited energy and tokens within 15 minutes. The in-game prices are disgusting! The new battle pass is well overpriced.

The usual problem... You can get so far then you hit the paywall. Blackstone's are needed to get items and they are really needed to get character drops however, the amount you are given in the game is ridiculously small (1 to 3 for completing a task), you need 3000 to do a guaranteed character drop or you need 10 scrolls which cost Blackstone's or you get one per level gained. I've been playing since global launch but I have only got four more characters than I started with, time to uninstall.
It's a pretty good game. That is what it says in the tin. Nice time killer, and if you are into a warhammer, then get it

Enjoying the game with its strategy elements and team options, but feel like you have to spend money to progress through the game without many frustrating hours grinding through the same missions to obtain level up items. I'm still enjoying the game, especially as a warhammer 40k collector. Looking forward to what the developers do next.

It's definetly a pricey p2w but it's warhammer so it's still fun and you can have a good time even without paying. Real time pvp has too short a timer to think. EDIT: After 300 pulls and getting none of the characters I want I am lowering rating from 3 to 1 stars, the game is already a grind without making it impossible to get characters you need/want

The game feels fun during the first three chapters of the starting campaign. But you hit a very, very obvious pay wall after that. The pacing slows down massively and You can't unlock additional campaigns unless you have 3 specific characters from those factions, which means you have to get lucky on the lootboxes.

I don't write reviews but the developers helped me restore my account extremely easily when I got a new phone and downloaded it with nothing there. That being said the game play is fun but it's a mobile game. Expect only about a hour of play a day. It's not perfect as some rewards and things of that nature can be better but it's not at all bad and not pay to play.

Great game, very addictive, there is pay to win but you can achieve the same results without spending money and the progression is steady. it starts out fast but then tapers off and stays at that rate. there's a few hours a day of gameplay if you don't pay so it's a good free time killer but won't demand you open it every 10 minutes to keep up. highly recommend

The game is good. A little too easy in the beginning for my taste, but it handles it well. It teaches step by step how the player should play. It is a fun and entertaining game.
