The cons: the only bad thing, and it is worth - 2 stars is the predatory monetary system. You can profit from a game without ripping off your players. Don't be Diablo Immortal, that's all I'm saying.

Recent game changes have now made the game more pay to win. Lots of grinding and requires a lot of time to complete all game modes. The grind has become boring and the game is not as good as it used to be... While they have reduced the rewards slowing down progress even further... Shame the new owners want to just make more money and not create a good game!

I think this game has a lot of potential and room for brilliant event surrounding the guild you can basicly build with friends as I have with 15 players, the downside is the stamina stuff you need to play missions I get its to ballance games but it's always annoying then having to wait but I get why it's a thing too. I pre registered for the game but never got my rewards sadly but other then the odd bits and pay walls if you want stuff faster, otherwise you can get stuff by grinding.

This game is fun, the gameplay is solid, characters offer enough to be unique, and there doesn't seem to be a major pay wall. That being said I do have some minor complaints. I feel how much they are charging for some of the in store items is way to high, I'm cool with supporting the devs of mobile games but not when you are talking as much money as they ask for with how little you get in return. My second gripe is how long it takes for things to recharge, just needs lower wait times really.

the game is really fun and unlike other similar games, I haven't gotten bored and dropped it. The game devs are constently changing and improving things while also adding to the abundant amount of thing already available. At the time of making this review I can't complain about much other than that Gibascapz needs a damage buff and a couple characters abilities should definetly be revised, such as yazigour and thaumacus and that the mythic machine of war abilities need to be completely revised:)

Gorgeous game and fun but hit the pay wall at battle 60. Less rewards at 45 and believe me you hit that battle fast. They start you off strong with all these levels ups and rewards then pull the rug out. Pretty much every page has a list of microtransactions. Disappointing but this could be great if you have a lot of money to burn.

Fun game for the first bit. Once the introductory freebies drop off u should drop this game... I can't give it one star cuz there are actually lots of interesting mechanics and cool abilities in the game, shame It feels like you're actively punished for leveling up your characters though. The currency needed to upgrade past lvl 7 changes and is extremely hard to get. 1-2 tokens in the mission that gives them and you get only 1 energy for said mission every 13hrs!!? No thanks!

This game sucks ALOT and for the wrong reason! Pros: large variety of characters, game play isn't to hard to understand, and so far the characters have no bad designs. Cons: It's unfair when it comes to gaining new characters, Ten times worse for the campaigns you only gain 5 tokens for every boss fight, Energy system for EVERY mode, VERY EXPENSIVE In app purchases make grinding and gaining characters Ten times harder, Leveling them up is even worse. Not for minimum wages, Wouldn't recommend 👎

was fun for the first few months. The developing company (Snowprint) does not care about player satisfaction or enjoyment, they are completely focused on profit. If the game was not 40k themed I would not have began or played, the core mechanics and gameplay are mind numbingly repetitive and simple. Almost anything else is a better way to spend your money and time.

The game is very fun when you can actually play it , otherwise expect to pay your earnings to play the rest of the game or grind your way for the next year and a half just to unlock the rest of the game on top of that they have a battle pass system but you can barely level it up unless , once again you pour lots of your money into the game the Heretics behind this scummy pay wall need to be purged by the Emperor's light .

My rating is based on the pay to win mechanics of the game. Recently there was an event to unlock a legendary character that was up a month or two ago. You're forced to compete in a solo ladder and the difficulty progressively gets harder to impossible. The only way to take advantage of unlocking the character is by pumping money into your account since this company doesn't even reset the ladder each event. So if you cap out, next time around you'll be in the same place & unable to progress.

Updated Review. So I realised I hadn't really given this game a fair go, so I did. Spent maybe a total of 30 hours on it and only spent a few quid here and there. Joined a guild. Unlocked some characters and for a while I was having fun. Then I noticed something. The Fun stopped, I was spending more time farming than playing. the game had preoccupied my mind even when I wasn't playing but not in a positive way. It's NOTHING like the tabletop experience. Because the ETHOS behind this is greed.

Sure it's fairly fun, but the monetization is amongst the most aggressive and yet insidious I've ever seen. 30$ offers to get nothing, 80$ characters that are required to be slightly competitive. A pull system that is just soul crushing... Pay money for your games upfront, they often don't have microtransactions or ads and you'll end up paying 5$ rather than the literal THOUSANDS so many people put into this one.

It's an okay mobile game, but it misses on so many marks. The tactics and strategy once you've chosen your team are barely more advanced than that of a games of checkers, and Warhammers number 1 unique selling point is absent from this game, customisation. No Army painter or swappable skins, and the so called customisation is nothing more than an upgrade path with you occasionally getting to choose which stat to apply a boost too until you get a better upgrade.
It's pretty fun and and doesn't get boring 5 stars!!

One of the best mobile games I've ever played. Tons of 40k flavor, interesting gameplay with decent strategy, and possible to do a tons of stuff without paying a dime. All of the PvP competitive game modes cap the power of characters, so it's never pay to win. The gacha elements are probably the least fun part imho, but the game gives you tons of ways to earn characters without spending money on pulls.

The idea and the gameplay of the game is really good, sadly it's a pay 2 win mobile phone game with tons of monetization to unlock everything in the game. I've tried to free to play it but I've slowly learned that it is going to take far to much time (several years). These games with loot box mechanics should be fully banned in all EU countries.

A fun enough to waste time 40K game with a simple combat system and an extensive upgrade system. Victory is less about position and more about upgrading your units to win. Levels, skills, equipment, and accessories all take grinding, and what grinding. Expect to spend $$$ or grind a year F2P to unlock the campaigns. Once you finish the 1st campaign no more story until you unlock specific new characters to start a particular campaign. Or spend money of course. Nothing to do but grind dailies.

This game is a lot of fun. I was worried that Id get to a point where I was stuck behind a pay wall, but I played for a couple hours every day for 3 weeks and haven't had any problems. The game does technically run off of consumables on a certain level, but its not annoying or money hungry by any means. I usually dont write reviews OR spend money on games, but this game has actually satisfied me so much that I bought the $6 battle pass. Obvious pay to win PVP, but the PVE modes are sick

The total experience is very good. Sadly the developers lack engagement in developing quests and offering the player choices on how to get certain character shards that they need in order to upgrade. Hitting a wall so often is frustrating, no shards no orbs , only by pure chance or on certain events you are allowed to get some . Guild War rewards on tier 1-2-3 bronze league,pitiful, energy one can use, simply not enough ..the prices on offers are ridiculous!

Bugs. There's so many bugs in this game. There's items I received that just disappered. On the battlefield if a player is too high the drop down menu will not let you select your enemy. This game was obviously pushed out too fast for a money grab for the show coming out. It's trash. For god's sake don't spend any money, I could see where they would screw you with the items that disappear.

Ok game but there are some thing that made me quit. Firstly, campaign is locked to certain characters. i get it, its a story thing and loyalists dont work with chaos and orks. still, I have a cool character I want to use but can because everything I can use it in is either locked until I get more characters of that faction (chaos, orks, ect) or is to high level and I get one shot. even on pull events with higher chances to pull a specific faction. out of 20 pulls I got 2 characters. its pricey

Too much grinding for too small of a reward. Character progression eventually becomes impossible since there is only a CHANCE of getting the rewards (upgrades, character shards, and orbs) from battles. Pricing is predatory, and most of the events favor more established players over newer ones when it comes to completing them.

a fun and engaging game, perfect for those that can't play all the time. And if on a time crunch can easily "raid"(instant win) for item upgrades rather than having to play the actual battle repeatedly. As with most game there is a pay option for certain characters to unlock campaigns, but it's not needed as the needed characters can be unlocked with a patience.

It's nice, great graphics, great gameplay, nice animations, etc etc etc. Really, the value of this thing is very high. So, why 4/5? Because this game, and in many similar games, has you spend more and more time outside of the actual game, doing all kinds of pointless side stuff: clicking on free rewards, upgrading characters, guilds, digging down 30 levels of menus to clear some annoying call to action flag, you name it. For me, who wants just the gameplay and the story, it gets boring fast.

The game is average at best. It has a good Warhammer feel, but after the first 60 missions, the difficult increases drastically, and you're stuck in the same gameplay loop for a very long time to level your characters up enough to move forward. Very p2w

Personally and not just some random bots opinion either, this game is really addictive and fun, the progress is rewarding and there's no ads which improves my game experience overall, if you're a fan of Hero's of Might & Magic type of game style with also Warhammer 40k being a hobby of yours, then this is the phone game you've been seeking for to plunge hours of in ;) Enjoy Lads, get on the grind!

Something that start as a beacon of light turn into grim dawn money maker . Decreasing champion emblem drop together with slow gring already is a step back and force players like to leave the game. RECONSIDER your policy and try to be like EA games. I try the recently again and oh boy its turn into epic grind shitshow fiesta in which even the spending of few buks daily, won't help you.

slow progress. its very hard to do content related to other players because everyone else has op characters and I dont, so in co-op guild bosses I do so little damage compared to others it doesnt matter and in pvp everyone oneshots my guys. you're basically locked to mindless grinding single player content for months until you can level up and get better units and i dont have the patience. I do like a lot of the units though I think most are pretty cool.
love the game but I really wish the skaven were a playable faction

Advancement is essentially behind a pay-gate (buy our packs!) Meaning that if you are trying to play for free you will absolutely reach a difficulty cliff that can only reasonably be surpassed with money. I am fine with occasionally putting money into f2p games (or watching OPTIONAL ads for rewards) but this is absolutely transparent and somewhat predatory. It is trying to get by on license alone.
is super fun and if you love to grind and get different characters that's your game .

Without question, the best 40k mobile game available. It doesn't feel like a pay to win. Sure, it helps. But if you play the game daily and do your quests, you WILL progress. It's a fun and rewarding grind and the gameplay is good fun. As the name suggests, if you are tactical, you can find away to clear levels even when undergeared. I've been playing for a few weeks and I'm still hooked. 100% recommend.

This is fine enough as a gatcha game. Because of how the game is designed, you will either be overpowered or getting stomped like an ant. The reason I give 1 star is because of how Indomitus Mirror Campaign is handled. Every other campaign you can have a team that just means the bare minimum requirements to beat it and have an easy enough time. Indomitus Mirror? It REQUIRES you to over invest in your Necrons. The big issue is with how overpowered the enemy snipers are. 1/5 until fixed.

Now here is a fun game. I have always maintained that a real 40k fan would not stoop to mobile games... Oh how wrong and foolish was I! This game is tons of fun without ads unless you chose to watch them for some extras. You don't have to buy your way to the top of you are patient, but feel free to buy some to support the devs. It can be a bit of a grind but then I wouldn't want to have everything top tier from the get ho. And the new event is scaled well for new and old players.

Much more heavily gated than rivenguard. Progress is very bursty as a result you feel like you really aren't progressing then unlock a new campaign and quests and you progress rapidly for a while then back to slowly creeping. Not a fan of orb requirements to level skills which are too difficult to come by. Having said the above still very much enjoy the game I just feel it needs some tweaking.

Love this game! Lots of different modes to play, but I do wish the waiting times for energy/onslaught style stuff didn't take 15+ hours to reappear! Only gave it 4 star because I can only play it for 20 minutes before I run out of tokens /energy! I would really really love if they could incorporate a "home base" you could build and defend from other player! Could be a really awesome update!
Fun game, very poorly optimized. I could forgive the poor performance a few years ago but it's made the guild raids and wars unbearable because I often lose tokens because the game crashes.

A solid tactics mobile title with a 40k paint job! Your standard gacha-rpg pulls/upgrades, but with 40k HQs for characters! It's a bit grindy as you get further in but thats all gacha rpgs. P.S. Bravo to the art design team, I'm amazed we've gone this long without anyone using the actual mini-designs and that GW paint style for the in-game models! As a tabletop player you cant ask for much more than that! Looks great, plays great, grim darkness, far future, etc. Just download and try it. 👍

Gameplay is nice, characters are fine, campaigns story could be better and more detailed or maybe offer a choice and let you play different branches. Problem is grinding, there are moments when campaign difficulty becomes impossible from one level to the other and it's not matter of tactics, but level of character and then you have to start grinding to upgrade character and it becomes chore more than a game. Too many currencies which only one matters and it's real money.

Alright game..very grindy but doesn't let you just farm the levels without tokens they force you to pay for which sucks and definitely takes a star away but doesn't kill the game completely just puts a death clock on it as most people won't waste the time on the game. PvP is horrible. The maps are small and only specific champs are useful and if you go second you can win the game in one turn. Maps need to be double the size at least. The PvP costs the game 2 stars it's just that bad.

I really do love this game. I've been playing for quite some time. This game isn't like other mobile games I've played. The long term progression feels good, unlocking new characters feels amazing, building specific teams to fight raid bosses or in the pseudo-PvP arena, theory crafting about hero synergies, etc. The game is a blast. Different metas, constant drip feeding of new characters and bosses, it all helps keep everything feel fresh. I truly love this game.

As a previous 40K gamer, I loved the concept. Feels authentically 40K - the turn based activity, various plots etc really good. Love the range of characters and factions. Although can be free, heavily leans on pay to win, as without £, stand little chance of accessing powerful character upgrades. Each game type relies on tokens - energy, battle, raid... that run out quickly, which can of course be bought to refresh access. Codes to provide additional content are also available.

The times to have tokens and energy back are way too long. If the devs want people to stick longer to the game, even to spend more money on it, you need to also give more. Half the campaigns are blocked or not fully playable as the roster takes a lot of time to complete and evolve. Good game overall, but needs to be more playable
great game got me in into warhammer 40k, very lore accurate its been fun discovering the info behind all the characters.

The game is good in some respect but many parts make the game unenjoyable .the campaign is absolutely impossible no matter what level your heroes are .the arena keeps putting me up against people sometimes ten times my power level . The requisition says you are recommended one character per ten requisitions. I've used at least twelve requisition using blackstone and orders and still nothing (I do not own all characters) Apart from these bits I do recommend the game as some things I do enjoy.

Great Turn based strategy game. There's a fair few game modes & a lot of events each month, enough to keep you occupied. Character balance is great & does rely on skill more than anything. In game purchases can vary, most I've found have definitely felt like the value you've paid. Great to see compared to other games within this category. Overall a fun game to play & if in an active guild, you can get a lot of rewards, even for new starters.

After a while of playing, I find that ,like most gacha games with pvp feature, it suffers from serious scaling issues. Once you enter the scout league and higher in the arena mode, it gets increasingly more difficult to find a fare match. The singeplayer campaigns suffer from this issue as well. It is still fun even when the progression gets a little sluggish, but there will be a point where you hit that wall of constant loosing streaks and halted progress.

There is nothing unique here. You've played this before, you've used these abilities before, you've been slapped in the face with seven kinds of currency like this before. Thirty bucks to purchase some of the "earnable" content is absolutely taking the piss, though. Skip this game.

Summon should be 30 and 300, not 300 and 3000. Everything (in-game and real world currency) is way too expensive, aside from gearing units. We shouldnt have to spend stamina to restart a level (during play) nor when we are using raid tickets. What's the point of having 2 separate currencies (stamina vs raid ticket) raiding uses both? Def need QOL improvements. I give 3* because the gameplay is fun and challenging & art design are good. Def needs to be more blood n gore to feel more 40k imo.

I play the game daily and love the play style, however, you can literally have nothing to do for 6 hours at a time in some game modes and there is a very steep mountain to climb for new players with the sheer time it takes to level and rank up characters. Paying your way through seems like a black hole as I've not seen anyone that does yt videos on the game get anything decent in hours of content, even getting a legendary in the req drops still leaves a month of rank up grinding to make useful

Good progress overall, cheers. Using one technical & technological basis, as soon as the story emerges and embraces new regions, expecting some new features soon on this area in developments on these type of platform. These strategy phone games need to modify the internal structure basis. But to all the fresh starters wondering to be in association with all the characters in the franchise is more than OK!

This is genuinely one of the worst games I have every played. Extremely predatory practices and even after spending hundreds of dollars on it (yes I know I have a problem.) I had nothing to show since they just want you to keep spending.

Can't give it more than 2 stars simply because the progression is the worst I've seen in a game like this by miles. Keeping huge parts of the campaign and multiple events locked behind unlocking whole factions of characters is absurd. The wall hits hard after about two days and even with daily plays for over a month, I'm literally no further. Took a break for a few months and came back to see if there was any change. Nothing. Just read other reviews. Such a shame as gameplay is absolutely class.

Early game is too slow. There are 3+ different progression systems for each character. Need to get further in campaigns to get the resources for those systems, but character power does not keep up due to overlapping rng layers. Think making 9% of a step per day, but you need 2 steps to beat next lvl. Oh, and the arena has poor matching and meaningless power numbers, but that's normal for a mobile game. Cool graphics tho.

its pay to win for sure but thats not the biggest issue, its just not fun its hard to get ne characters ur matching against p2w & try hards and its just childish in characters design & dosent evoke the feeling of this being a warhammer 40k game or even in the universe of said genre. for me its just not fun and very repetitive which kills the fun ontop of the horrible matchmaking I cant recommend it srry
it's SO good! I love warhammer! the gameplay is super addictive and you'll never get bored playing it lol

gameplay itself is awesome, but the menus are so overbearing with the microtransactions right in your face. having to scroll wayyy down through the paid content for the free daily items is a bit asinine. The strategy game aspect is fun but again, very overstimulating menus

I've been playing for over a year and a half as a free player. I've never felt like I was missing out on content, or that I wouldn't be able to compete or contribute. Guild groups that I've joined have been interesting and active. The game modes offer some good challenges, and daily quests offer an interesting grind. The most important thing is that this game offers actual solid strategy and gameplay, which I've found plenty of mobile games lacking. Devs, keep adding great conent thnx.

20 hours in, I would say it's solid. Plenty of depth for at least several weeks or months of consistent or casual play. Not over the top with pressing ads or add-ons, although there are plenty of options presented. Gameplay is streamlined allowing for many colorful and complex models, and animations are clean. Hopefully this leads to more models being introduced consistently into the future. A larger-scale 'pitched battle' mode with multiple, AI or not, teams might be a future nice to have. 4.74

Awesome game with plenty to do. Free to play is possible. You won't be able to get the super rare characters for a long time though and that's depressing. I've had good luck with my pulls and if you do spend a little bit, wisely, you can get a big jump on the game. All in all definitely worth playing if you're a 40k fan or into strategy games.

**Edit** Previous 2 star review downgraded. Guaranteed rewards and advertised percentages are not adhered to. No, let up for players grinding. Rewards are swayed to the poorest possible outcome. Have been playing for months and my recommendation is not to get into this as once you're in it is addictive and fun. Just unfair mechanics for the user. And extremely frustrating. P.S price point for in-app purchases are extortionate. Game has gone downhill fast, I rated this 5 stars when launched.
seems like a pretty good and fast paced game with a lot of cool characters, if you like 40k, you'll like tacticus

This is an updated review from one I left almost two years ago... Still a great game. Lots of updates keep it fresh, but there are missions I still haven't worked through at lvl 44 (I think that is actually a good thing by the way). By far the best thing is Guilds. I have met very interesting people and we have bonded like a band of brothers during the new Guild war events. It is now the only mobile game I play, and I genuinely don't mind paying every now and a again for a treat 😀
pretty fun so far. i'm just learning how to play.

This game is super fun, it can be a bit grindy sometimes, especially if you're not paying any money IRL for crates or anything but the strategy is fun, the daily/theme quests sometimes like to throw you a curve ball and require special units be used, or completing the battle in a certain number of rounds, or similar things which mixes it up and helps break the monotony of mining for that 6th ceramite lump or finding the right orb for your chaos marine. Good game, excited to see more Xenos later

Honestly loved the game, crashed very rarely on an older phone. I even went as far as to spend 50 bucks on the game after playing it for a few weeks. But then I went to ascend on of my troops and the game crashes instantly. I Uninstalled and reinstalled the game and still nothing. There's no submit a ticket option or game repair so I guess it's 50 dollars down the drain :/

guild battles are retarded, other battles locked out because I don't have the characters but I cant get the characters because I'm locked out of the battles. some battles make no sense, how can I overpower an army yet get half my squad wiped but when I try to attack above my weight I get completely destroyed. Just make a good game and people will give you money you don't need to make a pay to win game

Revising this review AGAIN. I have effectively hit a soft pay wall. I am stuck doing the same boring/grindy missions over and over or waiting days to get a CHANCE at the gear/items needed to advance further. And of course the insane amount of Micro Transactions that you are constantly bombarded with. The majority of them aren't even worth any real value. Whoever claims that this isn't pay to win is delusional.

I love the game, it reminds me of the good ol' Final Fantasy Tactics days on playstation. The only flaw I see with it is, it does crash Abit often. The story is very linear, but that's not always a bad thing. It is a mobile game after all. It seems like they fixed the data deletion bug too. So I'll give it the 4stars again. It's a good game.

Update to my review: Came back and am enjoying it a bit more. The trick is to go back to previous missions and "raid" them for resources to level up your characters. Slow but does work. @devs repeat after me: Infinitely spawning Scarabs are not fun. Making me fight other players literally double my level is not fun. Games are meant to be fun.

A very enjoyable game with a massive pay wall, also the requisition system is useless unless you do a 10 pull, the energy system is very expensive and the raid tickets not a good system and adds nothing to the enjoyment of the game, the in game currency black stone is very hard to get in game free to play, up until recently it wasn't a problem as I was a could afford the black stone drop every day but I had to give up work due to an injury and can no longer afford even that anymore

Developer isn't honest about file sizes, which is super annoying. In addition to the larger than advertised file sizes, you have creeping bloat and lag issues. It's not a good enough game to to keep watching it eat into my storage.

I honestly only played the first few missions. It's not a bad game, I'm just not an ultramarine player. This game is clearly for space marine fans as they are the only starter faction. I don't really want to grind with something I don't care about to get to something I do. edit: lowered it to one star after looking up how hard it is to play something other than Marines. it's both expensive and annoying.

Like so many mobile games these days this is a storefront disguised as a game. There is some content to be enjoyed here but it quickly gets very, very grindy. The numerous variations of currencies to speed- or level things up is dazzling but of course all of them can be bought... Even crazier, unlocking another campaign will set you back upwards of 30 euros which is quite as daft a price as it sounds. As a WH 40k fan I really wanted to enjoy this but alas the grind is real.

Addictive in all the bad ways. Almost quit multiple times during the 1+ years I played. Game is 5% tactical challenges and 95% grind until you're powerful enough to easily beat the next challenge. Which just gives you more to grind. Or spend hundreds or thousands of dollars to skip the grind just so you can grind at a higher level.
I find this game very fun to play. It's easy for new players to grasp and it provides a thoroughly enjoyable experience.
This might be one of the best addicting Warhammer 40k games for mobile for me

Fun despite ridiculous paywall. After a little while of playing you quickly realize that you have to buy in game currency for upgrades or invest a considerable amount of time into grinding. Think original Destiny. The PvP aspect is broken. Not sure how it matches but it's completely unbalanced. You'll get people who have way over-leveled teams compared to you that will 1-shot your team in a turn. Not very balanced and can be frustrating while trying to figure out the upgrade mechanic.

Since the latest update the app crashes when starting a guild raid, but the token is still consumed. Otherwise it's a fun and challenging game. Plenty of grinding and the energy is depleted before you realise. But it' quite fun when you unlock a new character and develop him enough to beat a boss level.

a decent game weighed down by all the trappings of free to play mobile; energy systems and embarrassing amounts of overpriced microtransactions that it practically begs for you to buy. no ads shoved in your face, though, and the gameplay itself is decent, so I'd say its worth holding your nose and seeing, at least if you like warhammer

The game is one of the best game i ever played for now. But it takes the pay to win to a whole other level. I will keep playing it because it is a good game and what to see how long can you get without spending. Most of the guys bought bundles and such as you need to pay a certain amount if you want to grow faster. If you do not have enough patience I do not recommend it as this will require quite a few bucks. Edit: after checking most of the reviews and see how the game progress is like 1 star.

it has potential but it's boring, takes forever to get a random unit mostly payments needed also you can't use any unit for any campaign it's real specific so it just feels like a boring story mode with not a lot of change.

It's a phone game, only reason I am even playing it is the Warhammer 40k paintjob. It's predatory, the gameplay is quite simple, models and characters look nice. Besides awful predatory microtransactions, my other criticism is not allowing a faction choice at the beginning, and forcing everyone to play space marines. I understand they add new factions over time, but I feel like the player should have a choice at the beginning to choose one of the base factions, then earn their way to others.

Repetitive and boring. The games art style is passable, and the hex tile turn based combat is a good idea especially for 40k but the strategy is nonexistent, the story is banal, and a slight gripe but making the NECRONS chaff is a terrible idea lore wise. There's a core here that COULD work but you can tell quickly that the game is just a crude skin stretched over the skeleton of a gacha box. DoW this is not.

The game is disgusting, I am pretty sure it is one of the top 10 pay to play games ,the gap between free to play and pay to play is HUGE . I played the game since launched every single day for about one hour and I still am behind the pay to win ,I haven't maxed out a single character it's insane . I am really sorry and I find it sad cause the game is amazing and had a lot of potential 😢 it only got worse the game pull system is scripted ,it's confirmed in their discord server....
Absolutely love this game. The progression is super addictive and doesn't make you feel too over powered!

It is a good little Warhammer mobile game that wants you to get invested into the character, as much as an app can, That said, some of the UI is too mobile, the contrasts between the colours can be nauseating, amination feel rushed, and the big BLUE, RED, GREEN buttons used on the menus pull me out off the 40k into the 2k. A bit of opacity. If that's a management decision, it was a poopy one, this game still has the potential to go places, I'm hoping it does. Without monetized playable content.
its a good game, the mechanics were good and the plot went smoothly. While you can pay to progress faster, you can match it free to play with some grinding.

The game is pretty good, almost like a mobile version of xcom. One thing I'd like to have changed is the massive retreat box on the pause menu, theres no confirmation so I have to wait another 12 hours to be able to finish the mission I accidentally left.

It's fun to play at first but with all the different currencies, timed limits (energy, coins you need for fights etc.) and especially the aggressive push of macro-transactions (they are way too expensive to be called micro) so you are able to keep playing, it gets ruined pretty quickly.

Played for 6 months so far. Its a big grind but a good one. You dont need to spend a penny to win like most games and you can in time unlock all units. The guild and community aspect to it makes the game great, highly recommend

I LOVE Warhammer 40k, and this is a good game to play if you love Warhammer 40k, too. You can build your own team. You and your enemies take turns attacking each other. So, if you are trying to find a good Warhammer 40k game, this is the go-to!!!

I didn't expect much tbh. I've mainly been playing the campaign and it was easy until level 45. They have lots of different offers to buy that are in a separate section so nothing feels forced to buy. The campaign has been decent, something to pass the time. Best thing I've enjoyed so far is no ads in-between levels. I've really been enjoying it so far. Great game!

Fun turn based strategy for a few weeks but progression becomes a crawl after a time. Campaign is fun. Weekly events are great, but you feel pressured into buying boosters to unlock the characters at times as there are no other guaranteed ways. Would be a 5* game if progression had a plausible end, but gets to a point 1 upgrade can take a week to achieve and that's not even a final level upgrade. This game is a long grind with little reward. Gameplay 4/5 Replayability 3/5 F2p friendly 3/5
always been a WH-40K reader and like to play the mobile game so far.

I'm through the first three weeks of casual play and I'm already where I need to to pay-to-win. I can't advance in the arena anymore because everyone is at least double my team power, I run out of mission energy before I can upgrade just one character, and token cooldowns for missions are way too long. Snowprint, at least try to make it not so obvious that money is your only true goal with this game...please?

This game is very, very good. No aggressive monetization, no tedious base building, and barely any p2w. The game is made out of love for 40k and I respect that. The thing I nickpick is the lack of cinematics and voice acting. But, it's explainable if they don't have the resources to do it. Overall, 5 stars.

I have not spent one cent and have enjoyed this game very much. The gameplay is great. I don't worry about being the best. I just play. The guild wars are very fun. I have progressed just fine. Sure, I could spend money and go faster. I feel no need. I am on elite campaigns in 7 of the 8 of them. And I have reached level 40 power level in 10 months. I have spent zero money. I ignore anything that costs real money. Progession has not been an issue at all.

Tried giving it a second chance and immediately regretted it. Instantly irritated, my account has been on act 1 for months because no matter what upgrade or how I play the field I can't get past it. I'm not buying some pack just to play either. It's like the definition of insanity continuing to try at this everyday and failing, as if I didn't have enough of that in my life. Great game if you need to get frustrated really quickly and like Warhammer.

Art is okay, overall game system is outdated and battle is just mindless, barely strategic. Its fun for first 30 minutes then the same patterns again and again, yea. And why the hell it doesn't give the stamina back when retry the stage? Just another mediocre Warhammer franchise game. Thats all.

It's a very well implemented tactical turn based game with plenty of upgrades. Units feel powerful. Spending money helps go faster but right now doesn't seem necessary. Edit: A bit over 2 years later. Still playing and the above still holds true. Can enjoy without money spent. Some of the pricing I feel is way more than reasonable. But none of the purchases are needed.

I've put around 5 hours into Tacticus so far, and I have no complaints. Fun, simple gameplay in the setting of a loved universe. It's a mobile game, so paying for shiny things is a given, I personally refuse to. Getting characters you want seems to be a grind and a half. I only got the game so I could get the Tyranids, and that seems like it's a pipe dream in terms of the RNG for their character shard drops. But all in all, good game.

Fun and nostalgic game, not required to pay in order to advance but the battle pass monthly definitely speeds things up. Only complaint, character event premium packages SHOULD have enough quests to unlock the character if you complete them all. Currently you are only able to unlock them if you're already advanced enough to complete the battles available. So you pay for nothing if you finish the quests but still don't have enough to unlock them.

Fun game, but the prices in the game are crazy high. You can get away being free to play for sure, but it's a real grind. The majority of the time spent in-game isn't really spent playing a battle. It's more so spent doing resource management to make your little guys slightly stronger so they do slightly better at the battle modes.

I absolutely love this game and the detail put into by the devs. I've played since the 1 year anniversary, but lost all that money and time, resources, characters becuase of the whole delete option being in the game where a spiteful ex can delete your entire progress. It's too expensive to regain all that on top of playing a new profile... again. The game has definitely made lots of money... that usually shows after a while.

About a week in, fun little tactical game that gives you good characters without needing to pay. My biggest gripe is the amount of time it takes to recharge certain content, mainly Salvage and Onslaught. Should really be "X Plays per day" rather than 10+ hour recharge. Makes it difficult to do the daily missions if you have played before the daily reset.

Decent warhammer mobile game. Could greatly benefit by allowing you to choose your starting character and faction. Edit: found this issue immediately after leaving the review. There is a fight where you need to 3 star for full rewards and the boss character 1 shots every character they give you. You can not 1 shot this boss character at this point. They force PtW to the point of unlocking full campaign rewards. I'm out... Aggressive ad placement made me accidentally open this game link. 2* > 1*

No use in playing the game. Its just like tabletop, SPEND A FORTUNE, if you want to win anything. If your in to 40k and the Warhammer Universe, do yourself a favor, and Dont, waste your time attempting to get something you enjoy. You will not be able to get your faction, even if they added it. Ive played for MONTHS, and have officially waited 3 months maybe more for a specific charecter box to come out. and after it DID. It didnt even give me one of the characters from the roster it gave us. RUN

I don't know much about Warhammer lore, but this game is pretty fun even if you know nothing, and it's quite fun to get into with friends. If they added a bit more to teach the lore of the game that would make it a 5 star.

A lumbering and unintelligent look at strategy. You are given nearly nothing to work with from the start. If you would like to spend real money, then there is some "fun" to be had. The game is not without merrit, but it's not something I found to be fun. Maybe if they let you try all factions from the start, or let you target open chests from a given faction, there could be some fun there. Let us develop our faction of choice through something that can't be time/upgrade gated.
Fun fame so far, cam really play a lot for free

As a 40k player IRL I appreciate the IP of course, though this is a very "clean" use if the IP (not grimdark). Game wise it seems pretty mellow as far as F2P is concerned. You can buy the units you need to continue straight up and while pricey, I appreciate being able to avoid the gacha. I've not hit any paywall yet though. Units are interesting in their abilities and there's a variety of things to do and it doesn't seem to end only in forced PVP battles where your wallet wins.

I am undecided if I like this game or not. I feel like advancement and progress is extremely tedious. very pay to win from what I'm seeing. The arena makes no sense. what works against one person doesn't work on the same person the next round. I don't know what characters to hunt or who is good. Not sure on team compositions either. I give it a month before I'm checked out and into another game.
just got into the Warhammer 40k world and love it. FOR THE EMPEROR!!!!!!!
I wish you could buy individual characters I wanna play death guard🥲

Pretty enjoyable as collectible hero games go. Not a lot of pressure on doing events and plenty of them let you unlock characters as a free to play. There are plenty of purchases available but none are necessary and the legendary character events repeat 3 times and save your progress. You can be competitive in pvp/pve if that's your jam or you can be fairly casual and I think it's possible to enjoy the game either way. Find a guild that suits you and enjoy the game.

The game is super crowded with advertisements asking for your money. The number of special currencies you have to collect is unacceptable. They also offered challenges with a timer that I literally couldn't complete without spending money. It's crazy how greedy games like this can get, this kind of behavior completely has the opposite effect on my desire to spend my money on a game.

Only gave 3 stars cause I just started playing. Graphics are nice. Game is smooth. Of course, there are lots of options to pay, pay, pay. First round of playing other players I was slaughtered immediately. (Guess they're hoping I pay for upgrades!)

Visual great it's great with the air work being very accurate and the abilites are pretty spot on. But you have to upgrade your characters soo often, you either upgrade and wait or fight & get nowhere. The energy bars needs looking at, 6mins for one bar, when you need 5-10bars is too long to do anything. And be a bit more generous with the black stones especially that when the upgrades relies on them most of the time. Gets very frustrating.

This game is pretty damn fun,gameplay loop is amazing, I could praise the aesthetic for days, it truly feels like a Warhammer 40k game. But my only complain is how tough it is to get characters and upgrades, either you pay up, or grind for weeks for a single character if that where to be changed, than maybe I'd give it a five star

This game could easily be 5* but it needs a quality of life overhaul. I wanted to write it up in here but that took up too many characters. Crafting/equipping gear, campaign buttons, the + signs on things you cannot build/equip/upgrade make it hard to know when you can equip a piece of gear. Let me know where I can submit a better written list of recommendations

I am a big fan of Warhammer and I love the video games and the tabletop. This game is a pretty basic linear grind with a lot of cool characters. There are however, several issues that I have with it. First of all is the energy system which I absolutely hate in every game. Second is the fact that you can only grind a specific mission 10 times per day. And last is the extreme monetization, I would much rather watch an ad to get free rewards than have to pay $50 for only 6800 gems.

Normal campaign game is nice, pvp it's kinda easy but good to level up. Guild fights against boss are great, the best part and real time arena sucks hard. Level up it's really slow so you have to focus on 4 to 6 units all your resources. If you plan to spend on the game get diamonds so you can use your raid tickets and avoid grindering maps. Don't worry they give plenty of diamonds. But don't spend 250 diamonds for level up... Just wait the next day. Any other sale sucks. Maps are too small 😥
its a pretty fun game, but the UI is complex, riddled with items for pay, and overall difficult to navigate. but once I get where I'm going it's a decent turn by turn game.

Typical Warhammer mobile game. Super shallow gameplay, and a couple hours of content before you start hitting extremely steep paywalls. They'll leave a comment about how you can play the whole game for free, but the time investment to do that would be hundreds of hours grinding the same repetitive tasks, over thousands of days due to limits and restrictions on how much and what you can actually grind. TLDR: Another Warhammer cash grab. Don't bother.

the base tactical game is decent - unique champs, neat mechanics, but maps are small, and more importantly, it's a gatcha game where leveling is hidden behind cards, not XP, which is how they control your progress/access to good characters. other gatcha mechanics include daily free loot, objectives, multiple leveling resources, etc.

A master class in exploitative free-to-play monetization schemes. Hard paywall, daily rewards, timed sales, confusing bundles, battle passes, pay to skip content or get stronger, countless microtransactions. Game is 90% tapping on successive glowing notifications that, at best, raise a unit stat by 0.01%, and at worst, do absolutely nothing. Incredibly boring and unfulfilling slog.

It was fun. Really I had a great time with every single game mode. However the requisitions ruined the whole experience. It's very sad to know that the game has preferences, so, if you are lucky to get cool characters, say thanks. Otherwise you will always get trash. More than 400 requisitions and never obtained something decent. So, I left the game for being unrespectful with me.

Good game would rate five stars if the dialog felt more natural in the realm of 40k. It feels like uninspired filler dialog ment to check boxes rather than actually tell a compelling story. Stories matter even on mobile games, and there's much to work with in the 40k universe. Mechanics are great though and im still in the beginning, but it feels like progression is adequately rewarding.

As a classic RTS gamer myself, i can honestly say that WH40kT is pretty smooth as far as strategy games go. Plus, there are a lot of ways to level-up and enjoy the game without needing to dump really any money into it as bonus rewards are fairly common. Yes, a few in-game pop-ups are mildly irritating, but the opt-out buttons are big & bold, so there's no pressure. But the reason i listed the game at 4-stars, is because the Multiplayer could do with better SBMM for fairer matches.

Gameplay is fun but it's really grindy, kinda confusing, and really time consuming. But it also limits the amount of time you can spend on it. So you'll get nowhere fast. If you're ok with that then I can't stop you, but yeah I'd just avoid it.
literally just started getting into Warhammer 40k really easy way to transition to cards

Played for quite a while and really enjoyed it. Some characters unlock semi quickly. But some of the characters need so many items I don't think you would ever get them. Super cool design and fun game overall though. Definitely notice the pay to win players. You will get demolished in guild wars, and the pvp.

I've been playing almost a year and my favorite 40k game. It's a gacha game...where the gacha mechanic is terrible and instead there's loads of f2p ways to get to exactly where you need to be. There's still some little content locked behind the gacha gambling, but you can experience and enjoy all game modes fully without having to spin to win. this is especially true in PvP where characters are rounded to the same abilities. really enjoyable game.

I enjoyed the gameplay well enough, but the constant badgering to spend money put me off in the end. There could be two different events going, advertising their boxes for sale, a monthly pass, and then just random junk cause maybe you'll unlock a new character. It's just way too much.

I've downgraded from 2 stars to 1 star. The game is insanely expensive if you actually want to enjoy it. And sadly they clearly never bother to do any product testing whatsoever - the arena mode is a complete waste of time. If you have Ragnar and Kharn in your team then you win, every single time. If the Devs cared at all then they'd work to balance the characters, but they clearly only care about money. Incredibly disappointing.

First of all, a fantastic game! Honestly, all what you would expect from this type of a game, but more fun and the story is awesome! I would like to point out a few kinks tho, because I can't find contacts anywhere. When I set my guild to "international" it shows sometimes Spain for some reason. Also, guild members activity info only shows if a player writes in the guild chat. I can't tell if my guild members are active without them writting. Besides that, fantastic experience!!!

Wouldn't let me play as the Big E, so I rage quit before I started, tried to leave a one star review, The Emporor auto corrects (SATIRE REVIEW) if you dig grindy games and Warhammer 40k, you will like this as well
there is zero protection against ads crashing the game. specifically the ones from White Out Survival. infuriating.

solid time wasted, you get plenty of recruits early on to not spend cash, though if you want to dig hard later, you can throw cash in. fun in general and I'm getting a laugh, because the dialogue for the ultramarines is very imperium.

The game is very accessible and I never felt the need to spend money to progress. You can play in all game modes and events without spending a dime. There are monthly events that rotate in and out and the Publishers have active communication and are very proactive with issues. Personally, I have spent money here and there, the monthly battle passes can be good value. Most deals are aimed at whales who spend, spend, spend, so just play the game and decide for yourself.

The characters all have different uses. The tactics actually take some thought. It does seem like this is a slow burn game that will take time to advance but I like those and this one seems fair. Im new to the universe and am fascinated by the MASSIVE amount of lore in this universe. This game isnt too heavy in the lore but its nice to experience some personalities. For casuals this might be too much. So far the difficulty is fair and I havent hit a paywall yet (on chapter 3) it might come.
Get that Warhammer fix! There's a ton of content but there's no pressure or time crunch to play catch up.
OK. You will need to spend large amounts of money to advance through any part of the game, failing that it's a long grind.
good game unfortunate that it has microtransactions, changed to 1 star because they i found out they added a non cannon custodes...Man they are really trying to force this
FOR THE EMPORER! Warhammer universe is so amazing and having this game as an option is so amazing thanks to the developers and makers! MUCH LOVE BROTHER!
it's pretty good so far, hopefully we can unlock things without an insane amount of time.
Brings back my youth playing turn based, interactive maps, and loads of characters and classes to choose from
this is a really good strategy builder game I would recommend this game to anybody who's a first-time learner of the Warhammer 40k
Bit too many pop-ups with deals, but otherwise fun experience so far in about 3 hours
the new faction gets a 20% damage boost in pvp or something like that. it's kinda blatantly bad marketing. it sums up how the game is run. it's decent outside of that
New to Warhammer but amazing game love it. wish the wait time between war tokens but love it.
more characters... so many missed opportunities here! like come on!!! even with what there is for factions it'd be easy to build on!!!
big fan here of Warhammer, I love the space wolf's please add more of space wolf's.
great game no ads you need to watch there will always be micro transaction but that's just the way it is
Great game though it is more number and tactics focused then a run and gun.
it a great game but i wish they had some Salamanders
Awesome game brings my memories from teenager times playing W40k

Interesting starter experience - any fan of the game will be hooked. After that it does just enough to keep you going, however I hate that the cash shop is full of INSANE price tags. A growing issue is the amount of characters but no new (or quicker) way to unlock them. Some old ones are still 100% luck based (looking at you, Death Guard) and there are zero ways to "focus" the faction you want. Real 40k fans will want to chase the characters that follow their favourite armies - I want my AdMech!
Putting Mephiston in TA for Armageddon event? That's a big problem, big, big problem 😡

Definitely a huge money grab if you want to make progress. $20 pop up for average rank up offer. you are going to have to spend thousands to get anywhere competitive. ranks up there with marvel contest of champions as a money grabber. wasn't a fan of their turn based gameplay. I've played a ton of turn based games over the decades but for some reason I just didn't care for this one.

A decent game that could be great if it were not marred by predatory/manipulative ads. I understand you have to make revenue to make fixes and new content but the lack of rewards you receive even when subjecting yourself to these godawful ads is usually why I end up leaving this game so often. And I have even paid into this game with real money and I dont feel like it was worth my investment so far. You have to grind a lot to get pretty much nowhere even on a daily basis. Stop with the BS ads!

I enjoyed it for a week. Standard cell phone collecting game. The strategy is very minimal if present at all. Just played their live duels and it's a joke. Can't make a dent in anyone who has been playing longer than me. The random drop rates are abysmal. It's either grind endlessly or pay to win. I love warhammer. Didn't love this.
this game is fun and it's made me interested In Warhammer. and I'm excited to see more characters added to the game
would be better if there were mini games but this is a great xcom like turn based game for a time killer I've ever played so far
First time i heard about Warhamer 40k, is when i watch a short about death korps of krieg. Since then, im really get into Warhammer 40k lore, and played this game. It was really fun!
standard gatcha hero game with all of the expected systems, but with a fair amount of depth.
Customer support is absolutely amazing and responsive. And the dev team is very involved in the community.

Hits a paywall really fast. I'm having fun, I obviously like the factions a 40k fan. But it hit a paywall really early, like 1 week into playing. I play other games and generally only keep playing ones that I feel reward my efforts like Warpath. This one I was stonewalled very early before almost any characters were unlocked. But hey, give it a shot
great turn base game fun intro and small learning curve. easy to get into

Have only been playing for two days, but hence far it's really fun. Certain things are time gated, with no way to advance them (So not even whales can proceed faster), but it would be nice to play some of the more fun modes (Onslaught & Clan Raid) a bit more frequently.
it's a good game to play on the go , love the Warhammer concept pretty good stuff !
I Like it never played the table top because of price but i belive this is good as a alternative

Tons of FOMO mechanics. Predatory monetization. They suck at rewarding players, and they don't respect your time. A mobile game shouldn't expect you to spend 3-4 hours just to feel progression. You should be able to do your in-game daily activities in less than an hour. Considering that the target audience for this game are people who are expected to have enough money to fund their hobbies, the game itself should understand that time is a valuable resource for those same target audience.
reminds me of old Xbox game GLADIUS. love the real time strategy. what I've been lookin for .
lots of problems with the app crashing. especially when trying to watch adds for rewards

Overall good game. Well designed. Starts off slow then gets rolling. Nice 40k feel and art style. Main issue is monetization doesnt make sense. The value is all over the place. The quantities are strange often taking multiple purchases to get one thing you want ( there isnt just a 3000 Blackstone pack or essential items easily findable per faction etc.) They badly need to iron out the monetization and value portion of this mobile game. Its pretty bad at the moment literally confusing.
lots of pay to win stuff but still plenty to do and not to hard fun working on upgrading units
tactical game as described some purchase options but that's optional no real pressure really enjoyed it would recommend

I love this game; the play is fun and addicting to grow your troops but they recently updated it and if you want to make a purchase it no longer goes thru the Google play store, they've linked it to a third party called Stash so any deals Google runs will not work and you also can't use Google play credits. This is ridiculous & shady going thru a third party makes me think they're going less secure to up revenue when the in-game deals are already questionable on pricing.
as a heavy fan of warhammer 40k, I love that this is a game to play while I wait for a new place to play my army at.
Easy to learn and quite addictive, great game for the commute
it's great. not aggressively transactional but fun and strategic. Just what the emperor ordered!

Very good and can't wait to see more factions and characters being introduced. Just Wish that there are other ways of gathering characters and gear like a wish list mechanic where you pick a character that you would like to get and earn that character's shards from the content you play.

I think it's good, yes there is monetization, but what game doesn't have that now? Just don't buy it. I am finding progression pretty easy right now, as in I have not hit a pay wall. It's a pretty strategic game, I really enjoy the card collecting aspect to level up different units. I would like to see more units/races added in the future, but I am sure development has plans.
Great game ..easy controls of characters and cool graphics 🥰.

Its def a fun time killer but also a "gotcha game." That said my main issue is the update or rather the inability to update. After opening the app it asked for an update, which I have no problem doing sence I've been enjoying the game so far. When I press the update button it takes me to the store whare I'm able to update the game. Yet when I try to do so it keeps telling me im unable to do so. So I uninstall then re-install the game hopeing to fix the issue only for all my progress to be gone

My favorite 40k mobile game. Active and very communicative devs. Great art design. Always a quest to accomplish. It may fall victim to the typical mobile game trope, "Leveling up is a grind, but you can pay to fast track your level up." They have to make money somehow though, and the grind is not a con imo.
it's really fun to play, I play this with my younger brother.
fun to play, no ads, the experience doesn't get unnecessarily interrupted
dont need to spend at all to be satisfied with this game. if youre a 40k fan, its a must play game that you can take casually or competitively, both without the pay-to-win
I've been a bit apprehensive about playing this but I'm enjoying thus far.
this is the best mobile game I've played. I've played ALOT of different mobile game and I immediately got hooked on this one compared to the rest.

This game is 100% pay to win. The company's comment below implies there is skill & strategy involved but the maps aren't large enough for real strategy. You just need to grind up levels and randomly collect tokens to one day maybe unlock a new character. You are prevented from grinding without buying stuff. Also I hope you like ads.

for the entire Necron campaign I'm stuck playing ultra Marines and have to back track to grind it's unfun, I see this game I think I get to customize a kill squad for my liking but no you have a wall of grinding or you pay to pass it to get to the good stuff.

Microtransactions are insane to where it costs hundreds of dollars to unlock a character and newly unlocked characters aren't even useful until you've done weeks of grinding (or hey, hundreds more dollars of spending) to get them leveled up. They have also started showing me super long ads that often crash or take me to the play store while trying to exit the ad, and then I don't even get credit for watching the ad.
Unskippable tutorial. You cannot choose which faction to play as, being forced into playing Ultramarines. Can't play the game if I can't even pick the most basic choice, which faction to play.
Pretty boring gameplay and clunky UI. Plus female custodies, gross.

Basic game play covered by an absolute orgy or items and transactions. An extreme example of pay to play. Even if you try to play free you get through about 70% of the first campaign before it becomes so hard, you quite littereraly can't complete missions without paying huge cash to upgrade your characters. Your units Just all auto die in 2 turns otherwise. We all love warhammer but this is absolutely terrible. More of a warhammer casino slot machine simulation then any sort of game

Was a fun game, but a recent major event started. One that had been waiting for and was super hyped up. I tried to start it, got a bug that prevented me from participating. Immediately put in a support ticket. Within in an hour got back a response of, essentially, "sucks to be you. Better luck next time" and ticket closed.

Good but not made for players who want to play through the story as the game caps you hard if you dont get overly lucky with drops it takes you way longer to move up (with you characters) and some are blocked by missions so you really are stuck. I'm stuck nothing to do but grind mission area is low as I play well but cant beat characters that are either 2-7stars higher or/and better characters. Game need something more for filler not too rewarding but spammable for the motivated players

Same as many others reviews. Quickly reach a point where progress is impossible without leveling characters equipment (6 items per character, plus 2 abilities and 3 power ups). Requires unfeasible grinding sometimes needing in excess of 15 mats. Drops are limited to approx 25-30% rate on missions limited to 10 attempts a day. At level 21 you have 106 stamina. Missions each cost 5/6 stamina. With 30% drop rate that's 270 stamina for one slot on one character. You need 5 characters per mission.

Was fun for about a day. Now its absolutely stagnant. Unless.of.course you spend money...which is fine. But game workshop is one of the most money hungry companies iv ever experienced. I played the tabletop game for awhile and they cant even get their app to work properly. Theyd rather spend resources going after third party apps or 3d printers. As old and big as this company is, sure seems like they cant figure it out.

Seems like a decent game, tutorial is a little annoying, but my main issue it looks like you don't get much choice in factions. I was hoping to play as Tyranids exclusively, but it looks like the factions are locked to their associated campaigns. Of course it starts you off as marines because humans.

There's really no other way to say it but it is like Games Workshop made a mobile game. They charge for everything. You are reminded constantly you haven't bought this pack or that. PvP is horrible as yiu can refresh your page because you can't fight 10K at 2k only to get more 10k and up players and this costs the premium currency. Don't really bother, there are other games you can play like sudoku.

Very fun, but I'd prefer to spend money to buy the game, rather than a F2P model. You can definately progress in the game without paying, but I do recommend you buy the Yarrick pack on offer at the start as he will carry you through the early game. One bit of constructive criticism for the Devs: It would be great to balance PVP away from trying to edge towards your opponent for the first couple of turns, as at the moment it's pretty much down to the person who can attack first = win

The game is genuinely quite fun and actually gives a basic understanding for how the board game works and lets you fight as a variety of characters and sports a decent range of enemies to fight against. I would love to see where this game goes, since as of now the Aeldari lineup still only has two characters. I'd love to see Space Wolves or Ravenguard added to the Imperium forces, maybe even World Eaters and Thousand Sons

Amazing experience. It is my first 40k game. It seems easy at first so you can get used to it, but it cranks up difficulty rather quick. Only complaint is the amount of charge times for missions (thank goodness there isn't any for upgrading). You can't do much after you have ran out of energy. It isn't "exactly" pay-to-win, but the purchases you do make on characters are absolutely with it and decently priced. Great game so far guys.

The gameplay kills everything. The only way to progress is to do the same stuff again and again. You should do the same battle (!) 50 times (!) to complete the mission to get points which will give you another 5% on your way to get another character. It's super time consuming and super boring even if you pay. Uninstalled.
Good game for military experience enthusiasts. Art of warfare and military tactics with transformer alien

Nice game! Very addicting. Unlocking new characters was originally a chore, and many of the older characters can be a bit of a grind, but every new hero so far has been unlockable so long as you take time to complete their event quests and accumulate enough points. I have so many characters now it's actually difficult to figure out who to focus on, which isn't a bad thing! All in all, I'm happy to play and even pay every now and then to support Snowprint.

Massive disappointment Looked good, pictures of it showed various factions, but actual gameplay forces you to play the worst available faction and either waste time grinding, or hand over money to be able to play any of the genuinely interesting sides Quit after the first campaign, not worth the hassle when there's other games that are actually good from the start

Out of most other Warhammer Mobile games this seems like one of the most well thought out and budgeted. Speaking of money you can get by without buying anything, Its just a little annoying seeing the deals popping up so often. Ive already put money into the game HOWEVER that doesnt mean im gonna wanna bug every single deal youve got. The game may be new and maybe in need of money however it should dial back the amount of microtransactions so it doesnt end up like Warhammer Conquest or Crusade

At first, I had my trepidations, was worried there wouldn't much actual gameplay, but this game is jam-packed with features and game modes. The game has surprisingly deep gameplay, easy to learn but with deep mechanics. This game is blowing me away, totally surprised in the best way. I will say though is that a lot of the monetization "deals" are very lackluster, and most do not add up in terms of giving an actual net benefit. Those "deals" need to offer way more for them to be worth it

Better than I thought it would be but far from what it could be. You're forced to play smurfs until you unlock the other factions. The abilities and terrain effects have a little depth (more than just damage), but each unit only has one attack and one "special". Maps are really small, I guess so they can fit the whole thing on a phone screen... but larger would be better even if it meant some scrolling around and zooming in and out. Battles are annoyingly short.

I have enjoyed the game alot until I hit the artificial wall that stops you playing at any reasonable rate without sinking an extortionate amount of money into the game. The game play is great but when the levels scale too high without days of unfun grinding to get passed the next 2 minute mission or spending large amount of money on loot Boxes it kills the gameplay

I've been playing for a few days now. I have yet to run into any pay walls to enjoy the game as is. It's a turn based, tactical game, similar to the XCOM series, but on a smaller scale utilizing hexagon tiles on a board to determine attack ranges and unit movements. Overall, very fun and I'd reccomend it to Warhammer and turn based strategy fans alike.

This is a very good game. I play multiple times a day for over a year now. The crashing issues have cleared up for me. If you like tactical games and/or warhammer this is the game to play! Went down to 4 stars cause support won't refund resources lost due to their servers being down(unplanned). They just expect you to plan your game time around possible server outages.

Genuinely a really fun game, and they absolutely nailed the setting. The store prices are currently way too high, but as they're optional and the game is in a really early stage of its life, please don't let this dissuade you. Pacing is excellent even without spending anything, the artwork is great, and there is so much to do. A really really bright start.

Great game. You can make microtransactions, but it's not required to play, win, or have fun. Also, there isn't an ad between each battle. I've been playing for a few days and having a blast. I love the WH40K setting, and this game has a lot of great story background and action. Highly recommend this game!

Pretty good all around, especially if you like to 40k setting. Would be 5 stars, but the monetization has gotten a little worse lately. Free to play is alright, but some of the recent character releases basically can't be unlocked without spending a fair bit of money.

I gotta say, its extremely polished, dynamic, and rewards your patience with a fair amount of progress. Especially for these gotcha style games. The modeling is beautiful and gameplay rewards a clever mind, not just your wallet. Highly recommend trying it out, rts 40k? Yes please!

It is a good game. I am a little annoyed that I can not view the abilities that summons have. If this is fixed someway I will update to 5 stars. To the devs: I would like if you could add a form of practice room where we could place enemy's so that we can experiment with strategies and abilities.

Out of all the 40k games I've played on Google Play, this is the most fun one I've experienced. It's clear the game is in development still: Guilds aren't able to send resources/troops, "matchmaking" can be tricky (but possible to win), etc. The gameplay itself is fantastic. Fire Emblem-esque, turn-based strategy with 40k characters. The representation of characters is kinda bare, but it's good. If you're okay with a game being developed as you play, this is a great choice!
you get to the pay to win wall pretty rapidly. the game is set up for whales. I'd say the game itself is pretty basic. the chaotic appearance of all the menus disguises a pretty boring game.

I really like the gameplay, graphics style, sound effects and most other features. I do wish there was a few bits of dialogue but that isn't essential. I do agree with Majorkill that a speed select would be nice and a zoom function however it doesn't discourage me at all from playing. I do believe the packs should be priced a bit lower. All and all i think its a great mobile game and think most Wh40k lovers would enjoy.

A super fun game, but hard to get resources. I've been playing for awhile now, but I haven't even been able to unlock much. I also wish you could choose maybe 3 or so character that you would have a higher chance of getting when you summon. Fun gameplay, just super slow.

The game contains false advertising. For example the Blood Moon Klan pack originally costs 144,99 zł and is advertised to be on an 80% sale... But somehow still costs 66,99 zł. When I reported this, Snowprint support said that it's confusing, but correct, so there is no need to deal with this further... Except that they make money off of this confusion. So... Flase advertising inside the game. I'm quitting.

A great way to waste time. My expectations were low when I downloaded but thankfully I was proven wrong. Easy to learn, simple, and not plagued with ads, thank the gods. The only thing I don't like is the periodic pop-ups asking you to buy things. My only suggestion is to add a bestiary that lets us ogle at the enemies we've defeated in detail.

After playing for about a couple of months I personally like the game. However! Despite me giving this game a 5 star rating in the begining, i give it 2 now. The drop rates are horrible and this is an extremely money based p2w game. You will have fun at start. Untill it becomes frustrating and you get stuck and everything is the same. There is no way to play without spending lots of cash and still be able to do something.

I really enjoy this game... But I probably spend too much. The grind is serious and the limited number of free plays you get can be frustrating. With that being said, the mechanics are interesting, the models and abilities are cool, and levels can be challenging. I hope they'll get a Freeplay mode or level creator one day.

Gameplay kinda nice but big flaw: SO MANY MICROTRANSACTIONS - You get to play only about 150 levels for free (which can be finished in a few days, replayable for grinding) - Other campaign missions? You gotta buy the 'packs' that comes with the related characters - SO MUCH grinding needed to unlock characters for free - Wait time for energy to recharge takes too long (onslaught missions) - Arena matchmaking needs to be more balanced Good things: - no performance issues so far - constant events

This is a fabulous game. I've spent over a dozen hours playing and am nowhere near sick of it. Main callouts - Vertical play style. Great for casual gaming. - Many different game modes, all which progress you in different ways, all important. - In-depth campaigns, characters. - Must play in bursts or pay money. I can play in ~30 hour chunks, probably twice a day. Which is perfect for me. - you don't have to pay to make progress. It is challenging, So you actually do have to be strategic!

So the game is pretty entertaining over all but I have some minor problem's . first of all energy refills. At the start I didn't even notice it because bthe game bombarded me whit it but now that it ended and a have a relatively small limit I have to balance my days of playing by either raiding the the missions I have done for items or shards or continue the campaigns . Which brings in my second point which is leveling you're characters. ovel all it's ok but if you have some difficulty's

Easy to get the hang of, simple game play that has provided hours of entertainment. I don't feel the need to pay for any of the optional boosts, but if you're the type who wants to unlock every character fast as possible it would help. Great game!

Edit: So I've continued playing, I'm part of a top 100 guild, the community is awesome, support is forthcoming and fast. It was indeed a fluke I drew the same. Cool game but the free 10drop pods, literally gave me 2 of the same character, which is useless lol, it's either a crazy coincidence or the system is flawed. It shouldn't be allowed to happen it feels like you're cheating me (on a free drop I know) but other than that the game is fun, I'd recommend just don't go pouring money into it

I want to love this game but the connection issues are insane! This new arena event is cancer! I've either been disconnected or had my opponent disconnect in over half my matches when I have full service. I took screenshots to prove it. I don't see any point in spending time on an event when you can't even have a proper match.

Been playing for about 2 weeks now and so far I am enjoying the game. Much can be done with out paying but if you want to speed through go-ahead and spend. Update: Been about a year now since I began playing this game. Still enjoy it and perhaps the main reason I'm still logging in is because of the devs. They have kept the game interesting and almost bug free, character models look amazing and in game purchase prices are fair.

Could be better, PAY TO WIN, AND PLAY. Slow energy regain and takes forever to unlock characters... The other campaign modes are locked behind paywalls unless you have the characters to play the campaign. It's 10 bucks per charicter and you need 3 of them in the same factionto unlock the campaign so they wanna charge you 30 bucks just to keep playing the game.

Great game, love the progression and turn based strategy combat. However i have given it 3 stars because it is the most unstable game ive ever played, constantly crashing out. Edit: I'm changing this to 1 star because the bugs and lag have gotten rediculous. Im collecting chests and energy, yet none of the stuff is being applied. The game is crashing out mid battle or when im collecting/buying stuff, Im losing my coins/blackstone/faith points but im not getting the items.

Did a few resets after the first 10 pull 4 times got the same pulls all Necro and Pluage boys, so I stopped because if it takes this long to get any kind of imperial troops that you can use whats the point, seems like an ok game but not worth the rolls lots of games out there that give you a much better chance to play with something you actually want.
