The actual game is 4 or 5 stars but the greed of the pricing of paid content is getting off the charts, 2 tiers of paid battlepass, individual characters that work out in the hundreds of pounds if you pay for the unlocks etc it is utterly eye watering. I recognise the paid content is optional of course but if they made it even somewhere realistic they would surely get more volume of sales rather than a handful of whales with lineups of characters of collective cost in the thousands of pounds.

Simple yet entertaining tactics game. Once you unlock Raids and Onslaught the game really opens up with more options and the strategy side of things gets a little deeper. Generous statt of the game for characters and level up/ascension materials. If you are a fan of the WH40k universe, you are sure to enjoy this for what it is, a Stamina based tactics games to be played in short bursts.

Who ever rates this game 1/5 are trolls. This is obviously a collecting game with microtransactions, don't like it? - Why play it? This is an Alpha version that I've played, but I am enjoying it so far and have no plans on paying for anything since it looks achievable for F2P players to compete in the end-game (this could obviously change). Solid visual style and it's well optimized. Could have a speed up for unboxing chests, so I don't have to spam click 8 times to get the items.

A lot of people are uninstalling because the devs slide in ads that just never close. If you want to close the ad, you have to close the entire game. This has been ongoing, and I don't see them fixing it. It's not too much, in top of the already expensive game items. I quit.

I got the game and after I got done with first boss the game would not connect to my wifi, every other app on my phone is working with wifi his app will not, it has potential but it seems that there are some bugs that need to be worked out. If the game is not fixed in a week in gone👍

Another fun Google play game! Great job staff. Gave this Warhammer battle game a chance and it's a good one. Gamers its got a helpful walk through to get you started. Easy step by step and level ups are fun with this one . Plus it gives you rewards Along the way. This game is turn based and these types seem fun because you can make decisions on which character you want to go next. Still new with this one but moving Along with it. Enjoy gamers.

It's a decent game. Could use a bit more Warhammer flair, such as more factions and more use of mobbing units for the player. Could also use more content. But for a mobile game, it's good! Strong foundation, and will continue to play it. I await even more content in the future!

The story is kind of fun. But the layout of the entire app is garbage, littered with useless unlabled unsearchable junk. I was in the shop today, and bought a rare weapon. Dropped all but 200 of my blackstone on it, didn't appear when I tried to put it on my character. Took me about 5-10 minutes of digging around to find out that it only works on something I don't have and wasn't planning on getting. I need to know these things before a purchase, not after.

Apart from being an exact copy of other similar games with warhammer theme, it is unplayable after a while, as the game has a very serious bug about not seeing internet connection. When i wanted to contact them about it, i had to register a forum? Like in the 90's? They didn't even bother with a native contact form. But again i see this serious bug is not even new as many people here commented about it. Them not fixing it shows you what kind of future this game has.

Rather dull. Battles are tedious and present no challenge at all after a couple of hours of playing. The rest of the game boils down to "press the green button" to receive numerous coins, gems, shards... blah, blah, blah. No idea what any of it is for. If you're looking to replicate the 40K experience, this ain't it :(

This is a provisional rating. However as a long time player of hero collection/resource management games. My first impression of this are very positive. So far it ticks all the right boxes, with no negatives yet. And while it follows in the foot steps on games like Star Wars Galaxy of heroes. And Marvel strike force just to name the top 2. There are enough different things about it already to make it stand out in a fresh and exciting way. The battlefield play style is fantastic!.

Overall the game is quite good however the time it takes for some things to refresh is way too long in my opinion. Waiting 8 hours just to have 1 onslaught game to upgrade characters just seams too lenghty. Also the energry runs out very quickly. Hop on do a few raids and its all gone.

Uh oh massive red flags of review comments, not that I did not see this coming. As for the game play, after playing to a certain point. Having to download additional, 400k + mgb. From what I saw most prices do fall within that .99¢ to $9.99 threshold of microtransaction. I didn't see any prices that exceeded into EFT retail style pricing for in-game digi artifacts. Yet the game like mostly all these games developed here in Play store are developed as a cheap skate way to extort a quick buck! 🙄

Fun game with variety of things to do. Pricing model is too high though. Not sure how free to play it is yet. Update: around mission 45 you start hitting a skill ceiling that will halt free to play players for a long time before you grind enough to raise your power.

The gameplay is good and is definitely worth 5 stars but you have tokens you gotta use to battle. These tokens can be stacked upto 3 times and regen over time, the time however is around 12 hours. You can buy them with teal money though, im guessing thats why they have a token system like this. Please increase the tokens and at least half the wait time for them, that would increase my rating

Has potentioall but goes nowhere and to tedious. Standard heroe collecter, but eventually you get far enough into campaing and nothing to do, your heroes will be at their highest levels and nothing to do bevause eveeyrhing is behind paywall. Good game if you have lots of time, but if you are like most player go play somerhing faster pace. Many mods require you to constantly manually long battles and it gets boring.

it's fun for the first 3 days then becomes a slow, tedious, mind numbing experience where you have to wait almost 2 whole days for everything to reset before you spend all your mission tokens and stamina within 2 hours. Also will boot you out mid mission to update and WILL NOT REFUND YOU THE SPENT TOKKEN. TAKES 8 HOURS TO RESET AN ONSLAUGHT TOKEN AND IT WONT DO YOU THE COURTESY OF REFUNDING IT WHEN THEY STEAL FROM YOU!

Pretty neat game, been playing for over a year and still enjoying it now. I don't complain much about paying money since I'm still a kid teen cuz I could just play for free like other mobile games. What I like are the sounds, interesting mechanics and most of all, the nice graphics of characters! Upgrading takes a while but it's just really quick as pressing a button multiple times. I'm a big Warhammer 40k enjoyer too which is also a good plus and introduces me into other lore from characters.

Like most games. Fun to play at first then you hit a point where everything takes far too long to obtain without spending money on unrealistic prices. £20 to roll the dice at obtaining one character that then costs you another £100 at leveling that character up. Do yourself a favour and don't even bother starting it.

Decent gameplay if you can even get to it behind the rediculous ads and stupid timers. I expect games to beg for my money these days but I was still shocked at the quantity of ads. Also, it seemed like such poor value to actually spend money here. Like, the cost to reward ratio is way too high.

When I saw the wild generous drops at the start. I just knew a massive payball was coming and this was the sweets before the sour. I don't know how many different currencies are in this game, but there is a lot which is a massive giveaway for rng to play so pay up. Game is actually great functions really smooth The gameplay is good. It's not groundbreaking but it's fun. So really heartbreaking that the game is cluttered with greediness just a typical thing you see in MMO stuff

A couple of hours in and this feels like a very good strategy game. UPDATE: a few hundred hours in and I'm addicted. These gacha games can feel exploitative, but Tacticus doesn't feel that way. While I do pay for the season pass, they add plenty of value, but it's not a pay to win (however, it does help you progress much quicker).

I really like this game. It is a good game. One gripe I have though, is there is no way to keep your progress on multiple devices. What I mean is, there is no way to have the same tacticus account on an android device and a ios device. I have a phone that is an ios device and a tablet that is not. This means that if I want to play tacticus on both devices, I will have to play on entirely separate accounts. This could easily be fixed and it frustrates me.

I mean.. what a great game However The 1 campaign u get to play is character locked. Every other faction u want to play in a campaign can only be unlocked by buying said campaign. Each campaign is about 30-40$ depending on ur country. Ive unlocked characters that id like to use in the one campaign i have but i cant cause again character locked. U can only mix and match ur units in pvp and in some other areas.. This game is worth 40$ total. And i would of paid that 40$. But now its an uninstal

The dev team seems very community focused, and I do feel like there's a level of tactics here that aren't present in other hero collectors. I have been looking for a replacement for galaxy of heroes and being a fan of 4k lore (haven't played the TT game but I watch a lot of leutin vids), I picked this up. So far I'm absolutely loving it.

Really wanted to like this game. It has a lot of potential, but the devs don't listen to their players and are strongarming them into playing a mode that maybe 10% of the base like. What's more, they won't even respond to criticism about it. I've seen developers like this. Its one game mode now, but pretty soon its a trip to the ruinous powers of cashgrab. #RemoveLivePVP.

Fun game at the start. Once you've reach a certain point you have to spend money or you won't get anywhere. I'm pretty much stuck now re battling the same stuff over and over. A bunch of my characters are maxed and still can't win past a certain point.

This game is actually very fun. There is so much to do (battle modes etc) that it can be overwhelming at first glance. Just play some of the campaigns if you want to learn on the fly. Plenty of PVE and PVP opportunities, at no risk to your own progress (you're not being looted by others). Guilds are cooperative, members all earn rewards as common goals are achieved, like "do 2,000,000 flame damage" or similar, and from defeating progressively harder boss stages. It's worth playing.

Good 40K games are few and far between. This game shows potential. I'm a disgruntled Marvel Strike Force player and all I have to say to the developer is "DO BETTER THAN $COPELY/BOUNDLESS". The bar is not high, I know, but if you can keep your greed in check, you might be able grab more of their playerbase. MSF is long overdue to be knocked down a peg or two...or three.

UPDATED: Played for a solid month straight now. Expensive and cant get the characters I want. Explicitly joined to get some Tau but you cant get them except during special events. Dropped a $20 durring tau event expecting an easier time to unlock a chaaracter I think looks cool but the pack mearly grants you a few extra missions. You will never have enough characters to complete all the special line ups. Do not spend cash on this game it wont help, pretty locked out of progression and missions.

I'm actually really enjoying this game, definitely best adaptation of 40k I've seen on mobile. Would give 5 stars if the pricing wasn't absurdly high (30 dollars for 3 characters and some PVE missions, that's a deal?!). Would really like to support the developers with my money but right now I just feel like I'd be getting almost nothing in return.

Like this game. Left for awhile came back when I seen the new characters I had missed and were being added. Realized I probably quit playing because it's a cash grab game that doesn't care if you play it only if you spend money on it. I cant get a new characters to safe my life when I spend 3000 gems to start a new campaign no I gave to buy them so I can play

The only issue I have with this game is the PvP matchmaking when the tournaments roll around. Because your enemies always seem to have characters vastly over leveled in comparison to yours when it comes to abilities and gear. I've had my most durable character utterly annihilated three times in a row because of this when normally they could endure much more

This game is great. The roster is good, the art department do a class job of bringing the models to life. The in-game animations take a bit of getting used to but have a lot of charm. The game modes are constantly developing and most importantly the Dev team are engaged with the playerbase, communicate regularly and are passionate about the content. Like with any gacha there are paywalls however the game is very accessible for the f2p players (more blackstone though please)

Good gameplay and generally well built game. So good I wouldn't mind if it was on PC as an RTS. The microtransaction stuff is not too intrusive and it seems you can play the game relatively easy without buying stuff. It would be 5 stars if it would cost some money without any in-app purchases.

I'm keeping my review at 5 stars but changing my words! The game is much more informative for beginners now, the generosity for F2P players is way up and the community is only growing, always willing to help! Things range from casual to dedicated and has a great blend of strategy and resource management. As a F2P player, the grind is real! Though every time I get to a new height the results show! I love how your progress is always trackable and recognisable. Play the game! It's really good!

Bad, it's everything you hate about games workshop. You get about a day of play time until the game becomes impossible without spending money. They seriously spent more time figuring out how to get you to spend real money than building a balanced game. It could have been fun. Don't waste your time.

I agree with a lot of things that have already been mentioned in other reviews. Plan to spend a lot of time grinding which is never fun they're fun at a certain point or a ton of money it's basically another cash grab. Arena is absolutely horrible considering after I won my 1st Aron my 1st arena every single opponent that it wanted me to go up against was double my power or More even after multiple refreshes which you have to use a resource to be able to do.

I'm a huge warhammer lore fan. The miniatures are beautiful and fun to paint even if overpriced. Sadly this game like most other gameworkshops stuff is overly complicated and way over priced. The upgrade system seems to be hugely balanced twords forcing you to play of you wanna play with the big dog. It supports whales while not caring about the less well of players. The game plays well and for a android game is fun.

More grinding than actual gameplay. Once you've completed the campaigns there's little else to do but upgrade your characters and gamble with lootboxes. The graphics and tactical gameplay is nice, but the Warhammer IP is definitely wasted here. A case of profit being put before the players.

Sucks. Gameplay is fine, but leans heavily on very high priced P2W model. That can be ignored and you can grind, but after some time, the app constantly claims it is not connected to the internet when my device is obviously connected. It also eats rewards because of this issue, although this is rarer. Main issue is not allowing battles to grind in because of the fake error.

I love this game, its brilliant and so cool how as a player, I can use different characters with different play styles to earn victory and if I fail to win I can just try a different way but I will say that some of the cool downs are too long for me who is active quite alot on this game and that's why it's 4 stars

In recent weeks, the game is quickly changing into a pay to play and if you dont pay enough, you dont matter. I messaged tech support, thinking maybe it was an oversight, and they told me the changes were intentional for player not paying for all the event upgrades.

Good at first and fun for a while. But it gets excessively grindy unless you're willing to pay. The struggle is too much it's not fun anymore. Also the ads are getting worse and worse. Can't click without them trying to sell you something.

Great game 3 or 4 hours in. Lots of pay to win options but the F2P experience is still fun and I don't (yet) feel constrained or limited by not opening my wallet. May edit this review later (can you even do that? Not sure.) to reflect any change in that opinion once I've got more game time under my belt. All in all, a good mobile experience with enough depth and attractive enough game play to keep me invested.

I was pretty excited about the game and the first few days seems great. I am 2 months in and have to say. The drop rates are terrible. If you want to enjoy this game to its full potential you need to be rich AF. The developers is extremely greedy. The progress ratio is extremely slow and benefits when reaching a milestone a joke. This game will bankrupt you before you get anywhere. I am not saying it should be free, just adjust the gains to make it worthwhile.

I haven't had too much time in the game yet, but the gameplay is REALLY FUN! And that is a lot for a free-to-play game and something you definitely can't say about 99% of games on the Play Store so Definitely worth a try and a MUST if you like WH40k. FOR THE EMPEROR!!!

Simple arcade style fun here with no strategy whatsoever. The game plays great, no complaints there, but the maps are too small, the unit icons are too big, which means the game feels very crowded & because it is so crowded, there is no strategies to be used, you simply attack forward in arcade style game play - The special effects for the weapons look cheap, the special effect sounds, sound cheap. You WILL have to spend money on this arcade game for sure to move forward - UN INSTALL for me

Simple yet satisfying gameplay and progression, fast paced, no time consuming and mind melting base construction mechanics like other games of its type. The microtransactions are a bit expensive, but because GW finally found a developer to give us a good Warhammer 40k mobile game, I can look past that. Not that you'd need to buy them because it's more pay-to-win-faster than pay-to-win. So far if you have the time to play, it paces itself fairly well.

Got this after majorkill posted his video on it, I like it a lot, good representation of characters from the lore and strong gameplay mechanics, the progression can get a little tough without paying once you get to about level 12 but the grind isn't anywhere near as long as some other games

Really fun gameplay. Can already tell there's going to be a very quick massive pay wall. Classic gacha system so any money spent is a waste except the packs that give you specific characters so you can play each campaign. Play for free until you can't anymore and uninstall.

Seems like a good gacta game. Summons for new characters should always have shards in or characters rather than level up materials. As feels like a waste of 300 to get essentially nothing. Alot going on when you first start, alot to keep track of, content locked behind pay walls for needed characters to start extra campaigns. Alot of packs available to buy before you even get started. Bit over whelming to anyone who isnt used to this sorta market

This game isn't just pay to win. It is mortgage your house to win. Characters are incredibly slow to get. Then after you get them, you have to pay for the $10 pack or the character is useless due to being such a low power for months. Arena battles are dumb because the leagues are set in a way that it makes you fight more difficult players based on your activity level and not your rank. So if you participate too much too early, you actually hurt yourself.

Very good core gameplay hamstrung by the usual mobile game chicanery: artificial bottlenecks, in-game currencies, tedious grinding. Expect to spend around six months grinding for each "top tier" character unless you get lucky and unlock one during a random pull. More often than not, the "new character" you'll get is one you already have. I say "top tier" in quotes, because even Legendary characters are utter trash if they're not properly leveled up. In sum, a solid game that falls sadly short.

The arena in the lower tiers is filled with people who have a power level of 100k or 50k, and it's almost impossible to progress. The campaign is incredibly difficult with your op characters getting one shotted by a lasgun or lascannon. The raids are a bit buggy half the time you don't get the drop you're after. Finally, the character drops for half the characters is incredibly bad.

Characters are cool, the strategy makes it fun since deploying and utilizing characters differently changes the dynamic of the battle each time. Kind of a grind to upgrade but what isn't paid or otherwise. Solid game. Expensive pay to play. I haven't bought anything and I'm satisfied. Very few commercials - really only if you do extra battles or refresh the store's items.

It would be an amazing game If it wasn't for the Pay to progress mechanics that it has, after a few days, leveling up skills and gearing up characters becomes excessively resource consuming, energy fills slowly so you will not be able to farm the items needed and have enough energy left to progress on the campaigns, se characters are only available through gatcha and without them you won't be able to play some campaigns, over all, progression and p2progress are not well implemented

This game is easy to learn, yet complex, you can pick up and play a little or a lot. It's really excellent!!! Update: I have been playing this game for a long time and it's just as awesome and fun as ever. If you're a few of leveling up, ranking up and promoting characters then this is the game for you. This is a strategy/RPG fans dream come true!!!

This game is sensational. Tactics style battles reminiscent of final fantasy tactics. You don't require purchases or ads to enjoy and get ahead, although if you're willing you can level a little faster. That being said even if you wanted to plow money into the game they don't let you just buy success. The timers and tokens suggest the developers had a "play the game about an hour a day" attitude so even if you want to spend hundreds to go faster, you can't really.

Lots of people are complaining about being walled off from content. I don't find this to be the case. In 2 months I had unlocked all but one campaign and each one has plenty of content. It's about focusing your resources and ticking things off. All campaign required characters can be obtained free to play through different methods. It might not be the most beginner friendly game but when you get into it, this game has a lot of depth to it

Casino like game, in the first 10 levels (10-15h of play) you will get bonus, after bonus and so on, you advance like crazy. After that, everything changes, marching with high tier players in arena, difficult characters upgrade, you wait half a day to play a match in guild, salvage and slaughter modes. Due to the lack of upgrades you won't advance in career mode fighting the necrons. Nice graphics although, yet the gameplay will become slow and boring if you don't pay and prices are HIGH!

I love this game. I'm pretty into the lore, but not the tabletop. Heard it's God awful expensive. This let's me experience that. Very fun, can unlock everything through gameplay; but you buy stuff too. The tactics you can utilize are varied as well. Great stuff

Been playing for over a year now. Plenty of great looking characters, lots of variation and lots of different game modes. Some stuff feels like it is behind a pay wall but the majority feels F2P. Legendary orbs are a premium so getting characters finished is almost impossible if you aren't willing to spend. That said most characters don't need to be maxed out for them to be good. I still suggest this game to casual and hard-core fans!

This game is a lot better than I initially expected, it's not as toxic or boring as other games, it still has a pretty big pay to win system. In the game there's a system that allows you to pretty easily get a character by using 10 req scrolls or 3k gems to open 10 supply drops. It says it's a 100% chance of getting a character. But some times you can get characters you already have so instead you get shards. Out of all the 10 draws I've done I only got 2 new characters. This is a trash system.

Really fun game, really expensive game. Why do i have to wait so long to play? Just a problem for no reason, how am i supposed to get characters in events when im out of energy all the time, unable to do these timed quests, like complete 75 campaign missions... that's gonna be 3 days even with watching ads to get more energy. Make the missions 1 energy per mission instead of 5 or 6+ per and I'll change my review to a 5 star as it should be when the heretical monetization is exterminatus. Big E

I see a lot of complaints about pay walls and crashes. I haven't experienced any issues with the game crashing. There are server outages, but they are always solved quickly, and the devs compensate with in-game currency, so it is never a big deal. The pay wall issue purely depends on whether you have any patience or not. I'm primarily a f2p player, and tend to buy the £4 monthly currency drop as it does help speed progress but is by no means necessary. It's a grind but incredibly fun. 10/10

This game is a lot of fun, quick matches, unit improvements feel like they influence how strong they are, and party co.position feels important. I feel like I am making progress at a slow enough and still fast enough rate. My only problem is the slow energy gain to play the campaigns. I wish that there was an option to purchase unlimited energy! If that were the case, I'd give this game a 6/5 star

Best Warhammer 40k game for your phone. I have found a problem it's with the cool down timers they are way to long in my opinion. The rest of the game is awesome so far been playing for hrs now and I really do like the game. Oh one more thing the price for DLC is very expensive I would love to buy them but for 30$ I can't justify spending that much on it. I want to see this game secede but I think lowering the price of DLC to something reasonable like 15$ .

To me I do like how they translated the game to this and how the models look like figures themselves, but with not many characters (specifically fictions/sub groups/legions) it makes seeing the same character a bit boring. But where it shines is like mentioned is how its played it reminds me a bit of Fire emblem heroes. Also please add the salamanders

Good game, one of the more enjoyable and well-done ones I've seen on Android. Really enjoyed the first few days with it, played the campaign and other game modes. After that I've hit a difficulty spike, ran out of resources to upgrade, which require grind..Basically a soft, gentle timewall+paywall. Its far from terrible, but coming from PC game culture, I don't approve this f2p monetization / grind scheme. So parting with it, 4/5 and moving on. Devs: you did good job on Tacticus!

Bad game. Tried connecting my google account and it doesn't let me. Couldn't connect to the internet, it said. Tried resetting my phone, the wifi, clearing the cache of the game, and it still doesn't let me connect. Sure the graphics is somehow passable and the gameplay is also passable, but it just won't let me connect to my google account. 2 out of 5 stars.

Not counting my days played or giving coins. I have been stuck on days played at 12 days and rewards are supposed to be at 14 days for 9 days. Then they keep changing rewards and increasing the amount to cash out. Like all the games in this app. They need to be sued like Google was. False advertisement and fraud. They blame each other when you do get. Response. 0 on a review.

If you like the figurine game warhammer, you will like this game mechanics, art, and scenario~ not a shooting game like space marine~ Only down side is that this game needs a continuous connection to the net, even to play solo... i would like an offline mode where i can progress in campaigns, even if all the loot comes only when I log back in. Beeing on the road a lot, this online only limits me a lot

Game is fun, but it quickly gatekeeps you with ludicrious damage from enemies or just random spikes that your runs become either impossible or lose potential rewards. Furthermore, there are so many menus, reward tracks and somehow you are getting at most 5 blackstone each and you require 300 for a single pull. And if you wanted to buy into the game they are charging 50 bucks for packs.

It's what you expect from a tactical genre of game, with a W40k skin on top. Needs more graphic settings so players can save battery. This game chews through battery pretty fast even though it doesn't look that power-hungry. Should give players an option to reduce framerate as well to save battery.

Edit 2: tried again for the anniversary. Nothing changed. Useless grind and constant requests for you to buy stuff. Just let this game die please Edit: down to 1 star. Early game goes is enjoyable then it's a grind with no reward. Don't fund this garbage. It's the same as anything else on mobile, they just want your money. Don't give them it

The gameplay is fun, but once you hit a certain point it's just the biggest grind ever to get just 1 or 2 shards out of 150 needed to get a new character or upgrade current ones. PvP is dominated by the same setup by whales. You will struggle just to get a single item needed for a simple defence upgrade. Also sucks because you have 0 control over who you get so if you like one faction but hate the humans well then you're out if luck. Would of been better to pick 1 faction to play in my opinion.

Simple gameplay, gentle learning curve, and a good IP, solidly four stars. (I also appreciate having a game where fan service isn't a factor in what makes the game appealing) Arena matching can be improved for brand new players, I'm simply unable to find anyone with a low enough strength when I first unlocked it.

Paywall is steep and most of the menu interface makes no sense. Its hard to navigate and get to character pulls or actual gameplay. Gameplay is watered down strategy. Way too many currencies. The whole experience feels like a giant waste of time. Why can't anyone make a good 40k game?

I am loving the game so far I think it would be a cool idea for the vehicles of war to give your troops additional bonuses if they are the same "class" like for the ultra marines if you're using the dreadnought it will give the other ultramarines more abilities like for the sniper. It could give him extra range or damage and so on. And I think you should also add more. vehicles of war like giving the orks one of their cars or tanks that would be a really cool idea. can't wait for more characters

One of the best games I've played and they are constantly being creative with their events an game play. It encourages players to promote different characters and not just bash out upgrades on a single character. That said though, you have to be tactical on where to spread your resources, not just in the battles themselves. (They are also pretty quick at fixing stuff and hand out freebies if they make mistakes!)

Fun to collect and see your favorite characters. Requires a massive amount of patience to not spend a ton of money. PvP is unbalanced and key resources are kept behind paywalls. All in all, fun potential ruined by predatory mechanics. There are better ways to get my money, like cool skins and things like that

Pay to Play. The game has a lot of potential, but is completely bricked for non-paying players. Hit level 67 in the first campaign and get basically one shot by every single enemy. Upgrading your characters is an absolute slog unless you buy packs. Jump on once a day to collect your daily loot and lose the same campaign level.

The probably and unfortunately best Warhammer 40k game for a mobile device, Overall good experience without the major problems. Those being the ridiculous pay to win prices, the amount of waiting, and the small amount of characters you can use in battles. If the currency prices and waiting gets reduced I'd say the games pretty good.

A good hex based tbs. The gatcha element is limited. But it would be better if the game told you what characters can only be got through the gatcha system. Like the infamous commissar yarick which is offered for direct purchase for a limited time after starting and can only be gotten from the gatcha system after the offer expires.

A solid tatical game and good use of the IP. The charaters are well done with diverse ablities and there is plenty to do. My only criticism would be the slow rate of earning blackstone and requisition means unlocking new characters is a very slow process but on the flip side, you feel like you earned them when you do.

The characters are cool and the gameplay is fine, but like most free to play games, it revolves around gambling mechanics and buying bundles of characters and ressources with real money. One bundle costs the same as an actual PC game, so if you're into 40k, I would recommend spending 70$ on a 40k PC game rather then 300$ on a mobile game.

I normally despise mobile games because the force to purchase to win, watch ads is forced in your face, I understand that is the nature of free to play games. Tacitus doesn't hide that you could spend a fortune on booster packs, resource all the tricks you see in these games but it gives you a decent set of content and modes without ramming it's darker heritical drive for your wallet in your face. The characters are suitably large and in your face and grim dark just as you would expect.

Dishonest and frustrating. They lure you in with a good first few hours then the difficulty upscales dramatically and the grinding strarts. The cool down on activities take way too long and all you end up with is a frustrating game that will take you weeks to get anywhere...or... As they would have it, you pay your way to the top.

Boring. I played for 2-3 days, then the game stops giving you meaningful rewards that so abundantly gives you in the first two days. It's a Star Wars - Galaxy of heroes clone with the extra step of moving and positioning characters in a battlefield. So if someone wants to advance with the same rate after these 2 days, they have to reach deep down in their pockets. Pay-to-win at its finest.

Great Game For Beginners!!! This game is very easy to pick up whenever you have time to play. Turn based so you don't have to worry about losing all the time when you get busy all of a sudden. Fairly simple game mechanics. Just a little bit much going on in the game in terms of arena, and guild, and lots of other things to adjust to and learn with so much to do and learn.

TLDR game is pretty fun until you hit the grind wall. Can't say this game is without pros. has nice tactical battles where you need to use wit. Game is set in Warhammer universe. But The grind and pricing are absolutely horrendous. I managed to complete initial campaign and grinded for 4/5 necrones roster. I can't proceed they campaign because mobs are too powerful and no amount of tactics will solve it: only months of grinding or a lot of money. And you need tickets to not replay same over&over

The game play isnt bad. It's sometimes fun and strategic. A good chunk of the fights are way too easy and some are flat out impossible to either beat or get max stars unless you upgrade your guys. There is a grind for unlocking units and for making them stronger which isn't terrible, but there are constantly popping in game offers to sell me things to reduce the grind, which get very annoying. I really like that you can offer items to guildmates or semd out requests from them.

Game runs well, plenty to keep you entertained and battling, progressing, collecting, etc. I'm tired of the mobile game formula rigammarole but I've been wanting a nice and fun little warhammer40k game to just tap away on my phone and although it's formulaic, just like 99% of mobile games, this game is still a good one. Quick. Deep, but not too deep or anything like that. Fun tactic RPG game.

It was a real fun game for 2 solid years, until someone decided that no part of the game should actually be beatable. my recommendation is to play this a year ago, when it was actually good. you WILL just be annoyed by this game, addictiveness be damned. it's by design 1/10 and 110% will talk people out of downloading it in future. Nice work SP

Progress after the first day or so predictably gets locked behind loot crates and season passes, forcing your hand into purchasing undefined "resources" at random, hoping to get the one your looking for. I'm a table top player and can only afford getting ripped off by games workshop once. As if 5000% markup on plastic resin isn't enough, the underhanded nature of games workshop shines here again. Go play Pokemon or something. GW will continue to pull this nonsense until they stop making money.

This game would be amazing if you didn't have to wait so long for the various energy currencies to regenerate so you can actually play it. The grind is SOOO bad, and coupled with how long you have to wait to regenerate energy means you're spending most of your time not playing the game. The devs need to significantly reduce the Regen time for all tokens to make this game actually fun.

This game is good however it is not for beginners. The game requires experience in turn based tactics games. Also kinda pay to win. Those who hate lootboxes should avoid this game. To get characters it requires lootboxes. Update: definitely pay to win in terms of tournament. Other than that other contents are not pay to win.

I really want to like this game. The core gameplay is good and 40k is awesome. But saddle up for a 3 year grindfest before you can get the guys you want. I just wanted to play with my fav factions black templars/blood angels. But with the abysmal chances of even getting lower tier character or the stuff to upgrade them I gotta go with 2 stars. WWAAYYY to grindy, and that comes from a fan of MMOs. So I wouldn't bother with this game unless you have cash you want to throw away on a mobile game.

An enjoyable game to start with but it rapidly becomes a punishing and repetitive grind. Repetition is fine but it is demoralising as more characters are released whilst the ingame economy stays the same; it makes it increasingly harder to enjoy and use the chars you like. Updates often have bugs and my customer support experience was terrible. I complained about it, but it remains unresolved. I think this could be ALOT more player focused and customers respected and valued much, much more.

I think the game is, for a mobile game, very beautiful and plays very well. The combat is until now satisdying and the factions are well differentiated. However, it bothers me that nearly all bonus content like additional factions and maps are locked behind a paywall... Still, im enjoying my time with the game and id definetly recommend it!

I like how it's easy to obtain characters from drops. That way you don't have to buy anything if you dont want too. That's always a good thing in any game that's free and you usually always have to worry about. Like the amount of content they launched with as well too

I've been playing this game for months and the story get difficult within a couple of days and to the point you can't progress without spending money. The other challenges in the game are impossible. I never spent money and never would for a game that requires 'luck' to get a better team. I would not recommend as it peaks early. The game play of turn based RPG is my thing. This cash grab is not. Best of luck.

Fun gameplay, but extremely grindy and repetitive. Very unfortunate as I think the game has great potential, but squanders it with bare-bones shallow story campaigns, tiny battlefields, stingy gacha, and repetitive dailies. Really wish they'd lean into the deep WH 40k lore for stronger campaigns, with larger maps that actually allow more tactical freedom.

EVERYTHING in the game, even the smallest things, are designed as aggressive microtransactions. After playing a small time, the difficulty ramps up to near impossible until you pay up. The people who give money to games and companies like this are NPC conSOOOMers that are no different from cattle. What a joke.

Very Pay2Win. Yes all the characters are grindable. Yes you "CAN" get all the stuff for free. But when the 2nd from the LOWEST PvP tier has a leader thats got 3x the rating of the rest of the tier [all 3 red star ranked or better characters]...it's buy your success. The game is great graphically and is a lot of fun as a turn based strategy style game and Warhammer 40k game. But as with all mobile games just avoid events and PvP. Update: Even worse now that the game has been out a while.

Like another user here, I found the P2W jump... After playing for about a week, the jump in difficulty is ludicrous, particularly in the versus mode. Other players units doing over double my damage, and the only way to compete is to pay. Micro transactions aren't very "micro" either. Avoid

The game *is* kinda fun, but honestly, I feel that being able to choose a faction is one of the most important parts of a warhammer game, and I don't want to pay 30 quid to play Chaos, when I already spend that much on a kit irl. The monetization and ads ruin the overall experience for me.

game is fun, gameplay is great, has a lot to do it and that's it. This game is the true definition of pay to win. I got level 74 in the campaign after that it was a done deal, couldnt make pass that level because this game is extremely grindy and heavy on pay to win. Arena(PVP) is a complete joke I had a power level of 3324 and i could only find players that had higher power levels than me, this game gives u nothing to help you level up unless you have money to spend. overall 6/10

So far it's what I was looking for, a similar experience to the actual tabletop game, it's fun, gameplay is actually very good too, easy to understand and addictive, just hope that further into the game the battles become more like the tabletop game with more units and unite types allowed on the battlefield. Very impressive though.

The game itself is solid. It's a fun tactical turn based 40k game with a great selection of unlockable factions and lots of satisfying upgrading. The effects are good for a mobile game, every battle feels chunky and blasty. Its only let down by ridiculous predatory money grabbing. You can buy so many different boosts, unlocks and resources it's absurd and the game throws them in your face constantly with limited time offers etc. Some of which are so greedily overpriced it's just unethical.

Though the "micro" transactions are really really big; borderline costs more then paying AAA games deleuxe editions from ubisoft, they are all optional. Yeah it sucks you can't play the fall of cadia insantly, but as a f2p player you still can unlock it, hell most of the modes give you garentied unlocks for orks and choas which helps a lot. The game itself tho? 20 Primarchs/9 Primarchs.

Got this game to get a tau guy and they made the event impossible for new players to succeed. Also on lvl 50 of the missions and can't beat anymore. This is a pay to win clearly and not fun with constant defeat after defeat after defeat. Not overly fun, such a serious grind. Another disappointment by Gamesworkshop. Avoid being sucked in by the hype.

Got 3 months worth of fun out of it. Game constantly wants you spending money to get at least some drops, which kills the fun factor in it.gameplay is kinda nice though, sadly enough. Would not recommend, as I lost 5 months of my life striving towards an end game that never comes, unless one dumps about 40k $ into it.

I play about an hour a day, have been playing for 2 weeks, haven't spent a single cent, and am really enjoying it. Many games like this suck if you don't spend extra money, Tacticus doesn't have that problem. Highly recommend if you like 40k and want a low stakes, fun game in that universe.

Well it is pretty much Rivengard themed in the Warhammer 40k's universe. If you like Rivengards gameplay you should feel right at home with Tacticus. Personally I feel Rivengard is the better game in terms with a larger roster of original characters, fresh art, overall a more interesting setting. A little disappointed that Eldars and Tau are not in ...yet.

Actually decent gameplay, surprised at how well everything runs. Only big issue is the massive cost of things, the state of gacha and loot crates is abysmal. Would never spend a dime in a loot crate or gacha system that is this expensive. Be generous with freemium coins and cheap to purchase packs, and this would be a 5 star, spend money weekly game. I could go buy full 60+ hour amazing games on pc for the same price as these 4 character packs. Well animated and modeled though.

Would be a 5, but the ads for ingame items and such are too intrusive. After every action performed in the GUI, you get a 2.99$ add or something else. Thankfully, it's only for the game itself. Not other games. Other than that, this is exactly how I would want a virtual Warhammer experience. The only cool thing would be if we could color the "figures" we get in the game.

Cool 40k characters. Fun grid turn based combat. Too much downtime. Starts off fast and fun but slows down very quickly unless you pay. This game is very pay to win. You can grind but it is just that, a huge grind. This is more of a once a day game unless you break out the wallet.

I was expecting this to be a part too win base building or card deck building game. But I'm genuinely surprised how fun and especially free this game is!!! I've only been playing for about a day not and I've unlocked quite a lot of stuff and characters in this game without having to spend anything. This dev team actually made a playable game instead of a micro transaction riddled *Thing* like that Diablo immortal disappointment, And to the devs keep up the great work!!!

1. Too much in the game just too much too many banners moving too much to purchase; try to seperate the bundle scrolling and and and other info, with the game sections so that it does not interfere. 2. The game is getting stuck frequently. Other than that I enjoy what is given to me.

Fun game, except for EVERYTHING THAT'S NOT GAMEPLAY. This game doesn't use honest "purchase permission to progress" paywalls; it uses "pay to get enough power to progress" paywalls. When your entire team gets 1 shot by a boss while that same team has 3-starred EVERY mission up to that point, that's not a difficulty curve; it's a difficulty WALL. Then there's arena matching low-level players against players 10x-200x thier power level because those accounts are inactive and have 0 rank. F you lot.

I came back to play this game since a friend got me back into it. I still hate how grindy it is but there's enough to do now that you can play for a long time every day before having to stop due to energy. BUT, every mission takes 6 energy to play and you only upgrade max energy by 1 upon leveling up. This is needlessly greedy and stupid. I have 101 energy. This means I only get to play about 16 missions before stopping. Why not just say I have 16 energy? Greedy and stupid.

Well made and seems very fair at this point. I've tossed a few dollars at the game to support the development team but overall it's a nice f2p set up. The scrolls for the gacha element of the game are a tad bit scarce but there's lots of ways to get most of the characters just by playing. Would love to see more factions soon and maybe some larger scale game play. Overall a 5 out of 5 for not being too stingy.

Great game I aim to adjust to 3 stars after some balancing. I understand the monetization of the game and it doesn't feel that bad, the main issue is balance. Many characters had mechanics to spawn troops on the map that scale just as good as the main hero units. Most challenges in the game are just who summons the most troops onto the field. Once they tweak that, I would play more of it and adjust the rating. Hats off to the character models and everything, it feels 40k

Great game, even if lacking in things to do. Just don't pay for gacha draw. You'll just lose money, as the game has the worst draw rates for top units. You'll either draw the free to get units, or low tier ones. The game should have a save every "x" turns for quitting and reloaring the progress when game freezes.

It's a good strategy game and all the characters feels unique and interesting to play. It's upgrades are like marvel strike force, if you're familiar. This causes issues when you start trying to upgrade higher as parts are needed from campaigns that you don't have access to until you unlock characters behind a $30 paywall, luck, or grinding and waiting for a while. Haven't minded too much for now, as there's plenty to do now. Badges to upgrade abilities are also difficult to come by and limited.

The parts of the game you can play are pretty fun, but pretty much 2/3 of the game requires you to pay at least $20 per army or storyline. You'll only get a handful of space marines, a sister of battle, some necrons and like three chaos warriors without spending at least $20 per faction They managed to take the price gouging of tabletop right to your phone!!!

I like it a lot, my only gripe, and maybe I can get some help I have missions I can't complete as a daily. I don't own the champions so I'm just stuck I can't do them and they just sit there every day. It really takes the wind out of my sails not sure why they would do that. Besides that super fun game, love the progression, just please explain or fix giving us missions in our daily that we can't do seems kinda messed up.

For now all is good. However - item info cannot be displayed once the item is equipped on the character. So, you dont have clear overview of stats. Also, you get thrown in the game really quickly - tutorial is only for basic controls, everything else - you need to learn on your own, so learning curve is a bit steep. It leaves unknown - what does the battle pass do? What is the gain of payed services? After a while, I guess I will find out, but, should be clear what currency is for what, etc.

I really wanted to like this game but its got some problems. Like many mobile games your first few hours will be consistent progress character unlocks ect. and then bam stone wall. I've been trying to unlock the two necron characters I don’t have (overlord/cryptek) forever and im not even halfway through either.... and their not even good in the current meta 250 shards get one and you can maybe get 2-3 a day? asinine. I'd say hard pass you could buy an army for the price of one character.

Great gameplay, and a good rate of leveling up. At least at the begining. My biggest gripe is getting new characters doesnt really seem to change anything, as you cant use them in most game modes, so even after unlocking half a dozen new characters, youre still stuck using your basic 4 or 5 starter characters.

So far this year, the events have been trash and seem to only be a cash grab. The game is heavily tilted to players who have been playing for a long time and is brutal to new comers. In December, I would have rated it 4 stars, but this year is really bad. Snowprint has managed to suck alot of fun out of the game with nerfs, bad events, and horrible monthly passes.

I love strategy games. This warhammer is great. Sure it's expensive with all the little bundles and options to boost experience in the game. But grinding is fun and part of life. I guess. Although it would be great if there was a bit more give for the rewards earned.

I really like this game, it has complex mechanics and character abilities. It's kind a way if you want to master everything, but you learn the essentials very fast. Progress isn't slow as in other games, where you have to grind days and weeks the same level. And of course, it's a Warhammer 40k scenario and it's made well. A very good strategy game and definitely worth a try!

Te game it self is very good I like the look and feel of characters and combat but there's a huge balancing issue with bosses. All levels up to the boss are fine some harder some easier but bosses are overpowered they can 1 shot your units most of the time and it ain't my units being low power. Please make the bosses do a little less damage it ruins the game.

Love it can't get enough! However the in game purchases with real-world money are very expensive for what you are getting, I would be alright with paying $5 or maybe $10 for something really cool, but never $30 or higher. for an in game purchase this is just way to high. HOWEVER! great game! And I feel no pressure to spend that extra money; the experience is deep, immensely enjoyable, with speedy progression, highly recommend!

It's a fun game, up until a certain point. That point being when you need an upgrade material that can only be consistently acquired from a campaign mission you can't access because you lack these three specific characters. Don't worry though because you can buy those characters in $14-30 bundles !

Gameplay itself is fun enough for a little time waster, I do wish the visuals were a little better though. For example the 3d characters do not look natural on the mostly 2d map at all. I also wish they hadn't gone for such a "cutesy" look for the art style. I get that it's a mobile game but it's still supposed to be Warhammer right?

Out of all the Warhammer phone games, this is the best one easily! Playing it feels almost like playing the tabletop! And the prospect of one day getting my sweet sweet grey knights? *Chef's kiss* Solid mechanics and great art style make for an enjoyable Warhammer experience! The grind for new characters can be slow, but the game is still very, very good!

so far the game is not bad, but is another "pay to win", the campaign is dull, sometimes even broken and unbalanced. MP is not a thing here, like I mentioned before. big wallet, bigger rewards. too expensive, the pass system is waste of money, the energy system do not suit the need to make better units and the raid tickets are useless. for the last, as i mentioned, resources are very scarce, and level system is contradictory. shards are stupid. Halo 5 devs is that you on the back ? (sarcasm)

The games desighn is Amazing quite literally what I was looking for in a game. Between having a whole team of diverse units and terrain to utilize in your strategy. Complimented by the graphics of digital units opposed to cards its my favorite game so far. The only bummerish thing is the size of the boards I'm really crossing my fingers to see larger and more challenging boards. Sincerely Thank you Aaron Gill

Nothing special, nothig critical. Kinda smooth gameplay, but it offers nothing special for your enjoyment. The absolutely good example of "hour long bored screen touching zombie game". If you have a battery that you'd like to kill or you have reeeally much time what you want to kill, then go. It is a good pick to you. But as a warhammer player it is a solid meh. The grim dark has changed to loot boxes. A lot of comment spoke about some kind a story, but actually there is no such thing in it.

This game is a lot like the other Warhammer games out there, it's a tactical combat game where you fight on a grid and progress through levels. The graphics are pretty good on this one and is probably the closest experience I've had to actually playing the game in real life. Even the character models look like the actual figures.

Honestly, I appreciate this game for what it is. An app game, with high quality art and a hexagonal tactic based gameplay. It works well, and all the characters feel good to play, but my issue comes with both the pay to win wall, gradually increasing preventing you from playing the game, and the harsh lack of things to do. Everything in the game has multi hour cool downs, making it so you have to wait days just to continue playing in the campaign, and you can't choose which characters you get.

I absolutely loved this game and put a lot of time into it, but when I had to replace my phone after it broke, I lost all of my progress as nothing was saved to Google play. Really demoralizes a passionate player. Especially when you can't log in and get your progress back before starting the tutorial.

The master audio for this app does not work for the many in game ads (which cannot be skipped for the reward and are around a minute long). I find that to be anti-consumer and purposefully disrespectful as is the pricing. On 21 Jul 2025 the best BlackStone package has 1¢ equal 1.3 BS. You have the privilege of paying 19.23¢ to skip the ads for your daily stack of coins. You can skip the ads for a single event token (of which you will need many to accomplish anything) for $2.31!

The advertisement says " choose your faction" not true you don't get to choose anything in this game you get GIVEN a certain number of characters and the rest is all random. unless an event has that character then you can jump through a million hoops to get a billion things to potentially unlock a character... or buy crates and hope that crate has shards to collect to eventually unlock a character. I've spent so much on this game in two years and haven't unlocked one character.

So far so good, I haven't had to purchase anything yet, there is a good choice of units, however I'd love to see more. And the mechanics aren't very hard, but make your decisions feel impactful, there is also multiple game modes that I haven't even unlocked yet. I'd recommend if your a 40k fan.

First, it would be great to have an option in game two actually associate to in account so I don't have to start all over again when I install that in more than one device. Also, it would be great if you can choose which faction you can start with because you're advertising Tau which I love but I am being forced to play everything else first and hope and randomly get what I want. I'm not a fan of the human factions at all...

by 2026 they rly fixed most of the issues the game suffred from. so good job devs. It has become a rly good yer relatively F2P friendly game. It still takes months to unlock the rest of the campaigns and few extra characters, further than the tutorial, but if you survive the first 1-2 month the game opens up a lot of fun and ways to progress and unlock new factions, for you :)

Ok strategy game though feels very bare bones, hopefully will get better content in the future. In game purchases are forced on you later on if you want to improve your roster as any sort of decent rate and even then the drop rates for rare orbs are obsurd. Better games out there to spend your cash on.

The game is fine until you complete the base campaign, then its straight pay to win. A new character bundle will run you $30 and you will need 5 specific characters to unlock another campaign. Granted they do bundles but they still run you around $30. Upgrading characters will take weeks and events are impossible to complete if you are F2P, you'll never gain enough event currency to get the promoted character. In my opinion, if you are F2P you're better off not wasting your time.

I'm quite new, but Tacticus is pretty enjoyable. The combat is fun, the UI is clean (aside from some obstruction of characters), and the artstyle is nice. It feels very polished. One critique I have so far is the rate at which you can summon is very slow. You realistically want to save for a 10 pull as that guarantees you a character, but getting a 10 pull Is a bit sluggish. Tinkering with your units and setup is something I enjoy in games. It's going to take some time to be able to do that here

Can be fun, as a huge fan of the franchise I love seeing all those recognizable characters in there, but any game that uses the energy mechanic these days is kinda scummy. Bit over the top with all the progression gates they put on you and how they want you to charge you to keep playing the game via energy refills. Endless pointless cycle. They are generous with characters at first but after a few days that stops completely. Battlepass completely overpriced and shouldn't exist I'd give it a miss

Completely impossible to play. I got this game at launch through pre-registration and was excited to see what it was like. But I got the the 2nd mission of the tutorial and it kept on freezing at exactly the same point. I tried contacting support and after a few days they responded asking if I still had the issue. I told them I did then heard nothing back at all. It's been over a week now. I recently updated the game and now it won't even load past the initial screen. I hope the Devs see this.

I liked the game with it turn based and strategic positioning of the characters. The grind is insanely slow but bearable with mostly repetitive missions and I am a Warhammer fan. The latest update just showed that the game become a cash grab game and paid to win(forced pvp for daily reward). The coins needed to unlock hero went from 10 to 40 and 50 to 80 which crash the economic. They sell a bundle of 3 heros with 70% off mind you... for $29.99 because of the coin increases to unlock that hero.

Don't listen to haters. This game is as good as any strategy and turned based game on the current phone technology. Want larger maps ? then choose from hundreds of PC titles but you won't get short and sweet battles. Monetization is optional. The biggest gain is from time and days played. Paying for characters does not equal more power, unless you have studied exactly what you aim to try. Top it off with 40k lore and cool characters. RP feels ftw.

It's very fun, frankly. I do feel like it might become a grindfest/pay2play experience because of how the way you unlock characters and the fact you need to have three characters from a faction to play their campaign, but I honestly can't be mad about that. It's well made, the character models are sick, and I'm having a great time.

Paper thin veneer of warhammer 40k. Gameplay is interesting and mindless enough at first, but difficulty doesent just ramp up, it goes from easy to impossible too quickly. Lvl 59 Necrons do not die, duplicate units every other turn, and will overkill your units turn 2. Stupid expensive cash grab. Im happy to watch a few ads to give the devs their money, but this game will cost you more than a 2000pt army in the real game.

Proobably the most pay to win game I've played. Pros are: -Good graphics -Lore is decent :Cons: -The UI is clunky and terrible to navigate. -The content runs out fast, and it's Pay to Win after that. It's very expensive to get energy to keep playing and be an asset to your guild. -Very little tactics can be used when playing. The battles are fast, and most of the characters can't reach high points or defensive positions before the battles are over. Just another money grab.

Amazing 40K game, definitely Top 3 mobile Warhammer title 100% worth giving it a try. However the insane difficulty spike of the game is annoying and 80% of the games modes are locked behind battle passes and characters are very difficult to obtain. But if spending cash doesn't bother you then this game will be an amazing experience.

Too bad the base game is fun and keeping me coming back as basic operations are having trouble - as you can tell from this post I do in fact have Internet access. Typically confusing mobile game. This one also offers fake out ad watch options which just trap you in another game until you force quit this one, giving them a free ad with no reward for the player.

I waited to get Tacticus to see how buggy and/or pay to win it was. Should have just jumped in. The game respects a grind, and gives enough that you can have fun without shelling out endless bucks. Plus, if you don't mind small buys (under $10), you can get very helpful stuff. Reminder:don't use shards for chests, not worth it.

Pathing is bad. I've lost many battles because it decided rather than move to the nearest spot to attack an enemy it would go to the furthest-v that put it in a position to get one shot. And arena battles are all about who goes first because almost every attack is 1 shot kill. Live arena is horrible and should be removed- its 100 percent about installs and spamming undies that can create other units. I was at least enjoying the hangs before it was added, I'm close to uninstalling now.

I started this game Christmas 2022, in the middle of the Sho'Syl introduction event. There were a lot of fun additions during that time, and now there are even more. The game requires a level of commitment both in playing the various game modes but also in grinding to build up your characters. Pros: fun, tactical, well-animated, constantly updated with new characters. Cons: high leveling costs, mode fatigue, energy-use play system.

I really enjoy the combat style and abilities. It's a typical squad based game where you complete missions and have a time gated currency. The unlocks seem fair paced. It crashes every time I click on the screen to start a mission. Makes it unplayable.

if you like Warhammer 40k, this is a solid game to get your fix if you can't buy mini's irl. runs great, character's look great, and events are easy to take part in. also Snowprint seems like a solid developer so far. always working on the game and genuinely grasps the feel of wh40k. no pressure for crazy microtransactions either which great, they are there & plentiful, but not annoyingly so, like what most mobile games usually do.

Its simple and fun, but eventually you hit a wall and its annoying to overcome because its luck based. Worst feeling is finally getting the ability to do a 10 pull and you get 9 resources you cant use yet or dont need and 1 character that gives you like, 10 tokens. Energy also never feels like enough when trying to progress through the game without paying

The amount of different resources is confusing and it's not made very clear what each one is used for or how valuable it is. Game wants to force you to play all of the game modes even if you don't like them, so that's a chore. Personally, I don't like the fact that you can't pick starting faction. There's minor bugs. Still, sort of decent if you like 40k

It's a very simple but amazing game if you ask me. Has all the characters you love from the Warhammer universe and all the ones you hate 😂. But I love how they did the upgrade system and character unlocks. The campaigns are very fun, and I'm excited for them to add more. Every character has a back story, so if you don't know a lot of lore, it helps. Overall an amazing game that I spend hours on a day. I definitely recommend it if you like the Warhammer series.

was a bit unsure about it being top down but was suprised it had actual 3D models instead of sprites. bummed that I need internet to play it but at least it doesn't take too much data to play without lagging and I can still check and appreciate all the character models even without a connection. would be cool if there was a mode to make it have a more isometric view of the battlefield but this'll do. Fun lil game, please add RavenGuard lol

The game as a whole is fun early on, but the mid to late game feels genuinley impossible. The grind is unreal and XP is not possible to get from battles, only from books. Which you can spend mutiple very limited curriencies on. The game needs a major rework and needs to feel actually rewarding to play for me to ever reccomend someone new playing this game.

Been playing pretty consistently for about 6 months and without forking over 100s of dollars to progress, it becomes a frustrating grind. The power curve is so severe that you can dominate a campaign fairly easily until the last 2-3 missions, which will then take months of leveling to get characters that don't get destroyed round 1.

Its a fantastic game, until you hit the paywall around 5-10 hours in. I need to upgrade my units and the parts to do so are in a separate campaign (exclusively, unless purchasing them in the store), and the additional campaign is 20$. There are multiple of these that are required. To be able to upgrade everyone and unlock campaigns to do so, will run you over 100$. Which isnt worth it by any metric. I love tactical games so I hope they do away with this campaign costs, for the good of the game

At first I really loved this game. Characters looked cool, the mechanics were okay, and it was overall a pretty good game. Or that's what I thought... When you get done with all the tutorial stuff it locks everything behind a massive paywall. You wanna get Anuphet? Well TOO BAD because you have to grind to indomidus 75 and then beat it which is extremely hard to do. Or, just simply swipe your credit card.

UPDATE: UNINSTALLED. Yet another mindless cash grab. More proof that GW only cares amount $ not players, since they issue licenses to devs to make games that LOOK GOOD on the outside, but dig deeper and you see the truth. You >CANNOT< progress unless you pay! It's a shame because it plays decent for a mobile game, but sooner than later it's another mindless "open packs, collect & upgrade" game. Imagine if GW were honest, and actually created real games that cost a few $ but weren't so empty.

Play for a week want to uninstall heavy pay to play/win. It starts off as ultramarine (typical poster boys for games workshop) it's pretty easy going, then halfway through your nailed with a difficulty spike and for some odd reason necron scarabs are 1 hit overfilling my units which I spent days deliberately grinding to over level to make it easier. I mean scarabs!! You need a very specific damage type to even kill them effectively to which you only have 1 character with it.

Provides excellent turn based combat and challenging battles with a variety of different characters to collect. While the grind of upgrading/unlocking characters can be slow and stagnant at times, it often just makes it all the more rewarding. Additionally, the overall style of the game helps bring the universe of 40k to life. The character, sound, and game design all combine to create a truly interesting experience that will leave the player coming back for more.

2/3 of the characters are blocked behind a paywall (DLCs). As first instance, it seems once the devs completed they game they locked most of its content behind a pay system. Shame, since they game is quite enjoyable but way too expensive and greedy. The prices should drop massively if they want players to invest on their material. Most of the DLCs are worth the same as other AAA and AAAA titles out there on PC and console. Deleted.

Loving it. This game is pretty good I've had one advert so far and it was optional not many games offer that great gameplay I'm not one for turn based games I thought it was going to be sort of like dawn of war 2 play style. Turns out turn based is pretty decent I know progress will slow down as I continue playing hopefully not slow enough to make the game grindy and boring as with most mobile games it would be a shame to stop playing and delete this very promising game.

Overall. It's a good game, has nice design and plays well. It is an 'energy-game',once you've run out, buy more type game. There are quite a few factions from 40k that you can play as and the devs are adding to them. One thing I like is that every hero can end up at legendary rank, though some will require time (or money) to make that happen. There are different modes, so it's not a (total) money-grab PvP type of game. Don't expect to unlock your favourite faction quick without lots of money.

Shameless cash grab. The thing you get to do the most of is the "Arena" which is a hyper imbalanced game option that forces you to consistently compete against opppnent line ups that exceed your power level by 5 times or more. They do throw you some bones every now and then to keep you playing, but for the most part they want that money or you will be grinding your life away to try to get a decent character, then of course once you have them you need another lifetime to make them strong enough

Amazing gameplay and versatility with a vast amount of units to unlock for full battle customization. If you'd like an interactive experience away from your tabletop Warhammer, then I highly recommend this mobile version for tactics practice and well-organized, turn-key campaign experience! It flows seamlessly even as a turn based RPG and I give the entire experience 5 out of 5 stars. The only thing that could make me happier is if they would bring me on as an audio engineer! AMAZING!

It's interesting but takes forever to collect and upgrade things, and always seem to get things I don't need due to being low powered, and some codes never seem to work. I've almost quit a few times due to how slow the build-up takes. The only reason I seem to stay is my loyalty to the 40k world, the only reason I stay.

The game is good, I would like the option of starting faction from the start however. I play and collect Death Guard and Chaos Space Marines and when I saw they were available, I was disappointed that I either had to pay to play them, or grind out the packs to unlock them. Fortunately, the game is fun enough on its own and can stand on its own merits.

As a long time player this game gets dire. Nothing feels worth it. It's a good tactical game yes but that is it, just that constantly. Great for seeing models come to life but if you aren't a warhammer die hard fan then you won't last. They do not care about you unless you put money into the game. Code that said don't share with freeloaders is ridiculous. Do not give them money.

Fun to play, easy to grasp the mechanics. scratches the collector itch without going crazy on the number of characters like most gacha games, but still plenty of variety. You don't have to p2w but some of the deals are cheap enough that it doesn't hurt to pitch a couple bucks to make the game more enjoyable.

Every other review stats the game starts fun and becomes a grind. For me I agree and the achievements show true to that.... Use abilities 100 times for the first one. And use 5,000 abilities for the second one.... It speaks for it self. How ever the early game is really fun and enjoyable I do think it's worth a play.

An obscene money sink dressed up as a tactics game. There's a great game hidden in here but it has the same kind of cancer Diablo Immortal has so you'll never actually play that great game. The f2p wall starts hitting hard at around day 2 of owning it, but you'll be constantly harassed to spend hundreds of dollars about 10 minutes after your first log in. Avoid this like the plague.

Warhammer mobile games continue to disappoint. The gfx during combat are BAD and overall gameplay is dumbed down. The maps you fight are all the size of your screen. No sweeping battles. No fog of war. No complex strategy. The design choices are baffling it's like a Fisher Price WH40K game. These people have zero understanding of what makes a good game.

Game is an unreasonable grind. Half the characters in it are not acquirable except through random drops and the drops very rarely give any characters at all let alone any rare ones nor do you get very many requisition pulls very often. I am able to pull 10 characters maybe once every month if I'm lucky without spending money. Many factions have been in game for a long time and never got a campaign (DG) PVP Arena is an almost guaranteed loss if you go second. Still best warhammer phone game.

I'm revising this review and would NOT recommend this game. You'll hit the paywall, such a horrible "gotcha" game with outrageous pricing. You can play the REAL tabletop for the cost they charge and it's done in such a way that if they believe you're a sucker the pack will cost more versus those that refuse to pay the cost less so they have a variable pricing scheme to basically milk out is much money as possible and it's disgusting. 100 dollar "special" for anniversary....just pass this one up.

Unfair Scaling, Unreasonable maps. Maps are too small to have any tactical playstyle. Characters dont have flat stats and have levels that offer different events per battle. Maps are small and height maps usually favor one player. height controls alot of damage and doesnt show up on chacter stats to show how much of a buff a character has. The UI leaves alot to be desired from a stats tactical approach. I understand there needs to be progression but its done in a bad way.

Pretty standard mechanics if you have ever played a FTP turn-based, squad game like this. I have been playing for a couple of days and I am hooked. It would be nice if you could pick the hero you want to unlock...but I understand why it is setup the way it is. The game menus can get a bit cluttered because there is A LOT of content to play. Overall the game looks great, runs perfectly fine for my S22 and I am progressing at a quick enough pace to keep my attention. I highly recommend!

Played. Enjoyed. Spent real money on this game as I was enjoying it. Then it crashed, needed reinstalling, and reconnecting to Google Play has overwritten my old account with the new one. Brilliant coding to let that happen. I am not going through that again and tbh, am going to look at ways to recover the money I paid. Thanks...

The game is fun, but in order to upgrade your characters so you can ACTUALLY progress in the game, you need to constantly bang your head against missions stacked against you using up a finite energy resource, and the only way to continually play and push these missions is to pay.

Unless you're willing to dump thousands of dollars into it you won't get anywhere. $30 for 1/3 of a rare character's shards or $35 for 1/5 of a legendary character's shards is downright criminal and absolutely unsurprising coming from Games Workshop. Also of note is the current event which "allows you to unlock a legendary character" but unless you have a large number of maxed out legendary characters as well as paying $20 for the "additional rewards" feature, you WILL NOT GET IT!!

Seriously bad paywall shoved in your face to progress in any meaningful way. Starts of strong with giving you the starting 5 characters, but once you get about halfway thru the main campaign, it suddenly jumps the difficulty past anything the game was giving you as rewards prior. I get there being a difference between playing for free versus the gacha system they have. But character progression and gear should not take me forever. I'm not dedicating a year of grinding to get anything meaningful.
