I'm only playing this beacause i'm the kind of dumb dumb that keeps falling for gw's predatory monetization tactics and can afford to spend a bit of money on stupid things. The game is good but i don't feel raccomending it to you, i'm around 250€ in and i'm still a scrub. I like this game a lot over clash royale, but when i used to play that i had all the cards and a bunch of maxed out decks and in a year of playing i didn't spend more than 70€

The game seemed fun but you very quickly run into a paywall and even if you decide screw it and spend money on it it doesn't get you anywhere I'm stuck in the same place I was so it's just me grinding on this game every single day for months on end before I even get enough to upgrade one character because doing the raid missions might get you two or maybe three of your character pieces everyday when you need at least 30 or more for the higher upgrades don't waste your time or money on this game.

This used to be a great grinding game. Grinding is pointless, but at least it's fun and you feel attached to the characters. Sadly, recently the developer chose an even more money pushing strategy: 1st introduce many powerful chars to attract investment from players. 2nd realese even more chars than usual. 3rd when all (dollar) investments done, they nerfed the original chars to ground, forcing players to invest in the newly realesed. The cycle will repeat. Don't fall for that as I did.

Pretty good tactics game, graphics are quality and the perks/bonuses are plentiful. Easy to play without having to "buy in" like so many other games....would like to see a bit of 1st person shooter combat (just to mix up the game play) but all in all...a solid game 🎮 👍

Only one major downside to me is the Onslaught game mode, my problem is that once you complete an Onslaught mission, there's no way to go back and replay low level missions, making trying to rank up lower tier characters quite annoying as you're pretty much dropping them into levels they're not prepared for and hoping they don't die. it would be nice to reply those lower level missions to get shards for the new factions that don't have their own stories yet. Oh yeah, add more storylines please.

You control how much I can play. I get about 1 hour a day. Then I'm out of all action points for any game mode. That is why we can't retain people. I give 3 stars because I like the game and the recent updates. Please consider reducing cool down in action points. Update 3-12-23 : I suggest when using raid tickets, we do not lose action points. This would be an easy way to increase gameplay

Rife with micro transactions and bugs. Lots of thirsty pop ups trying to get you to buy stuff. It was fun for a little (very grindy though) while until I tried to start the game offline and it went berserk. Would not recognize internet when I was connected again. Tried restarting the phone then uninstalling the app to fix it then just ran into another bug that broke it again. Oh well.

I haven't been playing for long but this is very enjoyable and very addictive. Monetization isn't overly intrusive at this point, and I've been able to go through the campaign at my leisure. Not a large scale turn based strategy, but based around skirmishes between small parties. Which works well for short bursts of play. The controls are easy to use and well thought out. Will update this review after playing longer.

Game is decent, but lacks some QoL features like skip tickets, Autobattle and a wishlist for recruitment. These features are common sense and established genre standard and their absence makes the game feel like a chore 🫠 Also getting the character you want is so hard without wishlists or pity systems. Overall the gacha experience is quite frustrating 😖

Really like this game, well done! Only reason for dropping one star is the tournament that is currently running needs addressing. Basically, it amounts to whoever gets to attack first, wins! So all you end up doing is both sides dance around out of range until either you or they make a mistake by getting too close, then you loose the round. No real game play at all in this mode at all, boring and frustrating. The rest of the game is excellent!

You should skip this s game. Monetization is outrageous. $13 for one character to unlock a campaign (prorated price for not even epic or legendary) , $15 for not enough shards for a character to even unlock, $20 dollars for a premium battle pass, etc. Pretty much this entire game is just nag screens to buy stuff.

For a project based on Warhammer, this was really nice one and quite enjoyable for a while. I got 7th rank in Arena, completed the campaign as Ultramarines and suddenly lost my save. That is a total disappointment because I was really having fun last week from time to time revisiting it, but I guess this final update made a big conclusion in my playthrough.

I've really been enjoying this game, but there's some sort of bug that takes my materials when I try upgrading my characters, without applying the upgrade, making me have to reobtain the materials, which can sometimes take days. I've received no compensation for all my lost materials and lost time.

This game is awesome for Warhammer 40k fans. I love it, so many characters, modes, and campaigns...but know what you're getting into. I bounced off this game at first because it is a game about grinding characters, getting stronger slowly, and becoming tougher. It takes time. Find a comfy rhythm for when to play it. It's a great time to join too. Snowprint has also been good about finding ways for players to unlock characters, without the bad gacha system. lots of fun rotating events.

The game is broken. Halfway through the tutorial, it has a game breaking bug. It says "hey you can do missions now!" Then requires you to claim an incomplete mission. Which you can't. It seemed like it might be a fun game if you could play it more than 5 min before it bricks itself.

Another pathetic money grab from GW. Sadly, even being produced by a different company doesn't prevent this game from being horrifically unbalanced. Game developer does't care about game balance, so after a few days, it is no longer a game that allows to have a chance to win based on making good tactical decisions. It comes down to who has or has bought enough supplies with real $$$. If you are not prepared to be a big spender on a mobile game, I would strongly advise avoiding this game.

Game was fine until it didnt let me update it. Honestly kinda annoyed since i was trying to complete the quests too. (I tried updating the game over a span of a week. Everyday, just entering play store to be told that I can't update it for some reason.) Eventually gave up. Tried reporting the problem...but nobody gave me a reply or anything...

The constant need to spend cash is kind of a drag even when forging gear 85% ish are failed items needing $1.99 to $4.99 to keep and of course you can spend $ on runes also to keep said items. I understand expansions can cost $ that's a given but it seems as though all these Warhammer games do is charge $ for every thing. I like the games but all of them are $ $ $ required as eventually you will also hit a paywall.

Content is a bit thin on the ground as timers are very long, maybe 30 mins of content a day, great for toilet gaming but not much more. easy to get bored of it quickly once you notice the easy win strategies, essentially it's a whale magnet, graphics and animations are nice, but wasted on being a polished idle game, capitalizes on a franchise, likely to burn out fast too due to timers, don't waste your money

I want to love this game but to be able to unlock new characters seems like you have to play the game nonstop. I play maybe an hour every other day and still cant get them unlocked. You also hit a wall with hard enemies shortly after starting and you can only run certain levels every so often

It's Grindy but has its moments. My main problem is bugs. Sometimes the audio won't work on launch, and it crashes constantly on data. The worst part is it doesn't save your progress when it does and you can't start back where you were on whatever level you were on . It's very frustrating and it happens constantly when your playing on the go. It would be better if you at least got the energy you just lost back Instead of having to wait for it to recharge on gamesmodes with a high energy wait.

Been playing for a long time as a free player and you can not unlock event characters without paying for the boost if you only use your free time you will only ever get close to having enough point but you will fall short this is obviously done on purpose as they push the very over priced boosters pretty heavily your only hope is to save 10 scrolls witch I've done and have gotten a few characters this way now but it's taken a very long time

Very fun tactile game set in the Warhammer 40k universe. The models look very good and it's overall smooth game play. Repetitive parts can hinder fun, but the diverse units and different army's makes it worth it. Glad to see a good warhammer game, that looks like its to encourage players to look at models in real life. I'm very happy about. After a re-edit and going back through it, the dependency on money to stay relevant really hinders the gameplay. And it's very saddening. Otherwise good.

Too grindy. Difficulty curve requires you to spend money to play singleplayer campaigns and has you starting in really bad positions with units that overwatch the first unit to move into the ground stopping you from completing the mission in a way that you can grind it for a 33% drop you need 15 of to complete an item 3 of your characters need. Arena quickly becomes unplayable after a month or so you end up only able to fight people that are 5+X your entire teams power level.

Just another typical tapfest with tons of flashy animations that's aiming to keep the ignorant masses wanting to constantly "play for upgrades." The art style and graphics are serviceable to good, but there's nothing spectacular with the actual gameplay. I was bored before I even made it to the first necron boss. Tacticus is just another example of the ever growing transaction heavy mobile games that only aim for your wallet instead of actually providing engageing gameplay.

It starts off strong and fun tactical game, however that ends real quick once you realize how tedious and grindy a game is. Especially when the quests don't reset like the Daily quest does which limits you to one a day or wait a couple days for it all to refresh. Your account level is tied to your BP for a slow grind forward, however just like the other game, the grind and wait can be skipped for about 30 dollars where you can buy units giving you access to more content.

Gameplay lacks strategic depth--there are better and worse ways to use special abilities and terrain, but this changes very little from battle to battle so it gets repetitive fast. Worse, they use every trick in the Skinner box to keep you playing despite mediocre gameplay. You will spend almost as much time claiming and applying your various rewards for progress as you will actually playing the game. Why make a game fun when you can just mash that dopamine rewards button?

The games seems ok, but in every gacha I played you could return used energy if you lose or restart the level. But here you spend it anyway, not cool. I already stuck in the game, because campaign became too difficult but I am not able to power up my champions, I dont have any energ or tokens and they recharge so slow.

I'm honestly loving this game. I don't particularly like games like this but gamesworkshop did good with this. Combined enough of being able to win and advance along with the ability to gain any of the characters instead of having to pay is one of the many reasons why I stay. The only thing I find wrong is that I don't see any Salamanders yet lmao. Great game legit af

Its a cool game in all based of the old fire raiders game with a 100 areas to spend money. Its completely a revenue oreneted. If your not spending money u dont get far. A minni campaign but pay for more and a useless side quests where u get junk.... Lol. Really id say not to bother if ur not looking to spend money. If you want to take a look at the mini campaign its the only thing good going for this game. Other then that screen after screen after screen of spees money. Its horrible To bad ...

Boring. Basic turn based grid. No challenge or story. After progressing thru seemingly endless effortless battles and multitudes of menus to get all the meaningless power ups you suddenly hit impossible battles without the ludicrously overpriced pay power ups. Since there is no strategy, story or sense of character there's no reason to continue. Real shame, this had potential. Devs should play the original goldbox Champions of Krynn series to see how it's done. Story and strategy.

I like the game but the scarabs are breaking the campaign. There needs to be a rework to them to make it less painful to deal with. The fact that they spawn more full health scarabs endlessly, even when the initial unit is almost dead, that can immediately attack is a little more than broken since they can deal upwards of 60+ damage with high armor pierce. I do like the high threat they pose but something needs to toned down, either damage, armor pierce or the spawning.

The connection issue was resolved in a bug update it seems and the game seems to run a little better, I never got a download though so idk Old 2*: The home screen is 40% ads for things to buy or the wider hobby and the game is constantly saying I'm not connected to the internet so I can't do anything. The fact that it requires internet for PVE and upgrades is ridiculous.

Best game I have found for 40K on a phone app. Love the effort to keep adding new characters to game. Guild raid format is great also. One game where it doesn't matter when you start. Not being raided by advanced players just because they can, is such a positive experience. I have quit so many of those games because you can never catchup to the player's who started at kickoff of game.

So I like the game, quite a bit actually. But... Stop it with the predatory time limit deals. 2 or 4 hours to buy something that just pops up that could really help your game is kind of gross and honestly should be illegal. Give me time to purchase these things on my schedule when it would be responsible for me to do so.

Insane micro transactions don't even unlock characters , for example currently there is an event going on for Titus and the secret level episode drop for Amazon. Along with the event quest which does almost nothing to help unlock the character for you, you can spend up to $70 on microtransactions and still not unlock this character. And the odds of getting him through a requisition drop is really low, but also technically another microtransaction.

After 3 years of playing this game, I have to say it is the best Warhammer 40k mobile game to date. The support team really listens to it's player base and the updates are in line with what the people have been asking. Is it P2W? Of course. it's a gacha game. But F2P players have a ton of content to enjoy and a majority of characters are farmable and thanks to the generosity of the game, you will complete all the characters eventually with enough time and patience.

Really good game. No crashes nor other bugs. But if you are going to add a campaign, at least make the characters required to play it easier to get. I'm still missing one of the eldar required for the new campaign and the only way to get said character would be by requisition drops. Characters are very rare to get this way. Plz change

I have tried a few Warhammer games on the playstore and never felt they quite loved up to the grandeur of the grim dark setting. This has been an enjoyable experience, though only a few hours in. I look forward to exploring the multiple play modes available. I appreciate no immediate paywalls, no aggressive hard to exit pop up ads, it has been free of those nuisances. Pay if you want, definitely play it and see what you think.

This is a really fun game that I wish I could play more, but because of how they limit how much you can play without paying extra I can't. Also the game has a few bottlenecks that make it very expensive to progress. Typical mobile game stuff but the root of the game that is here is fun and engaging. Also, they have very different events that happen frequently that change up the gameplay substantially. Seriously my only gripe is that I can't play more without having to fork over cash.

Hardcore pay to win. In the Arena, you stand no chance of finding opponents near your level if you are low. Have to wait 8 to 12 hours for 1 energy bar for most of the decent missions. It is exceptionally hard to get the characters you need unless you buy them with real money. Do not get it. It is a waste of time, money, and energy

Surprisingly good!! There is a ton of depth to this game, it does help to buy energy in this game to upgrade quicker. However the game play is really good! If you enjoy turn-based tactical strategy download it. My first Warhammer game ever so I tried a few others.. skip the others! Anyways fun guild-based events with a surprising amounts of events that will give ya pretty good rewards and new characters.

This is a no brain tactic game. Developers aim are to increase your dopamine to spend money to purchase characters, maps, etc and waste your time. the map are too small to talk about tactics and strategy. If you want some real turn based mode game with good storyline? Baldur Gate is the way to go. No doubt.

Warhammer is absolutely awesome and now I get to play it?! wish i could give a higher review, the community, the gameplay, the stories, the characters, the amount of ways to play, the amount of different items and choices, the tiers and star ranks, the newly added mythic rank, literally everything about this game is awesome, super balanced as well for the mostly, it takes a long time to level up later but it makes sense, and the power scaling is really great and also competitive, truly awesome:)

Quite disappointing for multiple reasons. 1). No auto battle feature? Lame. The battles become tedious to do manually after a little while. 2). After mission 60+ the power creep within campaign levels gets steep real fast. 3). Heavy PAY2WIN elements if you wish to progress and not be halted for a long while.

Game play is good, progression does take a sudden jump after the first three pages of a campaign to become quite slow. There are currently multiple bugs including having to reinstall due to the tutorial bugging out when accepting quests. And the game constantly saying it's off-line not allowing any play.

Loved this game but soon found out it's a pay to move on type of game after just like 3 bosses in. Now I'm stuck not being able to win any arena battles, advance in any campaign, let alone recruit anyone. Now I just sit and play assaults or scavanges if I have the two tokens to do so. I enjoyed this game til I hit this brick pay to play wall. Stupid.

Pretty cool game with decent game mechanics. Nice graphics and story line keeps it engaging. The game mode however are over confusing with several different items needed to play and same story with the characters. Fun for about 2-3 days then it's pay to play with what looks like £25 for each new story line or heavily grind. Highly recommend if you're stuck in an airports or traveling for a day but you'll probably want to delete as soon as you get home.

Easy to get into. Excellent Warhammer 40k theme, graphics, sound effects. Good game play, does require thought, not a button masher or point and click. A lot if different options after first introduction missions. There is some purchases but not necessary really if prepared to grind out missions as they can be repeated. Enjoying the game so far. Different factions to play and engage.

The standard Turn Based Strategy Collector game wrapped in a Warhammer 40K skin. Nothing ground breaking play gets repetitive before finishing a single campaign. Heavily monetized, without any really options that are competitive for the $/benefit. Beyond an initial purchase to support the game ... because it's 40K I haven't seen anything that encourages me to continue supporting the game.

Tried it out for a couple months. It is a tactics game. It has several game modes. I stopped playing because it chokes gameplay through energy. You only replenish like 80 energy which is like 5 minutes of gameplay. Also, it gives next to nothing to upgrade or get new characters.

Positives: Very strategy focused game - it's not all, grind. Due to how slow the grind is, you're more often then not dealing with situations that you can't just steamroll. Great support team - always quick to respond to any issues. A lot of characters, giving a huge range of playstyles. Probably half of them you can unlock without too much difficulty/luck. Ads really are optional Negatives: You quickly hit grind wall where upgrading/unlocking a character takes days or sometimes weeks.

By and far the best tactical game l've played... did youn enjoy FFT (Final Fantasy Tasctics) or perhaps Random Hearts? If so this game is for you. A small cash investment is recommended. 15-08-2015: My only complaint since playing is an issue with the graphics driver regarding Android it took some time to fix but to fix itself was excellent. By and far still my favorite game.

I love every bit of this game. It introduces characters and chapters giving more to the lore. one thing I would like is character changing as you give them more gear you can see it on them going through levels. Maybe a story line with non interchangeable legions so that the new player know which side to fight. great game Devs, I like 40k as well. I just love it.

This is one of those games where you need to get a bunch of shards of various characters and gear to improve them to the point where you can actually use them. The problem is the difficulty ramps up to the point where you need a bunch of stuff you can't reliably get much too soon. When everybody needs the same piece of gear, and there's only one place you can get it, and the difficulty is tuned to make sure you can't auto-grind it until you don't need it anymore? That's bad design.

Fine game for one, two evenings. But there are such a lot of mechanics, probably more than ten currencies. And so much paid content that it seems it was designed to be purchased just by accident. Basically the game is repetitive and repetitive.

I can get over the timewall, and I can manage slow progress, and it really can be great game. But... It just keep crashing and its getting worse as you progress. It crashes even on upgrading charachters animations, making your char shards irretrievably lost without upgrading charachter. And collecting those takes time...a lot of time...

Extremely repetitive, gets old FAST. Art style is evocative of the tabletop, with an easy-to-learn but hard-to-master difficulty, satisfying visuals and effects, but that's IT. The cash shop..It is overbearing and CONSTANTLY throwing EXPENSIVE $50+ "Buy this! Buy that!" Packs in your face like Pop-Up ads. You are always needing to upgrade and level up your characters or you'll get steamrolled against even PvE. Events are impossible for nonpaying players and PvP is FILLED with P2W meta whales.

Good game but only takes around 15 hours until you hit the pay wall. Arena match making needs fixing, I'm level 4000 and I'm always put in matches with level 30,000+ that you have no chance whatsoever of winning. Then you have to either wait hours for matchmaking to reset or spend 1 Blackstone to reset faster. I've spent 70 Blackstone in a row on resets, only to continually be put up against players of ridiculously high power levels. Unable to progress any further

So far played about 30 something missions in the Indomitus setting and seems ok, getting tired being offered to make purchases all the time and also in game gold seems to be a nothing in terms of making purchases for the game, have thousands but nothing to or worth spending on and no advise on what it can be used for. Will stick with it for now.

DONT BUY THIS GAME!!! It'll be fun for the first few levels. The ramp up in difficulty is INSANE! You're forced to wait 12-24 hours to reset your "play tokens" and your heroes will be terribly outgunned. Its a desperate money grab that could have been a fun game.

Played until defeating the first boss. Although it's better than most, what stopped me playing it is that it feels like no tactics, you could just go as fast as possible clicking and killing things without thinking and you will easily win. Maybe the tactics come later. idk and not willing to invest time to find out. Also there are a million minor upgrades and rewards which quickly starts feeling like a chore to upgrade and claim all the little rewards and wait for the animation to play out.

Great game, very fun. Couple of annoying issues however, first is unit balance. I can tell the Devs dont play 40k, if Scarabs were that good on the board, necrons would be winning ALOT! Second is the upgrade tokens. The game just doesn't seem to give them out, and your units cap really quickly. On a couple of occasions I'm sure the game has given me some, yet I can't use them...or I can't figure out how to, some of the mechanics can be confusing.

Probably the most predatory gacha game I've played yet. Horribly unbalanced, nerfs that don't make sense, etc. If you're a new player and wanted to get into this game, you need to sink hundreds of hours to grind all the relevant characters. You could also use real money to helps you grind but it's a still grind. Paying used to be reeeaally helpful early days of the game, but not anymore because the egregious price they've set. Do yourself a favor and ignore this game.

Can't remember where this popped up, most likely instagram ads. Downloaded it as as a fan it looked good, first day or 2 you get a lot to get you moving and then bam, grind or pay for characters and items to complete upgrades. I used to play Marvel Contest of champions that similar to this you hit the literal brick wall with levelling unless you paid for the items you need for upgrades. Very disgraceful

It starts ok but quickly gets dull as you grind for parts to upgrade your gear or have to grind for parts to upgrade your characters. I had 150 of one guys tokens but none of the 2nd thing to level him probably 4 or 5 times. It's barely tactical, most things are 1 hit them or 1 hit you and it loses it's apeal pretty quick even to a long, long term 40k fan and player. Worth a try, you might like it but I have uninstalled now after playing since release.

I love the tactics and strategy in battles, visuals look great and the community is top notch. But it is badly let down by instability (has been getting better) and the terrible lack of experience books: You end up massing loads of resources you can never use and serve no purpose as the one thing you need to get so you can use these resources is experience books, but they are no where to be seen in game. You can barely even buy them. Really starting to put me off as i can't progress.

Games is good. Needs lots of bugs worked out. Lots of crashing in various places. Onslaught crashes often and you are knocked out of attempts for many hours. Daily missions require onslaught attempts so if your game crashes you have to wait many hours to retry. Crashes and compensation has to be fixed. Waiting days for a response for a crashed attempts is bad. Tokens need to be bought per day with Blackstone at a 1 per day limit so compensation can occur with Blackstone easier

The amount of choke-points in this game is infuriating. The first campaign alone has 2 major ones, the last of which is so diabolically outmatched that its taken any fun out of the game very quickly. 4-tier componenta for upgrades early game also feels grossly unfair. In-game notifications also dont always clear, and the amount of adverts for various things make you feel pressured into spending in to the game

Just uninstalled. Monetisation is insane. We now have a premium and ultimate battle pass. The level of monetisation is parasitic and morally dubious at best. The whole game is designed to get you to part with cash to progress and there are solid barriers to progression if you don't pay. Strong recommendation to avoid.

Had potential but way too much gameplay is locked behind things that take months to unlock without paying their ridiculous prices. That might be tolerable but the battles are really badly designed where units often get one shot and way too many mechanics completely dependant on rng. Lowering to 1 star because of how egregious p2w this thing became.

This game has a WH40K table top feel, albeit more smaller. It has some features worse than other gacha games. Expect to be disappointed. It also tends to have bugs, but the developers are responsive so it isn't much of a problem. Don't use blackstones (premium currency) to buy requisition scrolls (gacha character currency). It's better to use those for energy refills. Also, as beginners, if you can afford it , do buy the Isabella offer via $$. It will help you greatly. Overall, pretty ok game.

As a long-time fan of 40k, this was a huge disappointment. Between the way the millions of RMT bundles are pushed as a pop-up every literally every screen, and just the terrible pricing of them, you'd honestly just save money buying tabletop armies instead. On top of all of that, the gameplay is terrible and the balance couldn't be further from both lore and tabletop. Games Workshop should be ashamed to have this represent their IP. Don't waste your time or money on this trash.

Overall a very solid game especially considering 40k games don't usually turn out too well. My main complaint is that the sniper enemies are way too strong in pve(just got to octarius campaign where they're absent and it's way easier) and the fact that the game slows down quite a bit after account level 10-15 when you barely receive summoning scrolls and get like maybe 1 every 3-5 days and you obviously wanna save for 10 so that takes a long time, wish I'd get 1 daily guaranteed at least

The game is fun to play. However it is almost impossible to play the game freely. It is very stingy with it's summoning materials and it is very hard to get characters leveled up without money. Even some of the campaigns are locked behind micro transactions.

All of a sudden cannot use requisition? When I click to use it, it states that I need to be connected to the internet (but I am connected?) I think their servers must have been down as ok now. Also the game could do with being more challenging. Only a few hours in at mo though.

Warhammer product = money grab. The TBS aspects of the game are decent. It runs well. F2p is incredibly time intensive and req planning but doable. RNG on requisitions is laughably bad with a decent character once every 130 draws or so. Points lost for laughably poor customer support. Recently, they've had a lot of event release bugs, and compensation is underwhelming and inadequate. Definitely not something I'd recommend paying 4. I spent early on and regret it after a poor support response.

Love this game, fantastic for warhammer fans, not pay to win, and very skill based. My only gripe is if you disconnect for any reason in the middle of a battle, the tokens you used to start the game aren't refunded and neither is there an option to resume the battle once you reopen the app, really wish they add a feature to help this

I've been playing for almost a year now, yet the updates never give a significant improvement of qol (e.g: purchase of multiple quantity of items, auto clear/raid of missions multiple times at a time, rank up to maximum availability of items, etc) only new characters and so on, no new stories, technically nothing new for each updates

I never really got into mobile gaming til I downloaded this one. Was worried that it would be a pay to win mess, but i haven't put any real money towards it! I haven't felt the need to purchase any in-game currency or boosts. I've been anticipating the release of Warhammer 40k Space Marine 2. This definitely has my attention til then.

Trash tier gambling sim. It has mild squad tactics. But it's unplayable a bit after the intro because of all the battle passes and micro transactions. Who wants to spend money on games as a service anymore when services end and you can't play what you paid for eventually. Like an online casino or other collectible trading scam games.

Update: So after another stint of playing this, it seems the PVP has miraculously gotten worse. So now, not only do I get put in absolutely horrible positions in maps, the enemy now outranks me by 3k points to almost 10k points everytime. So arena is all but unplayable, making the game unplayable since I can't get better characters through the only route available... arena. This game is a joke at how predatory it is.

Decent warhammer mobile adaptation. Very hero-centric so swarm armies aren't as fun but that's just how it goes obviously. I can't believe they don't have all the factions, or that they don't have any of the newer combat patrol units (genestealers don't get a biker for example), feels like a wasted opportunity. It is hard to get a specific unit you want, but the special campaign that lets you choose a faction means that in about a month you'll have a decent collection of a faction you like.

Initial first 2hrs in, this sort of takes me back to the Chaosgate game in the 90's. So it reminds me of that with a new flair in a more compact gameplay way but with updated visuals and greater units. Though it doesn't maintain the visual grit of 40k but more towards a plastic Legos end of the scale. (Not bad just easier on the eyes). The detail is still very good quality. The usage of equipment from the codexes and books shows they did good research or knew very well of the universe.

So far I am very impressed with this game. There is loads of game modes to play and more and more interesting challenges are throne at us players. Sure a little trouble with the game running properly, but the game just came out. Those bugs will be fixed soon. Also as a Warhammer 40K fan, I love the design of the whole game and excited to see new content added to the game.

The actual gameplay just isn't very interesting. if you're a fan of the genre, you're going to effortlessly coast through everything the game offers. this app relies desperately on people's identification with their particular 40k faction, and it really hopes that you'll pay the money it takes to get to play them... ...in yet more uninteresting gameplay. two stars because it's decently fun for free, but this app is very obviously a money-grinder, and that sucks.

its a good game, I quite enjoy it. however, play experience is limited by requiring energy or tickets to play missions, and game progression is insanely hindered by the same problem. I understand that a free game needs to make money to continue support, but sometimes it feels, not like its pay to win, but pay to play. Still good tho, give it a try :)

Picked this up after Majorkill's review. Haven't been able to put this stupid game down since. Great turn based combat, abilities. The art, units, and gear/level mechanics are great. Only feedback, the tutorial seems a bit drawn out - and while the music + effects are great, voice acting would take it up a notch. Excited for them to add more races & units. This has become one of my favorite 40k games. Definitely the best mobile. Keep up the great work!

Very addictive, lots of game modes, and fun, but they want to sell you SO MUCH and they are EXPENSIVE for what you get compared to other FtP unlock games, IMO. But it works and it's actively developed, that's just a warning to players ;) FEEDBACK TO THE DEVS: PLEASE add a confirmation request to any Retreat! It's such a bummer to accidentally hit the BIG RED button that's in your face after a pause and lose a valuable onslaught token without any shards or orbs. It almost feels intentional...

Fun game, not very stable. You need to watch ads or spend money for bonus energy or refreshes, but it crashes or freezes at the end of the ad without giving you anything. Sometimes freezes just when you start a fight (like character quests). Really kills the enjoyment of the game.

Had great potential, but too greedy. Large number of packs to buy, but they are not worth it. Pulled two 10 scrolls and got the same character I already had twice. And now scrolls are few and far between. Also, 1950 gems for the last 15 of an event character is robbery. I give up.

Overall this is a fun game with decent combat system and the WH40K aesthetics are very good looking (in both the interface with the varied cool looking imagery and the game itself with gorgeous models). With that being said, it is very "pay to win" and the PVP matches are ridiculously unbalanced; you can often end up facing an opponent that you can't possibly beat. Real life money gives access to very powerful characters that give major advantage in PVP and ease the story mode progression a lot.

Dope graphics, decent game play, and they have VLKA FENRYKA!!. I update this because I no have all 5 available Space Wolf Characters and I'm still enjoying the game. it's wierd that my Space Wolves didn't see any love in tandem with the tabletop refresh. but that's alright. I vote for our Machine of war, we get Bjorn the Fell-Handed with the hellfrost cannon. It can create ice tiles as well and that'll synergies with the Space Wolves. when we get that, 5 stars for sure.

Can you please sort out your ads. I love the game but recently the ads kicking me out of the app multiple time when I try close them, opening up the play store when you try and close them. So no reward and I have to sit through them. Plus the content has become below the standard I would expect from Warhammer. I had from a company called Tango that clearly an 18+ app. i don't really want to be sold sex at 09:00 in the morning on an otherwise normal app.

This is the first gatcha game I've played that actually locks campaigns behind having specific characters. It's Grindy and has awful monetization, but I can't recall a worse system of locking gameplay behind a gatcha system. Also whoever decided scrab swarms should replicate infinitely should rethink their life choices.

Pay to win garbage. They make you feel unstoppable at first, then it becomes virtually impossible to win any future battles without shelling out money. Character choices are poor, the UI is bad, and there's purchase prompts everywhere to try and get you to spend money. Save it for a better game.

An ok little time killer. The grind is real and there are only optional ads which I like. Upgrades system is easy and intuitive as well as being mostly on theme. Guilds are kind of lacking, except for achievement rewards they are not entirely worth being in so I hope they do more with them. Only 5 characters per faction at varying rarity makes putting together a whole team that is faction appropriate takes a looooong time without purchases. Looking forward to updates.

One of the best RPG. The campaigns are Awesome. Futhermore there are multiple events to choose from, creating an epic atmosphere. The graphics in the heroes zone are eye-catching and outstanding, bringing the game to life. The game is easy to understand, with step by step informative instructions on how to play the whole game. The battle grounds should also be commended, having strategic moves within every round. ★★★★½

Excellent Warhammer 40k mobile game. Ticks all the boxes for me as a newer 40k fan. Unlike other mobile games, the combat doesn't get stale after a few battles, it's tactile enough that you feel powerful, and fast paced enough that it doesn't overstay its welcome. Usual mobile game shenanigans included, i.e. guilds, arena, cash shop, etc. Warhammer 40k fans will definitely enjoy this, either as a casual time waster, or a hardcore new addiction.

Gameplay is fine, but within minutes of downloading, you are egregiously bombarded with countless confusing currency systems, limiting factors In how much you can play, difficult unlock and upgrade paths and many, many ways to pay to sidestep these convoluted systems they've created.

Bringing down from 4 star review. I've had a love/hate relationship with tacticus for a while--its the best warhammer mobile game by far, but its also the greediest. Recent baffling design decisions of making every event an endless swarm of respawning genestealers along with the genuinely cruel economy--even if you spend hundreds of dollars you will never, ever have enough badges or XP books to level the characters you want. All this means it takes months to max a single character. Fun!

Very fun and enjoyable game! My only real gripe is with the matchmaking, especially in the arena. I am quite new to the game, but in the arena I constantly get put against opponents with maxed out characters that are often legendary and have no way to win. apart from the matchmaking, it's a really addicting game!

Great game with a lot of content, very nice progression for both type of players, whether your pay a few bucks or free to play. I wish there were more ways to target certain characters and they definitely need to vary the Warshop, as well as give us more ways to reset characters if mistakes were made.

Great game, up until the 45th battle micro transactions aren't necessary, after that you receive less resources per battle than needed to be able to continue upgrading your units so there's unfortunately a dependancy on micro transactions from that point on. The heroes feel very strong and capable, their abilities are unique and interesting.

Need a lot of improvement to the tactics & gameplay The tournament is confusing, ends prematurely it take only one hit for you to lose i dont find it fun. Arena start setup is not all fair. And like mentioned by others you will face a difficulty spike and will take you a very long time or a lot of money wasted on random generated loot box

Overall good game. Has definite balance issues. Some heroes are meh while others can carry a level or arena match on their own. I find that heroes who spawn units are unbelievably more valuable as the units do a lot of damage and soak up damage My biggest gripe is the requisition scrolls (their loot box mechanic) you have to grind pretty hard to collect 10 for the guaranteed hero pull and on both pulls I only got exactly one hero and the second time my pull was a starter. Very lame.

The amount of fun to be had is entirely dependent on your rolls for characters. If you get all one faction you won't be able to even play a sizable chunk of the "campaign" until you unlock SPECIFIC CHARACTERS FOR EACH FACTION. Then campaign difficulty tends to vary on if you ever get more then the minimum characters for any said campaign. This game has potential but please add ways to roll for one specific faction between the three factions.(Chaos, xenos, and imperials) Worst gatcha game ever

It's WH40k Rivengard with some improvements. Some Rivengard characters are more fun than any in Tacticus, but there were many Rivengard characters I never used. I find myself using most all my Tacticus characters as there's more of a reason to use them. Some MTX purchases are worth it, some are clearly for the whales which is fine. I randomly cannot connect maybe once a fortnight and big fights will get stuttery on my 2 year old phone, besides that, no major issues.

One of the better 40K mobile games. Pros: great looking character models, decent campaign story, easy to pick up and play when you're bored, just about everything can be done for free. Cons: Gacha game, MTX offers everywhere, offers are really pricey, game becomes a grind after the first two or three chapters. Bottom line: worth a pickup, unless you're someone that is put off by the mere presence of MTX.

It's a pretty decent game, there's the usual microtransactions that most games have but I haven't hit a paywall yet at least. Gameplay is fun and deeper than most mobile games, the graphics are nice with a mix of realistic and slightly exaggerated colors. Only issue I've had so far is that I can't use Commissar Yarrick's ability without the game crashing so hopefully they fix that.

Combat and war style meets checkers and battle ship. I found it hard to get the hang of at first but it's easy to get into after a while. Overall fun. Could use some more simplicity though it's a lot to take in feels like taking too big of a bite, but still liked it.

Upgraded from 2 to 4 stars. Game has developed really well! I think the new Machines of War kind of event is very grindy and repetitive. Legendary events however drastically go from easy-alright-hard but okay-literally impossible. If there was a way to get common/uncommon badges this would be great, as you progress and require higher tiered badges, finding lesser ones become a lot more difficult when you can't progress through onslaught anymore.

It's a great game. It's a gatcha game and an honest strategy game. The micro-transactions are reasonably priced and some say they enjoy the game without putting money into it. At one point I realized my character roster is my digital "pile of shame". 40k table top fans know what I mean.

I've now had to have 2 accounts and lost the process to my first account as it won't let me try another account as I have multiple emails. there's a lot of in game purchases and the game is pretty pay to play I played the game for a straight year and had 33 characters and I was level 30 something. rip my first account

I have no idea who is greedier, Games Workshop or Snowprint Studios. This went to a relatively free game, into one you have to pay to get anything. Way too many things are locked behind a pay wall, at these prices you might as well just buy the miniatures and play the table top verson of Warhammer.

Not bad, the game play itself is enjoyable and is a step beyond autoplay, but the upside isnt amazing either... Games like this need to give decent rewards at a semi decent clip to retain players IMO. This one does for a while, sucks you in, then the rewards slow down and progress turns into a crawl... or, you know, buy your progress. To be clear, youre battling progression more than actual difficulty. FOMO/sunken cost approach is definitely what they are going for. I love 40k, its a shame...

I'm new to the Warhammer 40k scene (don't judge me) I'm learning the basics through this game, I've spoken to some wonderful people via the guild chat, the controls are easy to figure out, and I foresee actually being willing to drop a dime in this game. I highly recommend this game whether you're a newbie or pro.

Used to play it all day but for some reason it just froze....after game loads right after collecting daily bonus the game just freezes. Tried clearing cache, uninstall-reinstall, clear data nothing seems to be working...too bad i really liked this game but unfortunately it doesn't like me anymore...i guess this is where we part ways.

great game, but a HUGE cash grab. the catch: most buyable packs are rng. even if you manage to get good stuff, you still have to BUY energy just to play for over 30-45 minutes a day. the 2 stars is based totally on the actual game being great. if you dont mind only being able to play 30 minutes a day after the 1st week, its for you. all this actually includes the freebie codes. if you dont use the codes, itll be even harder to play. took me 2 weeks just to be able to play guild wars 🤦

Its awesome but.....has issues. Crashes a few times a day which isn't a problem per say, but if your mid game or whatever you can kiss that token or energy goodbye, which is extremely annoying when it can be 8-12 hours for a token.... needs fixed or they need to implement a feature that put u back into an open fight when it crashes

Pretty good game with great character design but is very grind heavy, it also gets kinda annoying at times with how difficult some of the missions are and how the arena seems to have nonexistent skill base match making (I'm 1875 power and commonly have to face 5000's). The game also frequently crashes for me and if it crashes while your in a game, it won't count you as playing that game but will still take a token required to play that game mode, making daily quest sometimes take 8 hours to do.

One of the better 40k games i have played in a good while, pc games included. Only complaint i have is a bug which makes the notification sound on my phone go off like crazy. If they fix that, i will gladly give it a five star. PS please add the salamanders, Night Lords, Imperial Fists and White Scars!

Been playing this for about a month now, it looks like a PaytoWin but the FreetoPlay aspect of it is actually really well done. Everything can be unlocked eventually w.o having to grind 24hours/7daysaweek. The only thing that prevents you from burning out is your energy bar and whatnots, which are extremely balanced for regen times. 4/5, would give 5 stars but there's too many PaytoWin players with decks in the early Arenas, which force me to Crystal reroll when I could be summoning instead.

Difficulty of the game is based on how levelled your characters are, the hex based tactical combat doesn't rely on skill or tactics, only on a well balanced and levelled squad - so it isn't that exciting to play or rewarding. I completed the second campaign. I'm now uninstalling.

This game has Space Marines and Tyranids and Orks, but the gambling mechanic, "Requisition", makes this game just one more re-skin loot box/ grind for dopamine time trap. So I played for a few hours and stopped to uninstall and write this review. I love playing Warhammer 40k and miss having the time to paint a whole army of miniatures to battle them at our small local game store. That is why I downloaded this trash tornado. Lame. Make better games.

Great tactics game with unique and fun character abilities. Would be 5 stars but i accidentally waaagh'd an onslaught mission with grots and couldnt finish because the enemies had nowhere to spawn so i lost my onslaught token and the wait time on those is super long. Please do something about that and its a 5 from me

Was not expecting the support I have received since playing. Every issue I put myself in, every request I've made was responded to in record timing. The game is already fun, highly addictive, but the player base is out of this world. There is nothing lonely about any aspect to this amazing franchise. I started out thinking mediocre, and sit now in awe. So thankful to have the opportunity to share what an awesome experience I have had, so thankful that I stopped playing for five minutes to write

Connectivity errors are killing this game for me. Even with a strong internet connection You will still get a "YOU ARE NOT CONNECTED TO THE INTERNET" error. Going by Reddit this has been an ongoing issue since release which has yet to be addressed and fixed. Really poor form from the game developers.

If you're like me and saw this hoping you could jump in and have fun with your favorite armies, this isn't for you. Good luck even acquiring pieces of them, as some are locked behind loot box RNG or noxious amounts of grinding set against you. Meanwhile, they take every chance in the world to charge you with horribly priced boosts. Of which will help, and your ONLY option to upgrade them besides the Onslaught mode for shards or overpriced loot box RNG. Shame on the devs for these practices.

After about a long (in total not in one day) of about 5 hours of gameplay there's still so much to do it kinda in a round about way for shadows things to expect in like space marine or any Warhammer game when it comes to the different HERITICS !! And also different people and a brief description of the character

Loved it until I got a new phone and instead of doing what other games do it didn't save any of my progress via email or a log in, it's something you manually have to do without any prompting. So, don't be dumb I guess and make sure you go into the settings and connect your acct.

Great game but micro transactions are WAY over priced. Just like Games Workshop Table Top models. I haven't purchased a GW TT model in ten years because of that. If prices in this game were reasonable I would purchase things. As of now I never will and I make over 200k a year. I can afford it but I will not be ripped off. MT prices remove a star from an otherwise 5 star game.

Great strategy game in general and a must-play for 40k fan. Graphics quality is on par with real 40k models and locations. Gameplay is fluid and fun, even after it gets repetitive. Developers are active and frequently bringing new events. Although I must say that after a few weeks of active gameplay it becomes extremely grindy and repetitive. But it is common amongst mobile gacha games.

Been playing since release,played most of the game and I can confidently say this game is not fun. The most boring missions, monetized to extreme levels that make no sense. No amount of changes will save this ,unless they do a 180.Do x with only this 1 character x amount of times is not fun.

What is a cool game core is ruined by layer after layer of intentionally bad game design that forces the player to have less fun and be less engaged with the content while constantly bribing the player with the ability to just pay some money to do the thing. Waste of time with a 40k coat of paint designed to extract micro transaction dollars out of fans with more money than sense. Classic mobile schlock. So very disappointing, this could easily be one of the best games on the platform.

What a shame..... Fun to play until everything is blocked behind a paywall which hits early on at around the third boss Some basic mission rewards are unobtainable without premium This is a season game, at the end of season you start from zero which is an awful mechanic especially when money is going into it. Overall gameplay and art is nice the game runs really well and is fun as long as you have $$$ otherwise very slow grind after stage 2

Great game, no ads (except for bonus reward videos which are purely your choice). Energy for campaign battles could maybe refill a little bit faster but other than than it's decent. My only issue is since getting a new device (Samsung A15) if I switch apps (eg to check email, send a message etc) upon switching back to tacticus it completely reloads the game, meaning if I'm in a paused battle, it completely resets but I appear to have lost the tokens. Never had this issue with my old Doogee S95.

I have been playing Tacticus for over two years now. The game is a strategic game without an autoplay feature (which is a great thing) You collect characters and pass missions with said characters. The game has an abundance of different game modes and each give different rewards. It is easy and fast to progress if you are willing to pay, but still extremely doable if you are looking to do it free to play. Great game for any Warhammer fans.

Pretty fun game but I haven't been able to make any in-game purchases, when I press to buy the premium battle pass it just slightly blurs the screen and never loads properly. The gameplay starts kind of boringly easy but gets fun pretty quickly, I've currently reached a point where it's VERY difficult to 3 star levels but once I level up my characters more it will be much easier. It's a nice turn based game but the big draw for me is the WH:40K theme, there seems to be frequent events very fun

The game is fun just to get that out there. My problem is the overpriced micro transactions. I haven't really felt like I am being forced to buy them, but it is 100% a pay to win. If you fork over loads of money, you are unstoppable. The game is a typical phone game. It's overly expensive to purchase anything, and if you are not willing to spend the money, just stick to PvE. Because of this money grab tactic, I can only give it 3 stars.

Had hopes upon seeing WarHammer title. 20 minutes in and it's clear too see its as unoriginal as all the other husked out games like it. I guess if you like Warhammer stuff a lot and can handle mediocrity or its your first time playing this style, you might like it. Needs something a little more interesting and less p2w

Could be great if it cost 10 euros and gave you a simple all-in experience where you can earn all factions and characters by simply completing the campaign. Unfortunately as a free to play you get very little for free and uncertain benefits when you pay. The campaign is limited and quite boring. The other factions and impossible to play unless you spend hundreds of euros. A money machine that lost all it's potential due to commodification .

The gacha aspect doesnt work well for this, you get a character and you cant even use it in some campaigns because obviously a different faction. Its just so tedious, grindy, greedy, the UI is cluttered and theres a buy option in every window instead of being strictly in the store page which brings us back around to the predatory cash grab nature of this. Your money is better spent buying minis from scalpers because ironically, theyre more reliable than this money funnel.

This is a very tactical game, 5-Star to the gameplay. NO AGGRESSIVE ADS HERE!!! One of the few games you wish there were more Ads, No kidding, 5-Star to Ads economy. Then the downside of the game (or not) where it is a REAL GRIND when you don't have money to use in-game, so 3-Star to that. Overall, this game has a hardcore strategy gameplay, is not that time consuming since you only check every few hours and play about 15min at a time, and it's WARHAMMER40K, BATTLE BROTHERS!! FOR THE EMPEROR!!

Played it before and actually got decently far before I just didn't play it as much. I recently reinstalled it and got through the tutorial levels and even a few after that. But now, I'm lucky if I can get to the main menu before it crashes before I have a chance to do ANYTHING. Not really much point in continuing to try playing a game that clearly doesn't want you to play.

It's a Gacha game so know what to expect. The art is nice to look at and my only complaint would be that the animations are a bit to fast so it's hard to properly just sit back an enjoy the action but if that's the worst complaint you can imagine this is a pretty worthwhile game.

I'm pretty new, but this is a fun game to play around with. I can see that there will be some grind in the progress, but that's nothing new (or unappealing) to me - I've played more than a few mobile games. Fun gameplay, some strategy, and lots of characters to collect. That's what I'm here for.

I would rate this game higher, but the matchmaking for the arena game mode has actually soured my opinion on the game overall. Not once have I been matched against someone on an even similar power level to myself, leading to one sided matches and a poor game loop of die-repeat until my match tokens run out, notwithstanding how the campaign is virtually impossible to progress in after the 45th level where levelling up your own characters becomes tedious and monotonous.

Base gameplay loop is fun enough for a time but the energy scarcity and parts grinding are painfully obvious artificial lengthen-ers. The Tournament Arena is the absolute worst returning event they have however: a 1v1 battle mode where players are actively resolving turns except unless you're a whale or spend a ridiculous amount of time you've essentially signed up for victim simulator to one shot attack from more senior players. Expect better of the devs, demand some balance.

I friggin' enjoy this game. It isn't perfect but no game is. I recommend it as it is fun. Either as a free to play or you can purchase some extras. That's up to the player. It's a bit of a grind to make progress upgrading your characters but it can be done for free. What game doesn't offer shots of dopamine for a price these days though? Still, it's a blast to play and I play it often. Join a guild. It's just better that way. More ways to make waaagh!!!

Game play can be fun but the grind is wrong and the odds are the worst. The guarantee character draws are guaranteed to pull only characters you already have. I have 15 characters and the 3 times I've saved enough to do a 10 draw acquisition I've gotten 6 characters that I already had instead of 35 that are still locked for me. And the game is ready for you to do it again for another 20+ of premium currentcy. The odds are bad and the money grasping devs should feel bad. Gameplay isn't bad.

This is a peak mobile strategy game. It's not the deepest strategy game ever made but that's okay because it is just plain fun and super satisfying to play. Character designs and art style are pretty cool. Satisfying combat and leveling up characters without having to pay is really great and very appreciated in a mobile gaming in 2025. Of course there is options to pay but honestly the game is fun enough to grind everything without spending money. Highly recommend 👌

Absolutely obsessed with this game, played it every day for months and still not getting bored of it. My only criticism is that every game mode requires energy or tokens so when you've used them all you can't play the game for a bit. They frequently release new characters and events which keeps the game fun and interesting. Best mobile game I've played

This game is actually fun and helps pass the time when you are stuck outside of your home without your warhammer books and armies. 10/10 recommend if you like the 40k universe and hate xenos heretics. More than likely not cannon but who cares? We are here to find an addictive little game to help pass the time. Space Marine 2 is better though...just a heads up.

As a standard turn based pay to win its fine. There are plenty of ways to progress without paying too much. In fact I would say it is reasonable. However, it is very buggy. I already lost out on resources that were not honored. It wouldn't be so bad but there isn't a easy way to request compensation. Overall I give this game a pass.

I know nothing about Warhammer. I play magic the gathering a bought the necron deck really happy with it. Thought the characters looked very interesting have to say it was worth it. I can see myself playing this game off and on my only problem is that the campaign seems to be too expensive for a phone game. Maybe $15 but def not $30 or more. Keep in mind this game already has micro transactions. So idk why they are so expensive. Other than that good game!

The game remains a blast. It's a good way to feed the tabletop addiction when you lack time to play. With that said, guys, PLEASE PLEASE provide some way to pick characters you want to unlock. I'm insanely frustrated with the randomness of drops, and getting characters unlocked on the 3k black stone drops that I already have. I play T'au and I'm desperate to get their characters unlocked, but I just can't. It's frustrating as hell. 130/150 for Shadowsuh but gaaaaaaah on Darkstrider and Sho'syl

DO NOT BUY YARRICK THE GAME IS BUGGED When you reach a level 15 your offered the ability to unlock commissar Yarrick for $5 and all his upgrades for an additional $10 DO NOT DO THIS The game is currently bugged and will crash every time you use his ability. It wouldn't bug be so much if I hadn't literally just paid money for a character that I can not use. The game was serviceable till then.

Great for Warhammer fans. Still a bit glitchy. Can crash during use, removing the token and giving no reward. Cust service, in my limited experience, is pretty quick. If you like games that grind, you will love this. Lots of things to spend money on. And it really does give you an edge. (A big chainsword edge). Frustrating at the number of people with one shot kill characters, The guild raids seem more random than using power. 45,000 power army destroyed by 16,000 power army?

The actual game I would say is 4 star, the adds they allow is negative 100 stars, so 1 star is about equal. Sever caution some apps auto download if your screen is touched anywhere during it! Others just take you to the store seemingly randomly. The good is this has not become a must pay or have to watch adds game, so 1 star is fair enough.

Enjoying it so far, it's something a bit different to play. I just wish there were some more characters for each group. Standard units and elite, maybe even some much bigger maps and larger scale fights would be awesome too.

You can grind endlessly and unlock characters for free as long as the shards are available. Heavily monetized and gameplay and modes are all essentially the same. Limited energy unless you wish to pay and play more. Events for unlocking characters seems near impossible to complete unless they are weak characters.

The game seems pretty simple, but in its simplicity, it performs really well. I started playing as part of a streamer's promotion, and to my surprise, I'm still going with it. That speaks volumes to its ability to hold my attention thus far, and it will probably satisfy Warhammer gamers looking for a simple experience in their off time!

Fun little game with good variation. Definately worth a punt but my big gripe is that scarab damage is a bit too good and after a while its demotivating (especially on the levels where there are just the three ultramarines) when you just see your toons get wiped out in a turn after the scarabs you just manged to kill regen. Maybe just dial the damage down a bit?

Gane is fun but can we please get a fix to the Raid system. They do not need to be triple resource locked! It's ridiculous. We have raid tokens, but the raid still cost energy and each level has a daily limit. Seriously, it's ridiculous. I can't use the raid tokens I have fast enough. I have 6k+ of the damn things, and I raid a lot. Just drop the energy requirements or something. Until then, no higher than 3 stars.

Take ANY of the other tile based character games (Star wars, marvel etc) and slap WH40k paint on it. Same upgrades, same gameplay, only (somehow) even more expensive. 30+ bucks for a poorly planned, bland add on campaign after you get a day into playing, when the free campaign has plot like white claw has flavor. Save your attention for something worthy of it.

Everything is hyper aggressively coming for your wallet. Upgrades you MUST have to advance the story, and characters are less than a 50% drop rate and are on a 12+ hour delay, so you only get 2 chances a day. Energy regen sucks so you think spending $3 a day to play more than twice is OK. Drop chance % is bad on everything. You can burn all your energy to do ten matches and only get 1 Shard to upgrade a character which may need 500 just to unlock it, and needs another 500 to upgrade.

(In short: super scummy would not recommend) On the third chapter there's a big difficulty spike on the final boss. If you don't know what your doing it can wipe your five man squad in about three turns. Basically just a Warhammer gotcha game, with heavy self advertising. If you're not careful you can find yourself "accidently" tapping/clicking on a 25$ pack.

Started out okay but quickly revealed itself to be too grindy to be F2P/ story based, especially considering all besides the first campaign are locked behind walls including PvP and events (or money). Saved currency for 2 weeks for a 10 pull gatcha and only got a few shards towards the 500 required for a nice character. If it had an easier to access campaign and I wasn't forced to PvP or be competitive with my wallet at every opportunity then I may have played longer.

A midling game that only rewards players that pay 2 win. Character events only benefit elite cash dump players, resulting in an extremely top heavy experience. Extremely grindy game that'll take Most of a year to unlock a single top tier character or months to upgrade lower tier characters. Honestly i wouldnt recommend unless you're flush with cash. The 1 year Anniversary event for example was extremely underwhelming, no free or unlockable character, no new missions just a purchase event, lame

Standard mobile gatcha trash with 5 different currencies, character level shards and other frustrating, pay-to-play nonsense. Gameplay for a tactics title is also absurdly easy and involves less strategy than than a game of blackjack. Pathetic offering and not worth your time, effort and certainly not your money.

The game contains just alitl bit of cherecters you can choos and you can't combine them together if they are from different factions so it gets boring verry fast and the game is Very expensive alot of pay walls for no good reason and there is no way to go through it without actually paying Minimum 30$ the game is full of bots to provide higher online numbers not recommended at all avoid this game!!!

The game is promising, graphics are good. My two main issues at the moment is that it's too easy (all campaign missions have been a breeze so far) and there's a bit of a resource overload with stones and coins and seals and whatnot

Lots of bonuses, and rewards without becoming too overwhelming. It's a little complicated to keep track of all the currencies. But, you're always unlocking cool new stuff! Fun war game, with cool characters.

Game has taken over my free time, busy time, dreams, and errant thoughts. Please have the option to buy the difference between the 10 requisitions needed and those I already have as a permanent option though. Only real complaint - having to fully wait for 10 requisitions or 3000 Blackstone is rough

Necrons die too easy my father had a necron army and they're quite hard I have completed nearly 30 levels in one hour and I have lost 1 Space Marine but I have prayed Warhammer 40k for many years and I have a lot of friends that do this is a good game for me but a easy one fear the Chapter of the Ultramarines the game needs more characters for the chapters there is only 5 to each 1

My teams power is 11000, i fight a team with 2100 and lose. You should not be able to lose when you're 5 TIMES more powerful. The power levels make no sense, don't tell me my teams that strong if it's not, they give you all this information to strategize with but none of it matters because the AI is awful too, it won't try to win it just tries to prevent you from getting 3 stars or a lightning win. Friendly AI are all saboteurs, they will do whatever they can to extend the match rather than win

Typical pay-to-win gacha game. Fun for the first 30 maps/rounds, then changes gears to "Can't get 3 stars? Requisition gear. Got garbage gear? Pay $10 and you MIGHT get decent gear or another character." I'd say see if you might be interested in Warhammer 40k with this, but soon as you hit the pay-wall delete and save yourself some space and frustration.

Incredibly fun and easy to learn turn based rpg set in the 40k universe. Characters level up, have gear and abilities, and there is a huge roster to earn and play with. Yes, the game has mtx, but they are not required. Game is worth a download and a try.

I'm enjoying the game, but seriously the pricing, you can play the game free pretty well but the cost of the inapp purchases, some I wouldn't mind buying but some of the prices are insane, the fact that Google play offers vouchers for in app purchases for £29 and more is rediculous. I honestly hope no one pays some of these prices

I tried to play the game, but in order to progress the game I need a specific character, Certus. Looking online I was supposed to unlock him during the tutorial but I don't have him unlocked. So it appears the game is glitched, therefore I can no longer play, and that's why it gets 1 star.

A pay to win game with a very strict meta. Its alot of fun for a day or two until the f2p fun ends and you stagnate at the paywall. Everyone runs the same strategy that basically boils down to how fast you can instakill or be instakilled. Naturally, the more you buy, the more you win. Buy the tabletop minis game. It's literally cheaper.

I'm very VERY new to the Warhammer Universe so I cannot speak on the lore or characters or any such thing. All I can say is, the little I know about the IP is very metal and I love that! As for the game, it's simple, easy and fun! Can't ask for much more than that. It gets 5 stars from me because I haven't encountered any issues and I can play for as long as I like without being hampered by cool-downs, ads or the need to pay to play or win.

played this for a month and the kind of pay to progress game (more than p2w). The drop rate is very poor, difficulty spike is horribly adjusted, Premium currency also very hard to get, like you need 3k currency for 10x rolls but game just give you 3~10 for completing an achievement/mission, not to mention their aggresive approach on premium package is.... well... idk what to say at this point. tl;dr If you f2p player, don't bother to play this if you have money, maybe go for it

Good game, certainly enjoyable. Primary issues are that it is overly monetized and certainly turns into a sludge like grind if you don't put money in here and there. *edited due to overwhelming amounts of unmutable ads, wont watch if i cant mute it, which automatically lowers its value.*

I thought yet another gacha... but its actually very strategic... and more like a standalone game with the drops just providing game progresion. I like that but kinda feal would have been better without the gacha... haha... wishful thinking :) Mechanics wize i love but limitting size of maps minimize the true strategic potential and i hope this can be introduced later. Xcom like in many areas but good 40k atmosphere and flavor. Now if you could make it tru pvp would be awesome...

The game is a complete pay-to-win from the very start. Tournaments are rigged to higher players favor so much, you can expect an add for new characters at $49.99 after the match. A new player has a power level of 4000. You do arena battles with people at 20000 after about two weeks. You can see from almost the load screen the money you will need to shell out, Save yourself time and pain, y the Games Workshop TTRPG and have real fun.

Insidious IAP pricing and targeting was bad enough. Then I made a small purchase, only to have said purchase revoked and by the Devs, no refund, just a lie about which IAPs were available (not been a Sisters of Battle event for months, clownshoes!). Ugly monetisation model. Those vulnerable to gambling or getting caught up in microtransactions should steer well clear.

The game is really fun. The only 2 things I think are missing are not being able to look up friends and dual them, and also, Primarchs, you could have the Lion, Magnus, etc.. but they are not in the game. I think it would be a really good idea and also make pvp in clan war and normal pvp way more fun other than that so far the game is super fun.

They have some good characters in the game and it'll only take you 10 years to earn them. It's basically the grindiest game ever unless you wanna throw cash at it. If you don't pay it's not really fun. Games workshop has the pay to win thing down on table top and now mobile too.

They remove low-rated reviews, real currency for paid unlockables are gated behind the most nefarious series of barriers. Character progression is not based on XP like almost every other RPG-lite but item-drops, instead. Said drops becoming increasingly rare as characters do eventually progress. Each progressive gate depends on 6-20+ drops, PER-CHARACTER. Most battles see a 30-40% drop rate per-item. They also cater to a pay-2-win demographic releasing events that only whales can undertake

So I had a lot of fun after a brief slow start- breeze through chapter one, then whoa- what did ya know? I can't even enter any battle, or other tab, without it force closing. (Windows, not IOS) If you guys could fix the bugs- got yourselves a great foundation for a top tier mobile game.

Insanely grindy gacha that if you don't have great pulls its unplayable and they try and force you more than any other gacha I played to pay to unlock and upgrade character as you'll spend days just making your character just slightly stronger. The main issue is also its very stingy with energy as even watching ads and spending in game currency its a blink and you're outta energy situation.

Another Moneysapping Warhammer experience!! the game its self is basic. Its stuffed full of meaning less loot boxes and flashing lights. PvP is bad, designed to infuriate and cause more spending. All in all this game isn't fun and to even get close to semblance of fun you'd have to part with ya house.

Ye it's good and very much like Games Workshop, if you want a decent Army you gotta spend hard earned cash. Never enough energy to battle as much as you need so progress plateaus regularly. I don't regret getting it though very tactical and gameplay is great for a turn based rpg.

It is a decently fun game, but when i saw all the usual horrible mobile game practices i couldnt help but uninstall. 10 requisitions costs 3000 gems but the closes pack for $20 only gets you 2600, next highest pack, for $50 gets you 6800... Before beating the tutorial they offer a discounted hero for 5.99 to get that foot in the door and enable on click buy then everything else is over costed. Typical gacha style mobile money pit. Do not play.

I like the game but the waiting times are just too much. It's fun, it has potential, but I'm getting tired of waiting 15h just to play Onlaught again, another 5h to play guild raid. That's the main reason I've decided to delete the app (even though i purchased some items).

I'd buy this for 20 bucks If it was like Gladius. But this bite size experience I just can't take it. Like having someone bumming money from you every chance you got. "I just gave you 5 bucks, why you still trying to get more" it's just desperate. I just played the Megaman offline gotcha game and it's a breeze when no one is forcing you to buy money. Love tacticus but it's being held back from its true potential.

This game is honestly lots of fun I've gained characters and I didn't even have to pay for them leveling I really easy. The only reason it doesn't get a 5 is because there were some factions I really wanted to play that have not been added yet (and I really wanted to play my favorite which is the salamanders) but when more characters and factions (please add the salamanders) I will add all 5 stars

Generally it's a fun game, with all the typical trappings of this kind of thing. But don't spend any money on it! I bought a pack of daily deliveries, and if I don't log in every 24 hours, instead of waiting for me, the delivery for that day that I PAID MONEY FOR disappears (!!). That's a rip off and part of an inexcusable, exploitative business model.

Hard locked if you don't spend any money or have no life. I make a habit to only spend money on games that reward you even if you don't spend money. This game locks you out of continuing due to difficulty by the end of the third chapter of the campaign or roughly level 44/45.

Games Just As bad as the ads on YouTube.next time don't get some idiot reading from a script with pcs in his background that sounds dumb as can be and maybe you will get a player base .
