My advice drop the ad and the doofis and start over ..simple as that ..He makes it look bad just by talking and looking away every 3 seconds reading a script . It just doesn't look good at all ....cringe

I had to reinstall the app and now I have completely lost my entire progression. All the hours and time wasted for nothing. Horrible. Don't waste your time. .. the game will work until a certain point and stop. Forcing you to uninstall and reinstall the game and when you do , your entire progression is lost. ..

Don't waste your time or money, unless you want an endless money sink because there's now way to win anything unless you spend ridiculous amounts on this game. Even if you're a 40k fanboy there's no reason to play with the limited amount of characters and gameplay options. Worthless, just like Games Workshop itself.

So far its grind grind grind. Its fun for the first 2 maybe 3 hours, an is a good concept but isnt really all that fun after. You get 2 maybe 3 trys on almost everything. Its super grindy unless you are a whale an ready to put hundreds of dollars into this game. Its still new but i have very little hope for it since 99% of phone games are wallet vacuums.

Good concept but terrible approach. Each campaign is 20euros. CANNOT unlock champions without progressing through Elite story. So u can spend money without the 5* being in the pool. Everything is spend money related. And sadly the gameplay is uninspired and bad. The writing is lackluster and simplistic. It scratches the 40k universe, written by people that did a Google search. Or worse don't even understand its lore. Nah just pass on it. Not worth your time.

It's fun but the game comes to a grinding halt (literally) when in I try to use the medic in the game. It's pretty annoying and ruining an otherwise solid game. UPDATE: turns out I just had more data to download. This game is easily one of the better games to play while on the toilet

This game is awesome, I love how chill and relaxing this games strategy is as well as complicated(in a good way). Environments has bonuses and hazards which I enjoy, gives you and your enemy an advantage while on the battle field. Also a variety of factions and characters to use in your squad(which personally I would choose the chaos space marines, BLOOD FOR THE BLOOD GOD, SKULLS FOR THE SKULL THRONE) I hope they add more later in the future. P.S. I wish they can add Khârn the Betrayer

As a warhammer 40k fan the game is pretty fun for a while, but they're not generous with their free gifts, so the game is very pay to win. Even if you do spend money, the chance of getting good rewards is still very low, and quite often do you get duplicates. So don't waste your time.

I enjoy the game because it is a unique playing style, and no matter how you play you can win in any strategy. Either swarming your enemies or fighting them with fire. Slight change to my review, it's still a good game, but my account was deleted and not by my own hand and i had commisar yarrick and a death guard who spawned some plague boys and chaos sorcerer who spawns blood letters and and ork who could spawn grot tanks and of course most of the ultra marines and battle sisters. It is sad tbh

By far the best mobile 40k game out there. It doesn't want money every 5 seconds like some other titles. Tacticus isn't repetitive, so you can play it for hours on end. While you can buy things in the game, it is not a necessity. You get enough free stuff. My only complain is, that its maybe a bit easy, but that ain't too bad. The develeopers can be proud of what they're doing and should keep on supporting the game with events and everything.

On launch it seems good. Pretty easy to level and get characters. Foresee though not getting as many Summons later though but will update. Otherwise good. Main issue tho is no auto battling (at least at lvl 9). Literally have to control each character movement.

Your Service To The Emperor Is Greatly Appreciated I am a recent fan of the Warhammer 40k series and I am struggling to figure out where to get into everything. Tacticus is a great stepping stone and teaches you about the characters, races, and different sections. It has interesting mechanics that keep combat engaging and fun without becoming repetitive.

Mostly fun. A bit of an overload of currencies to where idk what about 20% of them do and feels like to get properly powerful you gotta drop at least 100+ a month if not more. Still enjoying the campaign and leveling the characters. If only ftp games would start making things a bit more affordable I'd honestly probably spend a lot more one them in the end.

Very fun gameplay, typical free to play difficulty curve. But pretty generous with currency and stuff. My biggest frustration is how long it takes to get back tokens for onslaught, salvage runs, and guild bosses!!! These game modes are more fun to me than the campaign, but they take 8+ hours to get back, and can only hold 3 tokens for each max. Pretty disheartening but hope they change it

Don't waste your time. Whereas other f2p games give you a trickle of energy that can be extended with f2p methods or $, tacticus chose to go with a pay every 20 minutes system. They hard lock certain game types behind long timers(8hr+) despite having necessary materials only from those game types.(not 1-2 mats either, 10 per upgrade) They pretend you can push 1 campaign but won't give you upgrade materials for that team until the 3rd campaign that you must unlock via rolls. Its really bad.

The best phone game I've ever played. Plenty of opportunities to make your characters level up without dumping you paycheck into it. A lot of repayable aspects that you can't normally get with other games in the genre. It's easy to say that I've missed Warhammer games and this one is by far one of my favorite.

Very fun game with enough story and depth of strategy to keep me interested for several months now. That's a huge deal! Usually I get bored of mobile games after a couple hours. If it's too "dark", they have another game that's effectively identical but more wizards and fairies.

Great game. Love the details and characters. Cant wait for for more. Only issue I have is the amount of tokens we get for the other modes like onslaught or salvage. Would be great if it was 5 instead of 3. Just want to play the game more really. 😁 Keep up the good work.

Didn't even know what was going on. Love the 40k universe but within the first 5 minutes I was already confused. Game play is too fast you don't even get to see the animations. There's alot of typos which to me shows that this game was rushed and not looked over.

Loving this turn based stratergy game. Can play FTP or go full whale. Some of the missions you require some charaters to play and only get them with luck and others you get for finishing earlier campaign. Not to much to do enough to keep me playing on and off all day. Some nice features and different game modes. There are some buttons that dont work yet that shows there will be more things in the future. I would like 1 QOL improvement reduce ammout of clicks to open boxes or collect rewards.

So far I really enjoy the game and it's easy mechanics!!! Please keep adding more characters and other chapters as well can't wait to see it grow more!! 😁🤘 Note just to add I spent $40 on both different packs for shadowsun I understand she is legendary but I would have thought the advantage would be better but it's not as good as I thought and I'm worried after all the grinding I'm doing that I won't get her which would be frustrating it's alot to spend on a mobile game go easier lol

I've quit now. Probably would have kept playing a little but "Raid tickets" ruin the gane for me. Raid tickets are the auto battle feature most games give for free. Here they try to force you to buy them or else manually replay the same mission 100s of times to progress. Silly to gatekeep playing and punishes people with less time to game. I don't mind making purchases and bought a bunch of stuff but im not gonna flush money on raid tickets for a basic functionality.

It's fun, but I feel like you should be able to choose your starting faction. I imagine the reason you can't is because it would lower sales. Speaking of, the prices are kind of ridiculous and built around whales, there's been multiple things I'd have bought if they were cheaper

It's got a lot of potential, I think it's laid out right but you hit a massive pay wall 3 to 4 days after playing. They hook you in the beginning and then it gets so hard you can not progress. I tried playing a few days after I hit the wall and still got no where. I Uninstalled it's just a major waste of time.

Very good tactical RPG game, but the monetization is just super nasty. Battle pass is super expensive, in fact one of the most expensive I've seen. If you can live with the fact, that you'll progress very slowly without buying the battle pass, then just enjoy the game.

Garbage. Second time starting over and it failed critically like the first time I started over. After it updates it refuses to connect and basically destroysplayability. It refuses to connect for weeks after freezing. I will never play this again, im just tired of starting over. Terrible dumpster fire.

Like just about any mobile game nowadays it's designed to seem enjoyable at first then slam you against a wall where you can no longer progress whatsoever. After you beat the third boss or so progression basically stops and you can't really do anything because everything has to recharge or is on a timer.

This game is awesome, so much better than raid legends, call of dragons and all of those grindy micro transaction games. Tacticus tournaments all scale to the same level so that it's an even playing field versing people that have played forever. You can play the game and actually enjoy it without spending any money and without it being a massive grind. I have fun playing and believe the developers deserve it for their good work so I do buy some things. Strategy is the main key!

Nice game loved playing it. Had an issue where my profile got logged out and now it won't let me relog into my synced account. Emailed twice and no response. Paid a little money on the game and now I can't get that back. As I said great game but poor customer support. Make sure your game doesn't log you out.

Has potential, but right now it's a bit barren. Art style is too cutesy and Fisher Price looking which betrays 40k at its very core. Because like everything these days it has to appeal to kids and it's ruining another one of my long time hobbies. You HAVE to start playing as Spess Mahrines rather than being allowed to pick your faction. Which is boring especially if you don't care about Space Marines. Gameplay generally about as fun as a splinter under a fingernail.

I like 40k a lot, but this is incredibly predatory even for a gacha game. Every single monetisation decision looks like it came from the YouTube video about how developers can milk as much money from players as possible. You'll hit the paywall very quickly & find that there's nothing you can do unless you're willing to drop a lot of $$ on a random chance at 1 of the 100 different types of currency. Do yourself a favour, avoid this game.

I really enjoy the basic nature of the game, and am fairly new to warhammer lore so I love the introductory information we get about the universe. However the only reason I don't give the game 5 star is how almost predatory the game can be when it comes to microtransactions, like when you first unlock a new hero there's immediately a "Pay 9.99 to recieve a booster to get them to 4 stars!" message. While it's nice to skip grinding it's fomo to have these offers for the exclusive couple of hours.

The gameplay is pretty good, and that's pretty much the only positive. The story is meh. When you hit that wall, it is painfully slow upwards. Campaign has a "chance" of farming mats or unit XYZ shards. More important mats can't be farmed but earned, very slowly. This and the energy system halts progress to a snails crawl at a certain point. The swarm mode is a decent, guild bosses will one shot you, but you'll get something for it, unlike Arena. If you got the patience, you can have some fun.

So far, it's been really fun. The strategy aspect is simple but fun to learn. The biggest complaint is how often the "deals" bombard you. I want to enjoy the game and maybe spend some, but the constant pressure seems unnecessary.

Pay to win rip off. The game barely gives you few chances to roll for new characters with the best PvP characters being very low drop chances. The big hyped anniversary came out and the event was just buying a daily pack which included one for over £25. Events that unlock characters require multiple pack purchases to fully complete. Servers go down frequently. Devs should be embarrassed at this level of money grabbing for an otherwise fun game

The prices in the shop can be a bit high if you intend to pay to advance, but as a free to play player this game has been an absolute delight that has kept me coming back far longer than most games of this model. The tactics game play is wonderful and can be very engaging in pursuit of three stars on higher difficulty levels.

It's a shame I'm forced to complete Space Marine conquests before unlocking other races (without having to invest cash). Equally it's a shame other Space Marine legions weren't available to choose from to play through the opening conquests. Being forced to play an Ultramarine squad was underwhelming.

Need to fix the bug with the scarab swarms. Playing any sort of game vs the computer with them is not fun to play anymore. Can't kill them fast enough and all they do is multiply and when you get close to killing them they move and you can't chase. Updated 6 months later and it's still an issue. It breaks the game and makes it very unfun

If you've liked warlords of aternum, then you'll love this. 5 modes to play, with multiple campaigns after unlocking enough characters Yes, their microtransactions are ridiculously priced; don't buy them Most characters can be unlocked through play in the other modes and weekly events Never spent and Ive got half from each faction My major gripe is the raid token/energy system; pick one Energy is what I'd get rid of You're already limited by wins on each level each day, and drops chances are bad

Very nice, been playing 2 weeks straight and still going strong. Constant rewards but it doesn't make you overpowered, it doesn't give you a huge advantage in arena and honestly the characters are mostly balanced. Great game and I can't wait for the future game content to come!

I liked this game at first but frankly it is too punishing for a free to play person. You quickly hit difficulty spikes that are decided by rng or just obscene damage scaling (scarabs). Normally you'd grind to get stronger but that is also punishing since they put timers around everything that could help you get stronger, 24 hr timers in most cases. It's a shameful way to try to force someone to pay money. Plus the drop rate for champion scrolls is stupid rare, hence keeping you weaker too.

Starts off fantastic but hits a major paywall very quickly, unable to upgrade characters due to poor acquisition of upgr ade materials and it gives literally no cards to attain characters without paying! Every chest just gives coins which are of very little use in game without upgrade materials, which you have to pay for with crystals, it's these games that unfortunately ruin 40k for new players. Played since day 1

Only giving this a one star due to the payment issues. It is a great game! But, I am having my payment method declined. I have confirmed there are funds and that there is no issue with the financial institution but, still can't make purchases.

This game is greedy! I've played some gatcha games in my time, but this one is a complete vampire on your wallet. Needing so much energy just to play a poor, 'tactics' style game, where obvious lvl based paywalls exist is naff. Save your money, or just play the tabletop version...ironically might be cheaper...

Excellent turn based action. Great visuals, cool characters. Perhaps too many paywalls to access new characters but they are generous with free drops. Certainly one of the best Warhammer games on mobile, and a very notable turn based game in general.

One of the best Android games I have played. Very fun. Looks like there is a lot more content. There is different modes. Different characters, items for characters. Very very good. Performance seems ok and everything was clearly readable. Go for it.

40k, turn based tactics & slot machine luck for bonus characters. Farm gear & shards. If you like it, reload and buy $5 Yarrick. I've played a month and have the 1st of 3 Campaigns done, 2nd one running and also 1st of the 3 Mirror Campaigns on the go. Recent changes to unlock common mean it will be a 2nd month until I unlock the Ork 3rd campaign. Free2Play I may unlock the Templar 3rd Mirror after about 5 months? Hopefully they make more Campaigns with the new Factions.

Cant really find anything good about this game. Way to many menus, clicking on home causes all the ingame adds to been shown. Loading times after every button pressed and just dont press again during loading because it will than close that menu again. Gameplay basic and boring and a tutorial that goes on for to long

The requisition system really needs some modification. With less than half the character roster unlocked I only seem to ever get characters I already have. It should be tuned to lower the odds of that. It's really irritating.

Right now its just like any wast of time and money game where you have to whate endlessly to get the good gubbins and all you want to do is have fun in a game people devoted time and effort on just to make money thew transactions. What happend to gaming? it used to be fun and engaging with a unique experience just for people who want to have fun, If I made a mobile, It would be a game with a story that keeps you engaged and gave you a reason to play it.

It crashes on me a lot but for it being a game that can be forgiven due to it just coming out but otherwise I really enjoy it the characters are awesome looking and I enjoy their abilities I just wish there were more factions and members per faction to choose from but otherwise I'm happy with this game a good and simple combat system that's fairly fast paced I can't wait to see more of this game

So far it's fun. Im new, about 40 missions deep. Hasnt been overly difficult yet. Although it seems like it's gonna be a gatcha game and end game is going to require *alot* of money. 4 stars because of this. Unsure if there are systems in place to get higher end stuff without money

A great game made by Devs that actually care about fan feedback, which is always a plus. Definitely recommend the game. My one critique is that at a later point in the campaigns, maybe around lv 55+ of indomitus or cadia for example, you should be able to get combined items as a reward for beating some levels instead of individual components. Like getting a magazine of bullets as a reward instead of just one bullet to upgrade characters. It would make the grind feel much less tedious later on.

Great simple game. Love how they simplify the universe is amazing. Even the slightly cartoonish models help make it digestable. I wish there were more of the bigger named characters. Im new to 40k and i wanna see the guys that brought me to it. But I love this game as a jump off point into the 40k games.

Revised review. Still wish they would better balance war howl or change the critical attack system but they did add Emperor's Children. Devs seem to care a lot. Game can be expensive but still is accessible in many modes when playing for cheap. Still actively supported and played. Gameplay is much more than other party collectors. Old content does receive attention more than behind the scenes number tweaks. Music and home screens could be enhanced. Combat voices would be great.

Great mobile game, quick games, plenty of modes. It is not pay to win, there are alot of options but they are not required. As you play you unlock everything. If the developers read this the only thing I would say is decrease the time slightly on energy so we can play the campaign a bit more.

fairly good hex battler with various hero skills and landscape bonuses. good design and presentation, with some exceptions. opening chests is BORING. please, game devs, no more chests! progress shouldn't be presented as game-spam. too much junk complexity for the sole purpose of creating monetization opportunities, not fun!

The tactical gameplay is fantastic but it's broken at the moment. Paid for Battle Pass and now it's gone and I'm reset to level 1 and I can't upgrade characters star levels even though I have enough shards. What's going on with the game right now?

This is my day 1. So far the game is easy to learn, has a lot of progression options, and a variety of game options. The character advancement has been railroad so far but I have a feeling I'll have to make choices as my character menagerie grows.

recent changes have removed a massive amount of raid tickets which allow you to complete previously passed stage at 3 star rating instantly, this means you will now have to spend an extortionate amount of time replaying stages you have already aced to get the unlimited amount of gear required for tier ups. Improvement to the raid ticket system would see my rating go up significantly.

I've only been playing a few days and I have absolutely loved this game. I was a bit sceptical at first but once I started playing I got into it then I saw it THE DEATH GUARD my favorite characters other than the people of kreig in the entirety of the Warhammer universe, I can't wait until I get to unlock all of the death guard.

I'm really liking the Warhammer vibe in Tactics. You have to level grind to get your characters to a level that can romp and stomp. I especially like the levels when I can pull in any of the characters from different camps. There is so far a decent amount of gameplay for free to play, but I can already see that folks willing to drop some bucks will do way better with stronger characters and gear. Wether it's fair for all remains to be seen.

poor matchmaking, if you want to play the campaigns you need to pay 10 to 30 dollars depending if you get lucky on the loot boxes and restricts how much you can play and how many upgrade items you can get are all random. This game is micro transactions personified.

In the context of a mobile gacha game, this one is quite fun! Varied gameplay options and generous events that make grinding pretty easy. Energy limits aren't too intrusive, and if all you want to do is play the actual game then the campaigns will give you a lot of hours.

Edited/Updated: Game is fantastic and highly addictive. Gameplay is very good. With a simple interface but real opportunities to leverage strategic choices to gain advantage, fantastic to see in any strategy game. Lore for 40K fans is also kept to fairly well. It is an infinite and grim grind, which is on theme, but I'll tell you first hand that the grind for free to play is a brutal one. After your 3rd "guaranteed" character drop doesn't even yield upgrades; you'll feel the grimdark for sure.

Very good game with a good concept for gameplay but the limitations on how much you can play the game even if put money into it is a bit too insane. Actually grinding resources does not exist in this game. Which makes grinding for basically anything a process of weeks at a certain level.

By the time I finished the tutorial boss, the game keeps kicking me out of the app. Hope whoever is part of the dev team fixes this sometime in the future. Edit: The game runs well. As it stands, it is probably the most fun I had with a mobile game in over a year.

Gameplay is very fun, I will say that. But as a new player, who games on mobile often, this game is neither f2p or even beginner friendly. It starts f2p, but that paywall hits like Mike Tyson. The mission and achievement rewards are the worst I have ever seen in a mobile gacha. The amount of free pulls are pathetic, with most being for shards or items, not even heroes. Gameplay is fun at least... EDIT: a single pull is $3, or you can get a discount and pay $50 for two 10-pulls.

Better than many similar games, Warhammer universe is always a plus, tactical combat is fun... Negative side would be new player experience as there are almost no catch up mechanics, and no duplicate protection for legendary/epic pulls (did - 250 pulls, got 5 legendaries, however 4 of those were 2x the same unit, which turned out to be bad, so getting a duplicate of that while there are 5 other legendaries you don't have is an extremely feel bad moment...

I really do enjoy the game but it could just be since my phone isn't the best but tend to crash on me from time to time and my service is shotty so I can only play every now and then when I have a stable connection due to it requiring that even for just the campaign. But is a solid and fun game so far.

Fun, basic RTS set in the 40K universe. My only complaint is that the screen isn't optimized for the Chromebook which is how I'm playing this so it's kinda small. I also don't mind that the main Space Marine faction for this game is the Ultramarines seeing as they're the poster children for 40K as a whole but I'd love to possibly see the Dark Angels in a future update. The Adeptas Soritas you get to play as is a badass as well with her meltagun.

Another punishing game for new players. Forced to play as a faction you dont want, forced to play game modes you don't want, forced to slog out rubbish monthly quests, and forced to hope the missions give you what you want or wishing, hoping, pleading you might get a drop of a character you actually like. Joke of a cash grab game, at least others try to give you ways to get the characters you want. Can't beat the monthly mission with the borrowed chars? Tough. Pay them. joke of a "game"

Base game is pretty fun but suffers from a pay to win system that is very broken. Most p2w systems atleast have a skill factor to them, this doesn't. I have seen people the same level as me with super powerful and legendary characters with over powered abilities that can't be beaten. No amount of skill or positioning can beat a full team of high ranked legendary characters someone bought.

I enjoy the table-top mechanics of the game, seems well put together. My only critique is the Ultramarines. I know they're the "mickey mouse" of games workshop and 40k, but actually choosing who to start out with would be nice, (i.e The Black Templars, orks, or even the Chaos marines).

I was having a lot of fun until hitting obvious paywalls. The campaign difficulty jumps quite aggressively and becomes impossible to continue. You can't grind levels because everything needs event tickets or some such nonsense. Sapped all the fun out what could have been a really fun game.

When I first tried the game I thought it was quite fun, despite the excess grinding that most free to play mobile games have. However even when following the pace of the game when it comes to the story and upgrade progress I notice the game has SEVERE balancing issues. Swarm enemies are the absolute worst, even when countering them with the rock, paper, scissors style combat. Boss enemies also do ludicrous amounts of damage to your heroes compared to numbers I see my heroes doing. Time wasting.

This game is great, amazing gameplay, mechanics have just enough depth for a variety of strategies while not being lost on new plays, and it's built in a way that you can slow down and plan both in and out of battle, and it's even possible to get every character and max them out without spending a penny. Everything can be found in campaigns, different game modes, crates and supply drops (all of which are free, they only require waiting) (Also PLEASE GW ADD THE SALAMANDERS THEY WOULD FIT SO WELL)

Enjoying it so far. Only been in for about 2 hours... there seems to be a ton of stuff to do before the microtransactions become needed. The heroes and units are fun. UPDATE: After playing this thing for a good while now and unlocking tons of characters and upgrades, I'd like to dial back my statement of the micros being "needed". they do help for sure, and I'll admit I bought some of those sweet character boosters but it's all there in the game. Just play often and you'll get them! 5/5

This is very "ok". It has a 1000 systems to extract money from you. The core gameplay combined with the squad building us actually fun...but the monetisation hinder your ability to actualy make the squad you want to play, and forces you to make most of the characters you lucked into or started with.

This game is a ton of fun - I love it! One thing that I seriously appreciate is the sound design. This isn't something that I usually even notice, especially in mobile games, but the sounds that the bolters and various weapons make just have so much weight and bass to them! I do wish there was a feature to reroll daily/battlepass missions and also the campaigns are quite expensive, but the battlepass is a great value and overall it's a seriously great WH40K game!

Painfully slow if you don't want to spend money. Upwards of $30 to unlock three characters. All that to actually be able to access more missions. The Star Wars one is better if all you want is a well-constructed game. This one exists for the whales.

Love it, lots of emersion. I like the Onslaught game mode. One problem. The characters move too fast, I don't know if you can change this but I'd like to actually be able to see me characters do stuff instead of happening in under 2 seconds

Complete false advertising... "Buy 10 recruitments and you are guaranteed a character!". But that character will be a duplicate, so you ACTUALLY just get tokens, so you are NOT guaranteed a character. I wonder how a judge would rule on that one...

Warhammer:40,000: Tacticus is absolutely amazing considering that it is an mobile game. I'm a big fan of Warhammer: Fantasy; as well as Warhammer: 40,000, yet when it comes to a digital game; this is all one could ask for from the series. Very simple to get the hang of and it feels like you're playing a table-top game, which is gratifying to the entire experience of the summarized version of the whole title of Warhammer: 40,000. Quick, easy, entertaining. Five stars.

As soon as I finished level 15 on campaign the game crashes every time I start the game and go to a new tab on the menu... Is it just me or do other people experience the same problem? Edit* it seems to happen when I try to buy something from shop , pressing the message button I got on the main menu and when I wanna start a battle on campaign. I literally can't play the game at the moment :/ also tried reinstalling and that didn't fix the problem

The game and gameplay is good and satisfying. However, you can easily tell it's made to force you spend lots of money. Furthermore, it's draining my battery very fast and crashes often annoyingly during boss battles making me lose chances (you start with 3) everytime that happens.

The heroes and tactics are amazing, as is the art and animation. My biggest issue is that you're forced to use specific factions to progress through the story, so many of your summons are useless; which summons are hard to come by too. Other than that it's a great game.

At first glance I thought it was just another summoner, turn-based attack game with way too many currency's, but this is actually a genuinely great game (which is a breath of fresh air for this genre) with a lot of real 40k features. this honestly just feels like a mini 40k table-top, and I love it!

Such a fun game but the devs are becoming greedier by the season. They nerfed the season pass and introduced a new Ultimate pass which is priced at more than double the price of the regular season pass... I used to spend a bit of money on this game but I get the feeling that I will be taking my money elsewhere. So unfortunate.

been playing 6 months. and it's pretty darn fun honestly. you can get by without spending any $, though I spent $20 so far because I enjoyed the game. it's great for just logging in and playing a few rounds here and there. I don't forsee myself getting bored in the foreseeable future, except taking breaks from the daily grind not and then. it's great if you have interest in the lore but don't really have anyone to play the tabletop with

Do you like water without any ice? Well I hope so, because ultramarines are all you'll be playing with for mission after slogging mission. For a world with such vibrant variety in it, this game grinds into you with mountains of missions that might drop something akin to what you actually like. But in the meantime, you're playing as the boring ones. Not fun

By far the best Warhammer App I have ever played and I have played nearly all of them. There is so much to do and progression even without spending money is surprisingly quick. Obviously it slows down after a couple of days, but I have never felt stuck or like I HAVE to spend money to progress. Great graphics, great mixup of factions and characters, great gameplay, and so far a pretty great community as well. Looking forward to seeing the new factions and events they come out with!

Very fun warhammer experience. I'm on it daily. You get a great blast of warhammer with fun and fulfilling gameplay. Monetization is crazy and they try to get you to spend money at every turn but with enough time playing you can get just as far as someone who has spent thousands. Very fun game, highly recommended.

Progress goes from steady to standstill in the first hour or two of play. The pay to play is real. Game play becomes repetitive and dull, and rewards go from excessive to non-existent. Waste your time with literally anything else.

I enjoy it, I like that it take legendary campaigns from the universe and makes them accessible like this. I'm not going to say it's perfect or fun for everyone but for a fun little Warhammer themed time waster, it's pretty good and I like see how the characters are designed and animated for the battles.

The game is a fun time passer once or twice a day. You shouldn't get super invested into it unless you have a lot of money just like any mobile game. My biggest problem is that it sometimes crashes during onslaught runs and ONLY during onslaught runs. That is what I have experienced so far.

Solid game, fun challenges but wholly let down by an incredibly greedy pay for power system. The prices in the cash store and how little you get and how much RNG there is, it greed pure and simple. Makes the pricing of the actual miniatures game look fair and reasonable.

Cool gameplay and systems, it'a WH40K so that's great. 3 stars only because I don't think I've seen a more money-hungry and dopamine-dependent game on mobile. Extremely redundant and long character development, upgrading character stats, abilities, items, and "tier" is pretty meh

Update: Re-downloaded as it was showing up as a different game. Most factions were "full" and when I finally found one that was available, I could not play as the troops barely moved. Even revamped this game is unplayable.

My game crashes a lot recently. The worse part is it does this during matches. I've lost 2 guild raid tokens because of this. Those I didn't mind, to be honest. But about a few minutes earlier the game crashed mid onslaught match- the only game mode that allows you to grind character shards. And now I have to wait another 10 hours just to have another go at this. Just terrible.

I personally enjoy the game alot. Although I wish there were Night Lords to play as but with the game growing maybe there is hope! I've been progressing well and don't feel as though I have to pay my way through which is a plus. But I do look forward to supporting this game!

The game is great and very fun but the cool down timer on the tokens are insanely long, like can you guys just make 2-3 hours or maybe 4-6 hours like, it's so long, also I haven't hit that wall that I usually with other mobile games so that's great, it's just the energy system that is frustrating, my idea is allowed losses, like when you lose a campaign battle you lose 3 energy, lose more than 1 character, lose 2 energy, 1 character lost, lose 1 energy, and you would have 10 energy in the start

Playing since release. Gameplay has gotten boring and repetitive. It's the same play for all different modes in the game. Was really hoping for a 40k mobile game that would be enjoyable for years like I had on PC but this is not it.

A fairly enjoyable game that's hampered by the typical grindy mobile game system. The complexity and interesting parts of the game itself kick in around the same time as the grind leaving you in this game of take away where you enjoy a crumb of game play only to have it pulled away from you once you have a taste. Its a shame because it's genuinely a good game. It leaves me feel frustrated both when playing and hitting the grind/difficulty barriers and for what this game could have been.

Moving down to a 1 star until they decide to fix their server and bug issues. This is now a daily problem. It starts out fun but when you hit against the experienced players you either pay to win or just accept a very high loss rate. Team power ratings are useless and mean nothing. Strategy is only for those that have all the OP characters. If youre willing to grind and be patient and love warhammer you may find this ok.

After playing a few days, everything is just infuriating from how you get character tokens to the reliance on RNG for everything else. The time it takes to get one token back is too long for the other activities with nothing really to do after, but wait 3 days for all the none campaign tokens to resupply to exp being basically none exciting the Black crystals prices to get stuff to high for how little someone gets and the list goes one TLDR don't play and don't pay a dime for garbage.

Tons of fun small squad turn based combat. As you progress strategy starts to become a real part of gameplay, the different characters help keep combat pretty fresh. All in all its not what i thought it would be and im enjoying myself in the grim dark. 👍👍

Really fun Warhammer 40k game, I own most of the Warhammer games on Xbox and a lot more on my Steam account. Used to play and collect the models back in the 1990s, had a 10,000pt Blood Angels army(my favorite), found out it was easier to buy the games instead. This game is just like board game, and it doesn't cost a lot to play, I want to go after them Blood Angels marines, used to have Mephiston as a model.

Man oh man is this game greedy I was interested in warhammer learning some lore having fun just to get hit with multiple micotransctions of 20,40,50 dollars that's insane. Normal gacha games have starter packs of 1,5 or 10 the value difference in this is insane. I believe this game is the most greedy thing I've seen worse than mtg. On a positive note the game play is fun but the difficulty scaling gets steep,it does not take long in this game at all to hit it at full force I'd try other gacha g

Theres alot of different resources and things to upgrade, I didnt hit any big roadblocks during the first 10 hours of gameplay since the game showers you in energy items and resources early on, near the 15hr mark I'm starting to see the loop of getting gear and medals and promoting etc. Arena throws you against teams with double your power sometimes which is dumb, however you dont play live against another player. Games worth trying if you like Warhammer stuff or simplistic strategy.

Pretty good game for whammer 40k newbies and its fun with all the new features and guild war being released, but if you think you will be one of the top players without P2W you are solely mistaking, its a clear pay to win and reward is not proportional to the costs of the items, you can be a free to play player and still get good enough characters but you will need to put in years to get to a point where pay to players get to in a month.

Fun game, fulfilling and rewarding It is possible to play without spending $$. But it will take a fair amount of grinding to unlock campaign mission blocks and stronger characters. All together it's a solid game and I enjoy it.

I've played many mobile Warhammer games, this my favourite so far. For a mobile game it gives a good story with great art, excellent use of lore with decent stories to add a bit of depth to the gameplay, lets me blast Xenos whilst playing as Space marines, or spice things up by including other factions. There always seems something to do and missions are just as fun replaying. I'm a bit of a lone gamer but the factions are drawing me in. Can see this entertaining me for a long time.

It's fun to unlock and upgrade characters and there are a variety of permanent and rotating modes that can pass the time for a few minutes or up to a couple dozen minutes. The normal mobile monetization strategies are in place but it's enjoyable even without paying. Embrace the coolness of it being Warhammer 40K with light strategy instead of something like FF tactics/advanced wars/wargroove/into the breach.

Constant updates from devs, dedicated support. When issues arise although minor devs are quick to implement hotfixes. A 40K collected them all. Could be a pay to win but with patience you can unlock all the characters. Although by playing missions and through the reward system, the game offers plenty of ways to boost your desire for those much needed characters. Fingers crossed they release Kairos one day.

Id give it more stars if it wasn't a pay to win game literally they say its a free to play but that's a damn lie and half the grind for new players is so ridiculous its taken me 6 months just to get enough units to actually play in any one of the campaign missions not to mention the amount of resources needed for upgrading said units they want ya paying $10 for just basic game pass and $50 for deluxe which is just barely anything extra special if they didn't have pay to play it get a better rev

Game is cool, but completely crashes every 5 minutes which resets your progress, but still consumes used resources. Game is broken and devs need to seriously fix the stability of this game. If they can do that, it's a good game worth playing.

Awesome battle mechanics that add a fresh twist on how to best combat your enemies. Pvp from what I've experienced so far is over within a few rounds and it's super important to place your characters in a defensive position. 5/5 great game to play for a few rounds of campaign while waiting in a waiting room, or for hours at a time on a road trip as a passenger, exploring all the recoures. Vertical play makes it easy and convenient as a mobile game. Well done.

Pretty decent so far only just started I'd like to see this on PC via steam or Microsoft store due to the fact I've got an old af phone that barely has space for the game overall tho fairly decent game I'd suggest not forcing micro transactions in my face when finishing stages tho. Ps thanks to who devd this it some fresh air to Warhammer I been a big fan of the games for some time thanks yall

all pay, no play game (if you can call it that) is a confusing labyrinth of pay walls! YOU CANT PLAY FOR MORE THAN 5 MIN WITHOUT THEM WANTING MORE MONEY. that's if you can find the game play! It's very well hidden among 50 or so Windows asking for more money.

Love it, super fun and casual Edit: Still loving the game, but so far I have had 2 requisitions dissappear. I noticed because I was saving to get to 10 and when I was at 8 it went to 7 and when I was at 9 it went to 8. I didn't accidentally use them either, and these were separate occurrences spanning a day or two as I was activelynot trying to use them. Like I said though, love the game but maybe an odd bug.

Great mobile game, one of the best I've ever played. Entertaining, interesting and a challenge. It does have a long process AND of course just like every other mobile game its riddled with "watch ad" for energy and/or item that acts like energy. However energy every 5 min is nice and large energy rewards once in awhile is great too. Lastly, purchasing "packs" as of right now everything is "80%" off. Great! Ok not really because basic math says thats not 80% off its more or less than 80%.

This game really surprised me for the better! What I like most is probably what makes people giving it a low grade - this game requires patience and won't let you Bing on it, unless you're willing to pay. Difficulty piles up very balanced and you don't have to pay to progress, just complete missions as they give the rewards needed to get more heroes and upgrades. Been playing it for a week and so far - super fun! GJ guys.

It's a great game maybe my favourite mobile game granted purchases are very expensive for what they are I just wish that orbs were more affordable and a method to actually gather them apart from one its too long and hard to gather orbs for lower ranks other wise a amazing game just have to be patient and tactical with resources to progress if they created a method to grind orbs and fix the rewards for the pricing I would give 5 stars

Insane and predatory prices and unlock structure. Example: to unlock Octarius campaign, you need to unlock 3 ork characters. To reliably get their shards, you need to play Octarius mirror campaign. To play that mirror campaign, you need to unlock 3 characters by playing ... the Octarius campaign. So, you can either grind likely hundreds of hours for random shard drops or pay $30 for the campaign pack. They claim $30 is 70% off. Even a great AAA PC game isn't worth $100. Gross. Deserves to fail.

Enjoyable and decent balance between challenge and progress. It dose get alittle grindy and you get to the point where it's hard to tell if it's player skill or character progress that makes the fights. Also there isn't really a skilled based pvp. Player controlled bots usually win if their stronger.

Dropping my rating to three stars for one reason. That reason being: I saved up ten scrolls to get a "guaranteed character". It took a about a week to earn that. What I got was a character promotion, hoping to unlock a campaign. I feel a bit cheated. Glad I didn't spend more than 10$ to learn this lesson.

Highly addictive, lore-friendly W40k turn-based strategy. Lots of game modes and missions give the game variability and help forget the "grind" of resources to upgrade your characters. It's possible to play and progress well even as F2P player. Of course, you need to get lucky with the requisition pulls.

Very grindy game with a very limited pool of character. Unless you are willing to whale you be limited to 5 to 8 character for a very long time. Also mission get very difficult really quickly meaning you will have to grinds for days without seeing any meaningful progress.

Like the game so far but I'd like to be able to choose my starting faction. Missions are a bit clustered. I think it should be layer out a bit clearer so you haven't got to keep coking jn and out of different sections. Other than that it's quite enjoyable.

A solid tactical arena game, Tacticus is a welcome addition the 40k verse. The visual design of the UI and sprites is satisfyingly dynamic, and the combat is punchy. Like other reviewers, my biggest criticism is that while the initial pace is incredibly fast, it grinds to a halt after a few hours of campaign play, leaving you with very little to do. I also find the UI incredibly cluttered, meaning it is often unclear what to do next to advance the game. Overall, beware of addictive play!

Pros: Its pretty fun & the gameplay is good, a lot of different missions to try and they update regularly it seems. Excited for new tyranid characters. The bad: the amount of annoying "buy this pack for $$$" is way too high, theres not really any in-game support for new players, & the event tournament player balance is absolutely terrible. (Why are new players ranked against maxed out players? Or are events only for older players?)

Really fun Mobile game if you like 40k. My main gripe is they give you a lot of in game currency early but the amount of currency you get from basic play is small so I can see myself running low and needing to spend real dollars just to get basic ingame currency.

I really like this game except there's a few problems that I see while playing the game one is the chance of u getting a character that is rare on a 10 drop it seems impossible especially a legend and the amount of Blackstone u acquire for campaigns and side quest is practically nothing considering the price of everything in the shop so if they could change that and make it easier to acquire characters easier I would definitely give 5 stars

I thought Warhammer was an orcs and elves game. I chose it out of curiosity, and I'm glad I did. I can mostly play solo but with some benefits from an alliance. Not much investment is required to advance, but one can put in money to get nifty upgrades if you are so inclined. Truly something for everyone!

While the paywalls arent as terrible as other games, the reward per minute spent on the active gameplay is abysmal. As for the gacha itself; It'd be cheaper to buy a 2000 pt army and pay a professional to paint them for you than it would be to get a 5 character squad rolling in this.

Overall fun to a degree, but the resources needed to level up your characters come painfully sparse. Add on top of that an 18hour cool down to acquire these items. When you can only play the game every 2-3 days it's easy to forget about.

Got on the game after the daily reset and noticed the new battle pass and purchased it, it told me it would work itself out in the background and now the game won't load anything when I am currently connected to wifi. It's telling me about 9+ Guild notifications and won't let me see anything. Kinda pissed.

It's ok. The ads for micro-transactions get a little annoying. Honestly if it were up to me instead of starting with the ultramarine campaign by default, I'd let the player select an army and that be the ones they start with.

It's a good mobile game, which makes it just okay as far as games go, but it has the same flaws many other mobile games have, like being extremely grindy and charging way too much for content we really should be able to unlock without constant grinding or spending money(10 dollars for a mobile game character is crackhead levels of delusion). Another huge flaw is the energy BS. Let me play the fuggin game. The people at snowprint are scum

Apparently after having tons of characters unlocked, leveled up and hours put into the game I've miraculously lost all of it and am forced to start from square one. Paid some money to unlocked a unit or 2 and now thats all gone. Waste of time and money. Unfortunate.

these pay to win games getting out of hand just like PokeMon, been a player since day one. but I see players drop out steadily cause of how unfair matches are. really dropped the ball like alot of other games, add your transactions but remeber you got way more folks who dont have limitless pockets. but again don't worry bout player base barely keeping the game alive let's kill it some more. Smh. I get more out of CatsArena. better games to play for both paid and free players, and not one-sided.

this is probably the closest mobile game you can get to actual Warhammer 40k and it's actually pretty fun. there are micro transactions but you don't need to spend any money if you don't want to. you don't really hit a wall, like a lot of other games. overall, a surprisingly well made wh40k game!

OK some problems have been resolved, and they're adding really good features to stuff like guild wars. Actually a fan of lots of their movements, so still enjoying the game, and I've been a player since beta. Still some balance issues in guild wars maps, but it's better. And as always whoever is designing the characters makes them look INCREDIBLE. Good job art department. Hopefully some buffs for some really hurting characters are on the way but overall fun game!!

Wonderful game; 40K mobilized—for mobile! Progression is linear and effective, and the mechanics are just new enough to nurture the familiarity... My only issue? Heavily imposed in-app purchases. I don't mind real-money buyables, but... please, not row by row, in my face. I understand the necessity of making money off of a free game, I really do. Just less of the pressure, please 💙

Fun game. Menus are too cluttered and there's too much time between doing things, but it's fun. Stats are definitely more valuable than tactics, though. Just following a basic tankier units tank and maximizing target selection really is just overkill unless you're heavily out-statted in which case your tactics won't help anyways.

Tried to play this, but it's the same as every other mobile game these days... Just with poorly written warhammer characters. This is another money sink for fan boys and competitive losers. This game isn't free if you want to enjoy it. It relies on an IP to get you hooked then has repetitive "gameplay" designed to part you from your money because they know you are easily manipulated. Sorry, I'm not. Un-installed. Not even worth the single star I have to give.

ignoring the blatant pay to win ability of buying and upgrading any character with real money for a second, the fact that EVERY SINGLE GAME MODE has a limited amount of tries until you have to either wait for several hours or pay is so annoying in addition to a kind of random ranking system and completely luck based combat but it's kinda fun to watch Warhammer characters shoot each other so an extra star for that I guess

It's a good game. But unfortunately there's one thing that holds it back for me. Energy. I find myself quite often unable to do anything after using the energy for raids, and having to wait a while in order to play, or spend money just to play the campaign at all. It really takes away from the experience.

Fun and unique, but it takes literally half a day for the tokens you need to play the actual "free" game itself to replenish. I can't just have fun in the game, I don't really care about microtransactions, but this game has the most agregious and aggressive micro transactions, with the competitive scene being completely overrun by pay-to-win players. (P.S. the publishers will try to bribe you with in-game points, which is not only deplorable but sad)

. Some of the enemies are difficult like the scarab swarms who can replicate exponentially or the imperial guard guys who summon another guardsman every turn. Progression is kinda slow and the non campaign energy recharges way too slowly. Good for a few minutes here and there.

Keeps taking money and fails to deliver purchases. Bought the 100$ guild shipment package and as soon as I bought the lesser one for Blackstone it erased the cash purchased larger shipments with 8 days left of deliveries. This has happened with several other purchases. Great game just don't spend money on extras.

The paywalls are significant. It's rarely worth buying anything since actual money gets you so little, and the CANNOT play yet timers are annoying. But, if you're okay with the whole mobile FTP/PTW concept it's pretty engaging and if you're okay only playing 20-30 minutes 2x a day it's a cool squad tactics game. Raid tokens get rid of worst grinding. If only you could get a bit more for your money like a new character every battle pass or cheaper requisitions it would be 5 star.

The game is a bit of a con job. You'll hit a wall that is either gated my time and/or real money. Sank $30 thinking I was unlocking a new character, but no no it was only the chance to grind for 250 tokens in the battle pass to get said character. Absolute con, with dishonest marketing within the micro transactons..... Which wouldn't be a bad thing if you could grind more than 2mm a day. I regret giving this studio my money!

Hit a pay wall. Have characters as high as they can go without purchase and can't get past level 74. No way to build them up anymore. Scarab swarms are OPd. Drop rates are a joke. "Garuanteed" character is just shards. All lies. Just another money stealer.

Played this game very close to it's launch, can definitely say that the game is evolving and the devs are hearing the player base. Progress is quite capped with tokens regenerating periodically. But you can sink a lot of time in it regardless.

The game is visually strong and mechanically fun. Lots to do and see, for sure. That said, playing this game in F2P is one of THE slowest and grindiest F2P options I've seen in this genre of game. Unlocking a second node for farming a character takes hundreds if not thousands of hours to even get to without spending real money. Just FYI to anyone who thinks this will be a cheaper and/or more accessible pricepoint to the tabletop game.

Decent tactical game. As with all games now there are microtransactions, they are a little pushy when you get a new character and they suddenly have the perfect pack for upgrading... however the game runs smoothly, and loads quickly.

The campaigns are locked behind certain characters. Functionally the game is quite competent and fun to play, but the pve modes are locked to specific factions with specific characters that you have to randomly unlock (or buy outright, most campaigns cost $29.99 USD to unlock all the characters for it) but not all factions have a story quest which means the only faction I cared to play, the ta'u don't have a campaign so I can only play them in the time gated modes or pvp even if I unlock them.

Good game but the scarabs are far too OP. Literally two swarms can wipe out your whole squad which starts to make the game frustrating. As soon as games get frustrating people just tend to not bother playing them. Please decrease the scarabs power a bit, far too much considering on space marine should easily be able to defeat one swarm

Horrible game 1 month in. Constant bugs annoying reimbusments for continous server problems. No one emails you back when theres a bug issue to let you know you've been heard. Typical pay to win bulkshut game with a cool skin over the top that happens to be war hammer. How its getting nominated for GotY is beyond me. I hope the game developers rot in hell.

Game is pretty mid. I like the idea of a turn based 40k game rather than a full blown RTS, makes more sense in comparison to playing the irl table top game. However, the game is visually lacking, dialog is cringe, animations are too twitchy and it overall feels like a jr. game dev was in charge.

The game itself is very fun, the campaigns are well designed and the gameplay has a just one more battle feeling. Energy usage is a little high for playing though and you need tokens for special battles to progress each day which means you only play twice daily for a while. The cash shop is far too expensive so don't use it. One of the most expensive I've seen. I wouldn't mind spending some money on this game but I think the developers are losing revenue by trying to be a little too greedy.

This game is an honest joy to play. It triggers all those dopamine receptors with every win. However, in the game's current state, for whatever reason, the Arena mode game type outright LIES to you, and appears to actively buff teams that are meant to be weaker than you. There have been multiple instances of the Danger Zone being wrong, leading directly to my loss. In other instances, teams that are 2000+ power points weaker than my own team are almost invincible. It makes no sense.

I have played a lot of 40k style mobile games, this one just feels right. Battles are fun and I have a blast tearing through the ai. Needs more models though, as I would like to see first generation space marines like the tactile marines and other chapters as well.

When I first picked up this game, I thought it was a bit whale-centric. After playing the better part of a year, it absolutely is. If you invest a decent amount of time as an addicted player should, it's absolutely worth it to pick up the monthly pass. The game has a lot of depth, there are synergies in Guild War that no one discusses, Arena matches are fun, and being in a guild just makes the whole thing a blast. I love this game, and I wholeheartedly recommend it!

Actually a really decent game when it lets you play it. Especially considering I have no previous interest in warhammer. Not sure what to think really. There seems to be no winning anything beyond first few missions. I've sunk a fair few hours in this game over the last two months while work was not demanding. It's alright. Gets a bit grindy as you progress but still rewarding. I would prefer choosing which characters do I want to collect exactly and not have it random but it is what it is.

Tacticus is a turn based tactical RPG based on the Warhammer 40K universe. It's a free to play game that uses a gacha system as the main method of gaining new units. It's fairly simple to understand but has a little depth to it if you want to dive in further. While it is decently fun, the F2P mechanics of the game make gaining new characters and fully powering up your existing ones a bit of a chore. It has PvP if you are into that, but the PvE content is pretty limted

A lot of mobile turn-based tactics games feel like PC games awkwardly crammed onto a phone. Tacticus is the first one I've played that feels good on my phone but doesn't feel like it's sacrificing any depth. This has a lot to do with its well-organized UI and well-written guidance throughout the game (another rarity for mobile games). As a PC gamer who hates mobile games, I feel like it's a pretty big deal that I'm able to recommend this game with five stars. P.S. the Battlepass is worth it.
