Well this is actually a really good game, like the turn base system, graphics are pretty good. Good choice of characters, though would like to see a choice of space marine chapters instead of just ultramarines all the time

So I don't know if anyone experienced this yet but I recently started playing this game. I invested some money in this game as well and it started freezing after I invested into the game. I uninstalled the app and re-installed now it deleted everything and I have to start all over again. Can I get my money back and my characters I had a really good collection already of characters for the game and items and now it's all gone due to some glitch

Been playing a few months now, and really enjoying it so far. Events give the chance to unlock new characters if you participate really hard. Still far from endgame, but so far it all seems doable as ftp if you don't mind some grinding ^^ Edit: new legendary toons are virtually impossible to unlock as ftp, which is a bit frustrating. Still a great game, but making other toons more obtainable would be nice.

So my overall thoughts in the game, is that it is well designed. That said, i would recommend others that do decide to try to play is save your resource until you cannot get further without them. You dont get much in the way of any so spending them too early will result in some loss, speaking mainly for the requisitions. The game uses shards for pulling gacha and if you don't have enough shards to pull them, they will sit collect dust until you do. The currency earned is small.

Fum game with really supportive Devs. The grind is pretty good compared with other freemium games, and release events grant decent access to new content. P2P is also pretty much a non issue as there is level capping for PvP, and really level dependent PvE is optional and not central to progression. Servers do tend to go down at big patches/events, but the Devs give compensation for that sometimes :)

Uh.. very restricted. I want to use the Orks or such I've unlocked but 90% of the time it's "No be imperial heretic!!" got board of such limits unless I paid a fortune for the privilege to use other factions not a great way to showcase 40k. Game play is fine but a challenge so if your a space marine fan you will enjoy it maybe. And if they add a fun character "let's make it temporary!" man this games greed is set to max!

This game is horrible. - The characters are unbalanced even after the devs try to update them. - Every patch introduces game breaking bugs (latest July 1 Ra Event removing progress) - The event PvP is rarely tactical or fair as 1 player will often get an automatic win based on which side of the map they spawn on. - From start to endgame, it's just boring repetitive dailies that offer no engaging gameplay.

Very fun and we'll optimized game. It's like a mini mobile version of Kill Team. (It's not Kill Team..... But a 5 man team of WH40K characters fighting together is like a kill team, so...) Really enjoying Tacticus thus far. Keep up the good work. P.S. Please don't make this into a cash grab pay to win game.

Really enjoyable. Very easy to get into. Intuitive but still addictive upgrade system. Very simple to navigate no getting lost in menus. Very satisfying damage and animation. I'd just like a tiny bit of voice over for some of the commands - like the space marines in Dawn of War said "Death from above" perfectly for me. Not on every click but maybe on ability activation just a word or two to give the characters a bit more, well, character. Love it. Guild welcoming and social Great app

Way to much monetisation... Each dlc is 30€ or need to have specific characters to play (which means paying for summons as the resource is quite limited). My recommendation is to play the 75 lvls that's are there for free (as the game strategy wise is quite good) and then uninstall.

So it is evident that the game is heavily involved in micro transactions to advance about half way through. Your lucky enough to get drops for characters you need, campaign is fun and so is the game itself. Just wish it wasn't locked behind paywall.

This is a well made Warhammer game for a change, the downside is the massive paywalls, whilst you can earn almost all the hero's for free it will take a very very long time, currently stuck and have to replay old missions a few times everyday because of this paywall, otherwise its a decent game.

Wow disappointing, I could think of 100 ways to make this better game, hell just copy 40K somewhat and that could be a thing. This is a mess top to bottom. Not fun, not all that tactical, not even very 40K other than some species and character names. Super disappointed

Doing alot better since my last review hoping that characters become easier to obtain and upgrade also making it so that people can keep playing one way or another like adding more levels like scavenger and onslaught more of but different also giving out more energy. Looking forward to finishing up my races fun pvp too.

Its "semi" pay to win. Personally I love these types of games simply because their a fun grind type of game. You don't HAVE to drop money on it but it helps a bunch when u hit a road block. Personally its just enjoyable to grind and level mt guys up slowly while getting the occasional new character. Also event progress carries over when the event repeats, great detail

It's a good tactical game. Really enjoy the kits of units and how they interact with each. You seem to be able to get all units as a F2P though it will take longer. But otherwise decent, have enjoyed it so far.

My honest to God thoughts about this games is very optimistic. The classes and players abilities are evenly balanced. This is not a pay to win game either, which I enjoy! The shop is reasonably priced if you do want black stone or gold coin WH40K currency in exchange for real money. This is a somewhat turn based "RPG" that has a lot of fun and challenging missions that require planning and thought at times. The character progression and gameplay is pretty optimized for a mobile game. I say 10/10

This game is needlessly grindy and makes it nearly impossible to progress thru the game without either spending hours upon hours grinding or the true to mobile game strategy of just paying irl money to progress thru it the game does have fun mechanics but honestly its value disintegrates after a few hours of playing im sure most of the positive reviews here were made before they hit the painful parts of the game

You can't focus on your favorite faction and pretty soon you hit a wall unless you are a whale and you can drop a lot of money. You are forced to play arena and other modes as you are not given enough energy for the campaign. And even the campaign becomes impossible without buying stuff. Typical pay to win mobile game.

Scratches the Warhammer "itch." Same draw backs as other live service games, constantly asked to spend money, multiple different currencies to keep track of. Super easy to get into, the beginning campaign I'm blazing through. Tons of variety in the characters. Worth a try.

Only thing nice about this game is the Ai's you get look really nice I have 6 Ai's and can only use 5 Ai's the 6th Ai doesnt even show in the list where you pick your team to fight in a battle, why bother even adding a Ai if i cant even use it pointless and stupid. Gold is pointless to even have, unless you pay money to buy blackstones or lvl up your Ai which Ai lvls fast when you first start the game after your lvls are high upgrading seems non existen. And game crashes randomly removing game

this game is great, exactly what I expected and more. I simply can not give it 5 stars because of the play styles limitations, i wish that there was a way to implement more skill and tactics rather than just having high-level characters.

I've recently began reading Warhammer 40K novels and am purchasing my first faction pieces to being playing the tabletop game. While I'm waiting for my things to arrive I thought I'd find a Warhammer game to play. I played a few other games but they were terrible. But Tacticus is AMAZING!. It's a fluid, turn based RPG, that reminds me of the fame Final Fantasy Tactics, except instead of wizards and warriors it's amazing giga-Chat SPACE MARINES!!! After 30 missions, this game is GREAT.

Love the game so far, lots of levels and a very good roster start, along with the amount of factions added already is plended. That being said I like to see future factions and as well as bug fixes. For example, when clicking on vindicta, when she does the animation, her hand is inside the handle.

So far in my limited time playing the game seems pretty fun. My only issue is how expensive and prominent the micro transactions are. It doesn't feel like you need them which is good, but every screen has a buy button or limited time sale on it. The gameplay is pretty simple but fun.

Great game very user friendly downfall is that it's not much of a free to play and is very disappointing when it comes to free to play players. If you don't mind spending money to get characters that you want then this is great but besides that it's a good game with great graphics.

Complete change of review. Once you get so far in it is complete pay to win and none of the characters follow current 40k rules or special abilities, the enemies seem to get critical hits and special abilities that you don't. If you want to pass certain levels then grind or please insert bank card....

This is a truly great mobile game. I would say if you enjoy warhammer and turn-based games, this might be for you. The BIG NEGATIVE is that you can only play so much every day, which is incredibly dumb. Also the items in-game are way to expensive. Other than that two thumbs up 👍👍

While the gameplay is fun, this is one of the most pay-to-play character shard collector type game I've seen. The paywall hits very soon and the ratio of money spent to goods recieved is very poor. Unless you have a decent chunk of change to throw at a mobile game I'd look elsewhere.

Nice and expensive. Everything is nicely done, different mods to play, iconic characters for 40k universe. And than comes competitive play. In order to be amongst top players in league, tournament and guild raid (and I'm guessing guild battles when that comes), you need to invest at least $100 (that's if you're lucky with drops). Otherwise you will need weeks of grinding to have gear and characters to be even mildly competitive. And for god's sake, fix the necron swarms, way to overpowered.

It's better than before, but still the most unreasonable and egregious game I've ever encountered. Buying anything is unrewarding because of the gacha system. Nothing in this game is worth spending money on, and if you decide to f2p, be prepared to play this forever.

Good game overall for a mobile phone time killer and it is 40k, which makes it even better. Quite playable without paying too. Could have been even better, if non-campaign mode tokens regenerated faster, esp. Onslaught, which is essential for leveling up.

UPDATED 10/09/24. Tacticus is still the best GW licensed mobile game out there. The core gameplay battles & various game modes make this a must play. I quit the game months ago due to how unbalanced & stressful Guild Wars was. But I decided to give the game another chance because of how much I missed the other modes. The biggest surprise awaiting my return was the reworked requisition system with milestones. This is a huge deal since it solves the major issue I had with lackluster pulls.

Grindy, like a lot...and more. Costly, I had to sell my right kidney to buy stuff in this game. That much expensive.... The gameplay is kinda turn based rpg but stripped to 1 special attack option. Save yourself the time and money.

An absolute avalanche of monetisation. But don't worry, you can grind a mission for the CHANCE to get one of the 500 shards to get a good character. Also, at some point the enemy starts to obliterate you. Low and behold, paying money to upgrade is the way to progress. Uninstalled.

Man I really REALLY wanted to like this game, if I had infinite free time and money maybe I would but as it stands currently it's just a complete waste This game uses a scummy "shard" system which means you don't unlock characters unless you get enough Every inch of this game is designed to extract money from you. Which sucks because the animations for characters and weapon sounds are all there, plz fix this game warhammer 40k fans deserve it, it'll even make u more money bc more ppl will playit

A fun game with a lot of content and engaging gameplay that goes beyond just grinding characters. However, fundamentally still a gacha game. F2P is possible, but the game does try to get your money pretty insistently. No forced ads though!

This is a great Warhammer 40k mobile game that gives you lore accurate abilities and playstyle. Just don't put a lot of money into it. I spent $35 thinking I'd unlock a new character to play with, unfortunatly I was nowhere near getting anyone new unlocked.

This game is fun, but it takes WAAAY too long to grind and make progress. Either you spend a LOT of money or grind forever. Maybe lower the prices on things or lower the energy recharge to 3 minutes instead of 5? Can't grind enough since it takes too long to recharge energy

Visually the game is rather good, missions are OK just repetitive, typical Mobile game where you hit a stage and your forced to either grind that tier before leveling up/gear or pay money for resources, that is what the game is focused on, hate to say it but the devs have embraced Pay 2 Win, or should say they have bear hugged it hard, just a greedy cash grab, don't bother with PvP as you'll hit the wallet warrior's. -1 out of 5 for the blatant greed

It's pretty fun. Tacticus is a good game to play if you have time to waste, or are just looking for a decent warhammer mobile game. While it does have a lot of pay to win features, many of them can be circumvented by just playing the game.

It's good, but there's obviously stuff to be worked on. There's the hardcore grind that comes into play later on if you really get into the game as the pressure to spend money also increases. Personally my biggest issue was the lack of representation for some factions and how some are super underpowered which forces you into using certain groups/characters. This is also reinforced by you being forced to do campaigns and play often as set factions. I would love more Necrons btw and freedom/choice

A really fun game with lots of colorful characters. The only downfall is the rewards you get are poor and extremely difficult to earn. Obviously a money making ploy for the developers. Make things more affordable and you will have more customers tbh.

I have been playing for more than a year by now. The game is really fun byt it takes a really long time and grinding to upgrade your characters. Lots of different events and modes to play, but be prepared, you have to be patient, unless you are willing to spend some heavy money.

As a fan of strategy games in general, and warhammer 40K in particular, I like it well enough. The micro transactions it's trying to get you to make all the time are a bit too much, and the energy meter controlling how much you can play for free is kinda nasty. 3.5 out of 5

Honestly the game wasn't what I was expecting. I expected something closer to that star wars turn based rpg for mobile, but I really like the way the movement and Terrain works it also has a lot more content than expected. Huge plus is that the energy system isn't obnoxious like it is in most games.

The grind is unfun. When the novelty wears off and the rolls for characters is often met with orbs the game becomes abit of a unfun casino. Grinding every day for upgrades for your character which youll barely use because the game has a steep difficukty spike, 3 weeks later the awful RNG finally gives you items you need. Fun if you want a 2nd job, not so fun if you want a game to enjoy.

Awesome game!!!! Really well set up in the background, so if there is a glitch - its sorts itself. Gotta changes which make game play better. Mythic, more ads for free stuff ect. The mythic event was fantastic!!!!Collected many hero's!!!!!

I'm a long time warhammer 40k fan; I collect novels, build & paint the models, play the video games and consume a healthy amount of animations and lore videos to hit that 'Die hard' fan achievement. This game is great for anyone who likes the Grimdark, horrific setting that is the far future but with a comic strip look slapped over the top of it to make it more family friendly! The game itself plays how you'd imagine a hex-turn based mobile game to play, no issues, would recommend, worth a try!

My Expierence has simply been amazing, at first the game seemed overwhelming but don't let that stop you from an all out exciting adventure!!! Once you delve deeper into the content you'll realize that there's so much to do you won't be able to put the game down! I personally recommend for any age so start playing today you won't regret it!!!

It's just not fun. The timers for attacks is so slow. There really isn't anything to do but arena. The team making is boring and preset. The story is ok but not really interactive at all. It's just boring. The first few levels are fun but it falls off FAST.

Just a fun time getting into it. Not aggressive with any ads, yes there are pop ups for in app purchases but that's nice compared to other games that just overload unskippable ads. I'm just getting into this game but enjoying it so far! Can't wait to unlock the templars!

As a Warhammer 40k fan, Tacticus is the closest thing I could play for now. It's free but also a fun turn based game. I like that you can summon other space marines and if you have a commissar you can summon guardsmen. Atleast you're not alone in battle and they can also help you finished the mission. Anyway, hope the devs would add more modes and story missions that relates to most canon stories in 40k.

Fun, fast paced hexagonal strategy game with a distinct 40k flavor. It's well done with lots to do and decent strategic choice. Sticks to the theme well. Some expensive purchase options, but mostly you can do a lot without paying.

Disappointing missions that require soulless grinding of the same mission again and again to get certain damage types. The events are more of this. Leveling characters to Legendary takes 10 legendary orbs, ok, but then each stat boost rarity beyond that is another 10 legendary orbs, which they did not do with the previous tiers. It's too "pay to proceed" rather than pay2win, at least the battles with real people. The price of things is really up there too. It's well presented besides. A pity.

It's one of those gacha games that has a currency issue. Meaning anytime you get currency to roll for characters it's very low in the amount you get. I've played for about a week, you need 3k and I've only gotten I 17k after the 1st 10 roll they give you. So good luck farming. I probably won't be playing long, also you need to roll the same character to get tokens to rank them up. Not to mention there is a secondary currency needed to upgrade them as well. Graphics good, character models are ok

Fun game with insultingly overpriced in-app purchases. Certain events are straight-up pointless unless you've spent hundreds or even thousands of dollars beefing up your characters. You may as well buy an actual tabletop army for the money. They're responsive as devs though, and honestly the prices are likely driven by Wizards of the Coast being a greedy, trash garbage company.

Overall so far seems cool , sadly stuck on tutorial. As after 3 campaign maps the game takes me out to the main screen , to claim a mission for 4 campaign maps . Which I haven't done and can't do 😞. When this is fixed I'd love to see what else the game has to offer .

I think there's a good game in here. Unfortunately, I don't know because progression grinds to a CRAWL just as the difficulty is getting interesting (not even hard, just intriguing). The grind for resources is to steep and too sudden.

It was fun early on but after about 1 day of gameplay everything was getting slower and slower because the cooldowns take too long and the character requirement gets higher. Even though upgrading takes a lot of energy, the game doesn't give you a lot of energy to spare.

A good game for newcomers and hard-core fans alike. it's simplistic core concept is balanced out by a unique character and enemy roster, each with their own unique abilities. My main downside is that unlocking characters is grindy as all hell, and is often P2W.

Pretty good so far. Experiencing a bug in the first stage boss fight with commisar yarrick. When using his reinforcement ability, the game crashes. I love warhammer, my favorite hobby since the first dawn of War. I hope a lot more units will be added quickly. I hope they add iron hands and raven guard units.

Nice little time waster. The game looks nice and is fun in short burst. One major complaint I have is the game is a bit buggy. Especially with Incisus in my case. The game is win but I don't see it as overwhelming or necessary.

barely played but so far seems like a decent game though its simple in the beginning i believe its gonna ask for money later on.. just how it feels. Anyways one major problem with it and if it does continue to happen i will drop to 1 star and uninstall.. it crashes a lot and just gets stuck on certain screens so its a bit annoying and seems low on value score for what they trying to do. i actually never experienced many crashes in my games until now...

I like it. I just started. Reminds me of Final Fantasy Tactics. Its fun! I already shelled out 30 Bucks for the game. It's just the way of the new world. Everything is pay to win. Everything seems to be expensive,food & whatever. If you can afford it,do it. Life is too short not to enjoy yourself. Find what brings you joy even if you have to pay loads. All that being said,shame on all you developers for creating and continuing the pay2win format. Peace n best wishes to the users! TRON SON !

This is a great game so far. Loving the control system and the tactical play. Only minus is the limited amount of characters so far. With so much lore to draw from hope to see more heroes and character types jump into the game.

Decent game play, but you'll soon run into incredibly cheap enemies designed to make you whip out your credit card. Disappointed, because with what I've seen so far this is a game I'd buy. Update. Expect to get screwed by some truly baffling decisions by the AI.

The game play is fun, but there's some serious balancing issues if you're not paying the monthly premium pass or the "ultimate pass" you hover around 90-110 energy cap, you need usually 6 energy per pve round. 5 minute recharge per energy (like 8 hours to fully refill). and the rewards as a non pay to win player are less than fulfilling. Pvp is completely unplayable as a f2p player. Also "early drop" are set so if you're hoping to get lucky early on guess again. Tldr: Pay to win game

I did not have great expectations for this game, however. The mechanics have depth, and are varied, giving several play styles. The large but not collosal character options give choice without being daunting. And the variouse play styles keep things consistant, but not boring. There is very little that i think this game could do to better itself for a moble game.

Enjoyable game, look forward to future characters and campaigns...but there needs to be a way to save your progress. I bought a new phone and lost EVERYTHING I had won and paid for. Almost didn't bother to download it again.

Been playing a year and part of an active guild. Snowprint or their Support doesn't make the game accessable to the Colourblind. When you pick characters to use for the guild war game mode its very difficult to see what characters are selected if you cant see the colour green.

I honestly went into this with little to no expectations. It is a fun mobile game, nit just a fun mobile 40k game. I appreciate the interesting combat style and that micro transactions, as far as I've seen, are optional if you are willing to play to build up resources. Very swag my gamers

im sure my first impression wasn't to different from any other person who played this. a quick cash grab using Warhammers name but ive actually had a lot of fun and I get to use a wide selection of named characters from various factions with more being added in the near future and I love it

I'm really enjoying the game, and I honestly wouldn't mind having to work a little harder for all my progress, it feels a bit like Slots when finish a match, I'm also hoping the difficulty is going to scale. Reserving my fifth star till the end.

Love the game so far. Excellent characters with a lot of opportunities for progression. There are a lot of opportunities for different types of missions including campaigns, guild battles, etc. It's also a game you can play without breaking the bank unless you want to. So far I highly recommend it for Warhammer fans.

This is a fun turn based strategy game based around Warhammer 40,000. Personally I can't wait to see what new factions and units they bring into the game and their abilities, there are not many ads as well making it an even better game and the best part is it's free to play

Need more choice to make sure points go to imperial units and not orcs or necrons. I want to kill them not collect or waste items/resources. These games nees to give up uncommon characters more or make them easier to obtain... and people who buy their way in should only play others who do the same. I played Strike Force and it takes to long to collect characters of worth. I bought a bew phone before I could get who I wanted. Although people to choose who their winnings go for

Fun, interesting take to a Warhammer Game, lots of characters including fan favourites. Only issue, Would like to be able to buy Experience Books for Heros from the Store using Earned Currency from playing the campaign, same principle to items to enhance their rank/level.

Genuinely disappointed grinded and waited for 2 months spent money to do the 3000 summon for a guaranteed character. I got a few shards for characters I already owned from the base levels in the game. Honestly not worth the time or money for a not guaranteed character after all.

Very simple game but didn't take out the essentials of Warhammer 40k. I like the mechanic wherein if ranged units are locked in combat if enemy units engage in melee. The fact, I can fall back and shoot is really cool. Just amazing game, just started today and I'm already addicted.

PvP is : wait till the enemy is in a Position where you can attack first then you instandly win if you aren't totaly dumb, this game is 0% about tactics just typical I have the better heroes cause I banked and I lucked with the crits cause that oneshots a character. Overall absolutely repetitive and a shell of a game to justify the horrendous prices for virtual characters

Great game play and traffics, the interface is easy to pick up but the gameplay takes time to master. I wish there was a faster way to level my guild and the maps get a Lil monotonous but other than that it's 👌 perfect!

I just started but it's really fun. I will update my review later. if you like Warhammer, turn based RPGs, etc. you should try this. nothing to lose. update as of a week or so. I'm still playing. Rarely do I play a mobile game this long, it's solid. Try it.

Good game but grind and difficulty have a huge spike very often, lots of things are time-gated. Crashes have been happening way more often and I personally cannot play the game because the update refuses to be downloaded. Edit: The update bug seems to have fixed itself after a whole hour.

Great strategy game especially for Warhammer. A bit of a grind needed a lot of the time which can be solved by buying ridiculously priced boxes but that's to be expected in this kind of app, but not too friendly to the point where you have no progression

Great game great graphics, developers do not understand progression. Every mode wether it's guild war or arena or monthly quest goes from easy af to impossible there is nothing in between so it makes it impossible to progress properly enough to end game. Unless of course you want to spend money which is also the other bad point everything is 30% making this the most expensive game I've played want a hero 30% want some gold 30$ want new missions 30$ want a big pack 150%

A great game with solid gameplay and a decent amount of love put into it. Some of the microtransations can be predatory and unnecessary, but it genuinely seems like the goal is to be able to aquire all the characters for free provided you are willing to grind, which I am. Keep up the good work ya Snowflakes!

its almost bobblehead characters. WH is supposed to be super serious but this looks like a damn cartoon for 8 yr olds. levels too small. too many "upgrades, no grid, no strategy. only one way to beat each level. total joke of a game, especially for a WH title even later the game sucks. super boring.

Fun game, but some steep difficulty curves. Has improved since the early days, and the game is more generous with giving out items and the like. But go online early and you will hit a brick wall, some players have some very broken characters early game.

The project has mad potential in it but unfortunately the whole game is buried under timed gameplay, limited modes and micro transactions... Yes you can grind your way up through it but it would take you roughly around 50-63 teras to build a decent roster 😆 But despite all of that tough I still gabe it 3 stars because it's a very good / versatile game and it can pass lotta time. However it still needs more campaigns... More game modes on general with some of them NOT locked under energy / time.

It's a really well made game, I know next to nothing about the Warhammer universes, but thought I'd give it a go. The little info blotches on each of the many cool characters make me want to learn more about it. Fun game worth the time to check it out

I'm still only on the second page of the Campaign, but enjoying it still! The pay to play adds are a bit annoying, but the game is good so far, hope it continues! Gameplay is smooth and relatively fast pace, good to finally see a half decent 40k mobile game!

Have a lot of fun with this game but it can also be very didsapointing hence the 3 stars. They need to make it easy to get scrolls and characters you need for the campaigns. Been saving up 10 scrolls so much and for the past 5 times I got rubbish that I already have. It should either guarantee a NEW character or have more options to get new characters. Maybe buy the campaign characters with scrolls. Right now with nothing to aim for it is getting boring and you will lose a regular player.

There is a bug in the tutorial where they force you to claim a quest called we are the emperors chosen. But i am unable to due to not having finished the quest. Please fix this. | Update, they reached out to me via the in game mailbox, fixed the issuie and gave me extra loot. The game is also very fun!

Great stuff. You SHOULD be able to see terrain effects during character placement, as it affects the strategy of the entire match but the overwhelming random changes in damage balance and crit chances almost make up for it.

I'm a first time player and after only playing it a few hours I feel hooked even if it were only for the strategy and combat system. Turned based and lots of time to think up strategies. Any good game I'll give at least four stars but this one has me at Five! It's gotta be the best game with these mechanics I've actually ever played.

Gameplay, Design and Features are great. Progression however is horrendous. Once you reach the first "roadblock" that you usually meet in mobile game progression, it's already a collapsed bridge. It is so unbelievably slow to unlock anything, let alone characters you want. And "lootboxes" are also so damn scarce that you almost never roll for rare things (maybe 1-2 free boxes a week). It's not very new player friendly.

I've been playing this game since it's launch. And it keeps getting better and better. Every character in the game has some value depending on the game mode you're playing. This is one brilliant, polished gem of compact design and graphics with the best gameplay you can find in gacha games. Well deserving of it's five star rating with a plus.

Good game, nice graphics, don't need to pay (note that it does take quite a bit of time to get other characters), but my one issue is how demanding it is for devices. Please add a lower graphics version, because it is extremely frustrating when I crash after an hour :(

Tbh, the best mobile game app I've ever played for several reasons: virtually no ads, not pay to play at all, amazing gameplay, progression is continuous, great animation and attention to detail. Very high quality. Kudos to the developers! Even if I wasn't already aware of the Warhammer 40K universe, this game would be worth playing.

The details are there for each character. Being able to move only once and not to a certain total is lacking. But it's a great game noon the less and can't wait to see if they do all chapters and races

Even if ut is pay to win, I have never spent 1 pence, sorry developers for not supporting u with money, but it is completely possible to play f2p, it will only take a little longer than if u were to pay. Always would reccomend if u were up to a long grind great game 10/10 1 of the best games out there :).

I love playing this game. It's probably the best 40k out there. When it works. It seems extremely unstable, and I've been completely unable to play at all for the last few days. If the team can sort the crashing out they've got a real winner but for now I think I'll have to leave it and come back later.

This game IS fun and I enjoyed playing it for about two months. However, I got to a point where I couldnt progress without spending money. The last character I tried to upgrade, I had to wait for "onslaught" mode to refresh 10 or 11 days in a row. I finally got the required points to advance and it said you need to ascend this character to advance. I had just done that, and it reset the parameters again. As a free to play player, I expect to grind, but this is just not fun anymore.

Just starting and I'm digging it. Finally a tactic game that stands alone on mobile. In game currency is very slow for F2P. Only downside. Although, their isn't many characters to summon. So far everything else seems well balanced. Visuals are done very well. AMAZIN'!!

This game is pleasant for a bit and then it becomes the worst P2P I have ever played. You literally are unable to play the game, not to mention their rush to harder content is really a rush to make money. The Tournament Arena is the worst. The devs think it is great and I would rather go to a dentist. Avoid this, corpse running in vanilla WoW is more fun.

Bit greedy but a fun tactical element to the game - playing tough levels can end in a wipe or a 3 star success based on tactics alone. Very difficult and slow to earn level up orbs. Coins should be easier to access - too many raid tickets!! Character shards should average to 5/10 not 3/10 to make it a bit more bearable to grind for unlocks. The ones you can grind for are not the ones you can buy so the game could easily allow this. It is fun though and I'm playing and strong without paying.

As a fan of warhammer and tactics games this should be great . However they put too much emphasis on monetization . The forced slow down of progress is a bit frustrating. I would love to like this game but it is hard

Very fun game but it definitely has some balance issues in both Live and AI PVP, summoning anything snowballs a team into winning, and crits make me pull my hair out when a unit shouldn't be able to kill mine and then it just does without warning. Over all I recommend it, kinda gatcha kinda not but it's fun.

the combat is actually there it's fun and engaging. it follows the usual gacha systems but cranks up the prices this game isn't p2w it's W2W (whale to win) the monthly login but is 3$ and if u did it every day for a month wouldn't even cover a single 10x summons. your looking at minimum 10$ a char unlock realisticly. It actually takes over a month to get a 10x summons after ur first month. alot of resources have a locking difficulty climbing system and are random drops which is horrifying.

Wanted to like it, but the grind is ridiculous. Unique characters, good graphics, and fun at first. But after getting the same characters over and over and not being about to even grind without raid tickets just completely kills everything good about this game.

If you are a Warhammer 40k fan, then you have to download this game, graphics are great, storyline is nice and you can grind and still be competitive, packs are a bit pricey, but if you got some extra cash to throw around, then it might be worth it to drop a little here, 5 out of 5 for me

every game mode relies on an energy system and while you get tons of energy when you level up, the game slows to a crawl later on. Feels like hitting a brick wall at 60 mile per hour. Could definitely use a few modes where you can just play

Tl;dr: bug prevents me from using the app. After finishing a part of tutorial I took rewards from the missions before tutorial told me to do that. Now it prevents me from doing anything until I receive the rewards for a quest despite not having any quest finished.

Start off well enough as these games do . Then missions become impossible very quickly , but guess what ? You can spend money to level up your fellas . To grind the needed mats to level up is insanely time consuming , given limited attempts per day. Just another pay to win

Pretty fun at first but you quickly hit they pay wall. Your progress will be sluggish unless you fork over alot of cash and its also disappointing that the characters are unlocked in the same order for everyone, so the "random" lootboxes arent that random after all

Game is finally off pre-registration, so far I have found the game to be easy to get into. The tutorials are helpful and easy to follow. Plenty of campaign to work through and other modes to play. Graphically, the style is nice.

It's alright at first, but this is a very pay to win game. Even their 1 year anniversary celebration was just discounts on their paid stuff and absolutely bare minimum rewards for players. I'd only reccomend if you have either lots of time or money

Really cool game I'm a fan of all strategy games and this is no different I was looking for something to play after one of the other games I play got shut down and now I've found it the game plays great other than it kinda being buggy and lagging which I can deal with, I've got no massive complaints all around great game

Tacticus is a great game as far as mobile 40k games go , Ive already spent way to much money BUT that's because the game is fun and I'm happy to support it , it is a little pay to win but I'm sure you can achieve a lot with patience and grinding. My only gripe is running out of battle tokens but eh , it's not that big of a deal

Reminds me of Raid: Shadow Legends and D&D. I say that with high praise. Minimal optional ads. Guilds. PVP Arena. Great tactical top-down RPG. This one might be a hit for WH40K! Edit: 3 months in and it is very grind-heavy now and not really fun because I'm not making progress. It was fun while it lasted though

This game doesn't have any reason to play it. It's basic, it's grindy, it's boring. There's nothing of value to be found here. For a game that wants my money so bad it constantly barrages me with ads, it has nothing of substance to even entice me to play. It's just more gacha slop designed to do nothing but prey on whales

Enjoying the game a lot more than I did initially. Just some glaring, evident issues with balancing I've noticed. Summon characters, especially Aleph-Null, are massively overtuned. Especially in pvp. With the variety of characters in this game, it feels so disappointing coming to realize that all the energy I put into my Vindicta or Roswitha for example was wasted when the balancing clearly favors quantity over quality.

Constantly waiting for energy to refresh and other game modes to generate tokens is a massive problem. There needs to be a game mode you can play as much as you want because until I can play the game whenever I want to it's a no from me.

Looking pretty good so far. I would like more agency over gaining the factions i want though. For example, having to replay 40 games to get the first necron character is a long grind. I was lucky enough to get it in a drop fortunately, but if the grind for the others is as bad..

I liked the game play for the first few hours, but got really repetitive fast with its very limited unit selection. With only 5 units per faction, even a way to buy into it would help. Arena suffers from serious balance issues.

Litterally ZERO progress if you don't spend A LOT of money. Not fun at all. You get bombardet with offers. And you have to watch annoying ads for tiny benefits. I spend 24 dollars for the season pass, still almost no progress..

From the amount of time I've put into it (around 300 hours according to gaming hub on here) I've thoroughly enjoyed this game, now I've spent a little bit, maybe around £30-50 but I'm going to be honest, I didn't really get much value out of it, which in a way is kind of a good thing? Meaning it's fine to play free to play, I haven't played for a few months since I got sidetracked with life, but I'll definitely play it again when I get more free time

The ai for your own units is absolutely trash. I've had many instances of my own characters deciding to go into the worst spots possible when I tell them to attack. You can micro, but it's very clunky, and God help you if an input gets eaten.

Fun but slow and grindy. Progress bar status is nigh impossible to read with white text on yellow background so can't tell how much we need to complete a given mission. Update 2024.08.09 - Anniversary event runs for 2 weeks with extraordinary priced deals to squeeze more money out of the player base, insanely expensive for what it's worth.

Back up to 5 stars. After initially getting told I was SOL about getting my play account connected and dropping my review to 2 stars, a DIFFERENT customer service person reached out and got it fixed. I'll take what I can get, at least it works now. You may also get a trash customer service person at first, so I highly recommend if they tell you a bad answer, demand a second opinion. It shouldn't have to be that way, but maybe they should get more people who care about the players.

First of all, gacha mechanics are horrible in general, but I wouldn't even mind it as much if you could just start with the faction that you wanted and focus only on that faction. Instead they force you into one faction and the rest is all random chance of unlocking. I want to like this game but it's not for me.

The gameplay is good but it begs for money far too much. I played for 5 minutes and saw maybe 5 popups advertising stuff from the shop. Stupid prices too, like £30 for 3 characters when there are around 30 in total.

Bumping this up to 4* since every time I take it down the devs fix my problem. Now the only things I want from the game are non-repetetive gameplay and removing the sim-tickets. For a 150h+ work month I have no time to spare to grind for tickets so I can use up my energy without wasting time.

I enjoy this a lot. Wish the shop wasn't priced so terribly, but that's a completely optional part of the game. HRE's are also poorly thought out, like why am I getting more/fewer shards towards the unlock and upgrades based on how other people are spending? That's dumb, just like the people who hoard thousands of energy for those events. Sort out either of those and you got yourself a fifth star.

Amazing game, though it would be nice to have the option to choose between the factions which you would like to start with and work towards unlocking their higher units with the campaign, that would require more characters per faction, but hopefully it can be implemented, for a more personal experience.

Very nice game with lots to do. I don't give it 5 stars because you hit a difficulty spike very early, within a couple of days of active play. At that point you are effective blocked and must either spend real money or start grinding the daily missions.

I played the game for a long time and had accounts connected to it. (I do that with all my games). I got very far. I deleted it for a little while to make storage. I just got back Into it and it says I don't have any saved progress. I'm not going to start from scratch again

Newest update just draws out more repetitive boring gameplay. Increase shards needed for weakest of chars. Cant unlock new chapters unless you have atleast 3 of a faction. Shard drops are less than 33% needing 80 of 1, 10 times a day zzz. Removed missions that gave summon scrolls per lvl. Which will take 10x longer to get 1. Gear farm drops are horrid aswell. First 3 days is ok. Then incoming boring repetition. Hardly a turn based tactic game.

So far its a very solid yet simple 40k game and I love it. My only problem is that there have been complaints (like myself) from the visual standpoint of the game, and that being is it really drops the fps a lot. I know this game is still new but at least try to make it smoother.

I love the way it plays. But I want more playable characters besides main characters. I'd be just as happy with more basic characters and larger fields of battle. I feel that 6-8 members in a team would make the game feel more fleshed out and not so much like a mini chess game

Good game, I was in the beta for months before release. You could see the developers actually respond to community feedback and put it in the game. A little too much monetization in your face for my taste, but you can absolutely play for free without issues. Great Warhammer 40k feel.

Worst example of pay to win ever. I hit an impassable paywall after 2 days, the boss is so much stronger than the previous fights that it is almost comical. Story campaigns are short and cost 29.99 each. This game is a pathetic cash grab, and a copy of other games, nothing about tacticus is original, or done well. 0/5

Love this game, I played fire emblem heroes, but alot of those heroes felt the same. Not with tacticus, each hero is unique. There are multiple game modes that keep the game going and regular events to unlock new or existing characters, looking forward to new events in the future. Alot of the game is sadly locked behind owning characters, so while no financial investment is needed, it's heavily encouraged, but why not? It's a free game and there are no forced adds.

Impossible to give a game less than 5 that runs on literally the worst phones on the market. Outside that it's a simple strategy game. Lots of missions. Haven't spent a cent yet and it is cool to see a game that isn't just a copy of every other game. Levels could be a bit bigger and low for more tactical play but like I said. This game runs on very simple phones. So a good time killer when you wait for your new flagship ect Just for that I'm installing it on my s24+ just to see the difference.

Such a great community in this game, the gameplay is very fun with lots of content for new and old players, and the monitization is reasonable, and theres always tons of free codes. Tiny purchases to major ones, but none that are necessary. I started a guild right after starting to play and have been blown away with the quality of people im running into. But you will not have enough resources to invest in every unit. Im just hoping to see the Iron hands chapter soon, and more ways to get badges

Definitely one of the best WH40K games out there, well designed and the models look phenomenal. Really enjoying the tactical aspect of the game, like the physical board game itself. Seriously can't wait for the rest of the Tau units AND maybe with the Skaven being hinted at in 40K, units like them might be added :P All in all, amazing game.

Seems cool at first. Beware, that lasts until right after you get a pop-up asking you to review the game. This game is no different than a slot machine app, a bunch of flashing lights designed to entice you to spend money.

So I would give it a 5 but it's clearly pay to win like on mission pack 3 the final boss is literally, like I'm talking I tried 25 times and every single time right before the death blow it goes to full health and spawns additional units that then quickly dispatches your guys, so I pony'd up 5 bucks for yarrick, because I genuinely do enjoy the game and was able to win in like 3 turns bc yarrick summons 4 more guards to help you fight. So game play, story and how the game flows 5/5 but ptw is 👎

overall there's a lot of MTX and some FOMO elements as you would expect; F2P has a lot slower progression due to the lack of higher availability through the purchased things, but you can still get a vast majority of the things to play the game quite easily overall without making a single purchase.

I love 40k, never really played any tactic style games in the past but this game is fun, and it rewards you a lot just for playing. there's still pop ups for the stuff you can buy but it's not too much and it definitely feels like you can catch up to people who pay to win if you just stay on and read everything

Obvious that this is a money grab in every sense. I have no issue with pay to win model if that's what a developer chooses, but the prices make even that prohibitive. I'll stick to actual models where I actually get something for my money instead of a game that might disappear tomorrow

Fun quick game. Playing free version. Progression is slow so unless you're shelling out money anticipate a slow burn with pauses while you aquire upgrades for your characters. Paid items seem quite expensive though so still trying to figure that out. .

Do you like aggressive advertising do you like it when it's pushed in your face here spend this money and you'll get something that might work now this is usually fine and good for anything that is potentially a Warhammer or games workshop equivalent product as you know most of it's half baked it's just to spend your time but in this case you will get to a point and you're going to have to Shell out a lot of money for a game that really isn't worth that much

I'm still in the beginning. So far it's fine. Something to do if your bored don't expect anything epic from it. It doesn't have a lot of variety in the factions yet. Hopefully they add more ,but until then don't expect to get you 40k fix with this game just yet. We will see if it worth it down the road.

Lost all my progress, I have no idea why, but I had about 60$ and at least 50 hours in the game and I opened the game one day to the tutorial and my progress gone, I'm in a clan with a friend on my former account, if I can get it back I'll change the rating

One of the most egregiously monetized games I have ever tried, which I can typically ignore. The most recent ads, though, cannot be closed without interacting with whatever app is being advertised, which will then automatically install itself. No thank you, don't need that.

New to the 40k universe so have to learn the finer details, however the game is a bit hard to navigate and there is a lot for new players so making it hard for me progress and learn the game. Overall good game, good devs.

The game has addictive gameplay and caring developers who are always ready to help and listens to the community. However, the ranking and leveling systems need improvement, and character releases should be balanced to make upgrades easier to obtain. It's difficult to catch up when leveling characters to higher tiers requires too much energy and experience. Closing this gap would improve the overall experience. More campaigns please!

Very little free to play progression before you hit a wall and either have to pay to barely move forward or spend days getting single digit currency when one roll costs 300 and doesn't guarantee any actual progression because you can pull 1 orb which takes around 10 minimum to actual progress a character. Events are catered to purely the pay 2 win or power playing crowd. Its a gross cash grab that does nothing but give you scraps for playing. Absolutely putrid

I was intimidated by this because I've never played a tactical RPG before but this game is very beginner friendly. It has just the right amount of challenge and it's easy to figure out what everything means. I'm not an expert on 40k but it seems to be consistent with the lore and the character interactions feel like they belong
Wish they let you pick a faction there's tons of characters I have that I don't have any interest in using.

awful experience. after the first 30 levels are brain dead easy and then every enemy will one shot you after unless ofc you spend $1000s on their "shop". To add I was upgrading the characters and using terrain mechanics as much as some believe I am not.

Quite a fun game in itself, you have to ignore the false walls of upgrade items and just enjoy it. However, it's just let down by the constant pay to win element. £20 doesn't even unlock special new characters? Store offers are trash. Pure greed. Plan and simple. (Thats from a player who used to spend).

This is a resource management game. Expect to be bombarded with micro transactions, hit the "wall" on day 1. Battles are repetitive and come down to "Can you brute force your way through or not?" Overall this is just old mechanics with a new skin. The PvP is awful I've been matched with people who are 10x my power, the live PvP is just demoralising. Definitely not good, the clan I joined is full of inactive players which kinda shows how bad it is.

This was a fun game for a while, but they've now routinely nerfed chars, after asking for money and time to obtain/upgrade them. I've had around 7 chars nerfed into obscurity over the past year. I will not be spending any money on this game in the future and may drop off altogether.

Another dishonest cash grab, the game is playable for a few levels and is great while it lasts, then has a sudden artificial difficulty spike that forces you to either pay to win or sit replaying old missions and getting slapped around in pvp with the few under powered characters you can unlock.

Definitely an awesome game. One thing I could do without though. Double tapping to move spaces on the board. If I want to move a character I'd like to be able to tap the character and single tap the space where I want to place said character. Honestly it's more annoying than anything. Overall excellent game though

I've only been playing for a few days but I love it so far. The only thing I'm hoping for is having more characters come out which I'm not complaining with what we have rn but if they are teasers for more characters I'll stay for even longer than I'm planning and even change to a 5 star rating

Overall verry fun with some actually interesting combat systems and characters, but with everything that the game does have it is brought down by how obnoxious the marketing is, there's a pop up for overpriced bundles every 5 minutes but other than that it is very fun

This could not have been a better first experience with Warhammer 40k. 1. The models are AMAZING 2. From every sound effect to every kill is super satisfying. Cons. 1. The menu may be hard to navigate in the beginning 2. The battles have a map that's just a 2d picture

The 3rd person over view gives the game such a unique feel, being able to see the damage that will be done before the attack is extremely useful and seeing the attack animations is just satisfying to say the least haha, 5/5 I'm hooked on this game :)

Early on the game is fine, but if you want to stand a chance in Arena, or play any other campaigns, you'll have to start throwing a good amount of money at the game. And that wont even garauntee you getting to play the alternate missions and stories.

I love the IP but knew what was coming before I downloaded. It is built for pay to win. Several forms of premium currency, loot boxes, energy so you can only play so much unless you pay. It has all the tricks. Will there ever be a 40k game thats not over monetized?

Tacticus is genuinely one of the better mobile warhammer games to come out in recent memory in my opinion. It certainly has a lot more creativity and effort put into it than other GW approved items of the App Store and Google Play Store, and has a consistent coherency to the source material. While it may not satisfy some hardcore fans of the property looking to scrutinize under the absolute benchmark of "Muh Dawn Of War", it certainly can certainly be a good ride for those who have interest.

microtransactions too expensive, also game is limited, you need tickets to raid a mission? if you don't have them you have to manually do every single mission to farm materials, it's insanely time-consuming, repetitive and plain boring. the game is fun for the first 2 days but turns into a chore very quickly

Totally a cash grab. Installed after seeing reviews saying they were happy this game isn't a cash grab. Uninstalled an hour later after the game wanted $30 to play a mission. Edit: I wish I could remove the 1 star based on the lies you're trying to feed me. 0 stars pure cash grab.

So far its really good. Generous with upgrades etc it's a turnbased wh40k game... Right up my street. The guild wars is decent, you can work with others to do events. Considering it's just launched, it's very polished. I'd defo recommend this and as with these types of games more and more gets added along the way.

Surprisingly good for a mobile game, let alone a 40k game. Don't have to pay for anything if you don't want to and the grid isn't too bad, throws a decent amount of free stuff at you. I'll likely put many, many hours into Tacticus. Looking forward to seeing what the updates will bring.

Getting worse over time. Requisition system gets much less rewarding as you progress, and play becomes extremely repetitive after campaigns are complete. Machines of war get too much emphasis since introduction. Multiple recent freezes, losing tokens, and no response to support ticket.

Hard stop after a day or two, paywall. Slow energy regain for everything, run out of ads so you can't even do that most of the time. One example. You need X to advance, but X only exists later on unless you get super lucky or use real money. Now make that for every single character and all upgrades once you hit that wall. Look, add far more working ads, decrease the timers to 6 hours instead of 12 while making refresh at least 4x more with lower costs. Oh, N costs for items is nuts for most.

This is a good game with some fun modes to play. There are some frustratuons with controls and finding certain items can be tricky (esp rarer orbs). That said I don't agree with the pay wall comments, if you try a variety of missions they allow you to develop your team effectively. I'm on level 74/75 for the first mission set without paying a thing. The guilds are fun and add a team element to the proceedings. overall good fun and pretty strategic.

Good Warhammer 40K game. There are some adds for upgrades here and there, but nothing that will make you watch a different add for a whole minute. Overall a 5 out of 5 star game. Especially for those who are looking to get into the warhammer univers or hobby.

Seems ok at first but you quickly realise it's been made with the few of heavy monetisation. You run out of things to do after about a day or so of downloading and it becomes a skog with not much content. Prices of the mtx's are ridiculous. Avoid.

Amazing game killed by greed. You will require 2 lifetimes to get all characters without paying a fortune. 15-20$ to get 3 summons and 55fragments for a character you potentially already have or dont want. Events are basically a joke, a casual player has 0 chance to get even the basic rare character... a shame the game itself is great.

100 a pay to win game. Has several iconic characters from the lore but if youre not paying theres no way to farm a huge selection of characters at this moment. If you've been around since the beginning you have an edge but those that spend more are always gonna remain on top.

Love it so far amazing iv been playing a week now so I will definitely add more info latter but it's a blast for me an the kids I don't had the real game so this one holds me off tell I buy a console version but truly amazing the battles level ups an collecting all the ppl it's so fun can't wait for more content to be added definitely needs alot more factions an collectable ppl an I would be happier

Very fun, but you have to be smart how to invest your resources. Focus on 1 Character on each Faction (Necrons, Imperial, Chaos) and you get pretty far and keep advancing without investing. I advanced every week to an new pvp league without stopping since i started (ca.7 weeks). Im not even a huge warhammer fun, but this game i enjoy pretty much. Maybe currently the greatest game of its genre on mobile.

Edit: glaring issue. This is a phone game. As such my phone occasionally gets important calls, notifications and such that require swapping apps or the game just drops due to signal or issue. This will cause the game to reload and lose the battle you were in. Most events are time earned tokens and this can cause a 12 hour delay to complete dailies or get that one win you needed. This is a common issue. Either refund the spent energy or token or save our place. Refunding is easier option imo.

I was a bit uneasy when I saw the ads, but this is actually one of the better mobile games I've played. Very satisfying progression and gameplay loop. Hoping the long-term gameplay maintains the early game feel, I'm not that far as of writing.

Very fun and addicting. A few suggestions I have are removing the energy resources as it just slows down progression and being able to buy requisition orders without using them so i can save for a 10 pull. Having a 10 pull pity in the single pulls would be nice too.

Good game very addictive! And not as you may expect pay to win as the game balancing is very good, haven't paid a dime and I do fine. But of advice to new players find a good guild with decent chat and activity to join as it makes the game much more fun overall, I've had two play throughs of the game and the second time with an active guild is much better! 👍🏿 I also rate the Devs they are very involved and passionate about keeping the game fun and balanced. That's enough lol For the emperor!

So far, I've been playing it for a few hours, and it really fun. It is easy to understand and does guide you on how it works and how to upgrade your units. I'm new to Warhammer, so some factions and characters I don't really know, but so far, I enjoy it

So far enjoying it, however i imagine it might become too hard at later levels and have to put too much time into or pay to play. Edit: B4 level 12 starts slow going. All i can do is guild stuff...leveling is impossible and bosses one shot you...aint fun anymore...uninstalled.

Constant Error 'You are not connected to the internet'. Funny as EVERYTHING else on my phone seems to disagree with this app. Tried disconnecting from WiFi, running on 5G, LTE but nope, the game doesn't want to work. Time to uninstall, anotjer waste of $15 it seems.

The free to play parts of the game are good for casual players. If you are a free to play player all the in app purchase options can feel a bit much. To all the whales, spending a little in the game can get you a lot. I've really enjoyed playing this game.

Overall a fun mobile game for 40k fans. Tons of rolling events, lots of supported creator content. Bug support is super quick. Points lost because of the monetization. The monetization is pretty steep, partly because of the licensing I suspect (Thanks, James Workshop). Realistically, the battle passes are a bit expensive for the regular paid pass and very much not worth the ultimate. Blackstone and other bundles are also a bit ludicrous in pricing. 3.5/5

I would have previously given this game 5/5. Unfortunately, it's become P2P only recently. You can't progress your characters without buying their premium currency now. It's really sad, I've played this game for nearly 3 years and it used to be great. It's only driven by greed now.

Awesome gameplay. Excellent visuals. And as the only 40k content I've found that lets me team abbadon with celestine, A cool novelty. But it's a gacha so if that's a turn off that's understandable. But my only real gripe now is... All of the tokens to play different modes take waaaaaay too long to regenerate.

A good game aspechily for the first few hours but after that the game gets super grindy and not boring per say but less interesting I don't know how but they need to fix the later stages of the game, Alson I wish the visuals of the characters changed as you upgraded them it would make the game feel more interactive.

This would be a great game if it wasn't a BS pay to win game if you want to make money off of me make it a one-time purchase and let me play the game at a certain point enemies one shot kill you even though you have maxed out levels really wish they would not do this

A decent little game, they bombard you with 'offers' and 'deals' all day, but so far I haven't spent a penny! I've unlocked a decent amount of characters & 3 extra campaigns. Pretty good fun especially if you're a WH40k fan.

the game is fun till you start to figure out that the shards you need to unlock characters you need to get into events starts getting heavy into the pay to play greedy scam area and if you don't pay to play you are forced to take years missing out on characters as soon as they bring back the event that has that character but that takes a long time as it is random when or if that event ever comes back

There is no need for a forceful tutorial in the beginning of this game I have spent a lot of money on this game and it's really annoying so please fix it. We have waited so long! This game h1as more COMPLETENESS than so many of its genre! A real winner for that tactical rpg and a great rebirthing for WARHAMMER!

It is a really solid game and is one of the better Warhammer 40k games. There is some problems like you getting barge with deals when you open the menu but I can deal with that. The game play is solid and really good tbh. If you fix some things then I'll give a 5 stars but for now it will be a 4 :D

Pretty standard free to play game. Lots of free "meaningless" currency in the beginning to make you feel good. Loads of missions that scale up as the player gains experience. The tactics are pretty basic but at its core its still fun. It's a bit like raid shadow legends meats (not a spelling error) angry birds.

Will explain why you will have to pay to win or spend to keep up, Game AI is designed to hinder you and this has been proven on more then one occasion. Doing missions they will put enemies in later levels designed to one shot you unless you farm for months, not days months as you will be lucky if you get three tokens for the character you are trying to unlock, 1-3 tokens a day for 250 tokens. Unless you spend 9.99 - 19.99 for packs.

Really enjoying this game, only playing through the campaign at the moment, but it has nice steady progression, so far I don't feel pressured in to spending money in game, and although it is a very simplified take on the warhammer 40k game, I do feel it captures enough of the feeling to make it a worthwhile addition to the universe, and a worthwhile addition to my collection of mobile games.

Good game but it would be better if the campaign battles were balanced to the right difficulty. Instead they're usually either impossible or too easy depending on your characters' power. It's basically all about grinding away for characters and upgrades with cool art.

A solid 40k and strategy mobile game, with some cool collectable characters and gear. Some optional ads and microtransactions, no paywall as of yet either which is nice. Game does sometimes randomly kick me from onslaught, guild raids, ect and use my tokens even though I get no rewards. Don't know if that's just an android problem but just be aware that the game does still seem to have a few bugs.

Honestly very gameplay focused with plenty of room for strategy which isn't just brute forcing with numbers. Which is great because the concept of only progressing via having better stats doesn't force people to grind for long periods of time untill you have enough stats to win.

Good game, but after the initial binge that you can do from easy level ups that give you things to do you're r stuck on a 24 hour wait for energy and tokens to be able to even play anything. The only way to buy more gets very expensive after the 1st buy of the day.

Very Fun Action and Strategy gameplay with every character ability is unique, and the game design is amazing, but I have problems 1. I have to thank the developer for making a decent game with new content and still making it playable for people who spend zero dollars on it. Good work guys keep it up.
