So far though I am having a great time purging heretics and xenos.

I love this game now, the improvement they made to the gameplay and the characters is refreshing to see from a mobile game. I am very addicted at this point. One point of improvement may be the price of some packages being too high but other than that the core game is awesome now and keeps getting better with each update. Stuff still takes long to charge but with the added events there is enough to keep yourself busy with.

Devs need to drop the "Ultimate Pass" idea. $25/mo for a phone game that gatekeeps so much content behind passive token regeneration is just exploitative and gross. The game overall is fun and there's new content regularly available. Characters are interesting and it doesn't feel like it takes an inordinate amount of time to progress. Tacticus is well worth your time for 40k and GW fans but the ultimate battlepass is just a bridge too far for a sparkle portrait and a generic frame recolor.

Another gacha with zero consideration of players time. Twenty game modes, each as similar as the last. You must do them all, every day, or you are not progressing. Mission raid is additional currency - garbage mechanic that should not be in any game ever.

$43.99 for a minor character pack, '85% off', costs 30.99. Cash grab with bad math and mediocre writing. Strategy and character models are fine, does reward thinking and planning, I'm up to mission 60 and absolutely not encountering P2W.

Game still has bugs that crash during gameplay and consume the resources anyway making it tedious and demotivating. It also doesn't connect to the internet servers sometimes. But recent events have been player friendly, if they keep it up will rate higher

So far, the game gives great rewards for not dropping money on it. I'm having way more fun with this than Combat Cards! Once and if Tyranids become playable, I'll probably drop a few bucks. I recommend giving this game a try!

Very fun game. The combos are some of the most satisfying things in the world. I'd love to see more characters and see them being more accessible but more are still added and updates are constant. Also the alliances or Guilds need more work on them but overall very fun game.

Good game, fast-paced with some genuine tactical gameplay when opposing teams are around the same power level. Otherwise, it's your typical stats based grind-fest. Grind for loot, then steamroll over the opponent when you got the level advantage or get wrecked when they do.

Honestly i cannot recommend this game simply because of the fact there is a lot of RNG involved in the fights despite being a strategy game (Think crits and a chance for units to resurrect). That in it's self is not terrible however losing costs full stamina. So you cannot test set up's or RNG can literally remove a paid resourse from you. If 90-100% of stamina was refunded on defeat i think i would be giving this a much higher score.

Incredibly predatory pricing structure. Campaign packs are $30 at all times, but the makers perpetuate a fraud on the buyer by claiming this is 70% off. If you happen to unlock a character in that campaign, it is $10 cheaper, but they claim this is now 85% off. This is fraudulent pricing practices. This game is not free to play friendly, hitting a wall around level 70 of the indomitus campaign that you cannot pass without months of grinding 10/day battles.

Like most games from big publishers, it is pay to play/win. You can not advance unless money is spent on chest, daily activities, and the time it takes to get raid tickets is a joke. You get about 10 mins of game play, then you need to wait at least 12 hours before raid tickets reset. I really want to like this as I love the lore and W40k setting.

Game was initially entertaining but even with putting in not a minor amount of money, I hit a massive difficulty brick wall were the game effectively told me lol grind more content that is exactly the same battles against the exact line up of characters. No thanks, uninstalled and deeply regret spending any money on this.

Kind of fun. Mostly collecting gear to build better gear to try and upgrade the characters. The game costs a lot of time and money to really advance at all. Story lines are absolutely lacking. New weapons, armor, etc don't modify the the look of characters.

It is like Rivengard but in Warhammer, a grid based tactics game with collecting and upgrading stuff, so I like it so far. Little bit too easy in the beginning missions, with lots of ads and pay to get stuff options, but it is not necessary to buy them. It gets regular updates and looks good.

Big fan of Warhammer, thought it would be a generic base builder like most games these days, it isn't. It has some similar features like getting characters through a "Summoning" sort of feature, but for the most part the gameplay is unique turn based combat between heroes of whatever force your commanding and the enemy. The game doesn't have many factions yet, though I've heard that they are constantly updating and adding more. Can't wait for the Blood Angels!

Good, needs way to control the amount of things you ask the clan for and a way to trade character shards for other character shards so I can give one epic shard for two rare shards and etc so your can't get higher tier characters compared to the tier of the trade imospek is just hard to learn but there's a lot of waiting because of energy and characters not in campaigns are almost impossible to get also I see this game have a player for like a week and loose them so there's not many new players

So far a very enjoyable game. There are a few game modes. The main one at first is a campaign with small battles. It does take some strategy to use your team/squad together with the terrain. It might not be a long time game after you complete the campaign (not there yet).

this game is pretty good, but might be confusing to players who don't know much about the entire 40k storyline only been playing for 2 days and have been taking my time through the levels reason for not giving 5 stars is how hard it is to get new units since you only get 1 inquisition every level.

You can't play indefinitely, there's energy that runs out fast and you have to give $$$ to get more. simply put, you can spend about 3~5 minutes for free each day. If that were altered, the game would be a slam-dunk.

love this game, it's got a lot of fundamental issues with the games structure and pricing however the developers are always doing continual work on this game making it better. the support team is prompt and effective usually responding within hours. I can't say anything truly negative about this game. definitely work the download although you won't get very far playing for free.

One day we might get a good not P2W 40k game, but not today. Sadly I stayed playing after this review and boy what a mistake. I won't go into much detail but for example in this game about "tactics" in live pvp arena events if you go first, you mostly win. Brilliant game design!!!

Such an amazing game to just pass the time, genuinely as a Warhammer fan it's nice to finally play one of my favorite franchises on a mobile platform! Character models are nice and clean, the combat is simple yet requires some strategy to progress. Overall it's a 10/10

The game feels good, but I can also feel the pay wall coming. The premium currency is way too scarce so once my guys stop being overpowered it's not going to be easy to power them up, and since the premium currency is so rare getting new higher rank guys or hero shards for the ones I already have will take some serious grinding.

Great use of the rivengard platform. Hex based TBS with good combat arenas, nice unique feeling characters and plenty of activities. -1 star for the aggressive monetization. Ocasional pvp tournaments give you the chance to fight real people, wish they would implement the mode permanently. Overall one of the better mobile rpg/strategy games out there, but watch out for the real money shop, it's very tempting and can add up really quick

Terrible RNG gacha the power difference between my characters is the worst that trying to prefect a level is impossible because one or two my characters will get swarmed and die. The grinding mechanics is bad as well your force to collect these medals to be able to instant clear a level but those only come in loot boxes which are also slow to get ro spend your currency that should be saved to roll the gacha.

at first a very enjoyable game but rapidly reached the point of no progress can't complete missions as my characters are not strong enough can't continue improving them as the items required are unavailable unless you complete the mission (my characters are maxed as far as I can at the moment)

Currently end season don't have rewards. It kicks me out on aspirant and moved on to scout, literally a total waste of time game without getting your reward. If this is an issue rn please fix it asap because I need to grind on the next stages and I'll change the review.

I want to start with the actual game and gameplay itself ia fantastic. My only reservation is the pacing. I am unable to play the fall of cadia mirror, nor the ork story mirror because these stories are locked behind characters who require 120 shards to unlock. I'm level 22 so have used varying 10 requisition to aim for characters yet these typically just multiply existing characters. Im yet to access any characters I need to progress or start a story. Yet they cannot be unlocked except this way

So far the game is great. I would like to see more factions eventually not behind a pay wall like Ad Mech or Genestealer Cults. Personally, I would love to see a game like this, maybe a little bigger, on the PC.

For a mobile game this is fantastic. Fast paced and rewarding although the only thing I wish there would be more cover, and bigger maps so position mattered a tad bit more. Only on the 2nd boss so this could be a very uneducated in this game yet

Good game lot of potential, bad after it gives most heros in intro, maybe just teach with heros but let us draw randomly. To keep it mixed Everyone has same thing that's kinda boring Give us army to play with make our own fields with per hero and unit costs to fix maximum op character one can take, you know like tabletop

Pretty fun game, but I am definitely running into a paywall. 12 out of 12 of my characters are maxed out until I get 10 components per character to upgrade. I've been playing for about 3 weeks now and I've gotten one of 120 epic orbs that I need. "But you can always buy them for real world cash..."

As an introduction for me anyway to 40K this is a solid game so far and for guilds don't worry about inactivity as a newbie as far as currently it's fine take it slow it's a solid game definitely a upgrade from Marvel Strike Force for me and it seems all the purchases are small and not needed to get good but are there if need be 5/5 currently and it appears they may be adding more and more 40K characters as time goes on so yay good job on a 40K game "For The Emperor!"

Fun game until you hit lvl11. Practically impossible to progress unless you buy upgrade packs. Never experienced a game that has such an insane pay wall. I don't mind buying packs here and there, but not to this degree. The packs are not that great either. HIGHLY DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS GAME.

It's a nice run on the warhammer 40k genre the only reason I don't give 5 stars is due to the heavy handed way they use micro transactions. The game play is solid and the characters are few but beautifully made. All and all its a decent gatcha game

Game is what it is. But the way they try and sell you their massively over priced "deals" is pretty obnoxious tbh. "ONLY ONE IN STOCK LEFT" £26 for some garbage characters. Honestly just leaves a bad taste in the mouth. Give the game a go if you love warhammer but don't spend money.. It only encourages these rediculous prices.

Lot of fun: turn base tactic. At the beginning of each fight you choose where you characters are. Then you get your movement phase and shooting phase for each characters. You can use special abilities to do aoe, call reinforcement, heal, etc. There are multiple faction that unlock with playing the game. There are onslaught stage (multiple wave horde mode), campaigns which unlock when you unlock characters from other faction. You have plenty of fun for free. So worth trying out!

I really enjoy this game. It's fun to be taken into the 40k universe. What makes this game stand out is the amazing customer service. I had some technical issues. Within 24 hours the issue was fixed and all of my characters that I had collected were back. I have never experienced such good service. I have played other games where I have spent serious $$. My experience there was very poor service to say the least. Well done to the Tacticus team. 100% great experience

Game freezes after using the hero's ability in the second part of the tutorial. Using a One Plus 7 Pro, tried restarting and reinstalling the game multiple times. Left alone hoping for an update but after a few months came back and nothing changed.

It's a nice top-down, tactical, grid, turn-based rpg set in the warhammer 40k universe. Worth a try if you want to try playing it. If you don't want to give it a try, you have the luzury of not installing it. It's free to play.

It's actually a fun game, you don't have to pay for requisitions if you don't want to. I'm level 9 after 2 hours and have already gotten a legendary character. You get free requisitions to unlock characters or you can earn materials to purchase them with in game currency. Also there's plenty to do, you're not bottle necked into pvp where everyone is p2p. Though I haven't played pvp here yet, with the generous character unlocks you could probably hold your own pretty well against people your lvl

Poorly optimised with an energy system and a limited number of times you can do each mission a day which would be fine if they didn't restrict you even further with raid tokens, choose one or the other and now a bloody season pass to exploit fomo a shame it was a decent game despite the limiting mission system

One of the best games ive played in a very long time! However please make black stones and summon scrolls more available for non pay to win players, it would make the whole experience far more worthwhile to be able to unlock characters at a moderate pace

good game, absolutely possible to FTP it but you need to be patient and come in and do your levels and item raids once a day til you get what you need to advance. not a game you will spend hours at a time playing, just a few minutes here and there. enjoy it for what it is! or spend money and stop whining, I don't know what to tell you. 🤷🏻‍♀️

It was a great game, even spend 10 bucks on it. But now it has thrown me off, and I have lost my account. 4 months of work. 10 bucks. All gone, and now I am not going to play the game anylonger after such a loss. If you are going to play, make sure to save it somewhere, because otherwise you are screwed if you lose it

This is just gacha but instead of anime girls you have overpriced digital characters that cost almost as much as actual plastic minis. This game doesn't have matchmaking at all, you can play in the arena with enemies that are twice your power as well as play that have this power in hundreds of thousands of point while you're just 15 thousand (I'm not joking). I'd love to share more but I can't describe even a fraction of predatory strategies developers use to keep you engaged in this shitshow

Beating the first campaign felt excatic. Never have I been more satisfied in a mobile game. It DOES take a while to get any character/upgrade a character, and boy am I not excited to see a battle pass implemented, but if you ARE looking for another Warhammer mobile game besides HH:L... This'll keep ya addicted.

Amazing game, so much fun and so addicting!! It's one of those games when you can just play for hours, as there is so much available to do, if it's the multiple campaigns, various missions, intense arena battles or even the onslaught and salvage levels! Your fun will be endless. Keep up the updates devs, and i won't ever stop playing!

I have serious objections to any game that is deliberately designed to be frustrating in order to milk the users for cash and this is one of the worst. 90% of their monetization is copy pasted from Raid. So if you've played that, that's what you're getting into here but with way less content. Honestly there's hardly any "gameplay" here. It's a shame that GW insists on creating these shameful cash grabs instead of real games. Don't waste your time with this one.

I'm not a big fan of phone games, just because of how predatory they are with their loot boxes. This is one where I've yet to hit a pay wall. I havent spent a cent, yet am geting consistently great pulls. The gameplay is solid, and actually requires thoughtful tactics instead of luck. It's as close to the tabletop as you can get without needing to spend serious cash. One thing I've really enjoyed is the soundtrack. It sounds surprisingly great and really gets me in the purging mood.

Tried because of FreeCash, my first two offers completed with no issues. So I spent money on this game and completed two more higher offers and they refused to pay. Talked to FreeCash Support and they said it was the provider issue and now I lost 10 hours of playing this POS

This is honestly a great game. The two stars come from continued play. You hit a wall pretty early on if you aren't willing to spend money. I'll play it for a bit longer, but I don't see myself playing it long term because I don't want to have to grind for game mid game content. TLDR, if you have money to spend, you will have fun. If not, prepare for a grind.

One of the better Warhammer 40k strategy games out there. The character design is cool in its design style. Good progression without being heavily p2w (although that option does exist). Fun and engaging gameplay and even thought they don't have my faborite W40k characters I still love the ones that are available.

A definite play to win game and purchases aren't cheap. After playing for so long advancement will creep to a halt unless your willing to pay to level up characters in quick fashion. It can be fun but gets a little old once you stop advancing.

To describe this game, I would say it is probably one of the most fun and stressful Warhammer games I have played. Fun, because you get to meet tons of new people and friends alike. Stressful because of how the last boss quite literally nearly 1 taps you. In all honesty. I would tell anyone who likes Warhammer to try out this game. You'll have a blast.

Gameplay is quick, tactics are seemingly well balanced, loads of characters to get, no stupid base building stragety gameplay. The character models could use a little more detail, and the monitization options are waay off base, but all in all, the gameplay is good, it's absolutely not pay to win (please keep it that way), and I'm enjoying the hell out of it.

So far it seems to be a good game. Game currency doesn't seem unreasonable. As with most games like this there are alot of currencies to deal with but so far seems simple enough to grasp. No bugs as of yet that I have run into. I love so far but am still new so that could change down the road.

The game itself is very fun! I think the wait time in getting battle tokens is kinda long and there's not enough of them. Just 3 isn't that much and have to wait 18 hours for another is pretty lame. Besides the time wait and the pay to play its a great game

Loving it! But the energy system drives me nuts.... Wish I got more energy or if I could watch more adds to get more(the game only lets you watch one add to get energy once a day). I don't and won't spend money to get energy just play the game. But overall loving it! Combat is great, leveling characters and outfiting them with gear is fun and collecting 40k dudes to fight is awesome. FOR THE EMPEROR!!

Pay to win. Using bad guys is nearly impossible if you don't buy stuff to progress. I'm currently able to muster a measly 3/5 guys against like 9 and since there's no daily chest for cards it's all pay to play. You'll hit road blocks after the first level and third of the marine chapters.

Game was fun while it lasted for me. I don't mind dropping money to support the devs. However, the progression is sooo slow, like a snail race slow that even if you put money in it, it wouldn't help. You eventually hit a wall in progression that you end up deleting the game like I did.

Find its place on the cash grab section. This game rewards you or makes you gamble for orbs and badges that are unusable and quickly outleveled. They can't be sold or traded. The only way to level past 35 is to buy XP books in the shop. Levelling also cost gold you can't earn at a reasonable rate and thus you are encouraged to pay for that too. The battle pass recently released is an absolute pile of garbage with bad rewards while forcing player to chose between BP mission and progressing squad.

5 min in they want you to pay for a rare character but the starting units are really good so they aren't needed but if you do buy one of the packs the you fly through it. Game play is like most turn base I love the skills of all my units so far.

Thank you for making events unplayable by not capping characters at a power level, and instead just making me have a certain character. I get to miss out on the entire event because there is no way to start at a level that is equal to my character's level.

Level up your heroes and equipment, fight through campaigns, arena, clans, raids ect. Pros = fun. Cons = pay to win, pay walls. Great game the problem is it doesn't flow. At some point you will find yourself unable to progress the campaign, forcing you to grind or pay which is not fun.

Two times, two times! I link my account to Google and play for two to three months. Game lages, and I lose everything! I try and get my stuff back, but it can't find my accounts. If your going to make a game that asks players to spend money. Have a better recovery system!

Absolutely solid game, runs smoothly and looks amazing. The only reason I'm giving it 3 out of 5 stars is because of the UNSKIPPABLE boring exposition tutorial that every single Mobile Game thinks has to be absolutely mandatory. Nothing puts me out of the mood more then eagerly wanting to play a game then being thrusted into a boring mundane Tutorial for 10 minutes. I'm not a neanderthal, I understand how games work, how panels work, how information works, how controls work.

This is a predatory strategy gacha game where even the battle tab is just another shop. You have to scroll past packs in every tab and popups like on a xxsite with new packs and offers. Despite spending i felt unrewarded where my 200 dollars gave be absolutely no progression amd dopamine. I wish i could get refunded for this game it is just another game predating on whales that own you in the pvp despite you being a 1000+++ dolphin. Shameful display.

Great game. Unlike many similar games you can put as much or as little time into it as you want as there isn't any real power creep. If you are playing avidly for a few months then have a couple months off, you aren't crippled by your time away. I personally play every day because it's a great game.

Great concept and a well made game. Would love to see more races and a less pay to win feel about the game. The option to have more less strong characters such as gaurdsmen instead of just hero's would be awesome.

The best mobile game I've ever played. The only issues I have are about minor tweaks to the UI and the micro transactions. Some of the prices are outrageous but it's not all bad. The tragedy is that there are no emotes or skins for the characters as of yet.

I absolutely love this game but there's one major major major issue when you're in a battle when the enemy is at the very top of the screen the bar that gives you the information like what the abilities do what character do you have a clicked etc blocks you from being able to hit those top tiles 10 out of 10 game just that one really annoying issue

!!!Do not install this game unless you're okay with them taking money out of your bank account without asking!!! This game just charged me $25 for some in-app purchase I did not want. It did this while I was at work no less I didn't see the charges until later. I really liked this game but now I'm about to uninstall it and I'm furious I want my money back...

The squigs in arena are easily the dumbest, most irritating thing I've ever seen in a video game. I uninstalled because of it. I know I could have waited a few days until it passed, but if this is going to be the standard of new content and promotions I have no desire to see what the future holds. Absolute garbage, and I hope everyone involved stubs a toe and drops their favorite glass on tile.

Throws a lot at you in the beginning, makes it hectic with a tutorial that still feels drawn out despite the amount of information it throws at you. However once you begin to get into the game you'll come to find that it is a fun game and amongst the best mobile games put out recently.

Great game so far. My only problem is the same problem with many mobile games. I am a grown person who's played video games his whole life. Don't force me through a tutorial. I am not a child or dumb I can figure out it out myself. Atleast give an option to skip it. I have stopped playing more mobile games than I can count because of this reason.

Good game. I thought you could vs friends but it's turning out not to be the case yet. I unlocked all modes but the vs are against random player ai?? I think?? Multiplayer could work so well in this game why isn't there a matchmaking option, I'll update review to 5 stars if you can indeed 1v1 friends heroes.

Quick and easy right up until lv11 ability upgrades. Hit the pay wall hard. Blackstone accrues very slowly for what you get

It's ok. Becomes a bit too microtransaction-heavy later on, as the other campaigns are seemingly only avaliable through purchases The upgrade system is a bit lacking, and MT heavy Character roster is also MT heavy But the gameplay is solid, with a good learning curve (for the Ultramarines, at least) and the story is decent. You get 3/5 just for gameplay

Love the game itself and could live with the clear classic monetized mobile loot box grind time limits but the constant crashing of the UI and app itself brings this down a lot, could easily be a 5 star game with a bit more of dedication and more campaigns.
The game is alright but the mission cooldowns are laughable. It's really doing everything it can to take your money. Don't even bother with the competitive multiplayer if you aren't spending money.

Immense potential but it's monetization is too predatory for you to play it for long periods of time. It shoves constant money deals in your face and booster packs to a point where it just becomes annoying and invasive to the overall gaming experience.

Fun game to pass the time. I've not had to spend a penny so far, but I'm not far into the game, so that could change. Simple to grasp, already unlocked a couple of characters. None I want yet, though. Hoping for some Eldar goodness soon!

A very good game which nails the 40K vibe, BUT ruined by a ridiculous difficulty spike early on in the first (free) campaign, which renders the game unplayable :( Very disappointing, I was looking forward to playing this lots, but now will not bother :(

I was excited to try but it's been pretty boring so far. After half hour I don't really see much strategy or things to do really. I was hoping for an XCOM style experience though. Or at least some interesting multiplayer battles.

fun at the start but then becomes super pay to win in the mid to late game the difficulty also rockets into the sky.Hinting you to buy the stuff you actually want with real money. Overall the game would be better if it didn't lock you into the basic white girl faction (ultra Marines)

Really good, happy to spend money on the battle pass, other stuff not at all. Would prefer that if you are on battle pass, the calls to action to buy stuff were less obnoxious, like come on I given you money, stop and let me enjoy the great game you made.

I'm loving the game. you can work hard to get the resources you need rather than having to pay to play. The strategy is very good. Only downside is I can't start with the faction that I want. You have to unlock them. And there's always something to progress towards and complete. Never a dull moment.

Game is the usual grind for shards of heroes and that part is fine. The orbs needed along with the shards at late game make it an incredible slog. I have 3-4 high end character waiting on those orbs and they are not easily gotten. You can buy the orbs at random with real money but get so few and random makes it not worth it. I am on the fence if I should really keep playing at this point. I like Warhammer but this grind might be too much.

Not sure if they've adjusted the game balance or something but I've played this game on and off for A couple years But recently This last time I picked it up It seems that Things are finally A little more Obtainable. Also some purchases in shop Seem to be More down to earth now Not Really remembering how the prices were before but I'm somebody who doesn't mind spending a couple dollars here there but Not big chunks of money Like some other games Anyways Keep up the good work thanks!

Quite a consistent experience with nice graphics and simple strategic combat, but extremely overpriced in-game store. Items in the store on this game are worth one of the latest W40K games on Steam. Play for fun, not worth in-game purchases.

Went to load up my game today and all my progress and characters have been reset to the very beginning. I'd recommend some caution before putting time or money into this. Wouldn't want anyone else to loose their progress randomly like I did..

I gave Tacticus a full week of my time, hoping it would get better. It didn’t. The early game hooks you in with fun strategy and Warhammer 40k vibes, but once you hit a certain point, progression grinds to a halt. Every battle feels stacked against you unless you buy expensive character bundles, and PvP is just a pay-to-win nightmare. I tried grinding, optimizing my team, and playing smart, none of it mattered when my opponents could just buy their way to victory. It’s heartbreaking to see :(

Pay to play. The energy system sucks. You can only play like 2 matches The shop is only real-world money It's fun for 60 seconds a day, max, and that's when i hover delete app This is why you don't use AI to get you through school and get you a job. Lie more on your resume programmers, it shows

Gameplay is great, although the grind quickly ramps up so expect significantly slow progress. Main issue is the shop, the value is terrible and no ability to skip ads. Consider this game a significant time sink before you commit

In arena you can get matched up aginst someone with 4x more score than you with a whole extra unit called a machine of war. I dont expect pvp to be ballance but i do expect some kind of plability. That moment when the same necron revives it self 3 times in a row when you should have killed it the first time. Still at the beginning, the game seems balanced and fun. It's awesome so far, with the heroes given and how fighting progresses. The guild boss level is extremely difficult, maybe the GB is based on guild level? Idk, so I will just continue to grind it out and find out. Have fun all!

Very small scenarios, I don't like the units I'm forces to use. I kept hoping the game would open up and give me some options on what I can play, but I gave up before it ever did. Maybe if the game would let me know what I'm working towards and how long it will take, I would keep playing.
it's a fun game a love Warhammer and I play this everyday it's a 9/10

it's a cool game but it's limited if you don't want to spend money and the way you upgrade your character is cool but you go to upgrade and it glitches and you have to start over what you were upgrading please fix this it is frustrating to the point I want to delete this game fix the holding people back from progressing because you want money and fix the glitches and you'll have a solid game

this game is trash in every way, except graphics... they could have done a cool faction based PVP, but no, it's the same thing as the others. you can get characters from every faction, working together... so far ALL my guaranteed rare Heroes have been stupid chaos trash... the game also keeps showing me a picture pop up of a hero with a $5 stamp on them, but apparently that $5 stamp has nothing to do with the hero that is in a DIFFERENT advertisement underneath them...

Recent changes made an already grindy game almost unplayable. Three weeks of 120 energy per day into elite missions to get at best 2 drops, usually 0 or 1. Overly cluttered menus and tons of paywalls. Animation is good, but so far all i can play are Ultramarines, and it looks like that'll be my only army unless I fork over lots of cash or play for hours and hours.

Fun overall good story lines and arcs over all smooth can be alot to take in a first but they streamline it swell after tutorial so it's all good... Just a bit on graphics and skipping through pages of stuff each time but I'm not complaining hey...rewards are great !!!

So far I have no firstborn marines. I love the first born Marines they Are what got me into 40k. I also wish I didn't have to play the entire imdominus crusade before unlocking other factions. The Ads for this game are misleading, you either have to grind for a new character which is never a guarantee on who you get or you have to pay for them. Decent enough though if you don't care about that and only play on your toilet break.

Game heavily throws bargains at your face. Ranging from $7.99 to $79 it's bad in that regard. But you this game can definitely be played without a spending anything. Adds are actually bearable for once. 4 out of 5 because the game is good enough

Eh It's not bad. Your typical throw 25 currencies at them with flashing colors until they spend money. The tactics are pretty limited at best. More just does your combat score beat out the others. Games done in so few turns hard to say there's tactics.

Interesting game and art/sound is well done. Lots to engage with and do, and the game has been paced well so far. Would get 5 stars, but they offer a purchase pack every 5 seconds which gets a little annoying. Otherwise still not horrible monitization.

Turns out to be quite fun overall, didn't expect it. Great game for filthy casuals or hard-core gamers! Plenty of options for quick battles when you're waiting in line or in-depth campaigns when you're on public transportation or at home. Constant updates, events, and contests means there is always more content.

Suffers from having too many different kinds of resources, but it's still new enough that getting up to speed isn't overwhelming, and it works fine ftp. I find the game really fun since I like strategy games. The best part is how the game actually rewards you for playing. Either way from that the games amazing I really enjoyed it funny to think I downloaded it as a time waster.

Standard character progression with 6 item slots to rank up and character shards to star up. 2 days in and really enjoying it - more than other turn based games owing to the speed of the battles.

I rarely like mobile games and good 40k games especially are as rare as failing perils as a Farseer. This game is surprisingly good. I don't like the flashy animations but I'm OLD. Thankfully the game doesn't throw ads or pay to win deals in your face, too much.

Just started this game but it reminds me of all my favourite turn-based tactical games from back in the day, with great graphics and attached to a gaming mythology that is full of great storylines and characters. I know it's just a mobile game but this is warhammer 40K! The atmosphere with the music and written text is engaging and so enjoyable. PS (I'm not spending any money on microtransactions yea)

Game gets extremely repetitive after you reach a certain point. You either pay up ,or grind forever in extremely boring events or battles. Only play this game if you have money to throw out, or have absolutely nothing to do with your life. ( Maybe both)

Hard pay walls with grind being literally pointless, it takes the lessons of all the other games like it and goes "ok, so how can we make it worse." Was 4 star review but I've been playing since release and only have 8 characters. The grind is disgusting. The monetization scheme is criminal. It's alot like Raid Warhammer Legends at this point. Very disappointing. Using the Warhammer name to make a half baked game to sell premium currency.

Frustrating. I loved this game and then my phone broke. Tried redownloading it and all my purchases were gone. All my progress disappeared. Tried getting past the first fifteen levels as some recommend but nothing has changed

Honestly it is fast, really fast like im almost at the second boss of the story mode in under a hour fast. I love it, love the character picks, and Im hoping for future updates to stay good. Beyond that, I hope the mtx do not take over.

It's a fun little game that lets me jump into Warhammer when I'm taking a small break or sitting on a plane. Not too complicated, but still enough strategy that you have to put some thought into it. Good fun

I want to say there's a good game hiding somewhere in this, but it's so aggressively overmonitized I have found Tacticus to be unplayable. The character grind is completely centered around paying to unlock new characters instead of through gameplay.

Decent. Tokens and energy need to regenerate a LOT faster though. Or have some other, non-monetary aquisition method. I'd love to play the game for longer per day but I feel very restricted and almost shoehorned into buying blackstone, which is not a good feeling.

More pay 2 win slop. Even has a paywall in the campaign. Everything is so restrictive too. Excellent time killer with a nice retro turn based approach to gaming. Drop rates do become troublesome later on like any gacha, but microstransactions aren't shoved in your face like many other games. I'm on a w40k binge and this suffices.

Fun, I find my self re opening it for a few rounds every couple hours. And yet the ui experience is a little over bearing. The menus are icon heavy and there are so many notifications and different recources for no apparent reason other than the cash in for slight improvements to hero stats in-between rounds.. no real satisfying grind or loot besides the rare new hero/champion.

A fun game when you pick it up, ruined by greedy pricing structures and limiting gameplay mechanics to encourage spending. Too much repetetive grinding and daily timesinks required to make any progress after the initial honeymoon period.

Been really fun. A very polished experience. However there's a severe difficulty jump were the game required a lot more grinding. Also the Necrons don't really have any interesting well know characters.

I didn't think much of the game before release but I still pre-registered because I quite a big warhammer fan and once the game dropped I've been having a blast. Its a fun and strategic with fairly quick matches which let's you play whenever.

Great game. I would add a quick/auto fight for 3 starred campaigns. I haven't been hit with ads to buy packs as much as people are saying. There is a shop to do that but it hasn't been in my face yet.

the game doesn't stop holding your hand for a very long time and not only that if you want to play your favorite factions you have to pay real money to actually get those units and that is horrendous and predatory.

First, I'm a huge fan of 40K. To describe Tacticus in a nutshell, it feels like a vastly simplified but streamlined version of Dawn of War 2. I love it. The execution is excellent. Combat is deep enough to be interesting, and tactics really matter. The visuals are also excellent. I give this 5 stars, but that's my rendition of 9/10.

Looks cool, but this game have some serious cache optimisation issues on my lower end phone. I have to restart it every 10 minutes to empty the cache, and there are no options to lower the graphical quality and improve the gaming experience.

I stopped playing this game for a while and came back to it. I really hoped things would be better off but it's not. Progress is painfully slow without spending money, and the in came currency is ridiculously expensive

Would've done 5 out of 5, but I run Tau in the table top game and I can't play them without some kind of unlock which will probably cost money. I do see them as a playable option eventually in the game which is exciting and more than other Warhammer 40K games have offered in the past. 4 out of 5, "For the Greater Good"

Rounds are too quickly paced. Not a bad game, and not pay to win so far. Lots of room for improvement. Maps need to be larger, and PvP matches should last longer than 2 rounds. There would be more strategy involved if games were able to be played out longer with and more interesting maps. Not too bad though.

Game crashes past tutorial. I have re-loaded several times, re-downloaded the game and played through the tutorial twice for it to always crash and never get past "Good work so far". My device is up to date and not old.

Terrible support group. Spend every day trying to collect the latest character and the game won't let you get it because the game says you aren't connected. Then they won't even compensate you properly. Worse support I've ever had from a game company.

A fun time killer without annoying ads or force fed micro transactions. Resources are simple and straight to the point and the gameplay is just the right balance of tactical and simple so you get fun out of it without it needing too much attention.

I thought this game would be a play to win casino style money pit but I was wrong. Game is fun and easy to kill a few hours with the amount of game modes you can play. I do enjoy the 40k universe and this can scratch that itch.

Surprisingly good tactical depth. A lot of characters, modes, and tactical choices. Really happy with it so far. MTX are a little intrusive but I don't get the feeling they aren't anything more than time savers, as the grind for characters isn't that intense or time consuming. Having a lot of fun.

Like the art but it is immensely pay 2 win, starting recently feels bad as there are like 5 campaigns and each race requires different level up resources so most of my first hours has been giving me resources for characters I don't have.

Being a 40k fan I love it makes me feel like I'm able to play small skirmishes on the table top even when I don't really have the time to get a game in on the weekends. I totally recommend it for any one who is a fan or wants to kinda get a feel of the lore to check it out!

Was having issues saying I didn't have an internet connection, so I uninstalled and reinstalled. Now my game is in some kind of soft lock. I think I spent less than $100 on in game purchases. But still, kind of a bummer.

Fun simple game play perfect for passing the time. Microtransactions are about par for 99% of mobile games out there. Would recommend if you can have self control and not spend more than the $4.99 to grab Yarrick in the beginning. Grab Yarrick, period.

The energy for this game and tokens required to play is kinda rediculous because it takes 6 energy to play 1 mission each 1 energy take 5 mins to get so 30mins for 1 mission and a cap of 100 meaning 8 and a half hours to get full energy plus tokens and other things required to play other events this needs to be changed because they want you to pay to play or wait a stupid amount of time

Cash grab game disguised as a F2P grind. I only wanted to play as the Tau but the game forces you to follow the rail road tracks and Tau faction isn't even available until the end. I'm still fairly early in the game, but the game plays nicely and looks awesome. 4/5 though because the game does freeze and lag a little but it's generally not too annoying or frequent.

I mostly like the game but do not understand why there is a limit on each level you can play per day AND energy. Getting the hero tokens is hard enough with the 7 per day max but more like 2 or 3 is likely to happen and then you can only do 2 heros until your energy Is gone. It will take ages without paying... we only need one handicap, please get rid of the cash grab.

Fun game but I feel that the progression is a bit slow and it feels like it's geared toward people who are willing to spend money. Although I have spent a few dollars I feel that in order to be competitive I would need to spend a whole lot more than the $30 that I've spent.

Great game, lots of characters but highly P2W and P2P. You need to spend months to be able to open some content and characters. You cant even dream competing PvP unless you pay. Built around Warhammer 40k universe and thats why I gave 3 stars. The game is alive there are lots events but will be less rewarding because of leaderbord mechanisms favors payers.

Yeah it's grand so far, not too much power creep. I spent a little bit on a character and it helped a lot maybe too much. These early campaign missions aren't as challenging/fun as they probably should be.
Great graphics, powers, units, unit diversity, maps, mechanics, and so much more. For people starting out with the tabletop game, it is a great introduction to the style.

how can you play this game? you get past the tutorial, and the game shuts you out from doing anything due to a "connection error" wifi and mobile data are fine, im able to play other games and use other apps without issues. this game is a pile of junk if you can't play past the tutorial.

Great great game. Really beautiful and unique design of character that makes you want to collect them all. It's not just jumble of bigger numbers but more of the design and nuance of the character that makes you want it. Love it

Developer still hasnt fixed energy issue. Could be a great game, but you cant play it for more than 5 minutes. If you think you can level up toons....forgetaboutit. Bad drop rates and lack of energy keep you down

I want to like it more but it doesn't take long to bwing forced to pay money if you want any noticeable progression. Don't get me wrong you can never pay but the game difficulty scales faster than your player power.

This has to be the best mobile Warhammer game out there. I can't wait to see what factions get added in the future. Maybe we can get some Blood Angels, Eldar, Grey Knights, Inquisitors, Space Wolves, Tau and more. This is one for the ages and I highly encourage you to give it a shot.
Saw it advertised and reviewed. Good time killer. Fast turn based strategy game. Enjoy changing out squad members. Haven't hit the match limit yet. Cool animations and sound effects. Would recommend.
The core gameplay loop of the game is pretty good! But the rampant, aggressive monetization, coupled with constant ads and a lot of blatant FOMO, is very off-putting. Can't recommend.

Its fun, but the game constantly insists I am not connected to the internet when I very clearly am. Also energy systems in games are terrible, and a lazy way to control progression that ruins player experience.

Typical money machine. Need to either grind endlessly to unlock characters ect or pay up. Game play is fun but you hit a wall after some time unless you buy the req drops to unlock certain characters that are only available from those.

Yet another boring a$$ hyper-monetized pay to win/play game on play store. Why does anything cost money in games like these lol, literally just spreadsheets and nothing has any value yet your manipulated into dropping insane amounts of money. Here's a tip, just go buy a console and an actual game lol.

I've not played much in the way of phone games for years but they've come a long way. This one is really fun if you like tactics type games. It's got standard micro transactions to fund it but it's not bad about it. Definitely worth a shot

Its fun for a few hours then the grind gets hopeless fast. The micro transactions are greedy with no real value. Its sad cause it has solid gameplay but the constant barrage of "deals" is everywere on the menus.

Great game, great team behind it too! I lost my local save when my old phone died, I didn't realise it hadn't linked. I messaged them not realising the issues and they responded super quick and were really nice. Thank you to the Team, and the person who helped me, you made my week
Pay to win. It's so much more evident with the latest so-called match play, where really it's a question of who bought all the unlocked characters that can do things others cannot. Not fun.

Funny how it has soo many bad reviews but still has a good rating . . . Bad game, not only is it a pay to win but pay to play, tried to re download it to see if anything has changed, but got locked in the tutorial again, with no opiton to recover my save. Huge money grab.

Revision. To their credit the support team responded to try to help me recover my account so for a helpful support they get 2 stars. Luckily this has given me time to realize that this game and its aggressive microtransactions are not for me. Original review: So I had all my data and progress completely wiped the same day as I spent $100 on the monetization in this game. I don't think I need to explain why I give it 1 star.

Right now 2 days in. Its an absolut unit of a game. I like it, its a good break game where you can collect and upgrqde your favorite warhammer minis. I hope more races and minis will be added when the game rises and becomes a monster of a mobile game Anders

Just another garbage mobile game filled with micro transactions, timegates, paygates, etc. As for gameplay it's about one step away from being an idle game. There's little to no tactics involved, much like tenth edition.

Really fun game, needs to lower prices though. Didn't think I would like this game since 40k games are know for being sub par and cash grabs. This one is good but needs a pricing decrease, if it had that it would be a perfect free mobile game. This is coming from someone who despises mobile gaming.

It's decent enough with kinda fun pvp. And the gameplay does have a fun loop. But it's plagued with all the other issues 40k mobile games have, a bunch of different currencies, constant menu swapping, and dumb pay to win.

Game is pretty simple, but satisfying. Don't expect a major chess/starcraft like experience; it's more like if Final Fantasy tactics was hust the battles, and your classes are static. The puzzlepiece like upgrade mechanic is neat, and the explosion of ingame nonmoney currency makes little victories feel big. Definitely seratonin fuel.

I'm not much of tactical commander, but this game might win me over with how much fun I am having which is surprisingly good. They do it right by keeping it simple and easy that's why it works, tactics/strategies are like a machine the more complicated it is the more likely it is to fail and that's what makes it great because of its simplicity.

Incredible developers that constantly improve the game and keep the community up to date about changesthemselves, interesting characters to work towards with a steady increase in how many there are, guilds provide an excellent possibility of strengthening your roster, meeting great people and unlocks different game modes.
It's a very good game. Essentially like a tabletop RPG. The graphics look good and the variety of factions and units keeps it fresh.
Definitely one of the better 40k mobile games out there. It does not feel like a cash grab and you can play at your own pace. Hoping for more game modes and plenty more characters :)

Decent hero collector style game. I like the tactical battle system but it needs an auto battle option for when you know the outcome but you have to play the mission. I've lost interest in the game grinding without an auto battle option.

I wouldn't mind the grind if I could at least choose the faction I started with. But you HAVE to start with Space Marines, the most boring and cliche of them all, IMO. Not interested in playing,and replaying, the SM missions to slowly unlock new factions.

This is the only phone game I play. I love the massive amount of content. you don't HAVE to buy anything but it's alot quicker to get characters and campaigns unlocked. that being said I'm grinding and loving it

Not finished the intro missions but it is more like the tabletop RPG than a computer game thus far. Quite repetitive, more cash buys than you can aim a Bolter at. Help options are not so helpful, definitely needs work

Great game. Have been playing over a year now and still love it. Developers doing a great job to Jeep it entertaining. Update: has been playing it for the last 1.5 years and noticed that for about 9 months, the quality of details of the new characters has deteriorated noticeably.

Deleting. Have been getting max of two badges or whatever for all the characters in spending all my energy on for weeks. Whatever rng they had has become completely unusable. Just another game that tries to force you to spend money. Do yourself a favor and just buy a game that you enjoy.

The game is great when you get to play The amount of random clicking to unlock, boost, upgrade from one of the insane currencies, energy, gems, power is just stupid. Fun game wrapped in the worst mobile game cancers.

Turn based tactics combat in the 40k universe. Slowly build your roster of units from different factions by playing through the campaigns, arena, raids, guild war etc to unlock more units as you progress. You start with 3 or 4 of the 90+ characters. 98% of them can be unlocked through smart gameplay. Spending in game currency and energy wisely will greatly influence progression speed. Spending is optional, the grind is real, don't expect to reach the end game in 3 months. Great Game.

Played for 5 minutes and uninstalled. So Boring. The game has no depth or strategy, and keeps telling you what to do. It is very poorly designed in all aspects except visual. Just another low quality game leeching off the 40k IP.

A comfy, quick-to-play game in the vein of Autochess. The UI is a bit overwhelming once you unlock all the menu types in the main screen, but the game itself doesn't feel as overtly predatory as other mobile games.

The overall game is pretty much flawless the only thing i wished was different is the wait times on the salvage and onslaught battles. I get having wait times between token cooldowns but i dont want to wait 15 hrs just for one battle please lower the cool down even if by an hour

The game is good, but I have some suggestions. Can you add more heroes like garviel loken and sigismund or offer a free epic heroes for starters? It is quiet difficult to reach higher levels using lower tier heroes.

As someone who loves a good table-top game, it is such a joy to see Warhammer lore and mechanics in a mobile game. Appreciate the attention to detail and ease of access, while there's still the standard gacha/grind it doesn't kill the game's fun.

The hero scale is too small for any real tactical depth and too few characters per faction + starting as Marines with no options for anything else and having to spend forever to unlock an entire team of Orks.... Not worth your time let alone money.

The game's control is a bit wierd. It needs a clear button to cancel moves. I mis-released several times and my units moved to unintended tiles which costed me some wins. Other than that it's fun and tactical, it worths a try.

It has enough nuance to keep it interesting, but unfortunately it's not great at storytelling. It feels like every campaign is just an excuse to throw a bunch of battles around. If you're here just for the tactical gameplay, you'll have a decent time.
It's a good strategy game and (for the most part) accurate to the lore of 40K. The only problem I have is the grindy/pay-to-win aspect for getting characters but it isn't too bad.

It's a nice game, but it needs some polishing regarding: 1. Account linking. You can't play currently between Google account and Apple. 2. Game adds are very long and forces you to watch. Just to much.... 3. Leveling and progressing is very time consuming.

Another P2W game. It's very slow and very grindy, which is fine to a point, but it's way too much in this game. It gets 1 star because of the Warhammer 40k paint job on a predatory/cash grab game. Otherwise, it would be 0 out of 5.

It's starts out well, and then you get to the point that you cannot do anything questwise or guildwise. I know games like like this are pay to win, but seriously, you can't get far enough to make me want to spend money. To Generic, makes earning heroes more of a task than choose your faction and have fun. Being a Krieg player and not being represented isn't surprising but not being able to choose my faction from the start is annoying. Feels to much like pay to play so I just uninstalled the game
really like game it's fun but I would have had more fun if the salamanders were added

This game is just for the Warhammer fanatics. The gameplay battles are short and fun but they don't want you to play without actually having to pay. Other than that there's no actual game to play here just time mining.
fun enough, but there is a paywall hit very quickly.

For a Warhammer 40k fan I have to say its definitely one of my favorite mobile games to play. The character designs are a bit goofy but just right to make them look good. The game play is punchy in a good way, not large scale strategy mind you but it fits me perfectly. It also works offline so that's a plus. Also no Ads so far. I am giving it an honest 4 star review. Try it at least if you like 40K!

Awesome blend of sci Fi and fantasy..great strategy game.. awsome hero's.and I love the fact if you grind a little bit you can upgrade hero's and skills I hope to see this game grow.if you love strategy RPG then I highly recommend this awsome game..keep up the great work devs..I'm loving what I'm playing...
I'm new to the Warhammer 40K universe and Im really enjoying the lore of it all. makes me want to learn everything

Absolute trash. Phone throwing trash. Update: good news. Had 3 matches in a row where my opponent couldn't do any damage to *me* after 8 matches in a row where I couldn't do anything to my opponent! All in a supposedly "level matched" tournament. No clue why for any of it. Trash.

Five out of five stars. The art style is amazing, the movement is simple, is sometimes hard, and is overall a great game. Yes, I might've just started playing the actual board game but I still find it fun.

The gameplay of this game is fun, but the honeymoon is over fast when you realise you are just cannon fodder for the P2W players who started when the game was launched. All updates and developments since December 2022 have been catered for P2W players. You need to pay $50 a month, more to catchup if new, and spend >3h a day playing for more than 6 months, or over a year if F2P, before you are likely to get a legendary character. It's all just a predatory cash grab!

is good about keeping promotions and rotating chances to expand your collection, where it is a time as a currency game. good if you like to collect a team up and offers decent tactical strategy where skill can overcome more difficult opponents. however, removed a star from there being near zero power cap on arena. doing well with a team of 20k power will commonly offer matchups of teams in the 300k-1.5M power range, which is absurd. would like balancing.

Fun game but too many micro transactions and the PvP arena is a pay to win mess. You will be put against enemies you have no possible way to beat and the only way to get new opponents is to spend the precious premium currency they give out sparingly in small quantities. Good for 40K fans, not worth it for anyone else.

Fun game, been playing since day 1, been on and off but still have enough to be a powerful player. Have at least 1 character for about half of the factions and still playing it. Feels a bit grindy at times but what other mobile games aren't. Definitely recommend

It's really fun so far. I dont have the money to justify picking up figures and playing Warhammer IRL. So im really happy this game exists to bridge the gap. I do wish they had more factions and characters but it's also fairly new. So I trust they plan on adding things with future updates.

First time playing the game. I am absolutely hooked. Not too much of a Gotcha hook to it. Lots of unpaid rewards to keep you interested and the strategy element is top not, and I have barely scratched the surface.. anyway, I'm going back to playing 😆

The game is fun enough but you never have enough energy to play the game and the arena is broken, it consistently shows you people with absurdly high power scores. Clearly for monetization but it just pisses you off and discourages you from completing challenges.

I thought it was going to be boring when I first downloaded it so I un-installed it. It's awesome . It challenges you just enough while your learning and as your learning and skills go up so do the challenges. playing people online is the cherry on top. Do not miss out on this game.

The best 40k mobile game currently because its actually a game that requires some sort of skill. Only criticism is you do run out of things to do daily but that's only a problem because I want to play more.

The prologue is great offline but after that it requires internet for every little thing which is so pointless it's still the exact same game , there's no reason at all for it to require an internet connection midway through the game

Pretty meh. If you expect a proper Warhammer expirience, you won't find it here. You get SM units from the start. Would love to 5 star this review. Gameplay wise is a 10/10 for me. But I raised a support issue that's stopping me from playing on my new phone about 2 weeks ago and still have received 0 communication that it's even being looked at. Until it's fixed I can't give anymore than 1.

So far really good. The rating doesn't happen for awhile so you can actually play the game before getting the pop up. The controls are nice. The item system doesn't seem too complicated.

Only level 8 but the experience has been good so far, I have not seen any point where it was totally needed to buy anything off the store page which is nice and though I wish the requisitions gave you characters more often.

AMAZING GAME!!!! Look this game seems interesting in theory but right now the tutorial mission is bugged and you can not progress after fighting it for a bit I gave up and Uninstalled. Art is cool game play is simple but the bugs sour the mood.

so far it has been alot of fun and challenging my mind

Stunning art direction. Great models, environments, UI, and stylistic choices. Does have lootboxes, but very easy to get without paying. Doesn't feel like a gacha game. It's actually pretty fun, fast paced, and feels rewarding. Looking forward to playing more!

Update to raid tokens makes it so you get alot less from normal play and are pushed towards Blackstone purchases in order to keep progressing without spending hours re-grinding the same missions for the same amount of progression you would get in a few minutes.

I like the game only been playing for 2 days so far only wish it was a little easier to get characters or the stuff you need to get charicters and wish the maps were bigger that way it feels more like a Warfield but those are just nitpicks otherwise a good game and easy to learn

EDIT: Enjoying it so far, very diverse team builds. For everyone saying the game is P2W, it is not. I understand that PvP can seem impossible but you are wrong. Pretty good 40k game all things considered and probably my favorite mobile game. there's a lot of pop-ups to buy stuff and monetization but no ads and the progression is still satisfying without spending money
Good game overall. No ads as far as I'm aware of. I'm on level 25 or something and there is alot to do in this game. Many different characters and levels makes this game pretty solid. *and me too*

Same as every other mobile game like this. Nothing sets it apart except the price tag on everything. Just a grind game that u will end up spending a week to upgrade I item. The idea that this is anything to do with 40k is a joke

Good tutorial, great features, difficulty spikes after first campaign nicely and from my experience the rng is not so bad that you're forced to pay real money instead of just enjoying the game and progressing naturally. So far very good early game and mid game

Good looking game with some nice elements, bit cartoony for 40k but with each to their own. However 15hr wait for 1 battle tokens that will give you 5mins of game play! It's really a pay to play, and most certainly pay to win. UNINSTALL

Actually a exellent game what truly ruins this game is the beyond excessive Micro transactions and the every possible use of FOMO marketing possible and the wait times to play I actually love the game exactly what I was looking for ruined by enormous greed not sure ill be able to take it for much longer the energy required to play only seems to charge at 5min per 1 need 5 or 6 to play and maxes out at 15 out of 100 that I have why oh yeah to make you spend money everything is limited time if you
The game is fun and a great story, but I've seen better graphics though.

it's just okay. rewards are fair-ish it's very grindy. eventually you'll reach a point where it becomes repetitive. As most mobile games are whos main goal is a perpetual economy for the developers. Nothing wrong with that. In a way, In tune with 40k universal law that it is, Hellish

Enjoyable game. I like the different characters and being able to move them on the board. This gives the game a more strategic feel. It's early but I haven't encountered an overwhelming number of ads.
Enjoying it. But waaaaay to many pushes to buy something. The above was given when I wasn't that in to the game... Subsequently I have lost many hours. Very fun, and enjoy the variety of the game.

Game is fun but since the last update it's been glitching. For example the loot chest for belators quest, it will just keep showing up and when I click it just brings the chest back and will repeat it over and over.

It's a good game, easy to understand and play as well as the little lore tidbits to each character give a good small look into the characters without giving too much away encouraging you to find out more for yourself.

Was excited when preregistered as I used to paint warhammer, the game looks good and I like the mechanics but lack of summons avaliable early on ie managed 1, is a bit of a red flag that this game will be 100% P2W which is unfortunate, I don't mind spending money but this seems extremely a spending game

Awesome game. If you enjoy Warhammer 40k to any degree from casually hearing about it and seeing a few YouTube videos, or are a die hard fan whom plays 50k point tabletop matches for weeks on end before a champion is declared, you'll enjoy this game. 5 stars. Try it out. Even the sound effects get me pumped up to go into battle facing the Necrons. Graphics are stellar too. Seriously, if The Grim Dark is something you seek, you'll find it here.

Really fun 40k experience, but runs into a massive grind for shards and equipment quickly. Definitely feels pay-to-win after several days, but other than that, it's fun and addictive gameplay and great graphics make for an amazing 40k game.

if you want to maximize achievements, the game can be challenging. otherwise it's about as mentally engaging as Candy Crush for neckbeards. it's got all the boring junk of typical mobile games: loot boxes, grindy gameplay, etc.

Great production value. Fun progression, lots of game modes. Progression will likely slow down as they try to incentivize you to buy the in game currency but it's a lot of fun in the beginning for a free game

Gameplay is super easy and you can actually strategize and replay levels. High quality production value and f2p fair. You only need to spend if you want to collect characters now. All characters and campaigns are achievable through playing.

Another pay to win game, PvP is way unbalanced you face players that have bought every thing possible. Leveling up characters to complete campaign is not possible unless you face other people in arenas. Games just how I thought it would end up and I pre-registered for this game.

Simple, easy, and fast-paced. It has a lot of rewards and missions to play. It's the best Warhammer game I've played until now on mobile, and I can't recommend it enough. Personally, I haven't hit a pay wall yet. For the Emperor !!!

Generally stable, challenging when playing at right level, good interpretation of the IP. Devs have been responsive and interact with the players. Some IAP is overpriced, some is at upper end of "ok" - none of them are "required". Still early days so content is still expanding. Good learning curve. Slow progression with some bottlenecks once you hit a certain level. Limitations on p2w features, which is great to see. Does need some UI / UX work. Has become my go-to game.
